## Copilot

```iecst
FUNCTION_BLOCK PunchChanger
VAR_INPUT
	Trigger : BOOL ;
	Unload: BOOL;
END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT RETAIN
  ValidityFlag   : BOOL;                         (* TRUE if all requested tools exist in ATC *)
  PerIndexStatus : ARRAY[1..15] OF PIndexStatus; (* SAME or DIFF for each index *)
  PackageState   : PPackageState;                (* overall package classification *)
  NextActionHint : PNextActionHint;              (* suggested primary action *)

  numSame  : INT;
  numDiff  : INT;
  newCount : INT;
  oldCount : INT;

  ErrorText : STRING(200);

  Error : BOOL;
  Busy  : BOOL;
  Done  : BOOL;
END_VAR

VAR RETAIN

  i : INT;
  j : INT;
  k : INT;
  assigned:BOOL;
  foundIndex : INT;

  usedSlot :ARRAY [1..16, 1..15] OF BOOL;
  OldAssignedDrawer:ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  OldAssignedSlot:ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;

  NewAssignedDrawer:ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  NewAssignedSlot   : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  origNewIdx:INT;
  NewName : STRING(100);
  OldName : STRING(100);
  NewLen : STRING(100);
  NewLenReal : REAL;
  NewHorn : STRING(100);
  NewHornReal : REAL;
  OldLen : STRING(100);
  OldLenReal : REAL;
  OldHorn : STRING(100);
  NewRot : STRING(100);
  OldRot : STRING(100);

  eps : REAL := 0.001;

  foundLengthMatch : BOOL;
  hasLengthValue : BOOL;

  KeepList : ARRAY[1..15] OF BOOL;
  ReplaceList : ARRAY[1..15] OF BOOL;
  LoadOnlyList : ARRAY[1..15] OF BOOL;
  UnloadOnlyList : ARRAY[1..15] OF BOOL;
  OldMatched : ARRAY[1..15] OF BOOL;
  NewMatchedToOld : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;

  (* Temporary arrays for ordered packing *)
  UnloadTempCount : INT;
  UnloadTempOrigIndex : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;   (* original OLD index *)
  UnloadTempDrawerIdx : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  UnloadTempOrder : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;

  LoadTempCount : INT;
  LoadTempOrigIndex : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;     (* original NEW index *)
  LoadTempDrawerIdx : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  LoadTempOrder : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;

  KeepTempCount : INT;
  KeepTempOrigIndex : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;     (* original OLD index *)
  KeepTempDrawerIdx : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  KeepTempOrder : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;

  a : INT;
  b : INT;
  minIdx : INT;
  tmpInt : INT;

  (* Consume-old matching helpers *)
  OldAvailCount : INT;
  OldAvailIndex : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT; (* indices of available old entries *)

  (* ATC mapping iterators/temps as requested: c - row, d - slot, e - drawer *)
  c : INT; (* row iterator for UnloadPunchList / ATCUnloadPunchList *)
  d : INT; (* slot iterator *)
  e : INT; (* drawer iterator *)
  m : INT;
  UnloadCount: INT;
  LoadCount:INT;
  KeepCount :INT;
  lenStr : STRING(100);
  posStr : STRING(100);
  hornStr : STRING(100);
  lenRealLocal : REAL;
  hornRealLocal : REAL;

  (* multiplicity check temps *)
  neededCount : INT;
  availCount : INT;
  skipTriple : BOOL := FALSE;
  uniqCount : INT;
  uniqName : ARRAY[1..15] OF STRING(100);
  uniqLen  : ARRAY[1..15] OF STRING(100);
  uniqHorn : ARRAY[1..15] OF STRING(100);
  uniqNeeded : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;

  (* NEW: load slot selection helper *)
  IsBottomDrawer : BOOL;
  foundSlotCount : INT;
  candidateSlot   : INT;
  bestSlot        : INT;
END_VAR

VAR
	eTmp : INT;
	dTmp : INT;
END_VAR


(* Main execution: run on rising edge of Trigger or Unload *)
IF Unload THEN
  (* initialize *)
  Busy := TRUE;
  Done := FALSE;
  Error := FALSE;
  ErrorText := '';
  ValidityFlag := TRUE;

  numSame := 0;
  numDiff := 0;
  newCount := 0;
  oldCount := 0;

  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    KeepList[i] := FALSE;
    ReplaceList[i] := FALSE;
    LoadOnlyList[i] := FALSE;
    UnloadOnlyList[i] := FALSE;
    PerIndexStatus[i] := PIndexStatus.SAME;
    OldMatched[i] := FALSE;
    NewMatchedToOld[i] := 0;
  END_FOR;

  (* Clear all target global retain arrays before packing *)
  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
      Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,j] := '';
      Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[i,j] := '';
      Retain_LoadPunchList[i,j] := '';
      Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[i,j] := '';
      Retain_KeepPunchList[i,j] := '';
      Retain_KeepPunchListNew[i,j] := '';
    END_FOR;
  END_FOR;

  (* Build unload candidates only from current physical state PFields_Old *)
  UnloadTempCount := 0;
  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    IF PFields_Old[i,3] <> '' THEN
      oldCount := oldCount + 1;
      UnloadOnlyList[i] := TRUE;

      foundIndex := 0;
      FOR k := 1 TO 16 DO
        IF pDrawerName[k] = PFields_Old[i,3] THEN
          foundIndex := k;
          EXIT;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;

      IF foundIndex <> 0 THEN
        UnloadTempCount := UnloadTempCount + 1;
        UnloadTempOrigIndex[UnloadTempCount] := i;
        UnloadTempDrawerIdx[UnloadTempCount] := foundIndex;
        UnloadTempOrder[UnloadTempCount] := UnloadTempCount;
      END_IF;

      PerIndexStatus[i] := PIndexStatus.DIFF;
    ELSE
      PerIndexStatus[i] := PIndexStatus.SAME;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  numSame := 0;
  numDiff := oldCount;
  newCount := 0;

  FOR a := 1 TO UnloadTempCount - 1 DO
    minIdx := a;
    FOR b := a + 1 TO UnloadTempCount DO
      IF UnloadTempDrawerIdx[b] < UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] THEN
        minIdx := b;
      ELSIF (UnloadTempDrawerIdx[b] = UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx]) AND (UnloadTempOrder[b] < UnloadTempOrder[minIdx]) THEN
        minIdx := b;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    IF minIdx <> a THEN
      tmpInt := UnloadTempOrigIndex[a];
      UnloadTempOrigIndex[a] := UnloadTempOrigIndex[minIdx];
      UnloadTempOrigIndex[minIdx] := tmpInt;

      tmpInt := UnloadTempDrawerIdx[a];
      UnloadTempDrawerIdx[a] := UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx];
      UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] := tmpInt;

      tmpInt := UnloadTempOrder[a];
      UnloadTempOrder[a] := UnloadTempOrder[minIdx];
      UnloadTempOrder[minIdx] := tmpInt;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  UnloadCount := 0;
  FOR a := 1 TO UnloadTempCount DO
    UnloadCount := UnloadCount + 1;
    i := UnloadTempOrigIndex[a];
    FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
      Retain_UnloadPunchList[UnloadCount, j] := PFields_Old[i, j];
    END_FOR;
    Retain_UnloadPunchList[UnloadCount, 12] := INT_TO_STRING(i);
  END_FOR;

  FOR c := 1 TO 15 DO
    FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
      Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c, j] := '';
    END_FOR;
  END_FOR;

  FOR c := 1 TO UnloadCount DO
    tmpInt := UnloadTempOrigIndex[c];

    IF (tmpInt >= 1) AND (tmpInt <= 15) AND (PFields_Old[tmpInt,10] <> '') AND (PFields_Old[tmpInt,11] <> '') THEN
      e := STRING_TO_INT(PFields_Old[tmpInt,10]);
      d := STRING_TO_INT(PFields_Old[tmpInt,11]);

      IF (e >= 1) AND (e <= 16) AND (d >= 1) AND (d <= 15) THEN
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,1] := pDrawerName[e];
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,2] := PFields_Old[tmpInt,10];
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,3] := PFields_Old[tmpInt,11];
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,4] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchLength[e,d]);
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,5] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchPosition[e,d]);
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,6] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchHorn[e,d]);
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,12] := INT_TO_STRING(tmpInt);
      END_IF;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  PackageState := PPackageState.PARTIAL_CHANGE;
  NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.NO_ACTION;
  ValidityFlag := TRUE;

  Busy := FALSE;
  Done := TRUE;

ELSIF Trigger THEN
  (* initialize *)
  Busy := TRUE;
  Done := FALSE;
  Error := FALSE;
  ErrorText := '';
  ValidityFlag := TRUE;

  numSame := 0;
  numDiff := 0;
  newCount := 0;
  oldCount := 0;

  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    KeepList[i] := FALSE;
    ReplaceList[i] := FALSE;
    LoadOnlyList[i] := FALSE;
    UnloadOnlyList[i] := FALSE;
    PerIndexStatus[i] := PIndexStatus.SAME;
    OldMatched[i] := FALSE;
    NewMatchedToOld[i] := 0;
  END_FOR;

  (* STEP 1: basic ATC existence + requested length presence check for all requested new entries
     NOTE: PunchUsed is NOT checked here. Keep matching happens later. *)
  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    NewName := PFields[i,3];

    IF NewName <> '' THEN
      newCount := newCount + 1;
      NewLen := PFields[i,7];

      foundIndex := 0;
      FOR j := 1 TO 16 DO
        IF pDrawerName[j] = NewName THEN
          foundIndex := j;
          EXIT;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;

      IF foundIndex = 0 THEN
        ValidityFlag := FALSE;
        PackageState := PPackageState.INVALID;
        NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.INVALID_ABORT;
        Error := TRUE;
        ErrorText := CONCAT('INVALID: missing ATC tool name: ', NewName);

        FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
          FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
            PFields[i,j] := '';
          END_FOR;
        END_FOR;

        Busy := FALSE;
        Done := TRUE;
        RETURN;
      END_IF;

      IF NewLen = '' THEN
        ValidityFlag := FALSE;
        PackageState := PPackageState.INVALID;
        NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.INVALID_ABORT;
        Error := TRUE;
        ErrorText := CONCAT('INVALID: missing length for tool: ', NewName);

        FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
          FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
            PFields[i,j] := '';
          END_FOR;
        END_FOR;

        Busy := FALSE;
        Done := TRUE;
        RETURN;
      END_IF;

      foundLengthMatch := FALSE;
      hasLengthValue := FALSE;
      NewLenReal := 0.0;

      IF NewLen <> '' THEN
        NewLenReal := STRING_TO_REAL(NewLen);
        hasLengthValue := TRUE;
      END_IF;

      IF hasLengthValue THEN
        FOR j := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[j] = NewName THEN
            FOR k := 1 TO 15 DO
              IF ABS(PunchLength[j, k] - NewLenReal) <= eps THEN
                foundLengthMatch := TRUE;
                EXIT;
              END_IF;
            END_FOR;

            IF foundLengthMatch THEN
              EXIT;
            END_IF;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
      END_IF;

      IF NOT foundLengthMatch THEN
        ValidityFlag := FALSE;
        PackageState := PPackageState.INVALID;
        NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.INVALID_ABORT;
        Error := TRUE;
        ErrorText := CONCAT('INVALID: requested length NOT found FOR tool: ', NewName);

        FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
          FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
            PFields[i,j] := '';
          END_FOR;
        END_FOR;

        Busy := FALSE;
        Done := TRUE;
        RETURN;
      END_IF;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  (* STEP 2: Deterministic one-to-one keep matching (consume-old approach) *)
  OldAvailCount := 0;
  FOR j := 1 TO 15 DO
    OldName := PFields_Old[j,3];
    IF OldName <> '' THEN
      OldAvailCount := OldAvailCount + 1;
      OldAvailIndex[OldAvailCount] := j;
      OldMatched[j] := FALSE;
      oldCount := oldCount + 1;
    ELSE
      OldMatched[j] := FALSE;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    NewName := PFields[i,3];
    IF NewName <> '' THEN
      NewLen := PFields[i,7];
      NewHorn := PFields[i,9];
      NewRot := PFields[i,8];
      NewLenReal := 0.0;
      IF NewLen <> '' THEN
        NewLenReal := STRING_TO_REAL(NewLen);
      END_IF;

      NewMatchedToOld[i] := 0;
      a := 1;
      WHILE (a <= OldAvailCount) AND (NewMatchedToOld[i] = 0) DO
        j := OldAvailIndex[a];
        OldName := PFields_Old[j,3];
        IF OldName <> '' THEN
          OldLen := PFields_Old[j,7];
          OldHorn := PFields_Old[j,9];
          OldRot := PFields_Old[j,8];

          OldLenReal := 0.0;
          IF OldLen <> '' THEN
            OldLenReal := STRING_TO_REAL(OldLen);
          END_IF;

          IF (NewName = OldName) AND (NewHorn = OldHorn) AND (NewRot = OldRot) AND (ABS(NewLenReal - OldLenReal) <= eps) THEN
            OldMatched[j] := TRUE;
            KeepList[j] := TRUE;
            NewMatchedToOld[i] := j;

            FOR b := a TO OldAvailCount - 1 DO
              OldAvailIndex[b] := OldAvailIndex[b + 1];
            END_FOR;
            OldAvailCount := OldAvailCount - 1;
          ELSE
            a := a + 1;
          END_IF;
        ELSE
          a := a + 1;
        END_IF;
      END_WHILE;

      IF NewMatchedToOld[i] = 0 THEN
        LoadOnlyList[i] := TRUE;
      END_IF;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  FOR a := 1 TO OldAvailCount DO
    j := OldAvailIndex[a];
    IF PFields_Old[j,3] <> '' THEN
      UnloadOnlyList[j] := TRUE;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  (* STEP 3: PunchUsed-based validation ONLY for load-only punches *)
  (* 3a - per-load-only length availability in physically present ATC punches *)
  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    IF LoadOnlyList[i] THEN
      NewName := PFields[i,3];
      NewLen := PFields[i,7];

      foundLengthMatch := FALSE;
      hasLengthValue := FALSE;
      NewLenReal := 0.0;

      IF NewLen <> '' THEN
        NewLenReal := STRING_TO_REAL(NewLen);
        hasLengthValue := TRUE;
      END_IF;

      IF hasLengthValue THEN
        FOR j := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[j] = NewName THEN
            FOR k := 1 TO 15 DO
              IF (NOT PunchUsed[j,k]) AND (ABS(PunchLength[j, k] - NewLenReal) <= eps) THEN
                foundLengthMatch := TRUE;
                EXIT;
              END_IF;
            END_FOR;

            IF foundLengthMatch THEN
              EXIT;
            END_IF;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
      END_IF;

      IF NOT foundLengthMatch THEN
        ValidityFlag := FALSE;
        PackageState := PPackageState.INVALID;
        NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.INVALID_ABORT;
        Error := TRUE;
        ErrorText := CONCAT('INVALID: requested load punch length NOT available in free ATC punches FOR tool: ', NewName);

        FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
          FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
            PFields[i,j] := '';
          END_FOR;
        END_FOR;

        Busy := FALSE;
        Done := TRUE;
        RETURN;
      END_IF;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  (* 3b - multiplicity check ONLY for load-only punches *)
  uniqCount := 0;
  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    IF LoadOnlyList[i] THEN
      foundIndex := 0;
      FOR a := 1 TO uniqCount DO
        IF (uniqName[a] = PFields[i,3]) AND (uniqLen[a] = PFields[i,7]) AND (uniqHorn[a] = PFields[i,9]) THEN
          foundIndex := a;
          EXIT;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;

      IF foundIndex = 0 THEN
        uniqCount := uniqCount + 1;
        uniqName[uniqCount] := PFields[i,3];
        uniqLen[uniqCount] := PFields[i,7];
        uniqHorn[uniqCount] := PFields[i,9];
        uniqNeeded[uniqCount] := 1;
      ELSE
        uniqNeeded[foundIndex] := uniqNeeded[foundIndex] + 1;
      END_IF;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  FOR a := 1 TO uniqCount DO
    NewName := uniqName[a];
    NewLen := uniqLen[a];
    NewHorn := uniqHorn[a];

    foundIndex := 0;
    FOR e := 1 TO 16 DO
      IF pDrawerName[e] = NewName THEN
        foundIndex := e;
        EXIT;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    IF foundIndex = 0 THEN
      ValidityFlag := FALSE;
      PackageState := PPackageState.INVALID;
      NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.INVALID_ABORT;
      Error := TRUE;
      ErrorText := CONCAT('INVALID (load multiplicity): missing drawer for ', NewName);

      FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
        FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
          PFields[i,j] := '';
        END_FOR;
      END_FOR;

      Busy := FALSE;
      Done := TRUE;
      RETURN;
    END_IF;

    availCount := 0;
    IF (NewLen <> '') AND (NewHorn <> '') THEN
      NewLenReal := STRING_TO_REAL(NewLen);
      NewHornReal := STRING_TO_REAL(NewHorn);

      FOR e := 1 TO 16 DO
        IF pDrawerName[e] = NewName THEN
          FOR d := 1 TO 15 DO
            IF (NOT PunchUsed[e,d]) AND
               (ABS(PunchLength[e,d] - NewLenReal) <= eps) AND
               (ABS(PunchHorn[e,d] - NewHornReal) <= eps) THEN
              availCount := availCount + 1;
            END_IF;
          END_FOR;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;
    END_IF;

    IF availCount < uniqNeeded[a] THEN
      ValidityFlag := FALSE;
      PackageState := PPackageState.INVALID;
      NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.INVALID_ABORT;
      Error := TRUE;
      ErrorText := CONCAT('INVALID: insufficient FREE ATC slots for load tool ', NewName);
      ErrorText := CONCAT(ErrorText, CONCAT(' len=', NewLen));
      ErrorText := CONCAT(ErrorText, CONCAT(' horn=', NewHorn));
      ErrorText := CONCAT(ErrorText, CONCAT(' needed=', INT_TO_STRING(uniqNeeded[a])));
      ErrorText := CONCAT(ErrorText, CONCAT(' available=', INT_TO_STRING(availCount)));

      FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
        FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
          PFields[i,j] := '';
        END_FOR;
      END_FOR;

      Busy := FALSE;
      Done := TRUE;
      RETURN;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  (* Compute summary counters *)
  numSame := 0;
  numDiff := 0;
  FOR j := 1 TO 15 DO
    IF KeepList[j] THEN
      numSame := numSame + 1;
    END_IF;
    IF UnloadOnlyList[j] THEN
      numDiff := numDiff + 1;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;
  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    IF LoadOnlyList[i] THEN
      numDiff := numDiff + 1;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    OldName := PFields_Old[i,3];
    NewName := PFields[i,3];
    IF KeepList[i] THEN
      PerIndexStatus[i] := PIndexStatus.SAME;
    ELSIF (OldName = '') AND (NewName = '') THEN
      PerIndexStatus[i] := PIndexStatus.SAME;
    ELSE
      PerIndexStatus[i] := PIndexStatus.DIFF;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  IF NOT ValidityFlag THEN
    PackageState := PPackageState.INVALID;
    NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.INVALID_ABORT;
  ELSE
    PackageState := PPackageState.PARTIAL_CHANGE;
    NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.NO_ACTION;
  END_IF;

  ValidityFlag := NOT Error;

  IF PackageState <> PPackageState.INVALID THEN
    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_LoadPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_KeepPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_KeepPunchListNew[i,j] := '';
      END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Pack UnloadPunchList *)
    UnloadTempCount := 0;
    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      IF UnloadOnlyList[i] THEN
        foundIndex := 0;
        FOR k := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[k] = PFields_Old[i,3] THEN
            foundIndex := k;
            EXIT;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
        IF foundIndex <> 0 THEN
          UnloadTempCount := UnloadTempCount + 1;
          UnloadTempOrigIndex[UnloadTempCount] := i;
          UnloadTempDrawerIdx[UnloadTempCount] := foundIndex;
          UnloadTempOrder[UnloadTempCount] := UnloadTempCount;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    FOR a := 1 TO UnloadTempCount - 1 DO
      minIdx := a;
      FOR b := a + 1 TO UnloadTempCount DO
        IF UnloadTempDrawerIdx[b] < UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] THEN
          minIdx := b;
        ELSIF (UnloadTempDrawerIdx[b] = UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx]) AND (UnloadTempOrder[b] < UnloadTempOrder[minIdx]) THEN
          minIdx := b;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;
      IF minIdx <> a THEN
        tmpInt := UnloadTempOrigIndex[a];
        UnloadTempOrigIndex[a] := UnloadTempOrigIndex[minIdx];
        UnloadTempOrigIndex[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := UnloadTempDrawerIdx[a];
        UnloadTempDrawerIdx[a] := UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx];
        UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := UnloadTempOrder[a];
        UnloadTempOrder[a] := UnloadTempOrder[minIdx];
        UnloadTempOrder[minIdx] := tmpInt;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    UnloadCount := 0;
    FOR a := 1 TO UnloadTempCount DO
      UnloadCount := UnloadCount + 1;
      i := UnloadTempOrigIndex[a];
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_UnloadPunchList[UnloadCount, j] := PFields_Old[i, j];
      END_FOR;
      Retain_UnloadPunchList[UnloadCount, 12] := INT_TO_STRING(i);
    END_FOR;

    (* Pack LoadPunchList *)
    LoadTempCount := 0;
    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      IF LoadOnlyList[i] THEN
        foundIndex := 0;
        FOR k := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[k] = PFields[i,3] THEN
            foundIndex := k;
            EXIT;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
        IF foundIndex <> 0 THEN
          LoadTempCount := LoadTempCount + 1;
          LoadTempOrigIndex[LoadTempCount] := i;
          LoadTempDrawerIdx[LoadTempCount] := foundIndex;
          LoadTempOrder[LoadTempCount] := LoadTempCount;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    FOR a := 1 TO LoadTempCount - 1 DO
      minIdx := a;
      FOR b := a + 1 TO LoadTempCount DO
        IF LoadTempDrawerIdx[b] < LoadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] THEN
          minIdx := b;
        ELSIF (LoadTempDrawerIdx[b] = LoadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx]) AND (LoadTempOrder[b] < LoadTempOrder[minIdx]) THEN
          minIdx := b;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;
      IF minIdx <> a THEN
        tmpInt := LoadTempOrigIndex[a];
        LoadTempOrigIndex[a] := LoadTempOrigIndex[minIdx];
        LoadTempOrigIndex[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := LoadTempDrawerIdx[a];
        LoadTempDrawerIdx[a] := LoadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx];
        LoadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := LoadTempOrder[a];
        LoadTempOrder[a] := LoadTempOrder[minIdx];
        LoadTempOrder[minIdx] := tmpInt;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    LoadCount := 0;
    FOR a := 1 TO LoadTempCount DO
      LoadCount := LoadCount + 1;
      i := LoadTempOrigIndex[a];
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_LoadPunchList[LoadCount, j] := PFields[i, j];
      END_FOR;
      Retain_LoadPunchList[LoadCount, 12] := INT_TO_STRING(i);
    END_FOR;

    (* ATC load mapping - PunchUsed applies only here and in load-only validation above *)
    FOR c := 1 TO 15 DO
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c, j] := '';
      END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    FOR e := 1 TO 16 DO
      FOR d := 1 TO 15 DO
        usedSlot[e,d] := FALSE;
      END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      NewAssignedDrawer[i] := 0;
      NewAssignedSlot[i] := 0;
    END_FOR;

    FOR c := 1 TO LoadCount DO
      origNewIdx := LoadTempOrigIndex[c];
      NewName := Retain_LoadPunchList[c,3];
      lenStr := Retain_LoadPunchList[c,7];
      hornStr := Retain_LoadPunchList[c,9];

      foundIndex := 0;
      IsBottomDrawer := FALSE;

      IF (NewName <> '') AND (lenStr <> '') AND (hornStr <> '') THEN
        lenRealLocal := STRING_TO_REAL(lenStr);
        hornRealLocal := STRING_TO_REAL(hornStr);

        FOR e := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[e] = NewName THEN

            IF (e = 4) OR (e = 8) OR (e = 12) OR (e = 16) THEN
              IsBottomDrawer := TRUE;
            ELSE
              IsBottomDrawer := FALSE;
            END_IF;

            foundSlotCount := 0;
            bestSlot := 0;

            IF IsBottomDrawer THEN
              (* Bottom drawer: choose first valid slot *)
              FOR d := 1 TO 15 DO
                IF (NOT usedSlot[e,d]) AND (NOT PunchUsed[e,d]) THEN
                  IF (ABS(PunchLength[e,d] - lenRealLocal) <= eps) AND
                     (ABS(PunchHorn[e,d] - hornRealLocal) <= eps) THEN
                    foundSlotCount := foundSlotCount + 1;
                    IF bestSlot = 0 THEN
                      bestSlot := d;
                    END_IF;
                  END_IF;
                END_IF;
              END_FOR;
            ELSE
              (* Non-bottom drawer: choose rightmost valid slot *)
              FOR d := 1 TO 15 DO
                IF (NOT usedSlot[e,d]) AND (NOT PunchUsed[e,d]) THEN
                  IF (ABS(PunchLength[e,d] - lenRealLocal) <= eps) AND
                     (ABS(PunchHorn[e,d] - hornRealLocal) <= eps) THEN
                    foundSlotCount := foundSlotCount + 1;
                    bestSlot := d;
                  END_IF;
                END_IF;
              END_FOR;
            END_IF;

            IF bestSlot <> 0 THEN
              usedSlot[e,bestSlot] := TRUE;
              foundIndex := e;

              Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,1] := pDrawerName[e];
              Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,2] := INT_TO_STRING(e);
              Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,3] := INT_TO_STRING(bestSlot);
              Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,4] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchLength[e,bestSlot]);
              Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,5] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchPosition[e,bestSlot]);
              Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,6] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchHorn[e,bestSlot]);
              Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,12] := INT_TO_STRING(origNewIdx);

              NewAssignedDrawer[origNewIdx] := e;
              NewAssignedSlot[origNewIdx] := bestSlot;
            END_IF;

            EXIT;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    (* Pack KeepPunchList old + corresponding new *)
    KeepTempCount := 0;
    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      IF KeepList[i] THEN
        foundIndex := 0;
        FOR k := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[k] = PFields_Old[i,3] THEN
            foundIndex := k;
            EXIT;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
        IF foundIndex <> 0 THEN
          KeepTempCount := KeepTempCount + 1;
          KeepTempOrigIndex[KeepTempCount] := i;
          KeepTempDrawerIdx[KeepTempCount] := foundIndex;
          KeepTempOrder[KeepTempCount] := KeepTempCount;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    FOR a := 1 TO KeepTempCount - 1 DO
      minIdx := a;
      FOR b := a + 1 TO KeepTempCount DO
        IF KeepTempDrawerIdx[b] < KeepTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] THEN
          minIdx := b;
        ELSIF (KeepTempDrawerIdx[b] = KeepTempDrawerIdx[minIdx]) AND (KeepTempOrder[b] < KeepTempOrder[minIdx]) THEN
          minIdx := b;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;
      IF minIdx <> a THEN
        tmpInt := KeepTempOrigIndex[a];
        KeepTempOrigIndex[a] := KeepTempOrigIndex[minIdx];
        KeepTempOrigIndex[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := KeepTempDrawerIdx[a];
        KeepTempDrawerIdx[a] := KeepTempDrawerIdx[minIdx];
        KeepTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := KeepTempOrder[a];
        KeepTempOrder[a] := KeepTempOrder[minIdx];
        KeepTempOrder[minIdx] := tmpInt;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    KeepCount := 0;
    FOR a := 1 TO KeepTempCount DO
      KeepCount := KeepCount + 1;
      i := KeepTempOrigIndex[a];
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_KeepPunchList[KeepCount, j] := PFields_Old[i, j];
        Retain_KeepPunchListNew[KeepCount, j] := '';
      END_FOR;
      Retain_KeepPunchList[KeepCount, 12] := INT_TO_STRING(i);

      tmpInt := 0;
      FOR b := 1 TO 15 DO
        IF NewMatchedToOld[b] = i THEN
          tmpInt := b;
          EXIT;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;

      IF tmpInt <> 0 THEN
        FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
          Retain_KeepPunchListNew[KeepCount, j] := PFields[tmpInt, j];
        END_FOR;
        Retain_KeepPunchListNew[KeepCount, 12] := INT_TO_STRING(tmpInt);
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    (* ATC unload mapping uses PFields_Old[,10]=drawer and [,11]=slot *)
    FOR c := 1 TO 15 DO
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c, j] := '';
      END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    FOR c := 1 TO UnloadCount DO
      tmpInt := UnloadTempOrigIndex[c];

      IF (tmpInt >= 1) AND (tmpInt <= 15) AND (PFields_Old[tmpInt,10] <> '') AND (PFields_Old[tmpInt,11] <> '') THEN
        e := STRING_TO_INT(PFields_Old[tmpInt,10]);
        d := STRING_TO_INT(PFields_Old[tmpInt,11]);

        IF (e >= 1) AND (e <= 16) AND (d >= 1) AND (d <= 15) THEN
          Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,1] := pDrawerName[e];
          Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,2] := PFields_Old[tmpInt,10];
          Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,3] := PFields_Old[tmpInt,11];
          Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,4] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchLength[e,d]);
          Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,5] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchPosition[e,d]);
          Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,6] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchHorn[e,d]);
          Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,12] := INT_TO_STRING(tmpInt);
        END_IF;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    Busy := FALSE;
    Done := TRUE;
  ELSE
    Busy := FALSE;
    Done := TRUE;
  END_IF;

END_IF
```

## @snnrcpglu1677

Tamamdır bu güncelleme ile artık Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList doldururken artık en alt ve üst drawerlardan punch seçimi yaparken sürüklecek olanlar için en sağdan seçme kuralımızı ekledik. 
Şimdi ise Artık işin fiziksel hareket katmanı olan Punch_Loading FB mize geçebiliriz. 
Öncelikle loading FB mizi sana yeniden paylaşmamı ister misin bunu sorarark başlamak istiyorum

```
FUNCTION_BLOCK Punch_Loading
VAR_INPUT
  LoadStartCmd      : BOOL;   (* State_Machine'den gelen başlat komutu *)
  Reset             : BOOL;   (* SOFT reset: state/substate resetlemez, sadece requestleri keser *)
  Abort_Cycle       : BOOL;   (* HARD abort: tüm FB içi state/substate/flagleri resetler *)
  Automatic_Page    : BOOL;   (* TRUE: otomatik sayfa aktif, FALSE: otomatik dışı -> pause zorunlu *)
END_VAR

VAR_IN_OUT
  General_Stop      : BOOL;
  General_Start     : BOOL;   (* Enable/pause: FALSE iken pause, TRUE iken devam *)
END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT
  LoadStartAck      : BOOL;   (* State_Machine'e ACK *)
  LoadBusy          : BOOL;   (* FB aktif çalışıyor *)
  LoadError         : BOOL;   (* hata flag *)
  LoadDone          : BOOL;   (* tüm load bitti *)
END_VAR

VAR RETAIN
  {attribute 'ac_persist':='PersistenceChannel'} Local_Shuttle_State      : INT := 0;   (* Shuttle state *)
  {attribute 'ac_persist':='PersistenceChannel'} Local_WareHouse_State    : INT := 0;   (* Warehouse state *)
  {attribute 'ac_persist':='PersistenceChannel'} Local_RotArm_State       : INT := 0;   (* Rotation Arm state *)

  {attribute 'ac_persist':='PersistenceChannel'} LoadedPunchCount         : INT := 0;

  {attribute 'ac_persist':='PersistenceChannel'} PLoad_WH_SubStates       : INT := 0;
  {attribute 'ac_persist':='PersistenceChannel'} PLoad_SH_SubStates       : INT := 0;
  {attribute 'ac_persist':='PersistenceChannel'} PLoad_RotArm_SubStates   : INT := 0;

  lastStartCmd             : BOOL := FALSE;
  initiated                : BOOL := FALSE;

  Current_PunchIndex       : INT := 0;      (* 0 = yok, 1..15 geçerli *)
  Current_PunchLoaded      : BOOL := FALSE;
  LastInitializedPunch     : INT := 0;

  (* Warehouse internal flags *)
  WH_TargetDrawerIdx       : INT := 0;      (* hedef drawer index 1..16 *)
  WH_TargetRackID          : INT := 0;      (* hedef rack ID 1..4 *)
  WH_NeedRackBring         : BOOL := FALSE;
  WH_NeedRackChange        : BOOL := FALSE;
  WH_SameRack              : BOOL := FALSE;

  WH_R_MoveRequested       : BOOL := FALSE;
  WH_X_MoveRequested       : BOOL := FALSE;
  WH_R_Done                : BOOL := FALSE;
  WH_X_Done                : BOOL := FALSE;
  WH_WaitRackInPos         : BOOL := FALSE;

  WH_Eps                   : REAL := 0.01;

  WH_R_LoadRequested       : BOOL := FALSE;
  WH_R_LoadDone            : BOOL := FALSE;
  R_Not_Safety_Zone        : BOOL := FALSE;
  Rack_Presence_Error      : BOOL := FALSE;

  (* Shuttle placeholders - sonraki aşamalar için *)
  SH_DX_MoveRequested      : BOOL := FALSE;
  SH_DX_Done               : BOOL := FALSE;
  SH_DR_MoveRequested      : BOOL := FALSE;
  SH_DR_Done               : BOOL := FALSE;
  SH_Z_MoveRequested       : BOOL := FALSE;
  SH_Z_Done                : BOOL := FALSE;

  (* Rotation Arm placeholders - sonraki aşamalar için *)
  RA_W_MoveRequested       : BOOL := FALSE;
  RA_W_Done                : BOOL := FALSE;
  RotArm_ReadyForLoad      : BOOL := FALSE;
  RotArm_RotationDone      : BOOL := FALSE;
  RotArm_PunchReleased     : BOOL := FALSE;
  RotRequired              : BOOL := FALSE;
END_VAR

VAR
  risingStart              : BOOL;
  i                        : INT;
  foundFirst               : BOOL;
  punchDoneRising          : BOOL;
  lastPunchCompleted       : BOOL := FALSE;
  tmpInt                   : INT;

  AutoRunEnable            : BOOL;

  DelayFor_ClampOff        : BOOL;
  DelayFor_ClampOnn        : BOOL;
  ClampOff_Timer           : TON;
  ClampOn_Timer            : TON;
  tmpInt2:INT;
  k:INT;
  l:INT;
END_VAR
```

```
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Combined enable: must be on Auto page AND General_Start TRUE *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
AutoRunEnable := (General_Start AND Automatic_Page);
ClampOff_Timer(PT:=TO_TIME(TO_INT(Retain_GeneralParameters[4]*1000)));
ClampOn_Timer(PT:=TO_TIME(TO_INT(Retain_GeneralParameters[3]*1000)));
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Edge detection                                               *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
risingStart := (LoadStartCmd AND NOT lastStartCmd);


(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* HARD ABORT: reset all FB-internal state (lists are untouched) *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
IF Abort_Cycle THEN
  LoadStartAck := FALSE;
  LoadBusy := FALSE;
  LoadError := FALSE;
  LoadDone := FALSE;

  lastStartCmd := FALSE;
  initiated := FALSE;

  Current_PunchIndex := 0;
  Current_PunchLoaded := FALSE;
  LastInitializedPunch := 0;

  LoadedPunchCount := 0;

  Local_Shuttle_State := 0;
  Local_WareHouse_State := 0;
  Local_RotArm_State := 0;

  PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_IDLE;
  PLoad_SH_SubStates := PLoad_SH_SubState.SH_IDLE;
  PLoad_RotArm_SubStates := PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_IDLE;

  WH_TargetDrawerIdx := 0;
  WH_TargetRackID := 0;
  WH_NeedRackBring := FALSE;
  WH_NeedRackChange := FALSE;
  WH_SameRack := FALSE;

  WH_R_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  WH_X_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  WH_R_Done := FALSE;
  WH_X_Done := FALSE;
  WH_WaitRackInPos := FALSE;

  WH_R_LoadRequested := FALSE;
  WH_R_LoadDone := FALSE;
  R_Not_Safety_Zone := FALSE;
  Rack_Presence_Error := FALSE;

  SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_DX_Done := FALSE;
  SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
  SH_Z_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_Z_Done := FALSE;

  RotArm_ReadyForLoad := FALSE;
  RotArm_RotationDone := FALSE;
  RotArm_PunchReleased := FALSE;
  RA_W_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  RA_W_Done := FALSE;
  RotRequired := FALSE;

  arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisAutoSetVelocity := Retain_DRParameters[1];

  arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
  arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
  arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
  arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
  arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
  arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_W].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;

  RETURN;
END_IF


(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* PAUSE: freeze states, cut requests                           *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
IF NOT AutoRunEnable AND NOT PLC_PRG.HMI.Drawer_Demand_Enable THEN
  arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
  arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
  arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
  arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
  arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
  arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_W].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;

  lastStartCmd := LoadStartCmd;
  RETURN;
END_IF


(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* SOFT RESET: do not reset states/substates; only cut requests *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
IF Reset THEN
  arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
  arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
  arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
  arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
  arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
  arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_W].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
END_IF


(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Start handshake + init punch count + set initial punch index *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
IF risingStart THEN
  initiated := TRUE;
  LoadBusy := TRUE;
  LoadError := FALSE;
  LoadDone := FALSE;

  LoadedPunchCount := 0;
  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    IF Retain_LoadPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
      LoadedPunchCount := i;
    ELSE
      EXIT;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  IF LoadedPunchCount = 0 THEN
    Current_PunchIndex := 0;
    Current_PunchLoaded := FALSE;
    LoadDone := TRUE;
    initiated := FALSE;

    Local_WareHouse_State := 0;
    Local_Shuttle_State := 0;
    Local_RotArm_State := 0;

    PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_IDLE;
    PLoad_SH_SubStates := PLoad_SH_SubState.SH_IDLE;
    PLoad_RotArm_SubStates := PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_IDLE;

  ELSE
    Current_PunchIndex := 1;
    Current_PunchLoaded := TRUE;
    LoadDone := FALSE;

    Local_WareHouse_State := WareHouse_States.L_PDrawer_pickup_start;
    PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_INIT;

    Local_Shuttle_State := Shuttle_States.L_Shuttle_starts_PPick_up;
    PLoad_SH_SubStates := PLoad_SH_SubState.PLD_L10_INIT;

    Local_RotArm_State := RotationArm_States.L_RotArm_Init_And_Home;
    PLoad_RotArm_SubStates := PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INIT_CHECK_POSITION;
  END_IF;

  LoadStartAck := TRUE;

ELSIF initiated AND LoadStartCmd THEN
  LoadStartAck := TRUE;
  LoadBusy := TRUE;

ELSIF initiated AND NOT LoadStartCmd THEN
  LoadStartAck := FALSE;
  LoadBusy := TRUE;

ELSE
  LoadStartAck := FALSE;
  IF NOT initiated THEN
    LoadBusy := FALSE;
  END_IF;
END_IF


(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* New punch initialization                                     *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
IF (Current_PunchIndex <> 0) AND (Current_PunchIndex <> LastInitializedPunch) THEN
  Local_WareHouse_State := WareHouse_States.L_PDrawer_pickup_start;
  Local_Shuttle_State := Shuttle_States.L_Shuttle_starts_PPick_up;
  LastInitializedPunch := Current_PunchIndex;

  WH_TargetDrawerIdx := 0;
  WH_TargetRackID := 0;
  WH_NeedRackBring := FALSE;
  WH_NeedRackChange := FALSE;
  WH_SameRack := FALSE;

  WH_R_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  WH_X_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  WH_R_Done := FALSE;
  WH_X_Done := FALSE;
  WH_WaitRackInPos := FALSE;

  R_Not_Safety_Zone := FALSE;
  WH_R_LoadRequested := FALSE;
  WH_R_LoadDone := FALSE;
  Rack_Presence_Error := FALSE;

  SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_DX_Done := FALSE;
  SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
  SH_Z_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_Z_Done := FALSE;

  RotRequired := FALSE;
  RotArm_RotationDone := FALSE;
  RotArm_PunchReleased := FALSE;

  PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_INIT;
  PLoad_SH_SubStates := PLoad_SH_SubState.PLD_L10_INIT;
END_IF

```

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Rotation Arm Engine                                          *)
(* ============================================================ *)
IF LoadStartCmd THEN

  CASE Local_RotArm_State OF

    RotationArm_States.L_RotArm_Init_And_Home:

      CASE PLoad_RotArm_SubStates OF

        PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_IDLE:
          PLoad_RotArm_SubStates := PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INIT_CHECK_POSITION;

        PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INIT_CHECK_POSITION:
          RotArm_ReadyForLoad := FALSE;
          RotArm_RotationDone := FALSE;
          RotArm_PunchReleased := FALSE;
          RA_W_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          RA_W_Done := FALSE;

          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Rotation_Arm_Inside THEN
            IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_W].ActualPos - 90.0) <= WH_Eps THEN
              PLoad_RotArm_SubStates := PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INIT_MOVE_OUTSIDE_CMD;
            ELSE
              PLoad_RotArm_SubStates := PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INIT_W_TO_90_REQ;
            END_IF;

          ELSIF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Rotation_Arm_Outside THEN
            IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_W].ActualPos - 180.0) <= WH_Eps THEN
              PLoad_RotArm_SubStates := PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INIT_LOCK_CMD;
            ELSE
              PLoad_RotArm_SubStates := PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INIT_W_TO_180_REQ;
            END_IF;

          ELSE
            LoadError := TRUE;
          END_IF;

        PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INIT_W_TO_90_REQ:
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_W].TargetPos := 90.0;
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_W].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
          RA_W_MoveRequested := TRUE;
          RA_W_Done := FALSE;
          PLoad_RotArm_SubStates := PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INIT_W_TO_90_WAIT;

        PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INIT_W_TO_90_WAIT:
          IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_W].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
             (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_W].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_W].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
            PLoad_RotArm_SubStates := PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INIT_W_TO_90_REQ;
          END_IF;

          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_W].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_W].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_W].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            RA_W_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            RA_W_Done := TRUE;
            PLoad_RotArm_SubStates := PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INIT_MOVE_OUTSIDE_CMD;
          END_IF;

        PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INIT_MOVE_OUTSIDE_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Rotation_Arm_Move_Inside_Valve := FALSE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Rotation_Arm_Move_Outside_Valve := TRUE;
          PLoad_RotArm_SubStates := PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INIT_WAIT_OUTSIDE;

        PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INIT_WAIT_OUTSIDE:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Rotation_Arm_Outside THEN
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Rotation_Arm_Move_Outside_Valve := FALSE;

            IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_W].ActualPos - 180.0) <= WH_Eps THEN
              PLoad_RotArm_SubStates := PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INIT_LOCK_CMD;
            ELSE
              PLoad_RotArm_SubStates := PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INIT_W_TO_180_REQ;
            END_IF;
          END_IF;

        PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INIT_W_TO_180_REQ:
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_W].TargetPos := 180.0;
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_W].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
          RA_W_MoveRequested := TRUE;
          RA_W_Done := FALSE;
          PLoad_RotArm_SubStates := PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INIT_W_TO_180_WAIT;

        PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INIT_W_TO_180_WAIT:
          IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_W].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
             (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_W].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_W].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
            PLoad_RotArm_SubStates := PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INIT_W_TO_180_REQ;
          END_IF;

          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_W].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_W].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_W].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            RA_W_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            RA_W_Done := TRUE;
            PLoad_RotArm_SubStates := PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INIT_LOCK_CMD;
          END_IF;

        PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INIT_LOCK_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Rotation_Arm_Unlocking_Valve := FALSE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Rotation_Arm_Locking_Valve := TRUE;
          PLoad_RotArm_SubStates := PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INIT_WAIT_LOCKED;

        PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INIT_WAIT_LOCKED:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Rotation_Arm_Locked_CH2 AND Fmsc_PLC_IO.Rotation_Arm_Locked_CH3 THEN
            RotArm_ReadyForLoad := TRUE;
            Local_RotArm_State := RotationArm_States.L_RotArm_Ready_For_Load;
            PLoad_RotArm_SubStates := PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_READY;
          END_IF;

      ELSE
        PLoad_RotArm_SubStates := PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INIT_CHECK_POSITION;
      END_CASE;


    RotationArm_States.L_RotArm_Ready_For_Load:

      CASE PLoad_RotArm_SubStates OF

        PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_READY:
          RotArm_ReadyForLoad := TRUE;

          IF RotRequired THEN
            Local_RotArm_State := RotationArm_States.L_RotArm_Rotation_Interrupt_Active;
            PLoad_RotArm_SubStates := PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INT_WAIT_PUNCH_ON_ARM;
          END_IF;

      ELSE
        PLoad_RotArm_SubStates := PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_READY;
      END_CASE;


    RotationArm_States.L_RotArm_Rotation_Interrupt_Active:

      CASE PLoad_RotArm_SubStates OF

        PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INT_WAIT_PUNCH_ON_ARM:
          RotArm_ReadyForLoad := FALSE;
          RotArm_RotationDone := FALSE;
          RotArm_PunchReleased := FALSE;

          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Punch_Locked_on_Rotation_Arm THEN
            PLoad_RotArm_SubStates := PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INT_WAIT_SHUTTLE_CLEAR;
          END_IF;

        PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INT_WAIT_SHUTTLE_CLEAR:
          IF (PLoad_SH_SubStates = PLoad_SH_SubState.PLD_L13_DONE) THEN
            PLoad_RotArm_SubStates := PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INT_ARM_UNLOCK_CMD;
          END_IF;

        PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INT_ARM_UNLOCK_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Rotation_Arm_Unlocking_Valve := TRUE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Rotation_Arm_Locking_Valve := FALSE;
          PLoad_RotArm_SubStates := PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INT_WAIT_ARM_UNLOCKED;

        PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INT_WAIT_ARM_UNLOCKED:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Rotation_Arm_Unlocked_CH2 AND Fmsc_PLC_IO.Rotation_Arm_Unlocked_CH3 THEN
            PLoad_RotArm_SubStates := PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INT_W_TO_ROTATED_REQ;
          END_IF;

        PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INT_W_TO_ROTATED_REQ:
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_W].TargetPos := 0.0;
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_W].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
          RA_W_MoveRequested := TRUE;
          RA_W_Done := FALSE;
          PLoad_RotArm_SubStates := PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INT_W_TO_ROTATED_WAIT;

        PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INT_W_TO_ROTATED_WAIT:
          IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_W].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
             (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_W].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_W].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
            PLoad_RotArm_SubStates := PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INT_W_TO_ROTATED_REQ;
          END_IF;

          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_W].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_W].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_W].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            RA_W_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            RA_W_Done := TRUE;
            PLoad_RotArm_SubStates := PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INT_ARM_LOCK_CMD;
          END_IF;

        PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INT_ARM_LOCK_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Rotation_Arm_Locking_Valve := TRUE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Rotation_Arm_Unlocking_Valve := FALSE;
          PLoad_RotArm_SubStates := PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INT_WAIT_ARM_LOCKED;

        PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INT_WAIT_ARM_LOCKED:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Rotation_Arm_Locked_CH2 AND Fmsc_PLC_IO.Rotation_Arm_Locked_CH3 THEN
            RotArm_RotationDone := TRUE;
            PLoad_RotArm_SubStates := PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INT_WAIT_SHUTTLE_PICKBACK;
          END_IF;

        PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INT_WAIT_SHUTTLE_PICKBACK:
          IF (PLoad_SH_SubStates = PLoad_SH_SubState.PLD_L15_WAIT_ROTARM_RELEASED) THEN
            PLoad_RotArm_SubStates := PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INT_UNLOCK_CMD;
          END_IF;

        PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INT_UNLOCK_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Rotation_Arm_Punch_Unlock_Valve := TRUE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Rotation_Arm_Punch_Lock_Valve := FALSE;
          PLoad_RotArm_SubStates := PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INT_WAIT_PUNCH_RELEASED;

        PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INT_WAIT_PUNCH_RELEASED:
          IF NOT Fmsc_PLC_IO.Punch_Locked_on_Rotation_Arm THEN
            RotArm_PunchReleased := TRUE;
            PLoad_RotArm_SubStates := PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INT_RETURN_UNLOCK_CMD;
          END_IF;

        PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INT_RETURN_UNLOCK_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Rotation_Arm_Unlocking_Valve := TRUE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Rotation_Arm_Locking_Valve := FALSE;
          PLoad_RotArm_SubStates := PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INT_RETURN_WAIT_Z_SAFE_FOR_READY;

        PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INT_RETURN_WAIT_Z_SAFE_FOR_READY:
          IF arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].ActualPos > TO_LREAL(Retain_ZParameters[9]) THEN
            PLoad_RotArm_SubStates := PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INT_RETURN_WAIT_UNLOCKED;
          END_IF;

        PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INT_RETURN_WAIT_UNLOCKED:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Rotation_Arm_Unlocked_CH2 AND Fmsc_PLC_IO.Rotation_Arm_Unlocked_CH3 THEN
            PLoad_RotArm_SubStates := PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INT_RETURN_W_TO_180_REQ;
          END_IF;

        PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INT_RETURN_W_TO_180_REQ:
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_W].TargetPos := 180.0;
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_W].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
          RA_W_MoveRequested := TRUE;
          RA_W_Done := FALSE;
          PLoad_RotArm_SubStates := PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INT_RETURN_W_TO_180_WAIT;

        PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INT_RETURN_W_TO_180_WAIT:
          IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_W].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
             (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_W].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_W].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
            PLoad_RotArm_SubStates := PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INT_RETURN_W_TO_180_REQ;
          END_IF;

          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_W].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_W].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_W].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            RA_W_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            RA_W_Done := TRUE;
            PLoad_RotArm_SubStates := PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INT_RETURN_LOCK_CMD;
          END_IF;

        PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INT_RETURN_LOCK_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Rotation_Arm_Locking_Valve := TRUE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Rotation_Arm_Unlocking_Valve := FALSE;
          PLoad_RotArm_SubStates := PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INT_RETURN_WAIT_LOCKED;

        PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INT_RETURN_WAIT_LOCKED:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Rotation_Arm_Locked_CH2 AND Fmsc_PLC_IO.Rotation_Arm_Locked_CH3 THEN
            PLoad_RotArm_SubStates := PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INT_DONE;
          END_IF;

        PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INT_DONE:
          RotRequired := FALSE;
          RotArm_ReadyForLoad := TRUE;
          Local_RotArm_State := RotationArm_States.L_RotArm_Ready_For_Load;
          PLoad_RotArm_SubStates := PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_READY;

      ELSE
        PLoad_RotArm_SubStates := PLoad_RotArm_SubState.ROT_L_INT_WAIT_PUNCH_ON_ARM;
      END_CASE;

  ELSE
    ;
  END_CASE;

END_IF

```
(* ============================================================ *)
(* Warehouse macro states 9..12: LOAD punches (WH engine)       *)
(* ============================================================ *)
IF (Local_WareHouse_State = WareHouse_States.L_PDrawer_pickup_start) OR
   (Local_WareHouse_State = WareHouse_States.L_Punches_rack_taken) OR
   (Local_WareHouse_State = WareHouse_States.L_PDrawer_pickup_Pos_reached) OR
   (Local_WareHouse_State = WareHouse_States.L_PPickup_from_drawer_allowed) THEN

  IF Current_PunchIndex = 0 THEN
    LoadError := TRUE;

  ELSE

    CASE PLoad_WH_SubStates OF

      PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_IDLE:
        PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_INIT;

      PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_INIT:
        WH_TargetDrawerIdx := 0;
        WH_TargetRackID := 0;
        WH_NeedRackBring := FALSE;
        WH_NeedRackChange := FALSE;
        WH_SameRack := FALSE;

        PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_READ_TARGETS;

      PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_READ_TARGETS:
        IF Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,2] <> '' THEN
          WH_TargetDrawerIdx := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,2]);
        ELSE
          WH_TargetDrawerIdx := 0;
        END_IF;

        IF WH_TargetDrawerIdx >= 1 THEN
          tmpInt := WH_TargetDrawerIdx - 1;
          WH_TargetRackID := TO_INT(tmpInt / 4) + 1;
        ELSE
          WH_TargetRackID := 0;
        END_IF;

        IF Current_Rack_Type = 0 THEN
          WH_NeedRackBring := TRUE;
          WH_NeedRackChange := FALSE;
          WH_SameRack := FALSE;

        ELSIF Current_Rack_Type = 1 THEN
          WH_NeedRackBring := FALSE;
          IF TO_INT(Current_Rack_ID) = WH_TargetRackID THEN
            WH_SameRack := TRUE;
            WH_NeedRackChange := FALSE;
          ELSE
            WH_SameRack := FALSE;
            WH_NeedRackChange := TRUE;
          END_IF

        ELSIF Current_Rack_Type = 2 THEN
          WH_NeedRackBring := FALSE;
          WH_NeedRackChange := TRUE;
          WH_SameRack := FALSE;
        END_IF

        IF WH_NeedRackBring THEN
          PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_UNLOCK_CHECK;

        ELSIF WH_SameRack THEN
          PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_SAMERACK_DRAWER_CHECK;

        ELSIF WH_NeedRackChange THEN
          PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_RACKCHANGE_UNLOCK_CHECK;

        ELSE
          LoadError := TRUE;
        END_IF;

      PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_SAMERACK_DRAWER_CHECK:
        IF Current_Drawer_ID = WH_TargetDrawerIdx THEN
          PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L12_DONE;
        ELSE
          PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_SAMERACK_R_TO_DRAWER_REQ;
        END_IF;

      PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_SAMERACK_R_TO_DRAWER_REQ:
        IF (WH_TargetDrawerIdx >= 1) AND (WH_TargetDrawerIdx <= 16) THEN

          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].ActualPos - TO_LREAL(pDrawerParam1[WH_TargetDrawerIdx])) <= WH_Eps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            WH_R_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            WH_R_Done := TRUE;
            Current_Drawer_ID := WH_TargetDrawerIdx;

            PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L12_DONE;
          ELSE
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(pDrawerParam1[WH_TargetDrawerIdx]);
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
            WH_R_MoveRequested := TRUE;
            WH_R_Done := FALSE;

            PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_SAMERACK_R_TO_DRAWER_WAIT;
          END_IF;

        ELSE
          LoadError := TRUE;
        END_IF;

      PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_SAMERACK_R_TO_DRAWER_WAIT:
        IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
           (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
          PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_SAMERACK_R_TO_DRAWER_REQ;
        END_IF;

        IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
          WH_R_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          WH_R_Done := TRUE;
          Current_Drawer_ID := WH_TargetDrawerIdx;

          PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L12_DONE;
        END_IF;

      PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_RACKCHANGE_UNLOCK_CHECK:
        IF NOT (Fmsc_PLC_IO.Carriage_Unlocked_Left AND Fmsc_PLC_IO.Carriage_Unlocked_Right) THEN
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Carriage_UnLocking_Valve := TRUE;
          FMSC_PLC_IO.Carriage_Locking_Valve := FALSE;
        ELSE
          PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_RACKCHANGE_R_TO_SAFE_REQ;
        END_IF;

      PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_RACKCHANGE_R_TO_SAFE_REQ:
        arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(Retain_RParameters[3]);
        arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
        WH_R_MoveRequested := TRUE;
        WH_R_Done := FALSE;

        PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_RACKCHANGE_R_TO_SAFE_WAIT;

      PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_RACKCHANGE_R_TO_SAFE_WAIT:
        IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
           (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
          PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_RACKCHANGE_R_TO_SAFE_REQ;
        END_IF;

        IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
          WH_R_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          WH_R_Done := TRUE;

          PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_RACKCHANGE_X_TO_CURRENT_DRAWER_REQ;
        END_IF;

      PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_RACKCHANGE_X_TO_CURRENT_DRAWER_REQ:
        IF (Current_Drawer_ID >= 1) AND (Current_Drawer_ID <= 16) THEN

          IF Current_Rack_Type = 2 THEN
            IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].ActualPos - TO_LREAL(DDrawerParam2[TO_INT(Current_Drawer_ID)])) <= WH_Eps THEN
              arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
              WH_X_MoveRequested := FALSE;
              WH_X_Done := TRUE;

              PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_RACKCHANGE_R_TO_DROP_REQ;
            ELSE
              arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(DDrawerParam2[TO_INT(Current_Drawer_ID)]);
              arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
              WH_X_MoveRequested := TRUE;
              WH_X_Done := FALSE;

              PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_RACKCHANGE_X_TO_CURRENT_DRAWER_WAIT;
            END_IF;
          ELSE
            IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].ActualPos - TO_LREAL(pDrawerParam2[TO_INT(Current_Drawer_ID)])) <= WH_Eps THEN
              arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
              WH_X_MoveRequested := FALSE;
              WH_X_Done := TRUE;

              PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_RACKCHANGE_R_TO_DROP_REQ;
            ELSE
              arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(pDrawerParam2[TO_INT(Current_Drawer_ID)]);
              arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
              WH_X_MoveRequested := TRUE;
              WH_X_Done := FALSE;

              PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_RACKCHANGE_X_TO_CURRENT_DRAWER_WAIT;
            END_IF;
          END_IF;

        ELSE
          LoadError := TRUE;
        END_IF;

      PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_RACKCHANGE_X_TO_CURRENT_DRAWER_WAIT:
        IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
           (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
          PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_RACKCHANGE_X_TO_CURRENT_DRAWER_REQ;
        END_IF;

        IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
          WH_X_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          WH_X_Done := TRUE;

          PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_RACKCHANGE_R_TO_DROP_REQ;
        END_IF;

      PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_RACKCHANGE_R_TO_DROP_REQ:
        arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].TargetPos := -10.0;
        arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
        WH_R_MoveRequested := TRUE;
        WH_R_Done := FALSE;

        PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_RACKCHANGE_R_TO_DROP_WAIT;

      PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_RACKCHANGE_R_TO_DROP_WAIT:
        IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
           (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
          PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_RACKCHANGE_R_TO_DROP_REQ;
        END_IF;

        IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
          WH_R_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          WH_R_Done := TRUE;

          PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_RACKCHANGE_WAIT_RACK_RELEASED;
        END_IF;

      PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_RACKCHANGE_WAIT_RACK_RELEASED:
        IF NOT Fmsc_PLC_IO.Rack_Presence THEN
          PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_RACKCHANGE_CLEAR_CURRENT_INFO;
        END_IF;

      PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_RACKCHANGE_CLEAR_CURRENT_INFO:
        Current_Rack_ID := 0;
        Current_Rack_Type := 0;
        Current_Drawer_ID := 0;

        WH_NeedRackChange := FALSE;
        WH_NeedRackBring := TRUE;
        WH_SameRack := FALSE;

        WH_R_MoveRequested := FALSE;
        WH_X_MoveRequested := FALSE;
        WH_R_Done := FALSE;
        WH_X_Done := FALSE;
        WH_WaitRackInPos := FALSE;

        WH_R_LoadRequested := FALSE;
        WH_R_LoadDone := FALSE;
        R_Not_Safety_Zone := FALSE;
        Rack_Presence_Error := FALSE;

        PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_UNLOCK_CHECK;

      PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_UNLOCK_CHECK:
        IF NOT (Fmsc_PLC_IO.Carriage_Unlocked_Left AND Fmsc_PLC_IO.Carriage_Unlocked_Right) THEN
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Carriage_UnLocking_Valve := TRUE;
        ELSE
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Carriage_UnLocking_Valve := FALSE;

          IF R_Not_Safety_Zone THEN
            PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_WAIT_R_SAFEZONE;
          ELSE
            PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_R_TO_PICKUP_REQ;
          END_IF
        END_IF;

      PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_WAIT_R_SAFEZONE:
        IF arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].ActualPos < TO_LREAL(Retain_RParameters[7]) THEN
          R_Not_Safety_Zone := FALSE;
          PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_R_TO_PICKUP_REQ;
        END_IF;

      PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_R_TO_PICKUP_REQ:
        IF arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].ActualPos < TO_LREAL(Retain_RParameters[7]) THEN
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].TargetPos := -10.0;
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
          WH_R_MoveRequested := TRUE;
          WH_R_Done := FALSE;

          PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_R_TO_PICKUP_WAIT;
        ELSE
          R_Not_Safety_Zone := TRUE;
          WH_R_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          WH_R_Done := FALSE;
          PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_WAIT_R_SAFEZONE;
        END_IF;

      PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_R_TO_PICKUP_WAIT:
        IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
           (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].ActualPos - (-10.0)) > WH_Eps) THEN
          PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_R_TO_PICKUP_REQ;
        END_IF;

        IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].ActualPos - (-10.0)) <= WH_Eps THEN
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
          WH_R_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          WH_R_Done := TRUE;

          PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_X_TO_DRAWER_REQ;
        END_IF;

      PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_X_TO_DRAWER_REQ:
        IF WH_TargetDrawerIdx >= 1 THEN

          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].ActualPos - TO_LREAL(pDrawerParam2[WH_TargetDrawerIdx])) <= WH_Eps THEN
            WH_X_Done := TRUE;
            WH_X_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_R_LIFT_REQ;
          ELSE
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(pDrawerParam2[WH_TargetDrawerIdx]);
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
            WH_X_MoveRequested := TRUE;
            WH_X_Done := FALSE;

            PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_X_TO_DRAWER_WAIT;
          END_IF

        ELSE
          LoadError := TRUE;
        END_IF;

      PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_X_TO_DRAWER_WAIT:
        IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
           (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
          PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_X_TO_DRAWER_REQ;
        END_IF;

        IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
          WH_X_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          WH_X_Done := TRUE;

          PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_R_LIFT_REQ;
        END_IF;

      PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_R_LIFT_REQ:
        arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(Retain_RParameters[3]);
        arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
        WH_R_LoadRequested := TRUE;
        WH_R_LoadDone := FALSE;
        Rack_Presence_Error := FALSE;

        PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_R_LIFT_WAIT;

      PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_R_LIFT_WAIT:
        IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
           (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
          PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_R_LIFT_REQ;
        END_IF;

        IF arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].ActualPos >= TO_LREAL(Retain_RParameters[7]) THEN

          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Rack_Presence THEN
            Current_Rack_ID := WH_TargetRackID;
            Current_Rack_Type := 1;
            Current_Drawer_ID := WH_TargetDrawerIdx;
          ELSE
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            WH_R_LoadRequested := FALSE;
            WH_R_LoadDone := FALSE;
            Rack_Presence_Error := TRUE;

            General_Stop := TRUE;
            General_Start := FALSE;

            PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_ERROR_RACK_PRESENCE;
          END_IF

        END_IF

        IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
          WH_R_LoadRequested := FALSE;
          WH_R_LoadDone := TRUE;
          Rack_Presence_Error := FALSE;

          PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_WAIT_RACK_IN_POS;
        END_IF;

      PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_WAIT_RACK_IN_POS:
        WH_WaitRackInPos := (WH_R_LoadDone AND WH_X_Done);

        IF WH_WaitRackInPos THEN
          PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_DONE;
        END_IF;

      PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_ERROR_RACK_PRESENCE:
        WH_WaitRackInPos := FALSE;

        IF arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].ActualPos < TO_LREAL(Retain_RParameters[7]) THEN
          Rack_Presence_Error := FALSE;
          PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_R_LIFT_REQ;
        END_IF;

      PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_DONE:
        Local_WareHouse_State := WareHouse_States.L_Punches_rack_taken;
        PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L10_INIT;

      PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L10_INIT:
        WH_X_MoveRequested := FALSE;
        WH_X_Done := FALSE;
        WH_R_MoveRequested := FALSE;
        WH_R_Done := FALSE;

        PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L10_X_TO_PICKPOS_REQ;

      PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L10_X_TO_PICKPOS_REQ:
        IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].ActualPos - TO_LREAL(Retain_XParameters[2])) <= WH_Eps THEN
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
          WH_X_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          WH_X_Done := TRUE;
          PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L10_R_TO_PICKPOS_REQ;
        ELSE
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(Retain_XParameters[2]);
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
          WH_X_MoveRequested := TRUE;
          WH_X_Done := FALSE;

          PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L10_X_TO_PICKPOS_WAIT;
        END_IF;

      PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L10_X_TO_PICKPOS_WAIT:
        IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
           (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
          PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L10_X_TO_PICKPOS_REQ;
        END_IF;

        IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
          WH_X_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          WH_X_Done := TRUE;

          PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L10_R_TO_PICKPOS_REQ;
        END_IF;

      PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L10_R_TO_PICKPOS_REQ:
        IF (WH_TargetDrawerIdx >= 1) AND (WH_TargetDrawerIdx <= 16) THEN

          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].ActualPos - TO_LREAL(pDrawerParam1[WH_TargetDrawerIdx])) <= WH_Eps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            WH_R_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            WH_R_Done := TRUE;
            PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L10_DONE;
          ELSE
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(pDrawerParam1[WH_TargetDrawerIdx]);
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
            WH_R_MoveRequested := TRUE;
            WH_R_Done := FALSE;

            PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L10_R_TO_PICKPOS_WAIT;
          END_IF

        ELSE
          LoadError := TRUE;
        END_IF;

      PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L10_R_TO_PICKPOS_WAIT:
        IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
           (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
          PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L10_R_TO_PICKPOS_REQ;
        END_IF;

        IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
          WH_R_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          WH_R_Done := TRUE;

          PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L10_DONE;
        END_IF;

      PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L10_DONE:
        Local_WareHouse_State := WareHouse_States.L_PDrawer_pickup_Pos_reached;
        PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L11_INIT;

      PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L11_INIT:
        WH_X_MoveRequested := FALSE;
        WH_X_Done := FALSE;
        WH_R_MoveRequested := FALSE;
        WH_R_Done := FALSE;

        PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L11_LOCK_CMD;

      PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L11_LOCK_CMD:
        Fmsc_PLC_IO.Carriage_UnLocking_Valve := FALSE;
        Fmsc_PLC_IO.Carriage_Locking_Valve := TRUE;

        PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L11_WAIT_LOCKED;

      PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L11_WAIT_LOCKED:
        IF (Fmsc_PLC_IO.Carriage_Locked_Left AND Fmsc_PLC_IO.Carriage_Locked_Right) THEN
          PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L11_DONE;
        END_IF;

      PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L11_DONE:
        Local_WareHouse_State := WareHouse_States.L_PPickup_from_drawer_allowed;
        PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L12_INIT;

      PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L12_INIT:
        WH_X_MoveRequested := FALSE;
        WH_X_Done := FALSE;
        WH_R_MoveRequested := FALSE;
        WH_R_Done := FALSE;

        PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L12_SET_CURRENT_RACK;

      PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L12_SET_CURRENT_RACK:
        PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L12_VERIFY_CURRENT_RACK;

      PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L12_VERIFY_CURRENT_RACK:
        IF (TO_INT(Current_Rack_ID) = WH_TargetRackID) AND
           (Current_Rack_Type = 1) AND
           (Current_Drawer_ID = WH_TargetDrawerIdx) THEN
          PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L12_DONE;
        END_IF;

      PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L12_DONE:
        PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L12_DONE;

    ELSE
      PLoad_WH_SubStates := PLoad_WH_SubState.PLD_L09_INIT;
    END_CASE;

    IF WH_R_LoadDone AND WH_X_Done THEN
      WH_WaitRackInPos := TRUE;
    ELSE
      WH_WaitRackInPos := FALSE;
    END_IF;

  END_IF
END_IF
```

          PLoad_SH_SubStates := PLoad_SH_SubState.PLD_L10_Z_DR_TO_WH_PICKPOS_REQ;

        PLoad_SH_SubState.PLD_L10_Z_DR_TO_WH_PICKPOS_REQ:
          IF Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,2] <> '' THEN

            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,5]);

            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;

            SH_Z_MoveRequested := TRUE;

            PLoad_SH_SubStates := PLoad_SH_SubState.PLD_L10_Z_DR_TO_WH_PICKPOS_WAIT;
