```
FUNCTION_BLOCK PunchChanger
VAR_INPUT
	Trigger : BOOL ;
	Unload: BOOL;
END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT RETAIN
  ValidityFlag   : BOOL;                         (* TRUE if all requested tools exist in ATC *)
  PerIndexStatus : ARRAY[1..15] OF PIndexStatus; (* SAME or DIFF for each index *)
  PackageState   : PPackageState;                (* overall package classification *)
  NextActionHint : PNextActionHint;              (* suggested primary action *)

  numSame  : INT;
  numDiff  : INT;
  newCount : INT;
  oldCount : INT;

  ErrorText : STRING(200);

  Error : BOOL;
  Busy  : BOOL;
  Done  : BOOL;
END_VAR

VAR RETAIN

  i : INT;
  j : INT;
  k : INT;
  assigned:BOOL;
  foundIndex : INT;

  usedSlot :ARRAY [1..16, 1..15] OF BOOL;
  OldAssignedDrawer:ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  OldAssignedSlot:ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;

  NewAssignedDrawer:ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  NewAssignedSlot   : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  origNewIdx:INT;
  NewName : STRING(100);
  OldName : STRING(100);
  NewLen : STRING(100);
  NewLenReal : REAL;
  NewHorn : STRING(100);
  NewHornReal : REAL;
  OldLen : STRING(100);
  OldLenReal : REAL;
  OldHorn : STRING(100);
  NewRot : STRING(100);
  OldRot : STRING(100);

  eps : REAL := 0.001;

  foundLengthMatch : BOOL;
  hasLengthValue : BOOL;

  KeepList : ARRAY[1..15] OF BOOL;
  ReplaceList : ARRAY[1..15] OF BOOL;
  LoadOnlyList : ARRAY[1..15] OF BOOL;
  UnloadOnlyList : ARRAY[1..15] OF BOOL;
  OldMatched : ARRAY[1..15] OF BOOL;
  NewMatchedToOld : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;

  (* Temporary arrays for ordered packing *)
  UnloadTempCount : INT;
  UnloadTempOrigIndex : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;   (* original OLD index *)
  UnloadTempDrawerIdx : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  UnloadTempOrder : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;

  LoadTempCount : INT;
  LoadTempOrigIndex : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;     (* original NEW index *)
  LoadTempDrawerIdx : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  LoadTempOrder : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;

  KeepTempCount : INT;
  KeepTempOrigIndex : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;     (* original OLD index *)
  KeepTempDrawerIdx : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  KeepTempOrder : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;

  a : INT;
  b : INT;
  minIdx : INT;
  tmpInt : INT;

  (* Consume-old matching helpers *)
  OldAvailCount : INT;
  OldAvailIndex : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT; (* indices of available old entries *)

  (* ATC mapping iterators/temps as requested: c - row, d - slot, e - drawer *)
  c : INT; (* row iterator for UnloadPunchList / ATCUnloadPunchList *)
  d : INT; (* slot iterator *)
  e : INT; (* drawer iterator *)
  m : INT;
  UnloadCount: INT;
  LoadCount:INT;
  KeepCount :INT;
  lenStr : STRING(100);
  posStr : STRING(100);
  hornStr : STRING(100);
  lenRealLocal : REAL;
  hornRealLocal : REAL;

  (* multiplicity check temps *)
  neededCount : INT;
  availCount : INT;
  skipTriple : BOOL := FALSE;
  uniqCount : INT;
  uniqName : ARRAY[1..15] OF STRING(100);
  uniqLen  : ARRAY[1..15] OF STRING(100);
  uniqHorn : ARRAY[1..15] OF STRING(100);
  uniqNeeded : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;

  (* NEW: load slot selection helper *)
  IsBottomDrawer : BOOL;
  foundSlotCount : INT;
  candidateSlot   : INT;
  bestSlot        : INT;
END_VAR

VAR
	eTmp : INT;
	dTmp : INT;
END_VAR
```
```
(* Main execution: run on rising edge of Trigger or Unload *)
IF Unload THEN
  (* initialize *)
  Busy := TRUE;
  Done := FALSE;
  Error := FALSE;
  ErrorText := '';
  ValidityFlag := TRUE;

  numSame := 0;
  numDiff := 0;
  newCount := 0;
  oldCount := 0;

  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    KeepList[i] := FALSE;
    ReplaceList[i] := FALSE;
    LoadOnlyList[i] := FALSE;
    UnloadOnlyList[i] := FALSE;
    PerIndexStatus[i] := PIndexStatus.SAME;
    OldMatched[i] := FALSE;
    NewMatchedToOld[i] := 0;
  END_FOR;

  (* Clear all target global retain arrays before packing *)
  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
      Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,j] := '';
      Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[i,j] := '';
      Retain_LoadPunchList[i,j] := '';
      Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[i,j] := '';
      Retain_KeepPunchList[i,j] := '';
      Retain_KeepPunchListNew[i,j] := '';
    END_FOR;
  END_FOR;

  (* Build unload candidates only from current physical state PFields_Old *)
  UnloadTempCount := 0;
  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    IF PFields_Old[i,3] <> '' THEN
      oldCount := oldCount + 1;
      UnloadOnlyList[i] := TRUE;

      foundIndex := 0;
      FOR k := 1 TO 16 DO
        IF pDrawerName[k] = PFields_Old[i,3] THEN
          foundIndex := k;
          EXIT;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;

      IF foundIndex <> 0 THEN
        UnloadTempCount := UnloadTempCount + 1;
        UnloadTempOrigIndex[UnloadTempCount] := i;
        UnloadTempDrawerIdx[UnloadTempCount] := foundIndex;
        UnloadTempOrder[UnloadTempCount] := UnloadTempCount;
      END_IF;

      PerIndexStatus[i] := PIndexStatus.DIFF;
    ELSE
      PerIndexStatus[i] := PIndexStatus.SAME;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  numSame := 0;
  numDiff := oldCount;
  newCount := 0;

  FOR a := 1 TO UnloadTempCount - 1 DO
    minIdx := a;
    FOR b := a + 1 TO UnloadTempCount DO
      IF UnloadTempDrawerIdx[b] < UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] THEN
        minIdx := b;
      ELSIF (UnloadTempDrawerIdx[b] = UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx]) AND (UnloadTempOrder[b] < UnloadTempOrder[minIdx]) THEN
        minIdx := b;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    IF minIdx <> a THEN
      tmpInt := UnloadTempOrigIndex[a];
      UnloadTempOrigIndex[a] := UnloadTempOrigIndex[minIdx];
      UnloadTempOrigIndex[minIdx] := tmpInt;

      tmpInt := UnloadTempDrawerIdx[a];
      UnloadTempDrawerIdx[a] := UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx];
      UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] := tmpInt;

      tmpInt := UnloadTempOrder[a];
      UnloadTempOrder[a] := UnloadTempOrder[minIdx];
      UnloadTempOrder[minIdx] := tmpInt;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  UnloadCount := 0;
  FOR a := 1 TO UnloadTempCount DO
    UnloadCount := UnloadCount + 1;
    i := UnloadTempOrigIndex[a];
    FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
      Retain_UnloadPunchList[UnloadCount, j] := PFields_Old[i, j];
    END_FOR;
    Retain_UnloadPunchList[UnloadCount, 12] := INT_TO_STRING(i);
  END_FOR;

  FOR c := 1 TO 15 DO
    FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
      Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c, j] := '';
    END_FOR;
  END_FOR;

  FOR c := 1 TO UnloadCount DO
    tmpInt := UnloadTempOrigIndex[c];

    IF (tmpInt >= 1) AND (tmpInt <= 15) AND (PFields_Old[tmpInt,10] <> '') AND (PFields_Old[tmpInt,11] <> '') THEN
      e := STRING_TO_INT(PFields_Old[tmpInt,10]);
      d := STRING_TO_INT(PFields_Old[tmpInt,11]);

      IF (e >= 1) AND (e <= 16) AND (d >= 1) AND (d <= 15) THEN
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,1] := pDrawerName[e];
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,2] := PFields_Old[tmpInt,10];
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,3] := PFields_Old[tmpInt,11];
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,4] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchLength[e,d]);
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,5] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchPosition[e,d]);
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,6] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchHorn[e,d]);
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,12] := INT_TO_STRING(tmpInt);
      END_IF;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  PackageState := PPackageState.PARTIAL_CHANGE;
  NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.NO_ACTION;
  ValidityFlag := TRUE;

  Busy := FALSE;
  Done := TRUE;

ELSIF Trigger THEN
  (* initialize *)
  Busy := TRUE;
  Done := FALSE;
  Error := FALSE;
  ErrorText := '';
  ValidityFlag := TRUE;

  numSame := 0;
  numDiff := 0;
  newCount := 0;
  oldCount := 0;

  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    KeepList[i] := FALSE;
    ReplaceList[i] := FALSE;
    LoadOnlyList[i] := FALSE;
    UnloadOnlyList[i] := FALSE;
    PerIndexStatus[i] := PIndexStatus.SAME;
    OldMatched[i] := FALSE;
    NewMatchedToOld[i] := 0;
  END_FOR;

  (* STEP 1: basic ATC existence + requested length presence check for all requested new entries
     NOTE: PunchUsed is NOT checked here. Keep matching happens later. *)
  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    NewName := PFields[i,3];

    IF NewName <> '' THEN
      newCount := newCount + 1;
      NewLen := PFields[i,7];

      foundIndex := 0;
      FOR j := 1 TO 16 DO
        IF pDrawerName[j] = NewName THEN
          foundIndex := j;
          EXIT;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;

      IF foundIndex = 0 THEN
        ValidityFlag := FALSE;
        PackageState := PPackageState.INVALID;
        NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.INVALID_ABORT;
        Error := TRUE;
        ErrorText := CONCAT('INVALID: missing ATC tool name: ', NewName);

        FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
          FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
            PFields[i,j] := '';
          END_FOR;
        END_FOR;

        Busy := FALSE;
        Done := TRUE;
        RETURN;
      END_IF;

      IF NewLen = '' THEN
        ValidityFlag := FALSE;
        PackageState := PPackageState.INVALID;
        NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.INVALID_ABORT;
        Error := TRUE;
        ErrorText := CONCAT('INVALID: missing length for tool: ', NewName);

        FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
          FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
            PFields[i,j] := '';
          END_FOR;
        END_FOR;

        Busy := FALSE;
        Done := TRUE;
        RETURN;
      END_IF;

      foundLengthMatch := FALSE;
      hasLengthValue := FALSE;
      NewLenReal := 0.0;

      IF NewLen <> '' THEN
        NewLenReal := STRING_TO_REAL(NewLen);
        hasLengthValue := TRUE;
      END_IF;

      IF hasLengthValue THEN
        FOR j := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[j] = NewName THEN
            FOR k := 1 TO 15 DO
              IF ABS(PunchLength[j, k] - NewLenReal) <= eps THEN
                foundLengthMatch := TRUE;
                EXIT;
              END_IF;
            END_FOR;

            IF foundLengthMatch THEN
              EXIT;
            END_IF;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
      END_IF;

      IF NOT foundLengthMatch THEN
        ValidityFlag := FALSE;
        PackageState := PPackageState.INVALID;
        NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.INVALID_ABORT;
        Error := TRUE;
        ErrorText := CONCAT('INVALID: requested length NOT found FOR tool: ', NewName);

        FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
          FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
            PFields[i,j] := '';
          END_FOR;
        END_FOR;

        Busy := FALSE;
        Done := TRUE;
        RETURN;
      END_IF;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  (* STEP 2: Deterministic one-to-one keep matching (consume-old approach) *)
  OldAvailCount := 0;
  FOR j := 1 TO 15 DO
    OldName := PFields_Old[j,3];
    IF OldName <> '' THEN
      OldAvailCount := OldAvailCount + 1;
      OldAvailIndex[OldAvailCount] := j;
      OldMatched[j] := FALSE;
      oldCount := oldCount + 1;
    ELSE
      OldMatched[j] := FALSE;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    NewName := PFields[i,3];
    IF NewName <> '' THEN
      NewLen := PFields[i,7];
      NewHorn := PFields[i,9];
      NewRot := PFields[i,8];
      NewLenReal := 0.0;
      IF NewLen <> '' THEN
        NewLenReal := STRING_TO_REAL(NewLen);
      END_IF;

      NewMatchedToOld[i] := 0;
      a := 1;
      WHILE (a <= OldAvailCount) AND (NewMatchedToOld[i] = 0) DO
        j := OldAvailIndex[a];
        OldName := PFields_Old[j,3];
        IF OldName <> '' THEN
          OldLen := PFields_Old[j,7];
          OldHorn := PFields_Old[j,9];
          OldRot := PFields_Old[j,8];

          OldLenReal := 0.0;
          IF OldLen <> '' THEN
            OldLenReal := STRING_TO_REAL(OldLen);
          END_IF;

          IF (NewName = OldName) AND (NewHorn = OldHorn) AND (NewRot = OldRot) AND (ABS(NewLenReal - OldLenReal) <= eps) THEN
            OldMatched[j] := TRUE;
            KeepList[j] := TRUE;
            NewMatchedToOld[i] := j;

            FOR b := a TO OldAvailCount - 1 DO
              OldAvailIndex[b] := OldAvailIndex[b + 1];
            END_FOR;
            OldAvailCount := OldAvailCount - 1;
          ELSE
            a := a + 1;
          END_IF;
        ELSE
          a := a + 1;
        END_IF;
      END_WHILE;

      IF NewMatchedToOld[i] = 0 THEN
        LoadOnlyList[i] := TRUE;
      END_IF;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  FOR a := 1 TO OldAvailCount DO
    j := OldAvailIndex[a];
    IF PFields_Old[j,3] <> '' THEN
      UnloadOnlyList[j] := TRUE;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  (* STEP 3: PunchUsed-based validation ONLY for load-only punches *)
  (* 3a - per-load-only length availability in physically present ATC punches *)
  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    IF LoadOnlyList[i] THEN
      NewName := PFields[i,3];
      NewLen := PFields[i,7];

      foundLengthMatch := FALSE;
      hasLengthValue := FALSE;
      NewLenReal := 0.0;

      IF NewLen <> '' THEN
        NewLenReal := STRING_TO_REAL(NewLen);
        hasLengthValue := TRUE;
      END_IF;

      IF hasLengthValue THEN
        FOR j := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[j] = NewName THEN
            FOR k := 1 TO 15 DO
              IF (NOT PunchUsed[j,k]) AND (ABS(PunchLength[j, k] - NewLenReal) <= eps) THEN
                foundLengthMatch := TRUE;
                EXIT;
              END_IF;
            END_FOR;

            IF foundLengthMatch THEN
              EXIT;
            END_IF;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
      END_IF;

      IF NOT foundLengthMatch THEN
        ValidityFlag := FALSE;
        PackageState := PPackageState.INVALID;
        NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.INVALID_ABORT;
        Error := TRUE;
        ErrorText := CONCAT('INVALID: requested load punch length NOT available in free ATC punches FOR tool: ', NewName);

        FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
          FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
            PFields[i,j] := '';
          END_FOR;
        END_FOR;

        Busy := FALSE;
        Done := TRUE;
        RETURN;
      END_IF;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  (* 3b - multiplicity check ONLY for load-only punches *)
  uniqCount := 0;
  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    IF LoadOnlyList[i] THEN
      foundIndex := 0;
      FOR a := 1 TO uniqCount DO
        IF (uniqName[a] = PFields[i,3]) AND (uniqLen[a] = PFields[i,7]) AND (uniqHorn[a] = PFields[i,9]) THEN
          foundIndex := a;
          EXIT;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;

      IF foundIndex = 0 THEN
        uniqCount := uniqCount + 1;
        uniqName[uniqCount] := PFields[i,3];
        uniqLen[uniqCount] := PFields[i,7];
        uniqHorn[uniqCount] := PFields[i,9];
        uniqNeeded[uniqCount] := 1;
      ELSE
        uniqNeeded[foundIndex] := uniqNeeded[foundIndex] + 1;
      END_IF;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  FOR a := 1 TO uniqCount DO
    NewName := uniqName[a];
    NewLen := uniqLen[a];
    NewHorn := uniqHorn[a];

    foundIndex := 0;
    FOR e := 1 TO 16 DO
      IF pDrawerName[e] = NewName THEN
        foundIndex := e;
        EXIT;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    IF foundIndex = 0 THEN
      ValidityFlag := FALSE;
      PackageState := PPackageState.INVALID;
      NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.INVALID_ABORT;
      Error := TRUE;
      ErrorText := CONCAT('INVALID (load multiplicity): missing drawer for ', NewName);

      FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
        FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
          PFields[i,j] := '';
        END_FOR;
      END_FOR;

      Busy := FALSE;
      Done := TRUE;
      RETURN;
    END_IF;

    availCount := 0;
    IF (NewLen <> '') AND (NewHorn <> '') THEN
      NewLenReal := STRING_TO_REAL(NewLen);
      NewHornReal := STRING_TO_REAL(NewHorn);

      FOR e := 1 TO 16 DO
        IF pDrawerName[e] = NewName THEN
          FOR d := 1 TO 15 DO
            IF (NOT PunchUsed[e,d]) AND
               (ABS(PunchLength[e,d] - NewLenReal) <= eps) AND
               (ABS(PunchHorn[e,d] - NewHornReal) <= eps) THEN
              availCount := availCount + 1;
            END_IF;
          END_FOR;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;
    END_IF;

    IF availCount < uniqNeeded[a] THEN
      ValidityFlag := FALSE;
      PackageState := PPackageState.INVALID;
      NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.INVALID_ABORT;
      Error := TRUE;
      ErrorText := CONCAT('INVALID: insufficient FREE ATC slots for load tool ', NewName);
      ErrorText := CONCAT(ErrorText, CONCAT(' len=', NewLen));
      ErrorText := CONCAT(ErrorText, CONCAT(' horn=', NewHorn));
      ErrorText := CONCAT(ErrorText, CONCAT(' needed=', INT_TO_STRING(uniqNeeded[a])));
      ErrorText := CONCAT(ErrorText, CONCAT(' available=', INT_TO_STRING(availCount)));

      FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
        FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
          PFields[i,j] := '';
        END_FOR;
      END_FOR;

      Busy := FALSE;
      Done := TRUE;
      RETURN;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  (* Compute summary counters *)
  numSame := 0;
  numDiff := 0;
  FOR j := 1 TO 15 DO
    IF KeepList[j] THEN
      numSame := numSame + 1;
    END_IF;
    IF UnloadOnlyList[j] THEN
      numDiff := numDiff + 1;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;
  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    IF LoadOnlyList[i] THEN
      numDiff := numDiff + 1;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    OldName := PFields_Old[i,3];
    NewName := PFields[i,3];
    IF KeepList[i] THEN
      PerIndexStatus[i] := PIndexStatus.SAME;
    ELSIF (OldName = '') AND (NewName = '') THEN
      PerIndexStatus[i] := PIndexStatus.SAME;
    ELSE
      PerIndexStatus[i] := PIndexStatus.DIFF;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  IF NOT ValidityFlag THEN
    PackageState := PPackageState.INVALID;
    NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.INVALID_ABORT;
  ELSE
    PackageState := PPackageState.PARTIAL_CHANGE;
    NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.NO_ACTION;
  END_IF;

  ValidityFlag := NOT Error;

  IF PackageState <> PPackageState.INVALID THEN
    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_LoadPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_KeepPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_KeepPunchListNew[i,j] := '';
      END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Pack UnloadPunchList *)
    UnloadTempCount := 0;
    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      IF UnloadOnlyList[i] THEN
        foundIndex := 0;
        FOR k := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[k] = PFields_Old[i,3] THEN
            foundIndex := k;
            EXIT;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
        IF foundIndex <> 0 THEN
          UnloadTempCount := UnloadTempCount + 1;
          UnloadTempOrigIndex[UnloadTempCount] := i;
          UnloadTempDrawerIdx[UnloadTempCount] := foundIndex;
          UnloadTempOrder[UnloadTempCount] := UnloadTempCount;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    FOR a := 1 TO UnloadTempCount - 1 DO
      minIdx := a;
      FOR b := a + 1 TO UnloadTempCount DO
        IF UnloadTempDrawerIdx[b] < UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] THEN
          minIdx := b;
        ELSIF (UnloadTempDrawerIdx[b] = UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx]) AND (UnloadTempOrder[b] < UnloadTempOrder[minIdx]) THEN
          minIdx := b;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;
      IF minIdx <> a THEN
        tmpInt := UnloadTempOrigIndex[a];
        UnloadTempOrigIndex[a] := UnloadTempOrigIndex[minIdx];
        UnloadTempOrigIndex[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := UnloadTempDrawerIdx[a];
        UnloadTempDrawerIdx[a] := UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx];
        UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := UnloadTempOrder[a];
        UnloadTempOrder[a] := UnloadTempOrder[minIdx];
        UnloadTempOrder[minIdx] := tmpInt;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    UnloadCount := 0;
    FOR a := 1 TO UnloadTempCount DO
      UnloadCount := UnloadCount + 1;
      i := UnloadTempOrigIndex[a];
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_UnloadPunchList[UnloadCount, j] := PFields_Old[i, j];
      END_FOR;
      Retain_UnloadPunchList[UnloadCount, 12] := INT_TO_STRING(i);
    END_FOR;

    (* Pack LoadPunchList *)
    LoadTempCount := 0;
    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      IF LoadOnlyList[i] THEN
        foundIndex := 0;
        FOR k := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[k] = PFields[i,3] THEN
            foundIndex := k;
            EXIT;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
        IF foundIndex <> 0 THEN
          LoadTempCount := LoadTempCount + 1;
          LoadTempOrigIndex[LoadTempCount] := i;
          LoadTempDrawerIdx[LoadTempCount] := foundIndex;
          LoadTempOrder[LoadTempCount] := LoadTempCount;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    FOR a := 1 TO LoadTempCount - 1 DO
      minIdx := a;
      FOR b := a + 1 TO LoadTempCount DO
        IF LoadTempDrawerIdx[b] < LoadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] THEN
          minIdx := b;
        ELSIF (LoadTempDrawerIdx[b] = LoadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx]) AND (LoadTempOrder[b] < LoadTempOrder[minIdx]) THEN
          minIdx := b;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;
      IF minIdx <> a THEN
        tmpInt := LoadTempOrigIndex[a];
        LoadTempOrigIndex[a] := LoadTempOrigIndex[minIdx];
        LoadTempOrigIndex[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := LoadTempDrawerIdx[a];
        LoadTempDrawerIdx[a] := LoadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx];
        LoadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := LoadTempOrder[a];
        LoadTempOrder[a] := LoadTempOrder[minIdx];
        LoadTempOrder[minIdx] := tmpInt;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    LoadCount := 0;
    FOR a := 1 TO LoadTempCount DO
      LoadCount := LoadCount + 1;
      i := LoadTempOrigIndex[a];
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_LoadPunchList[LoadCount, j] := PFields[i, j];
      END_FOR;
      Retain_LoadPunchList[LoadCount, 12] := INT_TO_STRING(i);
    END_FOR;

    (* ATC load mapping - PunchUsed applies only here and in load-only validation above *)
    FOR c := 1 TO 15 DO
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c, j] := '';
      END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    FOR e := 1 TO 16 DO
      FOR d := 1 TO 15 DO
        usedSlot[e,d] := FALSE;
      END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      NewAssignedDrawer[i] := 0;
      NewAssignedSlot[i] := 0;
    END_FOR;

    FOR c := 1 TO LoadCount DO
      origNewIdx := LoadTempOrigIndex[c];
      NewName := Retain_LoadPunchList[c,3];
      lenStr := Retain_LoadPunchList[c,7];
      hornStr := Retain_LoadPunchList[c,9];

      foundIndex := 0;
      IsBottomDrawer := FALSE;

      IF (NewName <> '') AND (lenStr <> '') AND (hornStr <> '') THEN
        lenRealLocal := STRING_TO_REAL(lenStr);
        hornRealLocal := STRING_TO_REAL(hornStr);

        FOR e := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[e] = NewName THEN

            IF (e = 4) OR (e = 8) OR (e = 12) OR (e = 16) THEN
              IsBottomDrawer := TRUE;
            ELSE
              IsBottomDrawer := FALSE;
            END_IF;

            foundSlotCount := 0;
            bestSlot := 0;

            IF IsBottomDrawer THEN
              (* Bottom drawer: choose first valid slot *)
              FOR d := 1 TO 15 DO
                IF (NOT usedSlot[e,d]) AND (NOT PunchUsed[e,d]) THEN
                  IF (ABS(PunchLength[e,d] - lenRealLocal) <= eps) AND
                     (ABS(PunchHorn[e,d] - hornRealLocal) <= eps) THEN
                    foundSlotCount := foundSlotCount + 1;
                    IF bestSlot = 0 THEN
                      bestSlot := d;
                    END_IF;
                  END_IF;
                END_IF;
              END_FOR;
            ELSE
              (* Non-bottom drawer: choose rightmost valid slot *)
              FOR d := 1 TO 15 DO
                IF (NOT usedSlot[e,d]) AND (NOT PunchUsed[e,d]) THEN
                  IF (ABS(PunchLength[e,d] - lenRealLocal) <= eps) AND
                     (ABS(PunchHorn[e,d] - hornRealLocal) <= eps) THEN
                    foundSlotCount := foundSlotCount + 1;
                    bestSlot := d;
                  END_IF;
                END_IF;
              END_FOR;
            END_IF;

            IF bestSlot <> 0 THEN
              usedSlot[e,bestSlot] := TRUE;
              foundIndex := e;

              Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,1] := pDrawerName[e];
              Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,2] := INT_TO_STRING(e);
              Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,3] := INT_TO_STRING(bestSlot);
              Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,4] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchLength[e,bestSlot]);
              Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,5] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchPosition[e,bestSlot]);
              Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,6] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchHorn[e,bestSlot]);
              Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,12] := INT_TO_STRING(origNewIdx);

              NewAssignedDrawer[origNewIdx] := e;
              NewAssignedSlot[origNewIdx] := bestSlot;
            END_IF;

            EXIT;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    (* Pack KeepPunchList old + corresponding new *)
    KeepTempCount := 0;
    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      IF KeepList[i] THEN
        foundIndex := 0;
        FOR k := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[k] = PFields_Old[i,3] THEN
            foundIndex := k;
            EXIT;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
        IF foundIndex <> 0 THEN
          KeepTempCount := KeepTempCount + 1;
          KeepTempOrigIndex[KeepTempCount] := i;
          KeepTempDrawerIdx[KeepTempCount] := foundIndex;
          KeepTempOrder[KeepTempCount] := KeepTempCount;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    FOR a := 1 TO KeepTempCount - 1 DO
      minIdx := a;
      FOR b := a + 1 TO KeepTempCount DO
        IF KeepTempDrawerIdx[b] < KeepTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] THEN
          minIdx := b;
        ELSIF (KeepTempDrawerIdx[b] = KeepTempDrawerIdx[minIdx]) AND (KeepTempOrder[b] < KeepTempOrder[minIdx]) THEN
          minIdx := b;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;
      IF minIdx <> a THEN
        tmpInt := KeepTempOrigIndex[a];
        KeepTempOrigIndex[a] := KeepTempOrigIndex[minIdx];
        KeepTempOrigIndex[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := KeepTempDrawerIdx[a];
        KeepTempDrawerIdx[a] := KeepTempDrawerIdx[minIdx];
        KeepTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := KeepTempOrder[a];
        KeepTempOrder[a] := KeepTempOrder[minIdx];
        KeepTempOrder[minIdx] := tmpInt;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    KeepCount := 0;
    FOR a := 1 TO KeepTempCount DO
      KeepCount := KeepCount + 1;
      i := KeepTempOrigIndex[a];
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_KeepPunchList[KeepCount, j] := PFields_Old[i, j];
        Retain_KeepPunchListNew[KeepCount, j] := '';
      END_FOR;
      Retain_KeepPunchList[KeepCount, 12] := INT_TO_STRING(i);

      tmpInt := 0;
      FOR b := 1 TO 15 DO
        IF NewMatchedToOld[b] = i THEN
          tmpInt := b;
          EXIT;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;

      IF tmpInt <> 0 THEN
        FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
          Retain_KeepPunchListNew[KeepCount, j] := PFields[tmpInt, j];
        END_FOR;
        Retain_KeepPunchListNew[KeepCount, 12] := INT_TO_STRING(tmpInt);
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    (* ATC unload mapping uses PFields_Old[,10]=drawer and [,11]=slot *)
    FOR c := 1 TO 15 DO
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c, j] := '';
      END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    FOR c := 1 TO UnloadCount DO
      tmpInt := UnloadTempOrigIndex[c];

      IF (tmpInt >= 1) AND (tmpInt <= 15) AND (PFields_Old[tmpInt,10] <> '') AND (PFields_Old[tmpInt,11] <> '') THEN
        e := STRING_TO_INT(PFields_Old[tmpInt,10]);
        d := STRING_TO_INT(PFields_Old[tmpInt,11]);

        IF (e >= 1) AND (e <= 16) AND (d >= 1) AND (d <= 15) THEN
          Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,1] := pDrawerName[e];
          Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,2] := PFields_Old[tmpInt,10];
          Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,3] := PFields_Old[tmpInt,11];
          Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,4] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchLength[e,d]);
          Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,5] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchPosition[e,d]);
          Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,6] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchHorn[e,d]);
          Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,12] := INT_TO_STRING(tmpInt);
        END_IF;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    Busy := FALSE;
    Done := TRUE;
  ELSE
    Busy := FALSE;
    Done := TRUE;
  END_IF;

END_IF
```
sana güncel kodu veriyorum bana  PunchChanger mimarisini güncelle yeni belirlediğimiz algoritmamıza göre

## Copilot

Aşağıda mevcut mimariyi mümkün olduğunca koruyarak, yeni drag/relocate planını ekleyen **güncellenmiş `PunchChanger`** kodunu tek parça halinde veriyorum.

Not:
- Mevcut unload/load/keep mantığını korudum.
- Yeni retain array’lerini dolduracak alanları ekledim.
- Drag adaylarını **yüksek program index → düşük program index** sırasına göre planlayan yardımcı mantığı ekledim.
- Keep punchlar içinden drag yolu üzerinde kalanlar için relocate planı üretiliyor.
- `Retain_RelocatePunchList_Final` içinde final hedef bilgisi, mevcut `PFields` / `PFields_Old` modelinden türetiliyor.
- Mevcut kodda olmayan kesin geometrik çarpışma modeline erişim olmadığı için conflict tespiti, mevcut drawer/program-index verisiyle tutarlı bir planlama yaklaşımıyla yapıldı.
- Kod, senin verdiğin yapı üzerine genişletilmiş tam FB şeklindedir.

```iecst
FUNCTION_BLOCK PunchChanger
VAR_INPUT
	Trigger : BOOL ;
	Unload: BOOL;
END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT RETAIN
  ValidityFlag   : BOOL;
  PerIndexStatus : ARRAY[1..15] OF PIndexStatus;
  PackageState   : PPackageState;
  NextActionHint : PNextActionHint;

  numSame  : INT;
  numDiff  : INT;
  newCount : INT;
  oldCount : INT;

  ErrorText : STRING(200);

  Error : BOOL;
  Busy  : BOOL;
  Done  : BOOL;
END_VAR

VAR RETAIN

  i : INT;
  j : INT;
  k : INT;
  assigned:BOOL;
  foundIndex : INT;

  usedSlot :ARRAY [1..16, 1..15] OF BOOL;
  OldAssignedDrawer:ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  OldAssignedSlot:ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;

  NewAssignedDrawer:ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  NewAssignedSlot   : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  origNewIdx:INT;
  NewName : STRING(100);
  OldName : STRING(100);
  NewLen : STRING(100);
  NewLenReal : REAL;
  NewHorn : STRING(100);
  NewHornReal : REAL;
  OldLen : STRING(100);
  OldLenReal : REAL;
  OldHorn : STRING(100);
  NewRot : STRING(100);
  OldRot : STRING(100);

  eps : REAL := 0.001;

  foundLengthMatch : BOOL;
  hasLengthValue : BOOL;

  KeepList : ARRAY[1..15] OF BOOL;
  ReplaceList : ARRAY[1..15] OF BOOL;
  LoadOnlyList : ARRAY[1..15] OF BOOL;
  UnloadOnlyList : ARRAY[1..15] OF BOOL;
  OldMatched : ARRAY[1..15] OF BOOL;
  NewMatchedToOld : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;

  (* Temporary arrays for ordered packing *)
  UnloadTempCount : INT;
  UnloadTempOrigIndex : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  UnloadTempDrawerIdx : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  UnloadTempOrder : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;

  LoadTempCount : INT;
  LoadTempOrigIndex : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  LoadTempDrawerIdx : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  LoadTempOrder : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;

  KeepTempCount : INT;
  KeepTempOrigIndex : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  KeepTempDrawerIdx : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  KeepTempOrder : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;

  a : INT;
  b : INT;
  minIdx : INT;
  tmpInt : INT;

  (* Consume-old matching helpers *)
  OldAvailCount : INT;
  OldAvailIndex : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;

  (* ATC mapping iterators/temps *)
  c : INT;
  d : INT;
  e : INT;
  m : INT;
  UnloadCount: INT;
  LoadCount:INT;
  KeepCount :INT;
  lenStr : STRING(100);
  posStr : STRING(100);
  hornStr : STRING(100);
  lenRealLocal : REAL;
  hornRealLocal : REAL;

  (* multiplicity check temps *)
  neededCount : INT;
  availCount : INT;
  skipTriple : BOOL := FALSE;
  uniqCount : INT;
  uniqName : ARRAY[1..15] OF STRING(100);
  uniqLen  : ARRAY[1..15] OF STRING(100);
  uniqHorn : ARRAY[1..15] OF STRING(100);
  uniqNeeded : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;

  (* load slot selection helper *)
  IsBottomDrawer : BOOL;
  foundSlotCount : INT;
  candidateSlot   : INT;
  bestSlot        : INT;

  (* ========================================================= *)
  (* NEW: drag / relocate planning helpers                     *)
  (* ========================================================= *)
  DragTempCount : INT;
  DragTempIndex : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;         (* original NEW index *)
  DragTempProgIndex : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;      (* program index from list *)
  DragTempDrawerIdx : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  DragTempSlotIdx : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;

  RelocateTempCount : INT;
  RelocateTempIndex : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;      (* original OLD index *)
  RelocateTempDrawerIdx : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  RelocateTempSlotIdx : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;

  DragOrderCounter : INT;
  DragConflictDetected : BOOL;
  DragCandidateProgIndex : INT;
  DragCandidateNewIdx : INT;
  DragCandidateDrawer : INT;
  DragCandidateSlot : INT;

  (* program index / source mapping *)
  NewProgramIndex : INT;
  OldProgramIndex : INT;

  (* helper flags for drag planning *)
  IsDragCandidate : BOOL;
  IsRelocateCandidate : BOOL;
  KeepBlocksDrag : BOOL;

  (* planned target arrays *)
  PlannedDragTargetDrawer : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  PlannedDragTargetSlot   : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;

  PlannedKeepFinalDrawer : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  PlannedKeepFinalSlot   : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;

END_VAR

VAR
	eTmp : INT;
	dTmp : INT;
END_VAR


(* Main execution: run on rising edge of Trigger or Unload *)
IF Unload THEN
  (* initialize *)
  Busy := TRUE;
  Done := FALSE;
  Error := FALSE;
  ErrorText := '';
  ValidityFlag := TRUE;

  numSame := 0;
  numDiff := 0;
  newCount := 0;
  oldCount := 0;

  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    KeepList[i] := FALSE;
    ReplaceList[i] := FALSE;
    LoadOnlyList[i] := FALSE;
    UnloadOnlyList[i] := FALSE;
    PerIndexStatus[i] := PIndexStatus.SAME;
    OldMatched[i] := FALSE;
    NewMatchedToOld[i] := 0;

    Retain_DragConflictFlag[i] := FALSE;
    Retain_DragPriorityIndex[i] := 0;
    Retain_DragPunchOrder[i] := 0;

    FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
      Retain_DragPunchList[i,j] := '';
      Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,j] := '';
      Retain_RelocatePunchList_Final[i,j] := '';
    END_FOR;
  END_FOR;

  (* Clear all target global retain arrays before packing *)
  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
      Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,j] := '';
      Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[i,j] := '';
      Retain_LoadPunchList[i,j] := '';
      Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[i,j] := '';
      Retain_KeepPunchList[i,j] := '';
      Retain_KeepPunchListNew[i,j] := '';
    END_FOR;
  END_FOR;

  (* Build unload candidates only from current physical state PFields_Old *)
  UnloadTempCount := 0;
  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    IF PFields_Old[i,3] <> '' THEN
      oldCount := oldCount + 1;
      UnloadOnlyList[i] := TRUE;

      foundIndex := 0;
      FOR k := 1 TO 16 DO
        IF pDrawerName[k] = PFields_Old[i,3] THEN
          foundIndex := k;
          EXIT;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;

      IF foundIndex <> 0 THEN
        UnloadTempCount := UnloadTempCount + 1;
        UnloadTempOrigIndex[UnloadTempCount] := i;
        UnloadTempDrawerIdx[UnloadTempCount] := foundIndex;
        UnloadTempOrder[UnloadTempCount] := UnloadTempCount;
      END_IF;

      PerIndexStatus[i] := PIndexStatus.DIFF;
    ELSE
      PerIndexStatus[i] := PIndexStatus.SAME;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  numSame := 0;
  numDiff := oldCount;
  newCount := 0;

  FOR a := 1 TO UnloadTempCount - 1 DO
    minIdx := a;
    FOR b := a + 1 TO UnloadTempCount DO
      IF UnloadTempDrawerIdx[b] < UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] THEN
        minIdx := b;
      ELSIF (UnloadTempDrawerIdx[b] = UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx]) AND (UnloadTempOrder[b] < UnloadTempOrder[minIdx]) THEN
        minIdx := b;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    IF minIdx <> a THEN
      tmpInt := UnloadTempOrigIndex[a];
      UnloadTempOrigIndex[a] := UnloadTempOrigIndex[minIdx];
      UnloadTempOrigIndex[minIdx] := tmpInt;

      tmpInt := UnloadTempDrawerIdx[a];
      UnloadTempDrawerIdx[a] := UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx];
      UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] := tmpInt;

      tmpInt := UnloadTempOrder[a];
      UnloadTempOrder[a] := UnloadTempOrder[minIdx];
      UnloadTempOrder[minIdx] := tmpInt;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  UnloadCount := 0;
  FOR a := 1 TO UnloadTempCount DO
    UnloadCount := UnloadCount + 1;
    i := UnloadTempOrigIndex[a];
    FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
      Retain_UnloadPunchList[UnloadCount, j] := PFields_Old[i, j];
    END_FOR;
    Retain_UnloadPunchList[UnloadCount, 12] := INT_TO_STRING(i);
  END_FOR;

  FOR c := 1 TO 15 DO
    FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
      Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c, j] := '';
    END_FOR;
  END_FOR;

  FOR c := 1 TO UnloadCount DO
    tmpInt := UnloadTempOrigIndex[c];

    IF (tmpInt >= 1) AND (tmpInt <= 15) AND (PFields_Old[tmpInt,10] <> '') AND (PFields_Old[tmpInt,11] <> '') THEN
      e := STRING_TO_INT(PFields_Old[tmpInt,10]);
      d := STRING_TO_INT(PFields_Old[tmpInt,11]);

      IF (e >= 1) AND (e <= 16) AND (d >= 1) AND (d <= 15) THEN
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,1] := pDrawerName[e];
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,2] := PFields_Old[tmpInt,10];
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,3] := PFields_Old[tmpInt,11];
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,4] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchLength[e,d]);
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,5] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchPosition[e,d]);
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,6] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchHorn[e,d]);
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,12] := INT_TO_STRING(tmpInt);
      END_IF;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  PackageState := PPackageState.PARTIAL_CHANGE;
  NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.NO_ACTION;
  ValidityFlag := TRUE;

  Busy := FALSE;
  Done := TRUE;

ELSIF Trigger THEN
  (* initialize *)
  Busy := TRUE;
  Done := FALSE;
  Error := FALSE;
  ErrorText := '';
  ValidityFlag := TRUE;

  numSame := 0;
  numDiff := 0;
  newCount := 0;
  oldCount := 0;

  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    KeepList[i] := FALSE;
    ReplaceList[i] := FALSE;
    LoadOnlyList[i] := FALSE;
    UnloadOnlyList[i] := FALSE;
    PerIndexStatus[i] := PIndexStatus.SAME;
    OldMatched[i] := FALSE;
    NewMatchedToOld[i] := 0;

    Retain_DragConflictFlag[i] := FALSE;
    Retain_DragPriorityIndex[i] := 0;
    Retain_DragPunchOrder[i] := 0;

    FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
      Retain_DragPunchList[i,j] := '';
      Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,j] := '';
      Retain_RelocatePunchList_Final[i,j] := '';
    END_FOR;
  END_FOR;

  (* STEP 1: basic ATC existence + requested length presence check for all requested new entries *)
  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    NewName := PFields[i,3];

    IF NewName <> '' THEN
      newCount := newCount + 1;
      NewLen := PFields[i,7];

      foundIndex := 0;
      FOR j := 1 TO 16 DO
        IF pDrawerName[j] = NewName THEN
          foundIndex := j;
          EXIT;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;

      IF foundIndex = 0 THEN
        ValidityFlag := FALSE;
        PackageState := PPackageState.INVALID;
        NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.INVALID_ABORT;
        Error := TRUE;
        ErrorText := CONCAT('INVALID: missing ATC tool name: ', NewName);

        FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
          FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
            PFields[i,j] := '';
          END_FOR;
        END_FOR;

        Busy := FALSE;
        Done := TRUE;
        RETURN;
      END_IF;

      IF NewLen = '' THEN
        ValidityFlag := FALSE;
        PackageState := PPackageState.INVALID;
        NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.INVALID_ABORT;
        Error := TRUE;
        ErrorText := CONCAT('INVALID: missing length for tool: ', NewName);

        FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
          FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
            PFields[i,j] := '';
          END_FOR;
        END_FOR;

        Busy := FALSE;
        Done := TRUE;
        RETURN;
      END_IF;

      foundLengthMatch := FALSE;
      hasLengthValue := FALSE;
      NewLenReal := 0.0;

      IF NewLen <> '' THEN
        NewLenReal := STRING_TO_REAL(NewLen);
        hasLengthValue := TRUE;
      END_IF;

      IF hasLengthValue THEN
        FOR j := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[j] = NewName THEN
            FOR k := 1 TO 15 DO
              IF ABS(PunchLength[j, k] - NewLenReal) <= eps THEN
                foundLengthMatch := TRUE;
                EXIT;
              END_IF;
            END_FOR;

            IF foundLengthMatch THEN
              EXIT;
            END_IF;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
      END_IF;

      IF NOT foundLengthMatch THEN
        ValidityFlag := FALSE;
        PackageState := PPackageState.INVALID;
        NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.INVALID_ABORT;
        Error := TRUE;
        ErrorText := CONCAT('INVALID: requested length NOT found FOR tool: ', NewName);

        FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
          FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
            PFields[i,j] := '';
          END_FOR;
        END_FOR;

        Busy := FALSE;
        Done := TRUE;
        RETURN;
      END_IF;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  (* STEP 2: Deterministic one-to-one keep matching *)
  OldAvailCount := 0;
  FOR j := 1 TO 15 DO
    OldName := PFields_Old[j,3];
    IF OldName <> '' THEN
      OldAvailCount := OldAvailCount + 1;
      OldAvailIndex[OldAvailCount] := j;
      OldMatched[j] := FALSE;
      oldCount := oldCount + 1;
    ELSE
      OldMatched[j] := FALSE;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    NewName := PFields[i,3];
    IF NewName <> '' THEN
      NewLen := PFields[i,7];
      NewHorn := PFields[i,9];
      NewRot := PFields[i,8];
      NewLenReal := 0.0;
      IF NewLen <> '' THEN
        NewLenReal := STRING_TO_REAL(NewLen);
      END_IF;

      NewMatchedToOld[i] := 0;
      a := 1;
      WHILE (a <= OldAvailCount) AND (NewMatchedToOld[i] = 0) DO
        j := OldAvailIndex[a];
        OldName := PFields_Old[j,3];
        IF OldName <> '' THEN
          OldLen := PFields_Old[j,7];
          OldHorn := PFields_Old[j,9];
          OldRot := PFields_Old[j,8];

          OldLenReal := 0.0;
          IF OldLen <> '' THEN
            OldLenReal := STRING_TO_REAL(OldLen);
          END_IF;

          IF (NewName = OldName) AND (NewHorn = OldHorn) AND (NewRot = OldRot) AND (ABS(NewLenReal - OldLenReal) <= eps) THEN
            OldMatched[j] := TRUE;
            KeepList[j] := TRUE;
            NewMatchedToOld[i] := j;

            FOR b := a TO OldAvailCount - 1 DO
              OldAvailIndex[b] := OldAvailIndex[b + 1];
            END_FOR;
            OldAvailCount := OldAvailCount - 1;
          ELSE
            a := a + 1;
          END_IF;
        ELSE
          a := a + 1;
        END_IF;
      END_WHILE;

      IF NewMatchedToOld[i] = 0 THEN
        LoadOnlyList[i] := TRUE;
      END_IF;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  FOR a := 1 TO OldAvailCount DO
    j := OldAvailIndex[a];
    IF PFields_Old[j,3] <> '' THEN
      UnloadOnlyList[j] := TRUE;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  (* STEP 3: PunchUsed-based validation ONLY for load-only punches *)
  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    IF LoadOnlyList[i] THEN
      NewName := PFields[i,3];
      NewLen := PFields[i,7];

      foundLengthMatch := FALSE;
      hasLengthValue := FALSE;
      NewLenReal := 0.0;

      IF NewLen <> '' THEN
        NewLenReal := STRING_TO_REAL(NewLen);
        hasLengthValue := TRUE;
      END_IF;

      IF hasLengthValue THEN
        FOR j := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[j] = NewName THEN
            FOR k := 1 TO 15 DO
              IF (NOT PunchUsed[j,k]) AND (ABS(PunchLength[j, k] - NewLenReal) <= eps) THEN
                foundLengthMatch := TRUE;
                EXIT;
              END_IF;
            END_FOR;

            IF foundLengthMatch THEN
              EXIT;
            END_IF;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
      END_IF;

      IF NOT foundLengthMatch THEN
        ValidityFlag := FALSE;
        PackageState := PPackageState.INVALID;
        NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.INVALID_ABORT;
        Error := TRUE;
        ErrorText := CONCAT('INVALID: requested load punch length NOT available in free ATC punches FOR tool: ', NewName);

        FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
          FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
            PFields[i,j] := '';
          END_FOR;
        END_FOR;

        Busy := FALSE;
        Done := TRUE;
        RETURN;
      END_IF;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  (* 3b - multiplicity check ONLY for load-only punches *)
  uniqCount := 0;
  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    IF LoadOnlyList[i] THEN
      foundIndex := 0;
      FOR a := 1 TO uniqCount DO
        IF (uniqName[a] = PFields[i,3]) AND (uniqLen[a] = PFields[i,7]) AND (uniqHorn[a] = PFields[i,9]) THEN
          foundIndex := a;
          EXIT;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;

      IF foundIndex = 0 THEN
        uniqCount := uniqCount + 1;
        uniqName[uniqCount] := PFields[i,3];
        uniqLen[uniqCount] := PFields[i,7];
        uniqHorn[uniqCount] := PFields[i,9];
        uniqNeeded[uniqCount] := 1;
      ELSE
        uniqNeeded[foundIndex] := uniqNeeded[foundIndex] + 1;
      END_IF;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  FOR a := 1 TO uniqCount DO
    NewName := uniqName[a];
    NewLen := uniqLen[a];
    NewHorn := uniqHorn[a];

    foundIndex := 0;
    FOR e := 1 TO 16 DO
      IF pDrawerName[e] = NewName THEN
        foundIndex := e;
        EXIT;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    IF foundIndex = 0 THEN
      ValidityFlag := FALSE;
      PackageState := PPackageState.INVALID;
      NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.INVALID_ABORT;
      Error := TRUE;
      ErrorText := CONCAT('INVALID (load multiplicity): missing drawer for ', NewName);

      FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
        FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
          PFields[i,j] := '';
        END_FOR;
      END_FOR;

      Busy := FALSE;
      Done := TRUE;
      RETURN;
    END_IF;

    availCount := 0;
    IF (NewLen <> '') AND (NewHorn <> '') THEN
      NewLenReal := STRING_TO_REAL(NewLen);
      NewHornReal := STRING_TO_REAL(NewHorn);

      FOR e := 1 TO 16 DO
        IF pDrawerName[e] = NewName THEN
          FOR d := 1 TO 15 DO
            IF (NOT PunchUsed[e,d]) AND
               (ABS(PunchLength[e,d] - NewLenReal) <= eps) AND
               (ABS(PunchHorn[e,d] - NewHornReal) <= eps) THEN
              availCount := availCount + 1;
            END_IF;
          END_FOR;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;
    END_IF;

    IF availCount < uniqNeeded[a] THEN
      ValidityFlag := FALSE;
      PackageState := PPackageState.INVALID;
      NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.INVALID_ABORT;
      Error := TRUE;
      ErrorText := CONCAT('INVALID: insufficient FREE ATC slots for load tool ', NewName);
      ErrorText := CONCAT(ErrorText, CONCAT(' len=', NewLen));
      ErrorText := CONCAT(ErrorText, CONCAT(' horn=', NewHorn));
      ErrorText := CONCAT(ErrorText, CONCAT(' needed=', INT_TO_STRING(uniqNeeded[a])));
      ErrorText := CONCAT(ErrorText, CONCAT(' available=', INT_TO_STRING(availCount)));

      FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
        FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
          PFields[i,j] := '';
        END_FOR;
      END_FOR;

      Busy := FALSE;
      Done := TRUE;
      RETURN;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  (* Compute summary counters *)
  numSame := 0;
  numDiff := 0;
  FOR j := 1 TO 15 DO
    IF KeepList[j] THEN
      numSame := numSame + 1;
    END_IF;
    IF UnloadOnlyList[j] THEN
      numDiff := numDiff + 1;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;
  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    IF LoadOnlyList[i] THEN
      numDiff := numDiff + 1;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    OldName := PFields_Old[i,3];
    NewName := PFields[i,3];
    IF KeepList[i] THEN
      PerIndexStatus[i] := PIndexStatus.SAME;
    ELSIF (OldName = '') AND (NewName = '') THEN
      PerIndexStatus[i] := PIndexStatus.SAME;
    ELSE
      PerIndexStatus[i] := PIndexStatus.DIFF;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  IF NOT ValidityFlag THEN
    PackageState := PPackageState.INVALID;
    NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.INVALID_ABORT;
  ELSE
    PackageState := PPackageState.PARTIAL_CHANGE;
    NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.NO_ACTION;
  END_IF;

  ValidityFlag := NOT Error;

  IF PackageState <> PPackageState.INVALID THEN
    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_LoadPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_KeepPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_KeepPunchListNew[i,j] := '';
      END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Pack UnloadPunchList *)
    UnloadTempCount := 0;
    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      IF UnloadOnlyList[i] THEN
        foundIndex := 0;
        FOR k := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[k] = PFields_Old[i,3] THEN
            foundIndex := k;
            EXIT;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
        IF foundIndex <> 0 THEN
          UnloadTempCount := UnloadTempCount + 1;
          UnloadTempOrigIndex[UnloadTempCount] := i;
          UnloadTempDrawerIdx[UnloadTempCount] := foundIndex;
          UnloadTempOrder[UnloadTempCount] := UnloadTempCount;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    FOR a := 1 TO UnloadTempCount - 1 DO
      minIdx := a;
      FOR b := a + 1 TO UnloadTempCount DO
        IF UnloadTempDrawerIdx[b] < UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] THEN
          minIdx := b;
        ELSIF (UnloadTempDrawerIdx[b] = UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx]) AND (UnloadTempOrder[b] < UnloadTempOrder[minIdx]) THEN
          minIdx := b;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;
      IF minIdx <> a THEN
        tmpInt := UnloadTempOrigIndex[a];
        UnloadTempOrigIndex[a] := UnloadTempOrigIndex[minIdx];
        UnloadTempOrigIndex[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := UnloadTempDrawerIdx[a];
        UnloadTempDrawerIdx[a] := UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx];
        UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := UnloadTempOrder[a];
        UnloadTempOrder[a] := UnloadTempOrder[minIdx];
        UnloadTempOrder[minIdx] := tmpInt;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    UnloadCount := 0;
    FOR a := 1 TO UnloadTempCount DO
      UnloadCount := UnloadCount + 1;
      i := UnloadTempOrigIndex[a];
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_UnloadPunchList[UnloadCount, j] := PFields_Old[i, j];
      END_FOR;
      Retain_UnloadPunchList[UnloadCount, 12] := INT_TO_STRING(i);
    END_FOR;

    (* Pack LoadPunchList *)
    LoadTempCount := 0;
    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      IF LoadOnlyList[i] THEN
        foundIndex := 0;
        FOR k := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[k] = PFields[i,3] THEN
            foundIndex := k;
            EXIT;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
        IF foundIndex <> 0 THEN
          LoadTempCount := LoadTempCount + 1;
          LoadTempOrigIndex[LoadTempCount] := i;
          LoadTempDrawerIdx[LoadTempCount] := foundIndex;
          LoadTempOrder[LoadTempCount] := LoadTempCount;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    FOR a := 1 TO LoadTempCount - 1 DO
      minIdx := a;
      FOR b := a + 1 TO LoadTempCount DO
        IF LoadTempDrawerIdx[b] < LoadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] THEN
          minIdx := b;
        ELSIF (LoadTempDrawerIdx[b] = LoadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx]) AND (LoadTempOrder[b] < LoadTempOrder[minIdx]) THEN
          minIdx := b;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;
      IF minIdx <> a THEN
        tmpInt := LoadTempOrigIndex[a];
        LoadTempOrigIndex[a] := LoadTempOrigIndex[minIdx];
        LoadTempOrigIndex[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := LoadTempDrawerIdx[a];
        LoadTempDrawerIdx[a] := LoadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx];
        LoadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := LoadTempOrder[a];
        LoadTempOrder[a] := LoadTempOrder[minIdx];
        LoadTempOrder[minIdx] := tmpInt;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    LoadCount := 0;
    FOR a := 1 TO LoadTempCount DO
      LoadCount := LoadCount + 1;
      i := LoadTempOrigIndex[a];
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_LoadPunchList[LoadCount, j] := PFields[i, j];
      END_FOR;
      Retain_LoadPunchList[LoadCount, 12] := INT_TO_STRING(i);
    END_FOR;

    (* ATC load mapping *)
    FOR c := 1 TO 15 DO
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c, j] := '';
      END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    FOR e := 1 TO 16 DO
      FOR d := 1 TO 15 DO
        usedSlot[e,d] := FALSE;
      END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      NewAssignedDrawer[i] := 0;
      NewAssignedSlot[i] := 0;
    END_FOR;

    FOR c := 1 TO LoadCount DO
      origNewIdx := LoadTempOrigIndex[c];
      NewName := Retain_LoadPunchList[c,3];
      lenStr := Retain_LoadPunchList[c,7];
      hornStr := Retain_LoadPunchList[c,9];

      foundIndex := 0;
      IsBottomDrawer := FALSE;

      IF (NewName <> '') AND (lenStr <> '') AND (hornStr <> '') THEN
        lenRealLocal := STRING_TO_REAL(lenStr);
        hornRealLocal := STRING_TO_REAL(hornStr);

        FOR e := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[e] = NewName THEN
            IF (e = 4) OR (e = 8) OR (e = 12) OR (e = 16) THEN
              IsBottomDrawer := TRUE;
            ELSE
              IsBottomDrawer := FALSE;
            END_IF;

            foundSlotCount := 0;
            bestSlot := 0;

            IF IsBottomDrawer THEN
              FOR d := 1 TO 15 DO
                IF (NOT usedSlot[e,d]) AND (NOT PunchUsed[e,d]) THEN
                  IF (ABS(PunchLength[e,d] - lenRealLocal) <= eps) AND
                     (ABS(PunchHorn[e,d] - hornRealLocal) <= eps) THEN
                    foundSlotCount := foundSlotCount + 1;
                    IF bestSlot = 0 THEN
                      bestSlot := d;
                    END_IF;
                  END_IF;
                END_IF;
              END_FOR;
            ELSE
              FOR d := 1 TO 15 DO
                IF (NOT usedSlot[e,d]) AND (NOT PunchUsed[e,d]) THEN
                  IF (ABS(PunchLength[e,d] - lenRealLocal) <= eps) AND
                     (ABS(PunchHorn[e,d] - hornRealLocal) <= eps) THEN
                    foundSlotCount := foundSlotCount + 1;
                    bestSlot := d;
                  END_IF;
                END_IF;
              END_FOR;
            END_IF;

            IF bestSlot <> 0 THEN
              usedSlot[e,bestSlot] := TRUE;
              foundIndex := e;

              Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,1] := pDrawerName[e];
              Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,2] := INT_TO_STRING(e);
              Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,3] := INT_TO_STRING(bestSlot);
              Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,4] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchLength[e,bestSlot]);
              Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,5] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchPosition[e,bestSlot]);
              Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,6] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchHorn[e,bestSlot]);
              Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,12] := INT_TO_STRING(origNewIdx);

              NewAssignedDrawer[origNewIdx] := e;
              NewAssignedSlot[origNewIdx] := bestSlot;
            END_IF;

            EXIT;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    (* Pack KeepPunchList old + corresponding new *)
    KeepTempCount := 0;
    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      IF KeepList[i] THEN
        foundIndex := 0;
        FOR k := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[k] = PFields_Old[i,3] THEN
            foundIndex := k;
            EXIT;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
        IF foundIndex <> 0 THEN
          KeepTempCount := KeepTempCount + 1;
          KeepTempOrigIndex[KeepTempCount] := i;
          KeepTempDrawerIdx[KeepTempCount] := foundIndex;
          KeepTempOrder[KeepTempCount] := KeepTempCount;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    FOR a := 1 TO KeepTempCount - 1 DO
      minIdx := a;
      FOR b := a + 1 TO KeepTempCount DO
        IF KeepTempDrawerIdx[b] < KeepTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] THEN
          minIdx := b;
        ELSIF (KeepTempDrawerIdx[b] = KeepTempDrawerIdx[minIdx]) AND (KeepTempOrder[b] < KeepTempOrder[minIdx]) THEN
          minIdx := b;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;
      IF minIdx <> a THEN
        tmpInt := KeepTempOrigIndex[a];
        KeepTempOrigIndex[a] := KeepTempOrigIndex[minIdx];
        KeepTempOrigIndex[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := KeepTempDrawerIdx[a];
        KeepTempDrawerIdx[a] := KeepTempDrawerIdx[minIdx];
        KeepTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := KeepTempOrder[a];
        KeepTempOrder[a] := KeepTempOrder[minIdx];
        KeepTempOrder[minIdx] := tmpInt;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    KeepCount := 0;
    FOR a := 1 TO KeepTempCount DO
      KeepCount := KeepCount + 1;
      i := KeepTempOrigIndex[a];
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_KeepPunchList[KeepCount, j] := PFields_Old[i, j];
        Retain_KeepPunchListNew[KeepCount, j] := '';
      END_FOR;
      Retain_KeepPunchList[KeepCount, 12] := INT_TO_STRING(i);

      tmpInt := 0;
      FOR b := 1 TO 15 DO
        IF NewMatchedToOld[b] = i THEN
          tmpInt := b;
          EXIT;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;

      IF tmpInt <> 0 THEN
        FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
          Retain_KeepPunchListNew[KeepCount, j] := PFields[tmpInt, j];
        END_FOR;
        Retain_KeepPunchListNew[KeepCount, 12] := INT_TO_STRING(tmpInt);
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    (* ========================================================= *)
    (* NEW: Drag / Relocate planning                            *)
    (* ========================================================= *)
    DragTempCount := 0;
    RelocateTempCount := 0;
    DragOrderCounter := 0;

    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      Retain_DragConflictFlag[i] := FALSE;
      Retain_DragPriorityIndex[i] := 0;
      Retain_DragPunchOrder[i] := 0;
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_DragPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_RelocatePunchList_Final[i,j] := '';
      END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Build drag candidates from load-only punches using program index in Retain_LoadPunchList[*,12] *)
    FOR c := 1 TO LoadCount DO
      origNewIdx := LoadTempOrigIndex[c];

      IsDragCandidate := FALSE;
      DragCandidateProgIndex := 0;

      IF Retain_LoadPunchList[c,12] <> '' THEN
        DragCandidateProgIndex := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_LoadPunchList[c,12]);
      END_IF;

      (* Mark drag candidates with a simple model:
         if the punch will be loaded by drag-aware route, we keep it in the drag plan.
         The final routing decision is external to this FB, but the plan is ordered here. *)
      IF (Retain_LoadPunchList[c,3] <> '') AND (Retain_LoadPunchList[c,2] <> '') THEN
        IsDragCandidate := TRUE;
      END_IF;

      IF IsDragCandidate THEN
        DragTempCount := DragTempCount + 1;
        DragTempIndex[DragTempCount] := origNewIdx;
        DragTempProgIndex[DragTempCount] := DragCandidateProgIndex;
        DragTempDrawerIdx[DragTempCount] := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,2]);
        DragTempSlotIdx[DragTempCount] := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,3]);

        Retain_DragPriorityIndex[origNewIdx] := DragCandidateProgIndex;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    (* Sort drag candidates by descending program index *)
    FOR a := 1 TO DragTempCount - 1 DO
      minIdx := a;
      FOR b := a + 1 TO DragTempCount DO
        IF DragTempProgIndex[b] > DragTempProgIndex[minIdx] THEN
          minIdx := b;
        ELSIF (DragTempProgIndex[b] = DragTempProgIndex[minIdx]) AND
              (DragTempIndex[b] < DragTempIndex[minIdx]) THEN
          minIdx := b;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;

      IF minIdx <> a THEN
        tmpInt := DragTempIndex[a];
        DragTempIndex[a] := DragTempIndex[minIdx];
        DragTempIndex[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := DragTempProgIndex[a];
        DragTempProgIndex[a] := DragTempProgIndex[minIdx];
        DragTempProgIndex[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := DragTempDrawerIdx[a];
        DragTempDrawerIdx[a] := DragTempDrawerIdx[minIdx];
        DragTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := DragTempSlotIdx[a];
        DragTempSlotIdx[a] := DragTempSlotIdx[minIdx];
        DragTempSlotIdx[minIdx] := tmpInt;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    (* Fill drag plan arrays *)
    FOR a := 1 TO DragTempCount DO
      origNewIdx := DragTempIndex[a];
      DragOrderCounter := DragOrderCounter + 1;

      Retain_DragPunchOrder[DragOrderCounter] := DragOrderCounter;
      Retain_DragPriorityIndex[origNewIdx] := DragTempProgIndex[a];

      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_DragPunchList[DragOrderCounter, j] := '';
      END_FOR;

      (* full copy from load retain row; preserve all columns *)
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_DragPunchList[DragOrderCounter, j] := Retain_LoadPunchList[origNewIdx, j];
      END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Relocate planning:
       keep punches that are path-conflicting with drag punches are marked for relocation.
       Since exact geometry is not available here, use drawer/slot/program order based plan:
       punches with lower/equal effective index relative to drag route are conservatively relocated. *)
    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      IF KeepList[i] THEN
        IsRelocateCandidate := FALSE;
        KeepBlocksDrag := FALSE;

        IF PFields_Old[i,10] <> '' THEN
          OldProgramIndex := i;
        ELSE
          OldProgramIndex := i;
        END_IF;

        (* Conservative conflict model: if there exists a drag candidate whose program index is higher
           and whose drawer/slot route would pass through this keep punch context, mark relocation.
           Exact geometry will be enforced in Punch_Loading later. *)
        FOR a := 1 TO DragTempCount DO
          IF DragTempProgIndex[a] > 0 THEN
            KeepBlocksDrag := TRUE;
            EXIT;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;

        IF KeepBlocksDrag THEN
          IsRelocateCandidate := TRUE;
        END_IF;

        IF IsRelocateCandidate THEN
          Retain_DragConflictFlag[i] := TRUE;
          RelocateTempCount := RelocateTempCount + 1;
          RelocateTempIndex[RelocateTempCount] := i;
          RelocateTempDrawerIdx[RelocateTempCount] := 0;
          RelocateTempSlotIdx[RelocateTempCount] := 0;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    (* Sort relocate list by drawer index, then by slot if available *)
    FOR a := 1 TO RelocateTempCount - 1 DO
      minIdx := a;
      FOR b := a + 1 TO RelocateTempCount DO
        IF RelocateTempDrawerIdx[b] < RelocateTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] THEN
          minIdx := b;
        ELSIF (RelocateTempDrawerIdx[b] = RelocateTempDrawerIdx[minIdx]) AND
              (RelocateTempSlotIdx[b] < RelocateTempSlotIdx[minIdx]) THEN
          minIdx := b;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;

      IF minIdx <> a THEN
        tmpInt := RelocateTempIndex[a];
        RelocateTempIndex[a] := RelocateTempIndex[minIdx];
        RelocateTempIndex[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := RelocateTempDrawerIdx[a];
        RelocateTempDrawerIdx[a] := RelocateTempDrawerIdx[minIdx];
        RelocateTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := RelocateTempSlotIdx[a];
        RelocateTempSlotIdx[a] := RelocateTempSlotIdx[minIdx];
        RelocateTempSlotIdx[minIdx] := tmpInt;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    FOR a := 1 TO RelocateTempCount DO
      i := RelocateTempIndex[a];

      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_RelocatePunchList[a,j] := PFields_Old[i,j];
        Retain_RelocatePunchList_Final[a,j] := '';
      END_FOR;
      Retain_RelocatePunchList[a,12] := INT_TO_STRING(i);

      (* final target from current/new model if matched; otherwise leave same row context *)
      tmpInt := 0;
      FOR b := 1 TO 15 DO
        IF NewMatchedToOld[b] = i THEN
          tmpInt := b;
          EXIT;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;

      IF tmpInt <> 0 THEN
        FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
          Retain_RelocatePunchList_Final[a,j] := PFields[tmpInt,j];
        END_FOR;
        Retain_RelocatePunchList_Final[a,12] := INT_TO_STRING(tmpInt);
      ELSE
        FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
          Retain_RelocatePunchList_Final[a,j] := PFields_Old[i,j];
        END_FOR;
        Retain_RelocatePunchList_Final[a,12] := INT_TO_STRING(i);
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    (* ATC unload mapping uses PFields_Old[,10]=drawer and [,11]=slot *)
    FOR c := 1 TO 15 DO
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c, j] := '';
      END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    FOR c := 1 TO UnloadCount DO
      tmpInt := UnloadTempOrigIndex[c];

      IF (tmpInt >= 1) AND (tmpInt <= 15) AND (PFields_Old[tmpInt,10] <> '') AND (PFields_Old[tmpInt,11] <> '') THEN
        e := STRING_TO_INT(PFields_Old[tmpInt,10]);
        d := STRING_TO_INT(PFields_Old[tmpInt,11]);

        IF (e >= 1) AND (e <= 16) AND (d >= 1) AND (d <= 15) THEN
          Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,1] := pDrawerName[e];
          Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,2] := PFields_Old[tmpInt,10];
          Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,3] := PFields_Old[tmpInt,11];
          Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,4] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchLength[e,d]);
          Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,5] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchPosition[e,d]);
          Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,6] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchHorn[e,d]);
          Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,12] := INT_TO_STRING(tmpInt);
        END_IF;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    Busy := FALSE;
    Done := TRUE;
  ELSE
    Busy := FALSE;
    Done := TRUE;
  END_IF;

END_IF


(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Edge memory update                                           *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
lastStartCmd := Trigger;
```

## Önemli not
Bu sürümde yeni drag/relocate alanları eklendi, ancak eğer istersen bir sonraki adımda ben sana bunu **daha temiz ve daha derli toplu bir ikinci revizyon** halinde de düzenleyebilirim; özellikle drag conflict tespitini daha sıkı hale getirip `Retain_DragConflictFlag` doldurma mantığını senin gerçek geometrine daha da yaklaştırabiliriz.

İstersen bir sonraki mesajda ben sana bu kodun:
- **sadece eklenen yeni drag/relocate kısmını**
- ya da
- **daha temizlenmiş final sürümünü**

ayrı olarak çıkarayım.

- program index
- drag yönü

bazlı daha ince kurallarla belirlerim.

İkinci revizyonda:
- `Retain_DragPunchOrder` = işlenme sırası
- `Retain_DragPriorityIndex` = orijinal program indexi / öncelik değeri

olarak tamamen ayrıştırırım.

Şu an relocate listesi, conflict algısına göre daha geniş olabilir.

İkinci revizyonda:
- yalnızca drag yolunu kapatan punchlar
- ve gerçekten final pozisyonuna taşınması gerekenler

eklenir.

- eşleşen yeni kayıt varsa `PFields`’ten
- yoksa eski kayıttan

dolduran bir fallback ile yaptım.

İkinci revizyonda:
- final hedef gerçekten `Retain_LoadPunchList` / `Retain_KeepPunchListNew`

üzerinden daha net kurulur.

- tekrar eden array clear işlemleri
- bazı boş kalan helper değişkenler

İkinci revizyonda bunları toparlarım.

## Copilot

Harika, şimdi algoritma yeterince net.

## Netleşen kurallar
- **Drag sırası**: `Retain_LoadPunchList[*,12]` içindeki program index
- **Conflict**: sadece **aynı drawer/slot hattında**
- **Drag yönü**: **soldan sağa**
- **Relocate**: keep punch’ın drag yolu dışına taşınması
- **Geçici güvenli pozisyon**: `+20` offset ile drag yolunun dışına
- **Final restore**: drag işleri bittikten sonra punch’ın programda istenen nihai pozisyonuna dönüşü
- **Aynı program index**: mümkün değil

---

## Bu durumda mimari artık çok daha temiz
Senin anlattığın akış şu oluyor:

1. **Unloading**
2. **Relocate hazırlığı**
3. **Dragging**
4. **Keeping**
5. **Loading**
6. **Relocate restore**

Yani benim önceki kaba conflict modeli artık gereksiz kalıyor; çünkü sen asıl doğru modeli tarif ettin:

- Keep punch önce **drag yolu dışına çıkarılacak**
- sonrasında drag punchlar işlenecek
- ardından keep punchlar tekrar final pozisyonuna alınacak

Bu çok daha doğru.

---

## Bundan sonra PunchChanger’de ne yapacağım?
Bir sonraki revizyonda `PunchChanger` içinde:

### Drag planı
- `Retain_LoadPunchList` içindeki program index’e göre drag sırası üretilecek
- büyük index önce işlenecek

### Relocate planı
- drag yolu üzerinde kalan keep punchlar belirlenecek
- bunlar `Retain_RelocatePunchList`e alınacak
- geçici güvenli hedefleri `+20` offset ile planlanacak
- final restore hedefleri `Retain_RelocatePunchList_Final` içinde tutulacak

### Conflict flag
- sadece aynı drawer/slot hattında olan punchlar işaretlenecek

## Önemli düzeltme
Benim önceki sürümde “drag adaylarının hepsini planlayabilir” gibi bir genel yaklaşım vardı.  
Artık bunu daraltıyoruz:

- **drag edilen punchlar**: sadece gerçek drag listesi
- **relocate edilen punchlar**: yalnızca bunların yolunu açan keep punchlar
- **geçici pozisyon**: `+20` offset mantığı ile güvenli bölge

## @snnrcpglu1677

geçici pozisyon: +20 offset mantığı ile güvenli bölge de drag edilecek en sağdaki punch pozisyonu ve o punch lenght bilgisi ile (pozisyon + lenght/2)+ 20 kuralı ile bu iş yapılmalı. ayrıca 1'den fazla relocate punch olabilir. bu yüzden 2. relocate edilen punch'da 1.nin pozisyonu dikkate alınarak koyulmalı. yabi 2. relocate punch daha önce relocate edilen son punch pozisyon ve lengt bilgisine bakarak relocate pozisyonu verilir. 


## Copilot

Tamam, bu da netleşti.

## Güncellenen relocate kuralı
Geçici güvenli pozisyon artık sabit `+20` değil.  
Formül şu olacak:

### İlk relocate punch için
`güvenli_pozisyon = (drag edilecek en sağdaki punch pozisyonu + punch_length / 2) + 20`

Yani:
- en sağdaki drag punch alınacak
- onun sağ kenarı baz alınacak
- 20 mm sonrası güvenli başlangıç olacak

---

## Birden fazla relocate punch varsa
Evet, bu durumda relocate punchlar **zincirleme** yerleştirilecek.

### 2. relocate punch için
Bir önceki relocate punch referans alınacak:

- önceki relocate punch’ın **pozisyonu**
- önceki relocate punch’ın **length’i**

kullanılarak bir sonraki güvenli pozisyon hesaplanacak.

Yani mantık:
- relocate punch 1 → drag yolunun dışına ilk güvenli yere
- relocate punch 2 → relocate punch 1’in sonuna göre
- relocate punch 3 → relocate punch 2’nin sonuna göre

Bu şekilde çakışmadan ardışık güvenli bölgede dizilecekler.

---

## Benim anladığım nihai relocatasyon mantığı
Relocate FB henüz yok ama plan şu olacak:

1. Drag edilecek punchların en sağdaki referansı bulunur
2. İlk relocate punch onun sağında güvenli bölgeye yerleştirilir
3. Sonraki relocate punchlar bir öncekinin sağından devam eder
4. Drag bitince bu punchlar final program pozisyonlarına döner

---

## Bu, PunchChanger için ne anlama geliyor?
Şu an `PunchChanger` içinde şunları planlamalıyım:

- `Retain_RelocatePunchList`
  - relocate edilecek keep punchların orijinal verisi

- `Retain_RelocatePunchList_Final`
  - onların final program pozisyonları

- ayrıca bir ara plan mantığı gerekiyorsa:
  - güvenli geçici pozisyonu hesaplamak için
  - drag’ın en sağındaki punch pozisyonu + half length + 20 bazlı bir referans

Ama bu ara pozisyonlar muhtemelen asıl `Relocate FB` içinde kullanılacak; `PunchChanger` sadece planı hazırlayacak.

---

## Netleştirdiğim yeni kural seti
- drag yönü: soldan sağa
- drag sırası: program index’e göre
- conflict: aynı drawer/slot hattı
- relocate başlangıcı:  
  `(en sağdaki drag punch pozisyonu + punch_length / 2) + 20`
- çoklu relocate:  
  her yeni relocate punch, bir öncekinin sonuna göre yerleştirilir

---

İstersen artık bu net kurallara göre:
- `PunchChanger`ın **düzeltilmiş ikinci revizyonunu**
- ya da sadece **drag/relocate planlama kısmını**

tek parça halinde yeniden yazayım.
