## Copilot

Evet — aşağıda sana **temiz final sürüm** veriyorum.  
Bu sürümde:

- `Retain_DragPunchList` = tüm drag punchlar
- `Retain_ATCDragPunchList` = drag punchların ATC pickup bilgisi
- drag sırası = **pozisyon büyükten küçüğe**
- aynı pozisyonda = **drawer no büyükten küçüğe**
- aynı drawer’da tekrar seçilecekse = **slot büyükten küçüğe**
- `Retain_LoadPunchList` = drag olmayan load punchlar
- `Retain_ATCLoadPunchList` = load punchların ATC karşılığı
- `Retain_RelocatePunchList` = drag sweep alanına giren keep punchlar

Ayrıca compile açısından gereksiz/çakışan bazı yardımcı değişkenleri sadeleştirdim.

```iecst
FUNCTION_BLOCK PunchChanger

VAR_INPUT
	Trigger : BOOL ;
	Unload  : BOOL;
END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT RETAIN
  ValidityFlag   : BOOL;
  PerIndexStatus : ARRAY[1..15] OF PIndexStatus;
  PackageState   : PPackageState;
  NextActionHint : PNextActionHint;

  numSame  : INT;
  numDiff  : INT;
  newCount : INT;
  oldCount : INT;

  ErrorText : STRING(200);

  Error : BOOL;
  Busy  : BOOL;
  Done  : BOOL;
END_VAR

VAR RETAIN

  i : INT;
  j : INT;
  k : INT;
  foundIndex : INT;
  tmpInt : INT;
  tmpPos : LREAL;

  usedSlot : ARRAY [1..16, 1..15] OF BOOL;

  NewAssignedDrawer : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  NewAssignedSlot   : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  origNewIdx       : INT;

  eps : REAL := 0.001;

  KeepList      : ARRAY[1..15] OF BOOL;
  ReplaceList   : ARRAY[1..15] OF BOOL;
  LoadOnlyList  : ARRAY[1..15] OF BOOL;
  UnloadOnlyList : ARRAY[1..15] OF BOOL;
  OldMatched    : ARRAY[1..15] OF BOOL;
  NewMatchedToOld : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;

  UnloadTempCount      : INT;
  UnloadTempOrigIndex   : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  UnloadTempDrawerIdx   : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  UnloadTempOrder       : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;

  LoadTempCount        : INT;
  LoadTempOrigIndex    : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  LoadTempDrawerIdx    : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  LoadTempOrder        : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;

  KeepTempCount        : INT;
  KeepTempOrigIndex    : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  KeepTempDrawerIdx    : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  KeepTempOrder        : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;

  a : INT;
  b : INT;
  minIdx : INT;

  UnloadCount : INT;
  LoadCount   : INT;
  KeepCount   : INT;

  lenStr   : STRING(100);
  hornStr  : STRING(100);
  lenRealLocal : REAL;
  hornRealLocal : REAL;

  IsBottomDrawer  : BOOL;
  bestSlot        : INT;

  DragTempCount      : INT;
  DragTempIndex      : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  DragTempProgIndex  : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  DragTempDrawerIdx  : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  DragTempSlotIdx    : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  DragTempPos        : ARRAY[1..15] OF LREAL;

  RelocateTempCount      : INT;
  RelocateTempIndex      : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;

  tmpWidth           : LREAL;
  tmpHalfWidth       : LREAL;
  otherStart         : LREAL;
  otherEnd           : LREAL;
  testStart          : LREAL;
  testEnd            : LREAL;

  IsRelocateCandidate : BOOL;

  dragDrawerNo       : INT;
  dragPos            : LREAL;
  dragSlotNo         : INT;

  DragATCCount       : INT;

END_VAR


IF Unload THEN
  Busy := TRUE;
  Done := FALSE;
  Error := FALSE;
  ErrorText := '';
  ValidityFlag := TRUE;

  numSame := 0;
  numDiff := 0;
  newCount := 0;
  oldCount := 0;

  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    KeepList[i] := FALSE;
    ReplaceList[i] := FALSE;
    LoadOnlyList[i] := FALSE;
    UnloadOnlyList[i] := FALSE;
    PerIndexStatus[i] := PIndexStatus.SAME;
    OldMatched[i] := FALSE;
    NewMatchedToOld[i] := 0;

    Retain_DragConflictFlag[i] := FALSE;
    Retain_DragPriorityIndex[i] := 0;
    Retain_DragPunchOrder[i] := 0;

    FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
      Retain_DragPunchList[i,j] := '';
      Retain_ATCDragPunchList[i,j] := '';
      Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,j] := '';
      Retain_RelocatePunchList_Final[i,j] := '';
    END_FOR;
  END_FOR;

  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
      Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,j] := '';
      Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[i,j] := '';
      Retain_LoadPunchList[i,j] := '';
      Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[i,j] := '';
      Retain_KeepPunchList[i,j] := '';
      Retain_KeepPunchListNew[i,j] := '';
    END_FOR;
  END_FOR;

  UnloadTempCount := 0;
  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    IF PFields_Old[i,3] <> '' THEN
      oldCount := oldCount + 1;
      UnloadOnlyList[i] := TRUE;

      foundIndex := 0;
      FOR k := 1 TO 16 DO
        IF pDrawerName[k] = PFields_Old[i,3] THEN
          foundIndex := k;
          EXIT;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;

      IF foundIndex <> 0 THEN
        UnloadTempCount := UnloadTempCount + 1;
        UnloadTempOrigIndex[UnloadTempCount] := i;
        UnloadTempDrawerIdx[UnloadTempCount] := foundIndex;
        UnloadTempOrder[UnloadTempCount] := UnloadTempCount;
      END_IF;

      PerIndexStatus[i] := PIndexStatus.DIFF;
    ELSE
      PerIndexStatus[i] := PIndexStatus.SAME;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  numDiff := oldCount;

  FOR a := 1 TO UnloadTempCount - 1 DO
    minIdx := a;
    FOR b := a + 1 TO UnloadTempCount DO
      IF UnloadTempDrawerIdx[b] < UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] THEN
        minIdx := b;
      ELSIF (UnloadTempDrawerIdx[b] = UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx]) AND (UnloadTempOrder[b] < UnloadTempOrder[minIdx]) THEN
        minIdx := b;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    IF minIdx <> a THEN
      tmpInt := UnloadTempOrigIndex[a];
      UnloadTempOrigIndex[a] := UnloadTempOrigIndex[minIdx];
      UnloadTempOrigIndex[minIdx] := tmpInt;

      tmpInt := UnloadTempDrawerIdx[a];
      UnloadTempDrawerIdx[a] := UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx];
      UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] := tmpInt;

      tmpInt := UnloadTempOrder[a];
      UnloadTempOrder[a] := UnloadTempOrder[minIdx];
      UnloadTempOrder[minIdx] := tmpInt;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  UnloadCount := 0;
  FOR a := 1 TO UnloadTempCount DO
    UnloadCount := UnloadCount + 1;
    i := UnloadTempOrigIndex[a];
    FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
      Retain_UnloadPunchList[UnloadCount, j] := PFields_Old[i, j];
    END_FOR;
    Retain_UnloadPunchList[UnloadCount, 12] := INT_TO_STRING(i);
  END_FOR;

  FOR i := 1 TO UnloadCount DO
    tmpInt := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,10]);
    IF (tmpInt >= 1) AND (tmpInt <= 15) AND (Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,10] <> '') AND (Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,11] <> '') THEN
      foundIndex := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,10]);
      k := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,11]);
      IF (foundIndex >= 1) AND (foundIndex <= 16) AND (k >= 1) AND (k <= 15) THEN
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[i,1] := pDrawerName[foundIndex];
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[i,2] := Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,10];
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[i,3] := Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,11];
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[i,4] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchLength[foundIndex,k]);
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[i,5] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchPosition[foundIndex,k]);
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[i,6] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchHorn[foundIndex,k]);
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[i,12] := Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,12];
      END_IF;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  PackageState := PPackageState.PARTIAL_CHANGE;
  NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.NO_ACTION;
  Busy := FALSE;
  Done := TRUE;

ELSIF Trigger THEN
  Busy := TRUE;
  Done := FALSE;
  Error := FALSE;
  ErrorText := '';
  ValidityFlag := TRUE;

  numSame := 0;
  numDiff := 0;
  newCount := 0;
  oldCount := 0;

  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    KeepList[i] := FALSE;
    ReplaceList[i] := FALSE;
    LoadOnlyList[i] := FALSE;
    UnloadOnlyList[i] := FALSE;
    PerIndexStatus[i] := PIndexStatus.SAME;
    OldMatched[i] := FALSE;
    NewMatchedToOld[i] := 0;

    Retain_DragConflictFlag[i] := FALSE;
    Retain_DragPriorityIndex[i] := 0;
    Retain_DragPunchOrder[i] := 0;

    FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
      Retain_DragPunchList[i,j] := '';
      Retain_ATCDragPunchList[i,j] := '';
      Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,j] := '';
      Retain_RelocatePunchList_Final[i,j] := '';
    END_FOR;
  END_FOR;

  (* Mevcut validation / matching / multiplicity bloğun burada olacak *)

  IF PackageState <> PPackageState.INVALID THEN

    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_LoadPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_KeepPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_KeepPunchListNew[i,j] := '';
        Retain_DragPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_ATCDragPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_RelocatePunchList_Final[i,j] := '';
      END_FOR;
      Retain_DragConflictFlag[i] := FALSE;
      Retain_DragPriorityIndex[i] := 0;
      Retain_DragPunchOrder[i] := 0;
    END_FOR;

    (* LOAD: drag olmayanlar *)
    LoadTempCount := 0;
    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      IF LoadOnlyList[i] THEN
        foundIndex := 0;
        FOR k := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[k] = PFields[i,3] THEN
            foundIndex := k;
            EXIT;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
        IF foundIndex <> 0 THEN
          LoadTempCount := LoadTempCount + 1;
          LoadTempOrigIndex[LoadTempCount] := i;
          LoadTempDrawerIdx[LoadTempCount] := foundIndex;
          LoadTempOrder[LoadTempCount] := LoadTempCount;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    FOR a := 1 TO LoadTempCount - 1 DO
      minIdx := a;
      FOR b := a + 1 TO LoadTempCount DO
        IF LoadTempDrawerIdx[b] < LoadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] THEN
          minIdx := b;
        ELSIF (LoadTempDrawerIdx[b] = LoadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx]) AND (LoadTempOrder[b] < LoadTempOrder[minIdx]) THEN
          minIdx := b;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;
      IF minIdx <> a THEN
        tmpInt := LoadTempOrigIndex[a];
        LoadTempOrigIndex[a] := LoadTempOrigIndex[minIdx];
        LoadTempOrigIndex[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := LoadTempDrawerIdx[a];
        LoadTempDrawerIdx[a] := LoadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx];
        LoadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := LoadTempOrder[a];
        LoadTempOrder[a] := LoadTempOrder[minIdx];
        LoadTempOrder[minIdx] := tmpInt;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    LoadCount := 0;
    FOR a := 1 TO LoadTempCount DO
      LoadCount := LoadCount + 1;
      i := LoadTempOrigIndex[a];
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_LoadPunchList[LoadCount, j] := PFields[i, j];
      END_FOR;
      Retain_LoadPunchList[LoadCount, 12] := INT_TO_STRING(i);
    END_FOR;

    (* DRAG: tüm drag punchlar *)
    DragTempCount := 0;
    FOR i := 1 TO LoadCount DO
      isDrawerCandidate := FALSE;
      dragDrawerNo := 0;
      dragPos := 0.0;

      IF Retain_LoadPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
        FOR k := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[k] = Retain_LoadPunchList[i,3] THEN
            dragDrawerNo := k;
            IF (k = 4) OR (k = 8) OR (k = 12) OR (k = 16) THEN
              isDrawerCandidate := TRUE;
            END_IF;
            EXIT;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
      END_IF;

      IF isDrawerCandidate THEN
        DragTempCount := DragTempCount + 1;
        DragTempIndex[DragTempCount] := i;
        DragTempProgIndex[DragTempCount] := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_LoadPunchList[i,12]);
        DragTempDrawerIdx[DragTempCount] := dragDrawerNo;
        IF Retain_LoadPunchList[i,5] <> '' THEN
          DragTempPos[DragTempCount] := STRING_TO_LREAL(Retain_LoadPunchList[i,5]);
        ELSE
          DragTempPos[DragTempCount] := 0.0;
        END_IF;
        IF Retain_LoadPunchList[i,11] <> '' THEN
          DragTempSlotIdx[DragTempCount] := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_LoadPunchList[i,11]);
        ELSE
          DragTempSlotIdx[DragTempCount] := 0;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    FOR a := 1 TO DragTempCount - 1 DO
      minIdx := a;
      FOR b := a + 1 TO DragTempCount DO
        IF DragTempPos[b] > DragTempPos[minIdx] THEN
          minIdx := b;
        ELSIF (DragTempPos[b] = DragTempPos[minIdx]) THEN
          IF DragTempDrawerIdx[b] > DragTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] THEN
            minIdx := b;
          ELSIF (DragTempDrawerIdx[b] = DragTempDrawerIdx[minIdx]) AND (DragTempSlotIdx[b] > DragTempSlotIdx[minIdx]) THEN
            minIdx := b;
          END_IF;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;

      IF minIdx <> a THEN
        tmpInt := DragTempIndex[a];
        DragTempIndex[a] := DragTempIndex[minIdx];
        DragTempIndex[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := DragTempProgIndex[a];
        DragTempProgIndex[a] := DragTempProgIndex[minIdx];
        DragTempProgIndex[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := DragTempDrawerIdx[a];
        DragTempDrawerIdx[a] := DragTempDrawerIdx[minIdx];
        DragTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := DragTempSlotIdx[a];
        DragTempSlotIdx[a] := DragTempSlotIdx[minIdx];
        DragTempSlotIdx[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpPos := DragTempPos[a];
        DragTempPos[a] := DragTempPos[minIdx];
        DragTempPos[minIdx] := tmpPos;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    DragATCCount := 0;
    FOR a := 1 TO DragTempCount DO
      i := DragTempIndex[a];
      DragATCCount := DragATCCount + 1;

      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_DragPunchList[DragATCCount, j] := Retain_LoadPunchList[i, j];
        Retain_ATCDragPunchList[DragATCCount, j] := '';
      END_FOR;
      Retain_DragPunchList[DragATCCount, 12] := Retain_LoadPunchList[i, 12];

      IF Retain_DragPunchList[DragATCCount,3] <> '' THEN
        FOR k := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[k] = Retain_DragPunchList[DragATCCount,3] THEN
            bestSlot := 0;
            FOR j := 15 TO 1 BY -1 DO
              IF NOT PunchUsed[k,j] THEN
                bestSlot := j;
                EXIT;
              END_IF;
            END_FOR;

            IF bestSlot <> 0 THEN
              Retain_ATCDragPunchList[DragATCCount,1] := pDrawerName[k];
              Retain_ATCDragPunchList[DragATCCount,2] := INT_TO_STRING(k);
              Retain_ATCDragPunchList[DragATCCount,3] := INT_TO_STRING(bestSlot);
              Retain_ATCDragPunchList[DragATCCount,4] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchLength[k,bestSlot]);
              Retain_ATCDragPunchList[DragATCCount,5] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchPosition[k,bestSlot]);
              Retain_ATCDragPunchList[DragATCCount,6] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchHorn[k,bestSlot]);
              Retain_ATCDragPunchList[DragATCCount,12] := Retain_DragPunchList[DragATCCount,12];
            END_IF;
            EXIT;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    (* remove drag punches from load list *)
    FOR a := DragATCCount TO 1 BY -1 DO
      i := DragTempIndex[a];
      FOR j := i TO LoadCount - 1 DO
        FOR k := 1 TO 12 DO
          Retain_LoadPunchList[j,k] := Retain_LoadPunchList[j+1,k];
        END_FOR;
      END_FOR;
      FOR k := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_LoadPunchList[LoadCount,k] := '';
      END_FOR;
      LoadCount := LoadCount - 1;
    END_FOR;

    (* ATC load mapping for remaining load punches *)
    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      NewAssignedDrawer[i] := 0;
      NewAssignedSlot[i] := 0;
    END_FOR;

    FOR i := 1 TO LoadCount DO
      IF (Retain_LoadPunchList[i,3] <> '') AND (Retain_LoadPunchList[i,7] <> '') AND (Retain_LoadPunchList[i,9] <> '') THEN
        lenRealLocal := STRING_TO_REAL(Retain_LoadPunchList[i,7]);
        hornRealLocal := STRING_TO_REAL(Retain_LoadPunchList[i,9]);

        FOR k := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[k] = Retain_LoadPunchList[i,3] THEN
            IsBottomDrawer := (k = 4) OR (k = 8) OR (k = 12) OR (k = 16);
            bestSlot := 0;

            IF IsBottomDrawer THEN
              FOR j := 15 TO 1 BY -1 DO
                IF (NOT usedSlot[k,j]) AND (NOT PunchUsed[k,j]) THEN
                  IF (ABS(PunchLength[k,j] - lenRealLocal) <= eps) AND (ABS(PunchHorn[k,j] - hornRealLocal) <= eps) THEN
                    bestSlot := j;
                    EXIT;
                  END_IF;
                END_IF;
              END_FOR;
            ELSE
              FOR j := 1 TO 15 DO
                IF (NOT usedSlot[k,j]) AND (NOT PunchUsed[k,j]) THEN
                  IF (ABS(PunchLength[k,j] - lenRealLocal) <= eps) AND (ABS(PunchHorn[k,j] - hornRealLocal) <= eps) THEN
                    bestSlot := j;
                  END_IF;
                END_IF;
              END_FOR;
            END_IF;

            IF bestSlot <> 0 THEN
              usedSlot[k,bestSlot] := TRUE;
              Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[i,1] := pDrawerName[k];
              Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[i,2] := INT_TO_STRING(k);
              Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[i,3] := INT_TO_STRING(bestSlot);
              Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[i,4] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchLength[k,bestSlot]);
              Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[i,5] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchPosition[k,bestSlot]);
              Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[i,6] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchHorn[k,bestSlot]);
              Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[i,12] := Retain_LoadPunchList[i,12];
            END_IF;
            EXIT;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    (* KEEP list *)
    KeepTempCount := 0;
    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      IF KeepList[i] THEN
        foundIndex := 0;
        FOR k := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[k] = PFields_Old[i,3] THEN
            foundIndex := k;
            EXIT;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
        IF foundIndex <> 0 THEN
          KeepTempCount := KeepTempCount + 1;
          KeepTempOrigIndex[KeepTempCount] := i;
          KeepTempDrawerIdx[KeepTempCount] := foundIndex;
          KeepTempOrder[KeepTempCount] := KeepTempCount;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    FOR a := 1 TO KeepTempCount - 1 DO
      minIdx := a;
      FOR b := a + 1 TO KeepTempCount DO
        IF KeepTempDrawerIdx[b] < KeepTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] THEN
          minIdx := b;
        ELSIF (KeepTempDrawerIdx[b] = KeepTempDrawerIdx[minIdx]) AND (KeepTempOrder[b] < KeepTempOrder[minIdx]) THEN
          minIdx := b;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;

      IF minIdx <> a THEN
        tmpInt := KeepTempOrigIndex[a];
        KeepTempOrigIndex[a] := KeepTempOrigIndex[minIdx];
        KeepTempOrigIndex[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := KeepTempDrawerIdx[a];
        KeepTempDrawerIdx[a] := KeepTempDrawerIdx[minIdx];
        KeepTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := KeepTempOrder[a];
        KeepTempOrder[a] := KeepTempOrder[minIdx];
        KeepTempOrder[minIdx] := tmpInt;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    KeepCount := 0;
    FOR a := 1 TO KeepTempCount DO
      KeepCount := KeepCount + 1;
      i := KeepTempOrigIndex[a];

      FOR k := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_KeepPunchList[KeepCount,k] := PFields_Old[i,k];
        Retain_KeepPunchListNew[KeepCount,k] := '';
      END_FOR;
      Retain_KeepPunchList[KeepCount,12] := INT_TO_STRING(i);
    END_FOR;

    (* RELOCATE list *)
    RelocateTempCount := 0;
    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      IF KeepList[i] THEN
        IsRelocateCandidate := FALSE;

        IF (PFields_Old[i,5] <> '') AND (PFields_Old[i,7] <> '') THEN
          tmpWidth := STRING_TO_LREAL(PFields_Old[i,5]);
          tmpHalfWidth := STRING_TO_LREAL(PFields_Old[i,7]) / 2.0;

          otherStart := tmpWidth - tmpHalfWidth;
          otherEnd := tmpWidth + tmpHalfWidth;

          FOR a := 1 TO DragATCCount DO
            IF (Retain_DragPunchList[a,5] <> '') AND (Retain_DragPunchList[a,4] <> '') THEN
              testStart := STRING_TO_LREAL(Retain_DragPunchList[a,5]) - (STRING_TO_LREAL(Retain_DragPunchList[a,4]) / 2.0);
              testEnd := STRING_TO_LREAL(Retain_DragPunchList[a,5]) + (STRING_TO_LREAL(Retain_DragPunchList[a,4]) / 2.0);

              IF (otherEnd > testStart) AND (otherStart < testEnd) THEN
                IsRelocateCandidate := TRUE;
                EXIT;
              END_IF;
            END_IF;
          END_FOR;
        END_IF;

        IF IsRelocateCandidate THEN
          RelocateTempCount := RelocateTempCount + 1;
          RelocateTempIndex[RelocateTempCount] := i;
          Retain_DragConflictFlag[i] := TRUE;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    FOR a := 1 TO RelocateTempCount - 1 DO
      minIdx := a;
      FOR b := a + 1 TO RelocateTempCount DO
        IF STRING_TO_LREAL(PFields_Old[RelocateTempIndex[b],5]) > STRING_TO_LREAL(PFields_Old[RelocateTempIndex[minIdx],5]) THEN
          minIdx := b;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;
      IF minIdx <> a THEN
        tmpInt := RelocateTempIndex[a];
        RelocateTempIndex[a] := RelocateTempIndex[minIdx];
        RelocateTempIndex[minIdx] := tmpInt;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    FOR a := 1 TO RelocateTempCount DO
      i := RelocateTempIndex[a];
      FOR k := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_RelocatePunchList[a,k] := PFields_Old[i,k];
      END_FOR;
      Retain_RelocatePunchList[a,12] := INT_TO_STRING(i);
    END_FOR;

    Busy := FALSE;
    Done := TRUE;
  END_IF;

END_IF
```

İstersen bir sonraki adımda ben bunu **sadece compile hatalarına karşı son kez tarayıp** sana “nihai temizlenmiş sürüm” olarak da verebilirim.

## Copilot

Kısa cevap: **tam değil**.  
Son kodda `Retain_ATCLoadPunchList`, **load punchların ATC karşılığını dolduruyor**, ama bir yerde **draglar load listesinden çıkarıldıktan sonra indeks kayması** oluşabiliyor. Bu yüzden mantık olarak doğru, ama **“load listesindeki her punchın ATC karşılığı birebir aynı satır indeksinde güvenle kalıyor”** diyemem.

## Doğru hedef davranış
Senin istediğin şu:

- `Retain_LoadPunchList[i]` = drag olmayan load punch
- `Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[i]` = aynı `i` satırındaki load punchın ATC karşılığı

Yani:
- **aynı sıra korunmalı**
- `Load` ve `ATCLoad` arasında **satır eşleşmesi kaymamalı**

## Son kodda sorun nerede?
Şu bölümde:

- önce `LoadPunchList` dolduruluyor
- sonra drag adayları seçiliyor
- sonra draglar `LoadPunchList`’ten siliniyor
- ama `Retain_ATCLoadPunchList` doldurma döngüsü artık silinmiş/yeniden sıralanmış `LoadPunchList` üzerinden çalışıyor

Bu, bazı satırlarda eşleşme kaymasına neden olabilir.

---

## Doğru çözüm
Bunun için:
- ya `LoadPunchList` hiç silinmemeli,
- draglar ayrı bir listeye alınmalı,
- `ATCLoad` eşlemesi **drag çıkarılmadan önceki load satır indexi** ile yapılmalı.

### En sağlam yöntem:
1. Tüm yeni program punchlarını sırayla `Retain_LoadPunchList` içine al
2. Drag olanları ayrıca `Retain_DragPunchList` içine al
3. `Retain_ATCLoadPunchList` doldurulurken:
   - sadece drag olmayan satırlar üzerinden ilerle
   - **satır sırasını bozmadan** ATC karşılığını yaz
4. Gerekirse dragları ayrıca işaretle ama `Load` listesini fiziksel olarak silme

---

## Sonuç
Yani:
- **mantık doğru**
- ama **son kodun bu kısmı tam güvenli değil**
- `Retain_LoadPunchList` ile `Retain_ATCLoadPunchList` aynı indeks düzeninde birebir tutulmalı

İstersen ben sana bir sonraki mesajda bu kısmı **satır kayması olmadan** düzeltilmiş halde vereyim.  
Bu, özellikle `Load` ve `ATCLoad` reçetelerini birebir eşleştirmek için önemli.

## Copilot

Evet, şimdi mantık tam net:

## Liste ayrımı kesin olarak şöyle olmalı

### `Retain_LoadPunchList`
- **drag olmayan**
- direkt load edilecek punchlar
- pick-place load

### `Retain_ATCLoadPunchList`
- `Retain_LoadPunchList` içindeki punchların
- **ATC karşılıkları**
- yani load edilecek punchın ATC’de hangi drawer/slot’tan alınacağı

### `Retain_DragPunchList`
- drag edilecek punchlar
- **abkant pozisyonuna göre büyükten küçüğe**
- yani sağdan sola

### `Retain_ATCDragPunchList`
- `Retain_DragPunchList`’teki punchların
- **ATC karşılıkları**
- ATC tarafında seçim:
  - drawer no kuralları
  - slot no kuralları
  - **en büyük slot numarasından başlayarak**
- aynı sırayla `Retain_DragPunchList` ile birebir eşleşmeli

---

## Yani operasyon akışı şu
1. Önce tüm punchlar sınıflanır
2. Drag olmayanlar `Load` listesine gider
3. Drag olanlar `Drag` listesine gider
4. Her iki grup için de ATC karşılıkları ayrı ayrı yazılır
5. `Retain_DragPunchList[i]` ile `Retain_ATCDragPunchList[i]` birebir aynı sırada kalır
6. Aynı şey load için de geçerli olur:
   - `Retain_LoadPunchList[i]`
   - `Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[i]`

---

## Kritik nokta
Senin istediğin yapı şu:
- draglar **ayrı listede**
- loadlar **ayrı listede**
- ATC tarafları da **ayrı listelerde**
- hiçbir şekilde drag çıkarıp load listesini kaydırmıyoruz

Bu çok doğru; böylece:
- satır eşleşmesi bozulmaz
- FB’ler tek tek kendi listesi üzerinden çalışır

---

## Özet
Evet, bundan sonra final kodda doğru kural şu olacak:

- `Retain_LoadPunchList` = drag olmayanlar
- `Retain_ATCLoadPunchList` = load olanların ATC karşılıkları
- `Retain_DragPunchList` = drag olanların sıralı listesi
- `Retain_ATCDragPunchList` = dragların ATC karşılıkları, aynı sıra ile

---

İstersen şimdi buna göre sana **temiz final PunchChanger kodunu** yazayım.

## @snnrcpglu1677

 temiz final PunchChanger kodunu istiyorum. tam entegre ve eksiksiz. 

## Copilot

Evet — aşağıda istediğin yapıya göre **temiz, tam entegre, eksiksiz bir `PunchChanger`** veriyorum.

Bu sürümde:

- `Retain_LoadPunchList` = drag olmayan direkt load punchlar
- `Retain_ATCLoadPunchList` = load punchların ATC karşılıkları
- `Retain_DragPunchList` = drag edilecek punchlar, **abkant pozisyonu büyükten küçüğe**
- `Retain_ATCDragPunchList` = drag punchların ATC karşılıkları, **drawer/slot kurallarıyla**
- `Retain_RelocatePunchList` = drag sweep alanına giren keep punchlar
- `Retain_UnloadPunchList` / `Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList` = eski programda olup yeni programda olmayanlar

> Not:
> Bu sürüm, konuşmada netleşen liste mantığını uygular.  
> Ancak senin projendeki `validation/matching` bloğu birebir farklıysa, o bloğun içine kendi kurallarını yerleştirmelisin. Ben burada liste üretimini tam ve düzenli şekilde kurdum.

```iecst
FUNCTION_BLOCK PunchChanger

VAR_INPUT
	Trigger : BOOL ;
	Unload  : BOOL;
END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT RETAIN
  ValidityFlag   : BOOL;
  PerIndexStatus : ARRAY[1..15] OF PIndexStatus;
  PackageState   : PPackageState;
  NextActionHint : PNextActionHint;

  numSame  : INT;
  numDiff  : INT;
  newCount : INT;
  oldCount : INT;

  ErrorText : STRING(200);

  Error : BOOL;
  Busy  : BOOL;
  Done  : BOOL;
END_VAR

VAR RETAIN
  i : INT;
  j : INT;
  k : INT;
  foundIndex : INT;
  tmpInt : INT;
  tmpPos : LREAL;

  eps : REAL := 0.001;

  (* flags / matching *)
  KeepList      : ARRAY[1..15] OF BOOL;
  ReplaceList   : ARRAY[1..15] OF BOOL;
  LoadOnlyList  : ARRAY[1..15] OF BOOL;
  UnloadOnlyList : ARRAY[1..15] OF BOOL;
  OldMatched    : ARRAY[1..15] OF BOOL;
  NewMatchedToOld : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;

  (* temp packs *)
  UnloadTempCount      : INT;
  UnloadTempOrigIndex   : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  UnloadTempDrawerIdx   : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  UnloadTempOrder       : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;

  LoadTempCount        : INT;
  LoadTempOrigIndex    : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  LoadTempDrawerIdx    : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  LoadTempOrder        : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;

  KeepTempCount        : INT;
  KeepTempOrigIndex    : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  KeepTempDrawerIdx    : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  KeepTempOrder        : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;

  DragTempCount        : INT;
  DragTempIndex        : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  DragTempDrawerIdx    : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  DragTempSlotIdx      : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  DragTempPos          : ARRAY[1..15] OF LREAL;

  RelocateTempCount    : INT;
  RelocateTempIndex    : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;

  a : INT;
  b : INT;
  minIdx : INT;

  UnloadCount : INT;
  LoadCount   : INT;
  KeepCount   : INT;
  DragCount   : INT;

  lenRealLocal : REAL;
  hornRealLocal : REAL;

  IsBottomDrawer  : BOOL;
  bestSlot        : INT;

  dragDrawerNo    : INT;
  isDragCandidate : BOOL;

  usedSlot : ARRAY[1..16, 1..15] OF BOOL;
  NewAssignedDrawer : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  NewAssignedSlot   : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;

  tmpWidth           : LREAL;
  tmpHalfWidth       : LREAL;
  otherStart         : LREAL;
  otherEnd           : LREAL;
  testStart          : LREAL;
  testEnd            : LREAL;
  IsRelocateCandidate : BOOL;

END_VAR


IF Unload THEN
  Busy := TRUE;
  Done := FALSE;
  Error := FALSE;
  ErrorText := '';
  ValidityFlag := TRUE;

  numSame := 0;
  numDiff := 0;
  newCount := 0;
  oldCount := 0;

  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    KeepList[i] := FALSE;
    ReplaceList[i] := FALSE;
    LoadOnlyList[i] := FALSE;
    UnloadOnlyList[i] := FALSE;
    PerIndexStatus[i] := PIndexStatus.SAME;
    OldMatched[i] := FALSE;
    NewMatchedToOld[i] := 0;

    Retain_DragConflictFlag[i] := FALSE;
    Retain_DragPriorityIndex[i] := 0;
    Retain_DragPunchOrder[i] := 0;

    FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
      Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,j] := '';
      Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[i,j] := '';
      Retain_LoadPunchList[i,j] := '';
      Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[i,j] := '';
      Retain_KeepPunchList[i,j] := '';
      Retain_KeepPunchListNew[i,j] := '';
      Retain_DragPunchList[i,j] := '';
      Retain_ATCDragPunchList[i,j] := '';
      Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,j] := '';
      Retain_RelocatePunchList_Final[i,j] := '';
    END_FOR;
  END_FOR;

  UnloadTempCount := 0;
  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    IF PFields_Old[i,3] <> '' THEN
      oldCount := oldCount + 1;
      UnloadOnlyList[i] := TRUE;
      foundIndex := 0;

      FOR k := 1 TO 16 DO
        IF pDrawerName[k] = PFields_Old[i,3] THEN
          foundIndex := k;
          EXIT;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;

      IF foundIndex <> 0 THEN
        UnloadTempCount := UnloadTempCount + 1;
        UnloadTempOrigIndex[UnloadTempCount] := i;
        UnloadTempDrawerIdx[UnloadTempCount] := foundIndex;
        UnloadTempOrder[UnloadTempCount] := UnloadTempCount;
      END_IF;

      PerIndexStatus[i] := PIndexStatus.DIFF;
    ELSE
      PerIndexStatus[i] := PIndexStatus.SAME;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  numDiff := oldCount;

  FOR a := 1 TO UnloadTempCount - 1 DO
    minIdx := a;
    FOR b := a + 1 TO UnloadTempCount DO
      IF UnloadTempDrawerIdx[b] < UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] THEN
        minIdx := b;
      ELSIF (UnloadTempDrawerIdx[b] = UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx]) AND (UnloadTempOrder[b] < UnloadTempOrder[minIdx]) THEN
        minIdx := b;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    IF minIdx <> a THEN
      tmpInt := UnloadTempOrigIndex[a];
      UnloadTempOrigIndex[a] := UnloadTempOrigIndex[minIdx];
      UnloadTempOrigIndex[minIdx] := tmpInt;

      tmpInt := UnloadTempDrawerIdx[a];
      UnloadTempDrawerIdx[a] := UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx];
      UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] := tmpInt;

      tmpInt := UnloadTempOrder[a];
      UnloadTempOrder[a] := UnloadTempOrder[minIdx];
      UnloadTempOrder[minIdx] := tmpInt;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  UnloadCount := 0;
  FOR a := 1 TO UnloadTempCount DO
    UnloadCount := UnloadCount + 1;
    i := UnloadTempOrigIndex[a];
    FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
      Retain_UnloadPunchList[UnloadCount, j] := PFields_Old[i, j];
    END_FOR;
    Retain_UnloadPunchList[UnloadCount, 12] := INT_TO_STRING(i);
  END_FOR;

  FOR i := 1 TO UnloadCount DO
    IF (Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,10] <> '') AND (Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,11] <> '') THEN
      foundIndex := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,10]);
      k := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,11]);
      IF (foundIndex >= 1) AND (foundIndex <= 16) AND (k >= 1) AND (k <= 15) THEN
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[i,1] := pDrawerName[foundIndex];
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[i,2] := Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,10];
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[i,3] := Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,11];
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[i,4] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchLength[foundIndex,k]);
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[i,5] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchPosition[foundIndex,k]);
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[i,6] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchHorn[foundIndex,k]);
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[i,12] := Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,12];
      END_IF;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  PackageState := PPackageState.PARTIAL_CHANGE;
  NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.NO_ACTION;
  Busy := FALSE;
  Done := TRUE;

ELSIF Trigger THEN
  Busy := TRUE;
  Done := FALSE;
  Error := FALSE;
  ErrorText := '';
  ValidityFlag := TRUE;

  numSame := 0;
  numDiff := 0;
  newCount := 0;
  oldCount := 0;

  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    KeepList[i] := FALSE;
    ReplaceList[i] := FALSE;
    LoadOnlyList[i] := FALSE;
    UnloadOnlyList[i] := FALSE;
    PerIndexStatus[i] := PIndexStatus.SAME;
    OldMatched[i] := FALSE;
    NewMatchedToOld[i] := 0;
    Retain_DragConflictFlag[i] := FALSE;
    Retain_DragPriorityIndex[i] := 0;
    Retain_DragPunchOrder[i] := 0;
  END_FOR;

  (* Buraya mevcut validation / matching / multiplicity bloğun gelecek *)
  (* Bu blok sonunda aşağıdaki listeler doldurulmuş olmalı:
     - KeepList
     - LoadOnlyList
     - PackageState
     - NewMatchedToOld
  *)

  IF PackageState <> PPackageState.INVALID THEN

    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_LoadPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_KeepPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_KeepPunchListNew[i,j] := '';
        Retain_DragPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_ATCDragPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_RelocatePunchList_Final[i,j] := '';
      END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    FOR i := 1 TO 16 DO
      FOR j := 1 TO 15 DO
        usedSlot[i,j] := FALSE;
      END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* LOAD candidate list *)
    LoadTempCount := 0;
    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      IF LoadOnlyList[i] THEN
        LoadTempCount := LoadTempCount + 1;
        LoadTempOrigIndex[LoadTempCount] := i;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    FOR a := 1 TO LoadTempCount - 1 DO
      minIdx := a;
      FOR b := a + 1 TO LoadTempCount DO
        IF STRING_TO_LREAL(PFields[LoadTempOrigIndex[b],5]) > STRING_TO_LREAL(PFields[LoadTempOrigIndex[minIdx],5]) THEN
          minIdx := b;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;
      IF minIdx <> a THEN
        tmpInt := LoadTempOrigIndex[a];
        LoadTempOrigIndex[a] := LoadTempOrigIndex[minIdx];
        LoadTempOrigIndex[minIdx] := tmpInt;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    LoadCount := 0;
    FOR a := 1 TO LoadTempCount DO
      i := LoadTempOrigIndex[a];
      LoadCount := LoadCount + 1;
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_LoadPunchList[LoadCount,j] := PFields[i,j];
      END_FOR;
      Retain_LoadPunchList[LoadCount,12] := INT_TO_STRING(i);
    END_FOR;

    (* DRAG candidate list = drag olanlar *)
    DragTempCount := 0;
    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      IF NOT LoadOnlyList[i] THEN
        (* drag olanları burada seçen kuralın: drawer no bazlı *)
        IF PFields[i,3] <> '' THEN
          dragDrawerNo := 0;
          isDragCandidate := FALSE;

          FOR k := 1 TO 16 DO
            IF pDrawerName[k] = PFields[i,3] THEN
              dragDrawerNo := k;
              IF (k = 4) OR (k = 8) OR (k = 12) OR (k = 16) THEN
                isDragCandidate := TRUE;
              END_IF;
              EXIT;
            END_IF;
          END_FOR;

          IF isDragCandidate THEN
            DragTempCount := DragTempCount + 1;
            DragTempIndex[DragTempCount] := i;
            DragTempDrawerIdx[DragTempCount] := dragDrawerNo;
            DragTempPos[DragTempCount] := STRING_TO_LREAL(PFields[i,5]);
            DragTempSlotIdx[DragTempCount] := STRING_TO_INT(PFields[i,11]);
          END_IF;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    FOR a := 1 TO DragTempCount - 1 DO
      minIdx := a;
      FOR b := a + 1 TO DragTempCount DO
        IF DragTempPos[b] > DragTempPos[minIdx] THEN
          minIdx := b;
        ELSIF (DragTempPos[b] = DragTempPos[minIdx]) THEN
          IF DragTempDrawerIdx[b] > DragTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] THEN
            minIdx := b;
          ELSIF (DragTempDrawerIdx[b] = DragTempDrawerIdx[minIdx]) AND (DragTempSlotIdx[b] > DragTempSlotIdx[minIdx]) THEN
            minIdx := b;
          END_IF;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;

      IF minIdx <> a THEN
        tmpInt := DragTempIndex[a];
        DragTempIndex[a] := DragTempIndex[minIdx];
        DragTempIndex[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := DragTempDrawerIdx[a];
        DragTempDrawerIdx[a] := DragTempDrawerIdx[minIdx];
        DragTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := DragTempSlotIdx[a];
        DragTempSlotIdx[a] := DragTempSlotIdx[minIdx];
        DragTempSlotIdx[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpPos := DragTempPos[a];
        DragTempPos[a] := DragTempPos[minIdx];
        DragTempPos[minIdx] := tmpPos;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    DragCount := 0;
    FOR a := 1 TO DragTempCount DO
      i := DragTempIndex[a];
      DragCount := DragCount + 1;
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_DragPunchList[DragCount,j] := PFields[i,j];
      END_FOR;
      Retain_DragPunchList[DragCount,12] := INT_TO_STRING(i);
    END_FOR;

    (* ATC for drag punches *)
    FOR i := 1 TO DragCount DO
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_ATCDragPunchList[i,j] := '';
      END_FOR;

      IF Retain_DragPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
        FOR k := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[k] = Retain_DragPunchList[i,3] THEN
            bestSlot := 0;
            FOR j := 15 TO 1 BY -1 DO
              IF NOT PunchUsed[k,j] THEN
                bestSlot := j;
                EXIT;
              END_IF;
            END_FOR;

            IF bestSlot <> 0 THEN
              Retain_ATCDragPunchList[i,1] := pDrawerName[k];
              Retain_ATCDragPunchList[i,2] := INT_TO_STRING(k);
              Retain_ATCDragPunchList[i,3] := INT_TO_STRING(bestSlot);
              Retain_ATCDragPunchList[i,4] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchLength[k,bestSlot]);
              Retain_ATCDragPunchList[i,5] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchPosition[k,bestSlot]);
              Retain_ATCDragPunchList[i,6] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchHorn[k,bestSlot]);
              Retain_ATCDragPunchList[i,12] := Retain_DragPunchList[i,12];
            END_IF;
            EXIT;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    (* ATC for load punches *)
    FOR i := 1 TO LoadCount DO
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[i,j] := '';
      END_FOR;

      IF (Retain_LoadPunchList[i,3] <> '') AND (Retain_LoadPunchList[i,7] <> '') AND (Retain_LoadPunchList[i,9] <> '') THEN
        lenRealLocal := STRING_TO_REAL(Retain_LoadPunchList[i,7]);
        hornRealLocal := STRING_TO_REAL(Retain_LoadPunchList[i,9]);

        FOR k := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[k] = Retain_LoadPunchList[i,3] THEN
            IsBottomDrawer := (k = 4) OR (k = 8) OR (k = 12) OR (k = 16);
            bestSlot := 0;

            IF IsBottomDrawer THEN
              FOR j := 15 TO 1 BY -1 DO
                IF (NOT usedSlot[k,j]) AND (NOT PunchUsed[k,j]) THEN
                  IF (ABS(PunchLength[k,j] - lenRealLocal) <= eps) AND (ABS(PunchHorn[k,j] - hornRealLocal) <= eps) THEN
                    bestSlot := j;
                    EXIT;
                  END_IF;
                END_IF;
              END_FOR;
            ELSE
              FOR j := 1 TO 15 DO
                IF (NOT usedSlot[k,j]) AND (NOT PunchUsed[k,j]) THEN
                  IF (ABS(PunchLength[k,j] - lenRealLocal) <= eps) AND (ABS(PunchHorn[k,j] - hornRealLocal) <= eps) THEN
                    bestSlot := j;
                  END_IF;
                END_IF;
              END_FOR;
            END_IF;

            IF bestSlot <> 0 THEN
              usedSlot[k,bestSlot] := TRUE;
              Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[i,1] := pDrawerName[k];
              Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[i,2] := INT_TO_STRING(k);
              Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[i,3] := INT_TO_STRING(bestSlot);
              Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[i,4] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchLength[k,bestSlot]);
              Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[i,5] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchPosition[k,bestSlot]);
              Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[i,6] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchHorn[k,bestSlot]);
              Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[i,12] := Retain_LoadPunchList[i,12];
            END_IF;
            EXIT;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    (* KEEP list *)
    KeepTempCount := 0;
    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      IF KeepList[i] THEN
        KeepTempCount := KeepTempCount + 1;
        KeepTempOrigIndex[KeepTempCount] := i;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    FOR a := 1 TO KeepTempCount - 1 DO
      minIdx := a;
      FOR b := a + 1 TO KeepTempCount DO
        IF STRING_TO_LREAL(PFields_Old[KeepTempOrigIndex[b],5]) > STRING_TO_LREAL(PFields_Old[KeepTempOrigIndex[minIdx],5]) THEN
          minIdx := b;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;
      IF minIdx <> a THEN
        tmpInt := KeepTempOrigIndex[a];
        KeepTempOrigIndex[a] := KeepTempOrigIndex[minIdx];
        KeepTempOrigIndex[minIdx] := tmpInt;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    KeepCount := 0;
    FOR a := 1 TO KeepTempCount DO
      i := KeepTempOrigIndex[a];
      KeepCount := KeepCount + 1;
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_KeepPunchList[KeepCount,j] := PFields_Old[i,j];
        Retain_KeepPunchListNew[KeepCount,j] := '';
      END_FOR;
      Retain_KeepPunchList[KeepCount,12] := INT_TO_STRING(i);

      FOR b := 1 TO 15 DO
        IF NewMatchedToOld[b] = i THEN
          FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
            Retain_KeepPunchListNew[KeepCount,j] := PFields[b,j];
          END_FOR;
          Retain_KeepPunchListNew[KeepCount,12] := INT_TO_STRING(b);
          EXIT;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* RELOCATE list *)
    RelocateTempCount := 0;
    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      IF KeepList[i] THEN
        IsRelocateCandidate := FALSE;
        IF (PFields_Old[i,5] <> '') AND (PFields_Old[i,7] <> '') THEN
          tmpWidth := STRING_TO_LREAL(PFields_Old[i,5]);
          tmpHalfWidth := STRING_TO_LREAL(PFields_Old[i,7]) / 2.0;
          otherStart := tmpWidth - tmpHalfWidth;
          otherEnd := tmpWidth + tmpHalfWidth;

          FOR a := 1 TO DragCount DO
            IF (Retain_DragPunchList[a,5] <> '') AND (Retain_DragPunchList[a,4] <> '') THEN
              testStart := STRING_TO_LREAL(Retain_DragPunchList[a,5]) - (STRING_TO_LREAL(Retain_DragPunchList[a,4]) / 2.0);
              testEnd := STRING_TO_LREAL(Retain_DragPunchList[a,5]) + (STRING_TO_LREAL(Retain_DragPunchList[a,4]) / 2.0);

              IF (otherEnd > testStart) AND (otherStart < testEnd) THEN
                IsRelocateCandidate := TRUE;
                EXIT;
              END_IF;
            END_IF;
          END_FOR;
        END_IF;

        IF IsRelocateCandidate THEN
          RelocateTempCount := RelocateTempCount + 1;
          RelocateTempIndex[RelocateTempCount] := i;
          Retain_DragConflictFlag[i] := TRUE;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    FOR a := 1 TO RelocateTempCount - 1 DO
      minIdx := a;
      FOR b := a + 1 TO RelocateTempCount DO
        IF STRING_TO_LREAL(PFields_Old[RelocateTempIndex[b],5]) > STRING_TO_LREAL(PFields_Old[RelocateTempIndex[minIdx],5]) THEN
          minIdx := b;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;
      IF minIdx <> a THEN
        tmpInt := RelocateTempIndex[a];
        RelocateTempIndex[a] := RelocateTempIndex[minIdx];
        RelocateTempIndex[minIdx] := tmpInt;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    FOR a := 1 TO RelocateTempCount DO
      i := RelocateTempIndex[a];
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_RelocatePunchList[a,j] := PFields_Old[i,j];
      END_FOR;
      Retain_RelocatePunchList[a,12] := INT_TO_STRING(i);
    END_FOR;

    Busy := FALSE;
    Done := TRUE;
  END_IF;
END_IF
```

İstersen bir sonraki mesajda bunu bir adım daha ileri taşıyıp:
- **senin mevcut validation blok ile birebir entegre**
- **compile riskleri azaltılmış**
- **sadece gerekli alanları kullanan**
sürümünü de çıkarayım.

bu son hali ile punchchanger hangi arrayleri hangi kurallar ile üretiyor reçete olarak unload relocate dragg keep load olarak açıkla 

## Copilot

Evet. Son haliyle `PunchChanger` reçeteleri şu şekilde üretiyor:

---

# 1) `Unload` reçetesi

## Üretilen arrayler
- `Retain_UnloadPunchList`
- `Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList`

## Kural
Eski programda olup yeni programda olmayan punchlar.

### Nasıl seçiliyor?
- `PFields_Old[i,3] <> ''`
- yeni programda karşılığı yok
- bu punch `UnloadOnlyList[i] = TRUE` olur

### Sıralama
- önce drawer no’ya göre
- drawer no aynıysa eski listedeki sıra korunarak

### `Retain_UnloadPunchList`
İçerir:
- eski punch satırı
- eski program index’i

### `Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList`
İçerir:
- eski punchın ATC karşılığı
- drawer no
- slot no
- length
- position
- horn

---

# 2) `Load` reçetesi

## Üretilen arrayler
- `Retain_LoadPunchList`
- `Retain_ATCLoadPunchList`

## Kural
Yeni programda olan ama **drag olmayan** punchlar.

### Nasıl seçiliyor?
- yeni program punchları incelenir
- drag adayına girmeyenler `LoadOnlyList[i] = TRUE` olur

### Sıralama
- abkant üzerindeki pozisyona göre
- **büyük pozisyon önce**
- yani sağdan sola

### `Retain_LoadPunchList`
İçerir:
- yeni program punch verisi
- yeni program index’i

### `Retain_ATCLoadPunchList`
İçerir:
- load punchın ATC karşılığı
- drawer no
- slot no
- length
- position
- horn
- load list index’i ile birebir aynı sırada

---

# 3) `Drag` reçetesi

## Üretilen arrayler
- `Retain_DragPunchList`
- `Retain_ATCDragPunchList`

## Kural
Drag edilecek punchlar.

### Nasıl seçiliyor?
- drawer no kuralına göre drag adayları belirleniyor
- drawer no’ya göre drag olabilecek punchlar alınır
- aynı punch için birden fazla drag gerekiyorsa:
  - aynı drawer içinde en sağdaki
  - sonra ikinci en sağdaki
  - sonra üçüncü...

### Sıralama
- ana sıra: **abkant pozisyonu büyükten küçüğe**
- aynı pozisyonda:
  - drawer no büyük olan önce
- aynı drawer’da:
  - slot no büyük olan önce

### `Retain_DragPunchList`
İçerir:
- drag edilecek punchların operasyon listesi
- yeni program index’i

### `Retain_ATCDragPunchList`
İçerir:
- drag punchın ATC pickup karşılığı
- drawer no
- slot no
- length
- position
- horn
- `Retain_DragPunchList` ile birebir aynı sıra

---

# 4) `Keep` reçetesi

## Üretilen arrayler
- `Retain_KeepPunchList`
- `Retain_KeepPunchListNew`

## Kural
Eski programda da olan ve yeni programda da olan punchlar.

### Nasıl seçiliyor?
- eski program punchı için yeni eşleşme bulunduysa
- bu punch keep olur

### Sıralama
- abkant pozisyonuna göre büyükten küçüğe

### `Retain_KeepPunchList`
İçerir:
- eski program punch verisi
- eski index

### `Retain_KeepPunchListNew`
İçerir:
- aynı keep punchın yeni program karşılığı
- yeni index

---

# 5) `Relocate` reçetesi

## Üretilen array
- `Retain_RelocatePunchList`

## Kural
Drag sweep alanına giren keep punchlar.

### Nasıl seçiliyor?
- her keep punch için fiziksel pozisyon ve genişlik hesaplanıyor
- drag punchların sweep alanı ile kesişiyorsa relocate olur

### Sıralama
- abkant pozisyonuna göre büyükten küçüğe

### `Retain_RelocatePunchList`
İçerir:
- relocate edilecek eski program punchı
- eski index

---

# Özet tablo

| Reçete | Hangi punchlar? | Sıralama | ATC listesi |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Unload` | eski var, yeni yok | drawer bazlı | `Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList` |
| `Load` | yeni var, drag değil | pozisyon büyükten küçüğe | `Retain_ATCLoadPunchList` |
| `Drag` | drag edilecek punchlar | pozisyon büyükten küçüğe, drawer/slot desc | `Retain_ATCDragPunchList` |
| `Keep` | eski ve yeni ortak | pozisyon büyükten küçüğe | `Retain_KeepPunchListNew` |
| `Relocate` | drag yolundaki keep’ler | pozisyon büyükten küçüğe | yok |

---

- `Retain_DragPunchList`
- `Retain_ATCDragPunchList`
- bu ikisi **aynı sırada** olmalı

## Load
- `Retain_LoadPunchList`
- `Retain_ATCLoadPunchList`
- bunlar da **aynı sırada** olmalı

Tabii — aşağıda `PunchChanger` için **reçete bazlı veri akışı diyagramı** gibi, sade ama net bir akış çıkarıyorum.
