onaylıyorum devam et 

## Copilot

Aşağıda `Punch_Relocate` FB’nin kalan kısmını, senin tanımladığın `Shuttle_States` ve `PunchRelocate_RotArm_SubState` akışına göre tam iskelet olarak veriyorum.

Not:
- Bu sürümde ana omurga tamamdır.
- Entegrasyon kolay olsun diye state geçişleri, axis/pnömatik komutları ve commit aşaması ayrı tutuldu.
- `Retain_RelocatePunchList` içindeki kolonlardan şu alanları temel aldım:
  - `[3]` drawer adı
  - `[5]` punch position
  - `[7]` width
  - `[10]` drawer no
  - `[11]` slot no
  - `[12]` source index

Ayrıca senin anlattığın relocate mantığına göre:
- liste boşsa FB iş yapmaz
- liste doluysa 1’den başlayıp sırayla gider
- güvenli relocate pozisyonu her punch için hesaplanır
- DX/DR/Z ve pin/clamp akışı `Punch_Keeping` ile aynı “request/wait” tarzında ilerler

```iecst
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Derived control *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
AutoRunEnable := Automatic_Page AND General_Start AND (NOT General_Stop);
risingStart := RelocateStartCmd AND NOT lastStartCmd;
ZOffset := REAL_TO_LREAL(Retain_ZParameters[19]);


(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* HARD ABORT *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
IF Abort_Cycle THEN
  RelocateStartAck := FALSE;
  RelocateBusy := FALSE;
  RelocateDone := FALSE;
  RelocateError := FALSE;

  Local_Shuttle_State := Shuttle_States.SH_IDLE;
  PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_IDLE;
  PRelocate_RotArm_SubState := PunchRelocate_RotArm_SubState.PRSH_IDLE;
  PRelocate_WH_SubState := PunchRelocate_WH_SubState.PRSH_IDLE;

  initiated := FALSE;
  Current_PunchIndex := 0;
  RelocateCount := 0;
  SelectedPunchIndex := 0;

  NeedReAnalyze := FALSE;
  IterationCount := 0;

  SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_DX_Done := FALSE;
  SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
  SH_Z_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_Z_Done := FALSE;

  PinsReady := FALSE;
  ClampReleased := FALSE;
  ClampEngaged := FALSE;

  RelocateMaxEnd := 0.0;
  RelocateStartPos := 0.0;
  RelocateNextPos := 0.0;

  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    RelocateActive[i] := FALSE;
    RelocateDoneArr[i] := FALSE;
    RelocateOldIndex[i] := 0;

    RelocateWidth[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateOldZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateCurrentZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateTargetZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateSafeZ[i] := 0.0;

    RelocateOldRangeStart[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateOldRangeEnd[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateCurrentRangeStart[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateCurrentRangeEnd[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateTargetRangeStart[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateTargetRangeEnd[i] := 0.0;

    RelocateCalcSafePos[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateDebugCurrentZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateDebugTargetZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateDebugSafePos[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateDebugDrawerNo[i] := 0;
    RelocateDebugSlotNo[i] := 0;
  END_FOR;
END_IF;


(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* SOFT RESET *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
IF Reset THEN
  RelocateStartAck := FALSE;
  SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_DX_Done := FALSE;
  SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
  SH_Z_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_Z_Done := FALSE;
END_IF;


(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* START *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
IF risingStart AND (NOT initiated) THEN
  RelocateStartAck := TRUE;
  RelocateBusy := TRUE;
  RelocateDone := FALSE;
  RelocateError := FALSE;

  initiated := TRUE;
  NeedReAnalyze := TRUE;
  IterationCount := 0;

  Current_PunchIndex := 0;
  SelectedPunchIndex := 0;
  RelocateCount := 0;
  RelocateMaxEnd := 0.0;
  RelocateStartPos := 0.0;
  RelocateNextPos := 0.0;

  SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_DX_Done := FALSE;
  SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
  SH_Z_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_Z_Done := FALSE;

  PinsReady := FALSE;
  ClampReleased := FALSE;
  ClampEngaged := FALSE;

  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    RelocateActive[i] := FALSE;
    RelocateDoneArr[i] := FALSE;
    RelocateOldIndex[i] := 0;

    RelocateWidth[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateOldZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateCurrentZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateTargetZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateSafeZ[i] := 0.0;

    RelocateOldRangeStart[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateOldRangeEnd[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateCurrentRangeStart[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateCurrentRangeEnd[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateTargetRangeStart[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateTargetRangeEnd[i] := 0.0;

    RelocateCalcSafePos[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateDebugCurrentZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateDebugTargetZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateDebugSafePos[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateDebugDrawerNo[i] := 0;
    RelocateDebugSlotNo[i] := 0;
  END_FOR;

  Local_Shuttle_State := Shuttle_States.PRG_Proccesing;
  PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_INIT_START;
END_IF;


(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* PAUSE behaviour *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
IF initiated AND (NOT AutoRunEnable) THEN
  lastStartCmd := RelocateStartCmd;
  RETURN;
END_IF;


(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* MAIN STATE MACHINE *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
IF initiated THEN

  CASE Local_Shuttle_State OF

    Shuttle_States.PRG_Proccesing:

      CASE PRelocate_SH_SubState OF

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_INIT_START:
          IF NeedReAnalyze THEN
            RelocateCount := 0;
            RelocateMaxEnd := 0.0;

            FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
              RelocateActive[i] := FALSE;
              RelocateDoneArr[i] := FALSE;
              RelocateOldIndex[i] := 0;

              IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
                RelocateCount := RelocateCount + 1;
                RelocateActive[i] := TRUE;

                IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,12] <> '' THEN
                  RelocateOldIndex[i] := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,12]);
                ELSE
                  RelocateOldIndex[i] := 0;
                END_IF;

                IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,7] <> '' THEN
                  RelocateWidth[i] := STRING_TO_LREAL(Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,7]);
                ELSE
                  RelocateWidth[i] := 0.0;
                END_IF;

                IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,5] <> '' THEN
                  RelocateCurrentZ[i] := STRING_TO_LREAL(Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,5]) + ZOffset;
                ELSE
                  RelocateCurrentZ[i] := 0.0 + ZOffset;
                END_IF;

                RelocateOldZ[i] := RelocateCurrentZ[i];
                RelocateTargetZ[i] := 0.0;

                tmpHalfWidth := RelocateWidth[i] / 2.0;

                RelocateCurrentRangeStart[i] := RelocateCurrentZ[i] - tmpHalfWidth;
                RelocateCurrentRangeEnd[i] := RelocateCurrentZ[i] + tmpHalfWidth;

                IF RelocateCurrentRangeEnd[i] > RelocateMaxEnd THEN
                  RelocateMaxEnd := RelocateCurrentRangeEnd[i];
                END_IF;

                RelocateDebugCurrentZ[i] := RelocateCurrentZ[i];

                IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,10] <> '' THEN
                  RelocateDebugDrawerNo[i] := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,10]);
                ELSE
                  RelocateDebugDrawerNo[i] := 0;
                END_IF;

                IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,11] <> '' THEN
                  RelocateDebugSlotNo[i] := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,11]);
                ELSE
                  RelocateDebugSlotNo[i] := 0;
                END_IF;
              END_IF;
            END_FOR;

            NeedReAnalyze := FALSE;
          END_IF;

          IF RelocateCount = 0 THEN
            Local_Shuttle_State := Shuttle_States.PRG_Proccesing;
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_FINISHED;
          ELSE
            Current_PunchIndex := 1;
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_CHECK_LIST_EMPTY;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_CHECK_LIST_EMPTY:
          IF RelocateCount = 0 THEN
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_FINISHED;
            Local_Shuttle_State := Shuttle_States.SH_IDLE;
          ELSE
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PREP_CURRENT_INDEX;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PREP_CURRENT_INDEX:
          IF Current_PunchIndex > RelocateCount THEN
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_FINISHED;
            Local_Shuttle_State := Shuttle_States.SH_IDLE;
          ELSE
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_LOAD_SOURCE;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_LOAD_SOURCE:
          (* burada Current_PunchIndex’e bağlı satır okunur *)
          IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,3] <> '' THEN
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_DRAWER_NO;
          ELSE
            RelocateError := TRUE;
            Local_Shuttle_State := Shuttle_States.PRG_Proccesing;
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ERROR;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_DRAWER_NO:
          PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_PICK_Z;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_PICK_Z:
          (* pick Z, DR, safe position hesapları burada yapılacak *)
          tmpCurrentPos := RelocateCurrentZ[Current_PunchIndex];
          tmpWidth := RelocateWidth[Current_PunchIndex];
          tmpHalfWidth := tmpWidth / 2.0;

          RelocateStartPos := RelocateMaxEnd + tmpHalfWidth + 20.0;
          RelocateTargetZ[Current_PunchIndex] := RelocateStartPos;
          RelocateCalcSafePos[Current_PunchIndex] := RelocateStartPos;

          RelocateDebugTargetZ[Current_PunchIndex] := RelocateTargetZ[Current_PunchIndex];
          RelocateDebugSafePos[Current_PunchIndex] := RelocateCalcSafePos[Current_PunchIndex];

          IF Current_PunchIndex < RelocateCount THEN
            RelocateMaxEnd := RelocateStartPos + tmpWidth + 20.0;
          ELSE
            RelocateMaxEnd := RelocateStartPos + tmpWidth + 20.0;
          END_IF;

          PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_SAFE_POS;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_SAFE_POS:
          PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_NEXT_SAFE_POS;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_NEXT_SAFE_POS:
          (* Bir sonraki punch için güvenli pozisyon başlatma burada hazırlanır *)
          PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_CHECK_INSIDE;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_CHECK_INSIDE:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Inside THEN
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_CHECK_INSIDE;
          ELSE
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_MOVE_INSIDE_CMD;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_MOVE_INSIDE_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Inside_Valve := TRUE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Outside_Valve := FALSE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_WAIT_INSIDE;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_WAIT_INSIDE:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Inside THEN
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Inside_Valve := FALSE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_CHECK_INSIDE;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_CHECK_INSIDE:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Inside THEN
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_SAFE_REQ;
          ELSE
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_MOVE_INSIDE_CMD;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_MOVE_INSIDE_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Inside_Valve := TRUE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Outside_Valve := FALSE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_WAIT_INSIDE;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_WAIT_INSIDE:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Inside THEN
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Inside_Valve := FALSE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_SAFE_REQ;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_SAFE_REQ:
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(Retain_DXParameters[4]);
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
          SH_DX_MoveRequested := TRUE;
          SH_DX_Done := FALSE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_SAFE_WAIT;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_SAFE_WAIT:
          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos) <= KeepPosEps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DX_Done := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_PICK_REQ;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_PICK_REQ:
          tmpDrawerNo := 0;
          IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,10] <> '' THEN
            tmpDrawerNo := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,10]);
          END_IF;

          IF tmpDrawerNo <> 0 THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(pDrawerParam6[tmpDrawerNo]);
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
            SH_DR_MoveRequested := TRUE;
            SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_PICK_WAIT;
          ELSE
            RelocateError := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ERROR;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_PICK_WAIT:
          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos) <= KeepPosEps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DR_Done := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_Z_PICK_REQ;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_Z_PICK_REQ:
          tmpCurrentPos := 0.0;
          IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,5] <> '' THEN
            tmpCurrentPos := STRING_TO_LREAL(Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,5]) + ZOffset;
          END_IF;

          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].TargetPos := tmpCurrentPos;
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
          SH_Z_MoveRequested := TRUE;
          SH_Z_Done := FALSE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_Z_PICK_WAIT;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_Z_PICK_WAIT:
          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].TargetPos) <= KeepPosEps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_Z_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_Z_Done := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_PICK_ALIGN_REQ;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_PICK_ALIGN_REQ:
          tmpDrawerNo := 0;
          IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,10] <> '' THEN
            tmpDrawerNo := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,10]);
          END_IF;

          IF tmpDrawerNo <> 0 THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(pDrawerParam8[tmpDrawerNo]);
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
            SH_DX_MoveRequested := TRUE;
            SH_DX_Done := FALSE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_PICK_ALIGN_WAIT;
          ELSE
            RelocateError := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ERROR;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_PICK_ALIGN_WAIT:
          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos) <= KeepPosEps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DX_Done := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_OUT_CMD;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_OUT_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Inside_Valve := FALSE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Outside_Valve := TRUE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_OUT_WAIT;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_OUT_WAIT:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Outside THEN
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Outside_Valve := FALSE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_OUT_CMD;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_OUT_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Inside_Valve := FALSE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Outside_Valve := TRUE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_OUT_WAIT;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_OUT_WAIT:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Outside THEN
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Outside_Valve := FALSE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_CLAMP_OFF_CMD;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_CLAMP_OFF_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Press_Upper_ClampOn := FALSE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_CLAMP_OFF_WAIT;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_CLAMP_OFF_WAIT:
          IF NOT Fmsc_PLC_IO.Press_Upper_Clamp_Ok THEN
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_WITHDRAW_SLOW_REQ;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_WITHDRAW_SLOW_REQ:
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisAutoSetVelocity := Retain_DRParameters[2];
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos := arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - TO_LREAL(Retain_DRParameters[4]);
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
          SH_DR_MoveRequested := TRUE;
          SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_WITHDRAW_SLOW_WAIT;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_WITHDRAW_SLOW_WAIT:
          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos) <= KeepPosEps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DR_Done := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_Z_RELOCATE_SAFE_REQ;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_Z_RELOCATE_SAFE_REQ:
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].TargetPos := RelocateCalcSafePos[Current_PunchIndex];
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
          SH_Z_MoveRequested := TRUE;
          SH_Z_Done := FALSE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_Z_RELOCATE_SAFE_WAIT;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_Z_RELOCATE_SAFE_WAIT:
          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].TargetPos) <= KeepPosEps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_Z_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_Z_Done := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_PLACE_ALIGN_REQ;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_PLACE_ALIGN_REQ:
          tmpDrawerNo := 0;
          IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,10] <> '' THEN
            tmpDrawerNo := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,10]);
          END_IF;

          IF tmpDrawerNo <> 0 THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(pDrawerParam8[tmpDrawerNo]);
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
            SH_DX_MoveRequested := TRUE;
            SH_DX_Done := FALSE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_PLACE_ALIGN_WAIT;
          ELSE
            RelocateError := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ERROR;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_PLACE_ALIGN_WAIT:
          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos) <= KeepPosEps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DX_Done := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_INSERT_SLOW_REQ;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_INSERT_SLOW_REQ:
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisAutoSetVelocity := Retain_DRParameters[2];
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos := arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos + TO_LREAL(Retain_DRParameters[4]);
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
          SH_DR_MoveRequested := TRUE;
          SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_INSERT_SLOW_WAIT;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_INSERT_SLOW_WAIT:
          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos) <= KeepPosEps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DR_Done := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_CLAMP_ON_CMD;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_CLAMP_ON_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Press_Upper_ClampOn := TRUE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_CLAMP_ON_WAIT;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_CLAMP_ON_WAIT:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Press_Upper_Clamp_Ok THEN
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_IN_CMD;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_IN_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Inside_Valve := TRUE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Outside_Valve := FALSE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_IN_WAIT;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_IN_WAIT:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Inside THEN
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Inside_Valve := FALSE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_IN_CMD;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_IN_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Inside_Valve := TRUE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Outside_Valve := FALSE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_IN_WAIT;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_IN_WAIT:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Inside THEN
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Inside_Valve := FALSE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_COMMIT_UPDATE_PFIELDS;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_COMMIT_UPDATE_PFIELDS:
          CommitOldIndex := 0;
          IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,12] <> '' THEN
            CommitOldIndex := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,12]);
          END_IF;

          IF (CommitOldIndex >= 1) AND (CommitOldIndex <= 15) THEN
            PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,5] := LREAL_TO_STRING(RelocateTargetZ[Current_PunchIndex] - ZOffset);
            PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,6] := LREAL_TO_STRING(RelocateTargetZ[Current_PunchIndex] - ZOffset);
            PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,10] := Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,10];
            PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,11] := Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,11];
            PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,12] := Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,12];
          END_IF;

          PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_COMMIT_UPDATE_RETAIN;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_COMMIT_UPDATE_RETAIN:
          IF (Current_PunchIndex >= 1) AND (Current_PunchIndex <= 15) THEN
            RelocateCurrentZ[Current_PunchIndex] := RelocateTargetZ[Current_PunchIndex];
            RelocateCurrentRangeStart[Current_PunchIndex] := RelocateCurrentZ[Current_PunchIndex] - (RelocateWidth[Current_PunchIndex] / 2.0);
            RelocateCurrentRangeEnd[Current_PunchIndex] := RelocateCurrentZ[Current_PunchIndex] + (RelocateWidth[Current_PunchIndex] / 2.0);
            RelocateDoneArr[Current_PunchIndex] := TRUE;
            RelocateActive[Current_PunchIndex] := FALSE;
          END_IF;

          NeedReAnalyze := TRUE;
          IterationCount := IterationCount + 1;

          PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_COMMIT_NEXT_INDEX;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_COMMIT_NEXT_INDEX:
          Current_PunchIndex := Current_PunchIndex + 1;
          IF Current_PunchIndex > RelocateCount THEN
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_FINISHED;
            Local_Shuttle_State := Shuttle_States.SH_IDLE;
          ELSE
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_INIT_START;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_FINISHED:
          RelocateBusy := FALSE;
          RelocateDone := TRUE;
          RelocateStartAck := FALSE;
          initiated := FALSE;
          Local_Shuttle_State := Shuttle_States.SH_IDLE;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ERROR:
          RelocateBusy := FALSE;
          RelocateDone := FALSE;
          RelocateStartAck := FALSE;
          RelocateError := TRUE;
          initiated := FALSE;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ABORT:
          RelocateBusy := FALSE;
          RelocateDone := FALSE;
          RelocateStartAck := FALSE;
          initiated := FALSE;

        ELSE
          PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ERROR;
      END_CASE;

    ELSE
      ;
  END_CASE;
END_IF;


(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Edge memory update *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
lastStartCmd := RelocateStartCmd;
```

---

## Önemli notlar
Bu iskelette özellikle şu noktalar **sonradan kesin netleştirilmeli**:

1. `RelocateTargetZ` hesaplama mantığı  
   Şu an temel hesap var, ama senin dediğin “ilk punch en büyük pozisyona göre, sonra zincirleme” kuralı için gerekirse bir ayrı pre-calc loop yazacağız.

2. `PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,5]` ve `[6]` güncellemesi  
   Burada hangi alanın position, hangi alanın z/offset alanı olduğunu projendeki gerçek kolon tanımına göre kesinleştirmemiz gerekebilir.

3. `RotArm` ve `WH` state’leri  
   Şu an kullanılmıyor, ama enumları hazır olduğu için sonradan ayrıştırılabilir.

# Relocate pozisyon hesabı
## Kaynak
- `PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,6]` = position
- `PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,5]` = width

## İlk relocate punch
Tüm relocate adayları içinde:
- `PFields_Old[,6]` en büyük olan bulunur
- buna `+150` eklenir
- ilk relocate pozisyonu budur

## Sonraki punchlar
Bir punch relocate edildikten sonra:
- onun relocate pozisyonu
- + kendi width / 2
- + 20 mm

eklenerek bir sonraki punchın relocate pozisyonu hesaplanır.

Yani zincir şu:

```text
RelocatePos(1) = MaxPosition + 150
RelocatePos(2) = RelocatePos(1) + Width(1)/2 + 20
RelocatePos(3) = RelocatePos(2) + Width(2)/2 + 20
RelocatePos(4) = RelocatePos(3) + Width(3)/2 + 20
...
```

---

# Tutulacak debug data
Relocate FB içinde şunları tutacağız:

- her punch için hesaplanan relocate pozisyonu
- her punch için kullanılan width
- gerekirse drawer no / slot no

Böylece sonraki punch pozisyonu bu array’den türetilecek.

---

# Önemli düzeltme
Senin söylediğine göre:

- `PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,6]` = position
- `PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,5]` = width

Bu yüzden önceki koddaki commit satırında pozisyon/width alanlarını buna göre kullanacağız.

---

# Sonuç
Evet, artık relocate FB içinde:
- ayrı safe pre-calc fonksiyonu olmayacak
- relocate pozisyon zinciri doğrudan FB içinde oluşacak
- ilk punch için max position + 150
- devamı için önceki punch width/2 + 20

---

# Bir sonraki adım
İstersen şimdi ben:
1. `Punch_Relocate` FB’nin **düzeltilmiş tam final sürümünü**
2. bu yeni relocate position kuralını entegre ederek

tek parça halinde vereyim.  

Eğer istersen doğrudan “düzeltilmiş final kodu ver” de, ben kalan FB’yi buna göre revize edeyim.

## @snnrcpglu1677

PFields_Old[,6] ve PFields[,6] ortak bakılacak. 

## Copilot

Tamam, netleşti.

## Relocate position hesabında bakılacak alan
Hem:

- `PFields_Old[i,6]`
- `PFields[i,6]`

birlikte taranacak.

Yani başlangıç safe relocate pozisyonu için:
- iki listedeki tüm punchların `[,6]` değerleri incelenecek
- en büyük değer bulunacak
- buna `+150` eklenecek
- ilk relocate pozisyonu bu olacak

---

## Yani kural güncel haliyle şöyle
### İlk punch
```text
RelocatePos(1) = max(PFields_Old[* ,6], PFields[* ,6]) + 150
```

### Sonraki punchlar
```text
RelocatePos(n) = RelocatePos(n-1) + Width(n-1)/2 + 20
```

Buradaki `Width(n-1)`:
- bir önce relocate edilen punchın `[,5]` alanından okunacak

---

## Bu çok iyi
Bu sayede:
- yeni program ve eski program birlikte değerlendirilmiş olacak
- relocate alanı daha güvenli seçilecek
- zincirleme pozisyonlar tutarlı kalacak

---

## Son haliyle relocate FB’nin başlangıç mantığı
1. `PFields_Old` ve `PFields` tara
2. `[,6]` alanındaki max değeri bul
3. `+150` ile ilk relocate pozisyonunu üret
4. listedeki punchları sırayla bu relocate pozisyonlarına taşı
5. her taşıma sonunda:
   - o punchın width’ini sakla
   - sonraki punch için bir sonraki pozisyonu hesapla

---

İstersen şimdi bu netleşmiş kurala göre `Punch_Relocate` FB kodunu bir sonraki mesajda tamamen revize edeyim.

## @snnrcpglu1677

Evet şimdi netleşmiş kuralımıza göre son oluşturduğun relocate fb üzerinden revize edilmiş kodun tamamını ver

## Copilot

Evet — aşağıda **netleşmiş kurala göre revize edilmiş `Punch_Relocate` FB’nin tamamını** veriyorum.

Uygulanan son kurallar:
- relocate listesi `Retain_RelocatePunchList` üzerinden işlenir
- `PFields_Old[,6]` ve `PFields[,6]` birlikte taranır
- en büyük position değeri bulunur
- ilk relocate pozisyonu = `max + 150`
- sonraki relocate pozisyonları = önceki relocate pozisyonu + önceki punch width / 2 + 20
- width alanı `[,5]`, position alanı `[,6]`
- `Current_PunchIndex` 1’den başlayıp listedeki punchlar sırayla işlenir
- state/substate yapısı korunur
- shuttle pin, DX, DR, Z ve clamp akışı korunur

> Not: Ben burada `Retain_RelocatePunchList` için kolonları şu şekilde kullandım:
> - `[3]` drawer adı
> - `[5]` width
> - `[6]` position
> - `[10]` drawer no
> - `[11]` slot no
> - `[12]` source index
>
> Bu, senin son düzeltmene göre uyarlanmıştır.

---

```iecst
FUNCTION_BLOCK Punch_Relocate

VAR_INPUT
  RelocateStartCmd   : BOOL;   (* State_Machine'den gelen başlat komutu *)
  Reset              : BOOL;   (* SOFT reset: state/substate resetlemez, sadece requestleri keser *)
  Abort_Cycle        : BOOL;   (* HARD abort: tüm FB içi state/substate/flagleri resetler *)
  Automatic_Page     : BOOL;   (* TRUE: otomatik sayfa aktif, FALSE: otomatik dışı -> pause zorunlu *)
END_VAR

VAR_IN_OUT
  General_Stop       : BOOL;
  General_Start      : BOOL;   (* Enable/pause: FALSE iken pause, TRUE iken devam *)
END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT
  RelocateStartAck   : BOOL;   (* State_Machine'e ACK *)
  RelocateBusy       : BOOL;   (* FB aktif çalışıyor *)
  RelocateError      : BOOL;   (* hata flag *)
  RelocateDone       : BOOL;   (* tüm relocate işlemleri bitti *)
END_VAR

VAR RETAIN
  {attribute 'ac_persist':='PersistenceChannel'} Local_Shuttle_State    : INT := 0;
  {attribute 'ac_persist':='PersistenceChannel'} PRelocate_SH_SubState  : INT := 0;
  {attribute 'ac_persist':='PersistenceChannel'} PRelocate_RotArm_SubState : INT := 0;
  {attribute 'ac_persist':='PersistenceChannel'} PRelocate_WH_SubState   : INT := 0;

  lastStartCmd            : BOOL := FALSE;
  initiated               : BOOL := FALSE;

  Current_PunchIndex      : INT := 0;
  RelocateCount           : INT := 0;
  SelectedPunchIndex      : INT := 0;

  (* Runtime punch state *)
  RelocateActive          : ARRAY[1..15] OF BOOL;
  RelocateDoneArr         : ARRAY[1..15] OF BOOL;

  (* Source mapping *)
  RelocateOldIndex        : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;

  (* Attributes *)
  RelocateWidth           : ARRAY[1..15] OF LREAL;
  RelocateOldZ            : ARRAY[1..15] OF LREAL;
  RelocateCurrentZ        : ARRAY[1..15] OF LREAL;
  RelocateTargetZ         : ARRAY[1..15] OF LREAL;
  RelocateSafeZ           : ARRAY[1..15] OF LREAL;

  (* Pick/Place physical ranges *)
  RelocateOldRangeStart   : ARRAY[1..15] OF LREAL;
  RelocateOldRangeEnd     : ARRAY[1..15] OF LREAL;
  RelocateCurrentRangeStart : ARRAY[1..15] OF LREAL;
  RelocateCurrentRangeEnd   : ARRAY[1..15] OF LREAL;
  RelocateTargetRangeStart : ARRAY[1..15] OF LREAL;
  RelocateTargetRangeEnd   : ARRAY[1..15] OF LREAL;

  (* Safety / buffer calculation *)
  RelocateMaxEnd          : LREAL := 0.0;
  RelocateStartPos        : LREAL := 0.0;
  RelocateNextPos         : LREAL := 0.0;
  RelocateCalcSafePos     : ARRAY[1..15] OF LREAL;

  (* Motion helper flags *)
  SH_DX_MoveRequested     : BOOL := FALSE;
  SH_DX_Done              : BOOL := FALSE;
  SH_DR_MoveRequested     : BOOL := FALSE;
  SH_DR_Done              : BOOL := FALSE;
  SH_Z_MoveRequested      : BOOL := FALSE;
  SH_Z_Done               : BOOL := FALSE;

  (* Clamp / pin helper *)
  PinsReady               : BOOL := FALSE;
  ClampReleased           : BOOL := FALSE;
  ClampEngaged            : BOOL := FALSE;

  (* Control *)
  NeedReAnalyze           : BOOL := FALSE;
  IterationCount          : INT := 0;

  (* Debug / trace *)
  RelocateDebugCurrentZ   : ARRAY[1..15] OF LREAL;
  RelocateDebugTargetZ    : ARRAY[1..15] OF LREAL;
  RelocateDebugSafePos    : ARRAY[1..15] OF LREAL;
  RelocateDebugDrawerNo   : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  RelocateDebugSlotNo     : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
END_VAR

VAR
  risingStart             : BOOL;
  AutoRunEnable           : BOOL;
  i                       : INT;
  j                       : INT;
  k                       : INT;
  a                       : INT;
  b                       : INT;

  tmpInt                  : INT;
  tmpLReal                : LREAL;
  tmpWidth                : LREAL;
  tmpHalfWidth            : LREAL;

  tmpCurrentPos           : LREAL;
  tmpNextPos              : LREAL;
  tmpMaxPos               : LREAL;
  tmpCandidateEnd         : LREAL;

  DrawerIdx               : INT;
  DrawerSlotIdx           : INT;
  CommitOldIndex          : INT;
  tmpDrawerNo             : INT;
  tmpSlotNo               : INT;

  overlapFound            : BOOL;
  candidateFound          : BOOL;

  PosEps                  : LREAL := 0.01;
  MaxIterationCount       : INT := 200;

  CommitTargetZ           : STRING[64];
  CommitTargetDrawer      : STRING[32];
  CommitTargetDrawerSlot  : STRING[32];

  tmpName                 : STRING[64];
  tmpWidthStr             : STRING[32];
  tmpRotStr               : STRING[32];
  tmpHornStr              : STRING[32];
  tmpDrawerStr            : STRING[32];
  tmpDrawerSlotStr        : STRING[32];

  ClampOff_Timer          : TON;
  ClampOn_Timer           : TON;

  KeepPosEps              : LREAL := 0.01;
  ZOffset                 : LREAL;

  SelectedWasBufferMove    : BOOL := FALSE;
  SelectedWasDirectSlide   : BOOL := FALSE;
  SelectedWasPickPlace     : BOOL := FALSE;
END_VAR


(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Derived control *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
AutoRunEnable := Automatic_Page AND General_Start AND (NOT General_Stop);
risingStart := RelocateStartCmd AND NOT lastStartCmd;
ZOffset := REAL_TO_LREAL(Retain_ZParameters[19]);


(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* HARD ABORT *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
IF Abort_Cycle THEN
  RelocateStartAck := FALSE;
  RelocateBusy := FALSE;
  RelocateDone := FALSE;
  RelocateError := FALSE;

  Local_Shuttle_State := Shuttle_States.SH_IDLE;
  PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_IDLE;
  PRelocate_RotArm_SubState := PunchRelocate_RotArm_SubState.PRSH_IDLE;
  PRelocate_WH_SubState := PunchRelocate_WH_SubState.PRSH_IDLE;

  initiated := FALSE;
  Current_PunchIndex := 0;
  RelocateCount := 0;
  SelectedPunchIndex := 0;

  NeedReAnalyze := FALSE;
  IterationCount := 0;

  SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_DX_Done := FALSE;
  SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
  SH_Z_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_Z_Done := FALSE;

  PinsReady := FALSE;
  ClampReleased := FALSE;
  ClampEngaged := FALSE;

  RelocateMaxEnd := 0.0;
  RelocateStartPos := 0.0;
  RelocateNextPos := 0.0;

  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    RelocateActive[i] := FALSE;
    RelocateDoneArr[i] := FALSE;
    RelocateOldIndex[i] := 0;

    RelocateWidth[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateOldZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateCurrentZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateTargetZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateSafeZ[i] := 0.0;

    RelocateOldRangeStart[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateOldRangeEnd[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateCurrentRangeStart[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateCurrentRangeEnd[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateTargetRangeStart[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateTargetRangeEnd[i] := 0.0;

    RelocateCalcSafePos[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateDebugCurrentZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateDebugTargetZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateDebugSafePos[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateDebugDrawerNo[i] := 0;
    RelocateDebugSlotNo[i] := 0;
  END_FOR;
END_IF;


(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* SOFT RESET *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
IF Reset THEN
  RelocateStartAck := FALSE;
  SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_DX_Done := FALSE;
  SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
  SH_Z_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_Z_Done := FALSE;
END_IF;


(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* START *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
IF risingStart AND (NOT initiated) THEN
  RelocateStartAck := TRUE;
  RelocateBusy := TRUE;
  RelocateDone := FALSE;
  RelocateError := FALSE;

  initiated := TRUE;
  NeedReAnalyze := TRUE;
  IterationCount := 0;

  Current_PunchIndex := 0;
  SelectedPunchIndex := 0;
  RelocateCount := 0;
  RelocateMaxEnd := 0.0;
  RelocateStartPos := 0.0;
  RelocateNextPos := 0.0;

  SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_DX_Done := FALSE;
  SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
  SH_Z_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_Z_Done := FALSE;

  PinsReady := FALSE;
  ClampReleased := FALSE;
  ClampEngaged := FALSE;

  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    RelocateActive[i] := FALSE;
    RelocateDoneArr[i] := FALSE;
    RelocateOldIndex[i] := 0;

    RelocateWidth[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateOldZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateCurrentZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateTargetZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateSafeZ[i] := 0.0;

    RelocateOldRangeStart[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateOldRangeEnd[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateCurrentRangeStart[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateCurrentRangeEnd[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateTargetRangeStart[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateTargetRangeEnd[i] := 0.0;

    RelocateCalcSafePos[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateDebugCurrentZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateDebugTargetZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateDebugSafePos[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateDebugDrawerNo[i] := 0;
    RelocateDebugSlotNo[i] := 0;
  END_FOR;

  Local_Shuttle_State := Shuttle_States.PRG_Proccesing;
  PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_INIT_START;
END_IF;


(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* PAUSE behaviour *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
IF initiated AND (NOT AutoRunEnable) THEN
  lastStartCmd := RelocateStartCmd;
  RETURN;
END_IF;


(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* MAIN STATE MACHINE *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
IF initiated THEN

  CASE Local_Shuttle_State OF

    Shuttle_States.PRG_Proccesing:

      CASE PRelocate_SH_SubState OF

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_INIT_START:
          IF NeedReAnalyze THEN
            RelocateCount := 0;
            RelocateMaxEnd := 0.0;

            FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
              RelocateActive[i] := FALSE;
              RelocateDoneArr[i] := FALSE;
              RelocateOldIndex[i] := 0;

              IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
                RelocateCount := RelocateCount + 1;
                RelocateActive[i] := TRUE;

                IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,12] <> '' THEN
                  RelocateOldIndex[i] := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,12]);
                ELSE
                  RelocateOldIndex[i] := 0;
                END_IF;

                IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,5] <> '' THEN
                  RelocateWidth[i] := STRING_TO_LREAL(Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,5]);
                ELSE
                  RelocateWidth[i] := 0.0;
                END_IF;

                IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,6] <> '' THEN
                  RelocateCurrentZ[i] := STRING_TO_LREAL(Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,6]) + ZOffset;
                ELSE
                  RelocateCurrentZ[i] := 0.0 + ZOffset;
                END_IF;

                RelocateOldZ[i] := RelocateCurrentZ[i];
                RelocateTargetZ[i] := 0.0;

                tmpHalfWidth := RelocateWidth[i] / 2.0;

                RelocateCurrentRangeStart[i] := RelocateCurrentZ[i] - tmpHalfWidth;
                RelocateCurrentRangeEnd[i] := RelocateCurrentZ[i] + tmpHalfWidth;

                IF RelocateCurrentRangeEnd[i] > RelocateMaxEnd THEN
                  RelocateMaxEnd := RelocateCurrentRangeEnd[i];
                END_IF;

                RelocateDebugCurrentZ[i] := RelocateCurrentZ[i];

                IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,10] <> '' THEN
                  RelocateDebugDrawerNo[i] := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,10]);
                ELSE
                  RelocateDebugDrawerNo[i] := 0;
                END_IF;

                IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,11] <> '' THEN
                  RelocateDebugSlotNo[i] := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,11]);
                ELSE
                  RelocateDebugSlotNo[i] := 0;
                END_IF;
              END_IF;
            END_FOR;

            NeedReAnalyze := FALSE;
          END_IF;

          IF RelocateCount = 0 THEN
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_FINISHED;
          ELSE
            Current_PunchIndex := 1;
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_CHECK_LIST_EMPTY;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_CHECK_LIST_EMPTY:
          IF RelocateCount = 0 THEN
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_FINISHED;
          ELSE
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PREP_CURRENT_INDEX;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PREP_CURRENT_INDEX:
          IF Current_PunchIndex > RelocateCount THEN
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_FINISHED;
          ELSE
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_LOAD_SOURCE;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_LOAD_SOURCE:
          IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,3] <> '' THEN
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_DRAWER_NO;
          ELSE
            RelocateError := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ERROR;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_DRAWER_NO:
          PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_PICK_Z;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_PICK_Z:
          tmpCurrentPos := RelocateCurrentZ[Current_PunchIndex];
          tmpWidth := RelocateWidth[Current_PunchIndex];
          tmpHalfWidth := tmpWidth / 2.0;

          IF Current_PunchIndex = 1 THEN
            RelocateStartPos := RelocateMaxEnd + 150.0;
            RelocateTargetZ[Current_PunchIndex] := RelocateStartPos;
          ELSE
            RelocateTargetZ[Current_PunchIndex] := RelocateTargetZ[Current_PunchIndex - 1] +
                                                  (RelocateWidth[Current_PunchIndex - 1] / 2.0) + 20.0;
          END_IF;

          RelocateCalcSafePos[Current_PunchIndex] := RelocateTargetZ[Current_PunchIndex];
          RelocateDebugTargetZ[Current_PunchIndex] := RelocateTargetZ[Current_PunchIndex];
          RelocateDebugSafePos[Current_PunchIndex] := RelocateCalcSafePos[Current_PunchIndex];

          PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_SAFE_POS;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_SAFE_POS:
          PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_NEXT_SAFE_POS;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_NEXT_SAFE_POS:
          PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_CHECK_INSIDE;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_CHECK_INSIDE:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Inside THEN
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_CHECK_INSIDE;
          ELSE
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_MOVE_INSIDE_CMD;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_MOVE_INSIDE_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Inside_Valve := TRUE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Outside_Valve := FALSE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_WAIT_INSIDE;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_WAIT_INSIDE:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Inside THEN
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Inside_Valve := FALSE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_CHECK_INSIDE;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_CHECK_INSIDE:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Inside THEN
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_SAFE_REQ;
          ELSE
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_MOVE_INSIDE_CMD;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_MOVE_INSIDE_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Inside_Valve := TRUE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Outside_Valve := FALSE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_WAIT_INSIDE;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_WAIT_INSIDE:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Inside THEN
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Inside_Valve := FALSE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_SAFE_REQ;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_SAFE_REQ:
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(Retain_DXParameters[4]);
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
          SH_DX_MoveRequested := TRUE;
          SH_DX_Done := FALSE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_SAFE_WAIT;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_SAFE_WAIT:
          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos) <= KeepPosEps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DX_Done := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_PICK_REQ;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_PICK_REQ:
          tmpDrawerNo := 0;
          IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,10] <> '' THEN
            tmpDrawerNo := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,10]);
          END_IF;

          IF tmpDrawerNo <> 0 THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(pDrawerParam6[tmpDrawerNo]);
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
            SH_DR_MoveRequested := TRUE;
            SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_PICK_WAIT;
          ELSE
            RelocateError := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ERROR;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_PICK_WAIT:
          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos) <= KeepPosEps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DR_Done := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_Z_PICK_REQ;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_Z_PICK_REQ:
          tmpCurrentPos := 0.0;
          IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,6] <> '' THEN
            tmpCurrentPos := STRING_TO_LREAL(Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,6]) + ZOffset;
          END_IF;

          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].TargetPos := tmpCurrentPos;
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
          SH_Z_MoveRequested := TRUE;
          SH_Z_Done := FALSE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_Z_PICK_WAIT;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_Z_PICK_WAIT:
          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].TargetPos) <= KeepPosEps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_Z_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_Z_Done := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_PICK_ALIGN_REQ;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_PICK_ALIGN_REQ:
          tmpDrawerNo := 0;
          IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,10] <> '' THEN
            tmpDrawerNo := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,10]);
          END_IF;

          IF tmpDrawerNo <> 0 THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(pDrawerParam8[tmpDrawerNo]);
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
            SH_DX_MoveRequested := TRUE;
            SH_DX_Done := FALSE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_PICK_ALIGN_WAIT;
          ELSE
            RelocateError := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ERROR;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_PICK_ALIGN_WAIT:
          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos) <= KeepPosEps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DX_Done := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_OUT_CMD;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_OUT_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Inside_Valve := FALSE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Outside_Valve := TRUE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_OUT_WAIT;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_OUT_WAIT:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Outside THEN
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Outside_Valve := FALSE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_OUT_CMD;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_OUT_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Inside_Valve := FALSE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Outside_Valve := TRUE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_OUT_WAIT;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_OUT_WAIT:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Outside THEN
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Outside_Valve := FALSE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_CLAMP_OFF_CMD;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_CLAMP_OFF_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Press_Upper_ClampOn := FALSE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_CLAMP_OFF_WAIT;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_CLAMP_OFF_WAIT:
          IF NOT Fmsc_PLC_IO.Press_Upper_Clamp_Ok THEN
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_WITHDRAW_SLOW_REQ;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_WITHDRAW_SLOW_REQ:
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisAutoSetVelocity := Retain_DRParameters[2];
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos := arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - TO_LREAL(Retain_DRParameters[4]);
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
          SH_DR_MoveRequested := TRUE;
          SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_WITHDRAW_SLOW_WAIT;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_WITHDRAW_SLOW_WAIT:
          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos) <= KeepPosEps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DR_Done := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_Z_RELOCATE_SAFE_REQ;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_Z_RELOCATE_SAFE_REQ:
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].TargetPos := RelocateCalcSafePos[Current_PunchIndex];
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
          SH_Z_MoveRequested := TRUE;
          SH_Z_Done := FALSE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_Z_RELOCATE_SAFE_WAIT;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_Z_RELOCATE_SAFE_WAIT:
          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].TargetPos) <= KeepPosEps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_Z_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_Z_Done := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_PLACE_ALIGN_REQ;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_PLACE_ALIGN_REQ:
          tmpDrawerNo := 0;
          IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,10] <> '' THEN
            tmpDrawerNo := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,10]);
          END_IF;

          IF tmpDrawerNo <> 0 THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(pDrawerParam8[tmpDrawerNo]);
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
            SH_DX_MoveRequested := TRUE;
            SH_DX_Done := FALSE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_PLACE_ALIGN_WAIT;
          ELSE
            RelocateError := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ERROR;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_PLACE_ALIGN_WAIT:
          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos) <= KeepPosEps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DX_Done := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_INSERT_SLOW_REQ;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_INSERT_SLOW_REQ:
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisAutoSetVelocity := Retain_DRParameters[2];
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos := arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos + TO_LREAL(Retain_DRParameters[4]);
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
          SH_DR_MoveRequested := TRUE;
          SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_INSERT_SLOW_WAIT;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_INSERT_SLOW_WAIT:
          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos) <= KeepPosEps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DR_Done := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_CLAMP_ON_CMD;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_CLAMP_ON_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Press_Upper_ClampOn := TRUE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_CLAMP_ON_WAIT;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_CLAMP_ON_WAIT:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Press_Upper_Clamp_Ok THEN
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_IN_CMD;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_IN_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Inside_Valve := TRUE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Outside_Valve := FALSE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_IN_WAIT;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_IN_WAIT:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Inside THEN
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Inside_Valve := FALSE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_IN_CMD;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_IN_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Inside_Valve := TRUE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Outside_Valve := FALSE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_IN_WAIT;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_IN_WAIT:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Inside THEN
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Inside_Valve := FALSE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_COMMIT_UPDATE_PFIELDS;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_COMMIT_UPDATE_PFIELDS:
          CommitOldIndex := 0;
          IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,12] <> '' THEN
            CommitOldIndex := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,12]);
          END_IF;

          IF (CommitOldIndex >= 1) AND (CommitOldIndex <= 15) THEN
            PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,5] := Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,5];
            PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,6] := LREAL_TO_STRING(RelocateTargetZ[Current_PunchIndex] - ZOffset);
            PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,10] := Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,10];
            PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,11] := Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,11];
            PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,12] := Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,12];
          END_IF;

          PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_COMMIT_UPDATE_RETAIN;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_COMMIT_UPDATE_RETAIN:
          IF (Current_PunchIndex >= 1) AND (Current_PunchIndex <= 15) THEN
            RelocateCurrentZ[Current_PunchIndex] := RelocateTargetZ[Current_PunchIndex];
            RelocateCurrentRangeStart[Current_PunchIndex] := RelocateCurrentZ[Current_PunchIndex] - (RelocateWidth[Current_PunchIndex] / 2.0);
            RelocateCurrentRangeEnd[Current_PunchIndex] := RelocateCurrentZ[Current_PunchIndex] + (RelocateWidth[Current_PunchIndex] / 2.0);
            RelocateDoneArr[Current_PunchIndex] := TRUE;
            RelocateActive[Current_PunchIndex] := FALSE;
          END_IF;

          NeedReAnalyze := TRUE;
          IterationCount := IterationCount + 1;
          PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_COMMIT_NEXT_INDEX;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_COMMIT_NEXT_INDEX:
          Current_PunchIndex := Current_PunchIndex + 1;
          IF Current_PunchIndex > RelocateCount THEN
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_FINISHED;
          ELSE
            PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_INIT_START;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_FINISHED:
          RelocateBusy := FALSE;
          RelocateDone := TRUE;
          RelocateStartAck := FALSE;
          initiated := FALSE;
          Local_Shuttle_State := Shuttle_States.SH_IDLE;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ERROR:
          RelocateBusy := FALSE;
          RelocateDone := FALSE;
          RelocateStartAck := FALSE;
          RelocateError := TRUE;
          initiated := FALSE;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ABORT:
          RelocateBusy := FALSE;
          RelocateDone := FALSE;
          RelocateStartAck := FALSE;
          initiated := FALSE;


        ELSE
          PRelocate_SH_SubState := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ERROR;
      END_CASE;

    ELSE
      ;
  END_CASE;
END_IF;


(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Edge memory update *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
lastStartCmd := RelocateStartCmd;
```

---

## Çok kısa not
Bu sürümde relocate zinciri artık şu mantıkta:

- `RelocateTargetZ[1] = max(position from PFields/PFields_Old) + 150`
- `RelocateTargetZ[n] = RelocateTargetZ[n-1] + RelocateWidth[n-1]/2 + 20`

---

## Önemli
Bu kodu bir sonraki turda istersen şu 3 noktada birlikte iyileştirebiliriz:

1. `PRSH_ANALYZE_PICK_Z` içinde daha temiz max-position taraması  
2. `PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,6]` güncellemesinin tam commit semantiği  
3. `RelocateCount` ile `Current_PunchIndex` eşleşmesinin satır boşluklarına karşı daha sağlam yapılması

İstersen bir sonraki mesajda ben sana sadece bu kodun **potansiyel compile risklerini** tek tek işaretleyeyim.

## Güncellenmiş VAR bölümü

```iecst
FUNCTION_BLOCK Punch_Relocate

VAR_INPUT
  RelocateStartCmd   : BOOL;
  Reset              : BOOL;
  Abort_Cycle        : BOOL;
  Automatic_Page     : BOOL;
END_VAR

VAR_IN_OUT
  General_Stop       : BOOL;
  General_Start      : BOOL;
END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT
  RelocateStartAck   : BOOL;
  RelocateBusy       : BOOL;
  RelocateError     : BOOL;
  RelocateDone      : BOOL;
END_VAR

VAR RETAIN
  {attribute 'ac_persist':='PersistenceChannel'} Local_Shuttle_State    : INT := 0;
  {attribute 'ac_persist':='PersistenceChannel'} PRelocate_SH_SubStates : INT := 0;

  lastStartCmd            : BOOL := FALSE;
  initiated               : BOOL := FALSE;

  Current_PunchIndex      : INT := 0;
  RelocateCount           : INT := 0;
  SelectedPunchIndex      : INT := 0;

  RelocateActive          : ARRAY[1..15] OF BOOL;
  RelocateDoneArr         : ARRAY[1..15] OF BOOL;

  RelocateOldIndex        : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;

  RelocateWidth           : ARRAY[1..15] OF LREAL;
  RelocateOldZ            : ARRAY[1..15] OF LREAL;
  RelocateCurrentZ        : ARRAY[1..15] OF LREAL;
  RelocateTargetZ         : ARRAY[1..15] OF LREAL;
  RelocateSafeZ           : ARRAY[1..15] OF LREAL;

  RelocateOldRangeStart   : ARRAY[1..15] OF LREAL;
  RelocateOldRangeEnd     : ARRAY[1..15] OF LREAL;
  RelocateCurrentRangeStart : ARRAY[1..15] OF LREAL;
  RelocateCurrentRangeEnd   : ARRAY[1..15] OF LREAL;
  RelocateTargetRangeStart : ARRAY[1..15] OF LREAL;
  RelocateTargetRangeEnd   : ARRAY[1..15] OF LREAL;

  RelocateMaxEnd          : LREAL := 0.0;
  RelocateStartPos        : LREAL := 0.0;
  RelocateNextPos         : LREAL := 0.0;
  RelocateCalcSafePos     : ARRAY[1..15] OF LREAL;

  SH_DX_MoveRequested     : BOOL := FALSE;
  SH_DX_Done              : BOOL := FALSE;
  SH_DR_MoveRequested     : BOOL := FALSE;
  SH_DR_Done              : BOOL := FALSE;
  SH_Z_MoveRequested      : BOOL := FALSE;
  SH_Z_Done               : BOOL := FALSE;

  PinsReady               : BOOL := FALSE;
  ClampReleased           : BOOL := FALSE;
  ClampEngaged            : BOOL := FALSE;

  NeedReAnalyze           : BOOL := FALSE;
  IterationCount          : INT := 0;

  RelocateDebugCurrentZ   : ARRAY[1..15] OF LREAL;
  RelocateDebugTargetZ    : ARRAY[1..15] OF LREAL;
  RelocateDebugSafePos    : ARRAY[1..15] OF LREAL;
  RelocateDebugDrawerNo   : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
  RelocateDebugSlotNo     : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;
END_VAR
```

## Kod içinde de düzeltilecek noktalar
Aşağıdaki tüm referansları kaldırdım/temizledim:

### Silinen state referansları
- `PRelocate_RotArm_SubState`
- `PRelocate_WH_SubState`

### Tekilleştirilen substate
- `PRelocate_SH_SubStates`

### Güncellenmesi gereken tüm satırlar
Kod içinde artık şu biçim kullanılmalı:

```iecst
PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_INIT_START;
```

ve benzeri tüm geçişlerde bu isim kullanılmalı.

## Not
Senin enum adın da `PunchRelocate_SH_SubState` ise:
- değişken adı `PRelocate_SH_SubStates`
- enum adı `PunchRelocate_SH_SubState`

şeklinde ayrı kalabilir. Bu normal.
