```
      END_IF;

      foundLengthMatch := FALSE;
      hasLengthValue := FALSE;
      NewLenReal := 0.0;

      IF NewLen <> '' THEN
        NewLenReal := STRING_TO_REAL(NewLen);
        hasLengthValue := TRUE;
      END_IF;

      IF hasLengthValue THEN
        FOR j := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[j] = NewName THEN
            FOR k := 1 TO 15 DO
              IF ABS(PunchLength[j, k] - NewLenReal) <= eps THEN
                foundLengthMatch := TRUE;
                EXIT;
              END_IF;
            END_FOR;

            IF foundLengthMatch THEN
              EXIT;
            END_IF;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
      END_IF;

      IF NOT foundLengthMatch THEN
        ValidityFlag := FALSE;
        PackageState := PPackageState.INVALID;
        NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.INVALID_ABORT;
        Error := TRUE;
        ErrorText := CONCAT('INVALID: requested length NOT found FOR tool: ', NewName);

        FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
          FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
            PFields[i,j] := '';
          END_FOR;
        END_FOR;

        Busy := FALSE;
        Done := TRUE;
        RETURN;
      END_IF;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  (* STEP 2: Deterministic one-to-one keep matching (consume-old approach) *)
  OldAvailCount := 0;
  FOR j := 1 TO 15 DO
    OldName := PFields_Old[j,3];
    IF OldName <> '' THEN
      OldAvailCount := OldAvailCount + 1;
      OldAvailIndex[OldAvailCount] := j;
      OldMatched[j] := FALSE;
      oldCount := oldCount + 1;
    ELSE
      OldMatched[j] := FALSE;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    NewName := PFields[i,3];
    IF NewName <> '' THEN
      NewLen := PFields[i,7];
      NewHorn := PFields[i,9];
      NewRot := PFields[i,8];
      NewLenReal := 0.0;
      IF NewLen <> '' THEN
        NewLenReal := STRING_TO_REAL(NewLen);
      END_IF;

      NewMatchedToOld[i] := 0;
      a := 1;
      WHILE (a <= OldAvailCount) AND (NewMatchedToOld[i] = 0) DO
        j := OldAvailIndex[a];
        OldName := PFields_Old[j,3];
        IF OldName <> '' THEN
          OldLen := PFields_Old[j,7];
          OldHorn := PFields_Old[j,9];
          OldRot := PFields_Old[j,8];

          OldLenReal := 0.0;
          IF OldLen <> '' THEN
            OldLenReal := STRING_TO_REAL(OldLen);
          END_IF;

          IF (NewName = OldName) AND (NewHorn = OldHorn) AND (NewRot = OldRot) AND (ABS(NewLenReal - OldLenReal) <= eps) THEN
            OldMatched[j] := TRUE;
            KeepList[j] := TRUE;
            NewMatchedToOld[i] := j;

            FOR b := a TO OldAvailCount - 1 DO
              OldAvailIndex[b] := OldAvailIndex[b + 1];
            END_FOR;
            OldAvailCount := OldAvailCount - 1;
          ELSE
            a := a + 1;
          END_IF;
        ELSE
          a := a + 1;
        END_IF;
      END_WHILE;

      IF NewMatchedToOld[i] = 0 THEN
        LoadOnlyList[i] := TRUE;
      END_IF;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  FOR a := 1 TO OldAvailCount DO
    j := OldAvailIndex[a];
    IF PFields_Old[j,3] <> '' THEN
      UnloadOnlyList[j] := TRUE;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  (* STEP 3: PunchUsed-based validation ONLY for load-only punches *)
  (* 3a - per-load-only length availability in physically present ATC punches *)
  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    IF LoadOnlyList[i] THEN
      NewName := PFields[i,3];
      NewLen := PFields[i,7];

      foundLengthMatch := FALSE;
      hasLengthValue := FALSE;
      NewLenReal := 0.0;

      IF NewLen <> '' THEN
        NewLenReal := STRING_TO_REAL(NewLen);
        hasLengthValue := TRUE;
      END_IF;

      IF hasLengthValue THEN
        FOR j := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[j] = NewName THEN
            FOR k := 1 TO 15 DO
              IF (NOT PunchUsed[j,k]) AND (ABS(PunchLength[j, k] - NewLenReal) <= eps) THEN
                foundLengthMatch := TRUE;
                EXIT;
              END_IF;
            END_FOR;

            IF foundLengthMatch THEN
              EXIT;
            END_IF;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
      END_IF;

      IF NOT foundLengthMatch THEN
        ValidityFlag := FALSE;
        PackageState := PPackageState.INVALID;
        NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.INVALID_ABORT;
        Error := TRUE;
        ErrorText := CONCAT('INVALID: requested load punch length NOT available in free ATC punches FOR tool: ', NewName);

        FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
          FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
            PFields[i,j] := '';
          END_FOR;
        END_FOR;

        Busy := FALSE;
        Done := TRUE;
        RETURN;
      END_IF;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  (* 3b - multiplicity check ONLY for load-only punches *)
  uniqCount := 0;
  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    IF LoadOnlyList[i] THEN
      foundIndex := 0;
      FOR a := 1 TO uniqCount DO
        IF (uniqName[a] = PFields[i,3]) AND (uniqLen[a] = PFields[i,7]) AND (uniqHorn[a] = PFields[i,9]) THEN
          foundIndex := a;
          EXIT;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;

      IF foundIndex = 0 THEN
        uniqCount := uniqCount + 1;
        uniqName[uniqCount] := PFields[i,3];
        uniqLen[uniqCount] := PFields[i,7];
        uniqHorn[uniqCount] := PFields[i,9];
        uniqNeeded[uniqCount] := 1;
      ELSE
        uniqNeeded[foundIndex] := uniqNeeded[foundIndex] + 1;
      END_IF;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  FOR a := 1 TO uniqCount DO
    NewName := uniqName[a];
    NewLen := uniqLen[a];
    NewHorn := uniqHorn[a];

    foundIndex := 0;
    FOR e := 1 TO 16 DO
      IF pDrawerName[e] = NewName THEN
        foundIndex := e;
        EXIT;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    IF foundIndex = 0 THEN
      ValidityFlag := FALSE;
      PackageState := PPackageState.INVALID;
      NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.INVALID_ABORT;
      Error := TRUE;
      ErrorText := CONCAT('INVALID (load multiplicity): missing drawer for ', NewName);

      FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
        FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
          PFields[i,j] := '';
        END_FOR;
      END_FOR;

      Busy := FALSE;
      Done := TRUE;
      RETURN;
    END_IF;

    availCount := 0;
    IF (NewLen <> '') AND (NewHorn <> '') THEN
      NewLenReal := STRING_TO_REAL(NewLen);
      NewHornReal := STRING_TO_REAL(NewHorn);

      FOR e := 1 TO 16 DO
        IF pDrawerName[e] = NewName THEN
          FOR d := 1 TO 15 DO
            IF (NOT PunchUsed[e,d]) AND
               (ABS(PunchLength[e,d] - NewLenReal) <= eps) AND
               (ABS(PunchHorn[e,d] - NewHornReal) <= eps) THEN
              availCount := availCount + 1;
            END_IF;
          END_FOR;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;
    END_IF;

    IF availCount < uniqNeeded[a] THEN
      ValidityFlag := FALSE;
      PackageState := PPackageState.INVALID;
      NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.INVALID_ABORT;
      Error := TRUE;
      ErrorText := CONCAT('INVALID: insufficient FREE ATC slots for load tool ', NewName);
      ErrorText := CONCAT(ErrorText, CONCAT(' len=', NewLen));
      ErrorText := CONCAT(ErrorText, CONCAT(' horn=', NewHorn));
      ErrorText := CONCAT(ErrorText, CONCAT(' needed=', INT_TO_STRING(uniqNeeded[a])));
      ErrorText := CONCAT(ErrorText, CONCAT(' available=', INT_TO_STRING(availCount)));

      FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
        FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
          PFields[i,j] := '';
        END_FOR;
      END_FOR;

      Busy := FALSE;
      Done := TRUE;
      RETURN;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  (* Compute summary counters *)
  numSame := 0;
  numDiff := 0;
  FOR j := 1 TO 15 DO
    IF KeepList[j] THEN
      numSame := numSame + 1;
    END_IF;
    IF UnloadOnlyList[j] THEN
      numDiff := numDiff + 1;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;
  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    IF LoadOnlyList[i] THEN
      numDiff := numDiff + 1;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    OldName := PFields_Old[i,3];
    NewName := PFields[i,3];
    IF KeepList[i] THEN
      PerIndexStatus[i] := PIndexStatus.SAME;
    ELSIF (OldName = '') AND (NewName = '') THEN
      PerIndexStatus[i] := PIndexStatus.SAME;
    ELSE
      PerIndexStatus[i] := PIndexStatus.DIFF;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  IF NOT ValidityFlag THEN
    PackageState := PPackageState.INVALID;
    NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.INVALID_ABORT;
  ELSE
    PackageState := PPackageState.PARTIAL_CHANGE;
    NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.NO_ACTION;
  END_IF;

  ValidityFlag := NOT Error;

  IF PackageState <> PPackageState.INVALID THEN
    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_LoadPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_KeepPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_KeepPunchListNew[i,j] := '';
      END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Pack UnloadPunchList *)
    UnloadTempCount := 0;
    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      IF UnloadOnlyList[i] THEN
        foundIndex := 0;
        FOR k := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[k] = PFields_Old[i,3] THEN
            foundIndex := k;
            EXIT;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
        IF foundIndex <> 0 THEN
          UnloadTempCount := UnloadTempCount + 1;
          UnloadTempOrigIndex[UnloadTempCount] := i;
          UnloadTempDrawerIdx[UnloadTempCount] := foundIndex;
          UnloadTempOrder[UnloadTempCount] := UnloadTempCount;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    FOR a := 1 TO UnloadTempCount - 1 DO
      minIdx := a;
      FOR b := a + 1 TO UnloadTempCount DO
        IF UnloadTempDrawerIdx[b] < UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] THEN
          minIdx := b;
        ELSIF (UnloadTempDrawerIdx[b] = UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx]) AND (UnloadTempOrder[b] < UnloadTempOrder[minIdx]) THEN
          minIdx := b;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;
      IF minIdx <> a THEN
        tmpInt := UnloadTempOrigIndex[a];
        UnloadTempOrigIndex[a] := UnloadTempOrigIndex[minIdx];
        UnloadTempOrigIndex[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := UnloadTempDrawerIdx[a];
        UnloadTempDrawerIdx[a] := UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx];
        UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := UnloadTempOrder[a];
        UnloadTempOrder[a] := UnloadTempOrder[minIdx];
        UnloadTempOrder[minIdx] := tmpInt;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    UnloadCount := 0;
    FOR a := 1 TO UnloadTempCount DO
      UnloadCount := UnloadCount + 1;
      i := UnloadTempOrigIndex[a];
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_UnloadPunchList[UnloadCount, j] := PFields_Old[i, j];
      END_FOR;
      Retain_UnloadPunchList[UnloadCount, 12] := INT_TO_STRING(i);
    END_FOR;

    (* Pack LoadPunchList *)
    LoadTempCount := 0;
    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      IF LoadOnlyList[i] THEN
        foundIndex := 0;
        FOR k := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[k] = PFields[i,3] THEN
            foundIndex := k;
            EXIT;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
        IF foundIndex <> 0 THEN
          LoadTempCount := LoadTempCount + 1;
          LoadTempOrigIndex[LoadTempCount] := i;
          LoadTempDrawerIdx[LoadTempCount] := foundIndex;
          LoadTempOrder[LoadTempCount] := LoadTempCount;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    FOR a := 1 TO LoadTempCount - 1 DO
      minIdx := a;
      FOR b := a + 1 TO LoadTempCount DO
        IF LoadTempDrawerIdx[b] < LoadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] THEN
          minIdx := b;
        ELSIF (LoadTempDrawerIdx[b] = LoadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx]) AND (LoadTempOrder[b] < LoadTempOrder[minIdx]) THEN
          minIdx := b;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;
      IF minIdx <> a THEN
        tmpInt := LoadTempOrigIndex[a];
        LoadTempOrigIndex[a] := LoadTempOrigIndex[minIdx];
        LoadTempOrigIndex[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := LoadTempDrawerIdx[a];
        LoadTempDrawerIdx[a] := LoadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx];
        LoadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := LoadTempOrder[a];
        LoadTempOrder[a] := LoadTempOrder[minIdx];
        LoadTempOrder[minIdx] := tmpInt;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    LoadCount := 0;
    FOR a := 1 TO LoadTempCount DO
      LoadCount := LoadCount + 1;
      i := LoadTempOrigIndex[a];
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_LoadPunchList[LoadCount, j] := PFields[i, j];
      END_FOR;
      Retain_LoadPunchList[LoadCount, 12] := INT_TO_STRING(i);
    END_FOR;

    (* ATC load mapping - PunchUsed applies only here and in load-only validation above *)
    FOR c := 1 TO 15 DO
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c, j] := '';
      END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    FOR e := 1 TO 16 DO
      FOR d := 1 TO 15 DO
        usedSlot[e,d] := FALSE;
      END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      NewAssignedDrawer[i] := 0;
      NewAssignedSlot[i] := 0;
    END_FOR;

    FOR c := 1 TO LoadCount DO
      origNewIdx := LoadTempOrigIndex[c];
      NewName := Retain_LoadPunchList[c,3];
      lenStr := Retain_LoadPunchList[c,7];
      hornStr := Retain_LoadPunchList[c,9];

      foundIndex := 0;

      IF (NewName <> '') AND (lenStr <> '') AND (hornStr <> '') THEN
        lenRealLocal := STRING_TO_REAL(lenStr);
        hornRealLocal := STRING_TO_REAL(hornStr);

        FOR e := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[e] = NewName THEN
            FOR d := 1 TO 15 DO
              IF (NOT usedSlot[e,d]) AND (NOT PunchUsed[e,d]) THEN
                IF (ABS(PunchLength[e,d] - lenRealLocal) <= eps) AND
                   (ABS(PunchHorn[e,d] - hornRealLocal) <= eps) THEN
                  usedSlot[e,d] := TRUE;
                  foundIndex := e;

                  Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,1] := pDrawerName[e];
                  Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,2] := INT_TO_STRING(e);
                  Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,3] := INT_TO_STRING(d);
                  Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,4] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchLength[e,d]);
                  Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,5] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchPosition[e,d]);
                  Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,6] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchHorn[e,d]);
                  Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,12] := INT_TO_STRING(origNewIdx);

                  NewAssignedDrawer[origNewIdx] := e;
                  NewAssignedSlot[origNewIdx] := d;
                  EXIT;
                END_IF;
              END_IF;
            END_FOR;

            IF foundIndex <> 0 THEN
              EXIT;
            END_IF;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    (* Pack KeepPunchList old + corresponding new *)
    KeepTempCount := 0;
    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      IF KeepList[i] THEN
        foundIndex := 0;
        FOR k := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[k] = PFields_Old[i,3] THEN
            foundIndex := k;
            EXIT;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
        IF foundIndex <> 0 THEN
          KeepTempCount := KeepTempCount + 1;
          KeepTempOrigIndex[KeepTempCount] := i;
          KeepTempDrawerIdx[KeepTempCount] := foundIndex;
          KeepTempOrder[KeepTempCount] := KeepTempCount;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    FOR a := 1 TO KeepTempCount - 1 DO
      minIdx := a;
      FOR b := a + 1 TO KeepTempCount DO
        IF KeepTempDrawerIdx[b] < KeepTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] THEN
          minIdx := b;
        ELSIF (KeepTempDrawerIdx[b] = KeepTempDrawerIdx[minIdx]) AND (KeepTempOrder[b] < KeepTempOrder[minIdx]) THEN
          minIdx := b;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;
      IF minIdx <> a THEN
        tmpInt := KeepTempOrigIndex[a];
        KeepTempOrigIndex[a] := KeepTempOrigIndex[minIdx];
        KeepTempOrigIndex[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := KeepTempDrawerIdx[a];
        KeepTempDrawerIdx[a] := KeepTempDrawerIdx[minIdx];
        KeepTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := KeepTempOrder[a];
        KeepTempOrder[a] := KeepTempOrder[minIdx];
        KeepTempOrder[minIdx] := tmpInt;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    KeepCount := 0;
    FOR a := 1 TO KeepTempCount DO
      KeepCount := KeepCount + 1;
      i := KeepTempOrigIndex[a];
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_KeepPunchList[KeepCount, j] := PFields_Old[i, j];
        Retain_KeepPunchListNew[KeepCount, j] := '';
      END_FOR;
      Retain_KeepPunchList[KeepCount, 12] := INT_TO_STRING(i);

      tmpInt := 0;
      FOR b := 1 TO 15 DO
        IF NewMatchedToOld[b] = i THEN
          tmpInt := b;
          EXIT;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;

      IF tmpInt <> 0 THEN
        FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
          Retain_KeepPunchListNew[KeepCount, j] := PFields[tmpInt, j];
        END_FOR;
        Retain_KeepPunchListNew[KeepCount, 12] := INT_TO_STRING(tmpInt);
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    (* ATC unload mapping uses PFields_Old[,10]=drawer and [,11]=slot *)
    FOR c := 1 TO 15 DO
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c, j] := '';
      END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    FOR c := 1 TO UnloadCount DO
      tmpInt := UnloadTempOrigIndex[c];

      IF (tmpInt >= 1) AND (tmpInt <= 15) AND (PFields_Old[tmpInt,10] <> '') AND (PFields_Old[tmpInt,11] <> '') THEN
        e := STRING_TO_INT(PFields_Old[tmpInt,10]);
        d := STRING_TO_INT(PFields_Old[tmpInt,11]);

        IF (e >= 1) AND (e <= 16) AND (d >= 1) AND (d <= 15) THEN
          Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,1] := pDrawerName[e];
          Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,2] := PFields_Old[tmpInt,10];
          Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,3] := PFields_Old[tmpInt,11];
          Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,4] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchLength[e,d]);
          Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,5] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchPosition[e,d]);
          Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,6] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchHorn[e,d]);
          Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,12] := INT_TO_STRING(tmpInt);
        END_IF;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    Busy := FALSE;
    Done := TRUE;
  ELSE
    Busy := FALSE;
    Done := TRUE;
  END_IF;

END_IF;
```
İşte burda yeni son güncel punchchanger kodum. 
Yapmamız gereken ve tespit etmemiz gereken şey eski kodumdaki array mapinglerine bağlı kalmak yeni kodumda farklılık varsa tespit etmek. 
Sonrasında oluşturduğumuz diğer arrayları aşağıdaki gibi çıkarmak .
PFields_Old
[i,3] → name
[i,6] → position
[i,7] → length
[i,8] → rotation
[i,9] → horn
[i,10] → drawer no
[i,11] → slot no
PFields
[i,3] → name
[i,6] → position
[i,7] → length
[i,8] → rotation
[i,9] → horn



## Copilot

Anladım. Yeni kodu ve kesinleşen alan şemasını aldım.

## Şu an kesin kabul ettiğim mapping

### `PFields_Old`
- `[i,3]` → name
- `[i,6]` → position
- `[i,7]` → length
- `[i,8]` → rotation
- `[i,9]` → horn
- `[i,10]` → drawer no
- `[i,11]` → slot no

### `PFields`
- `[i,3]` → name
- `[i,6]` → position
- `[i,7]` → length
- `[i,8]` → rotation
- `[i,9]` → horn

## Eski koda göre yeni kodda gördüğüm ana uyumsuzluklar

### 1) `PFields` için kolon kayması yok gibi görünse de
Yeni kodda `PFields[i,7]`, `PFields[i,8]`, `PFields[i,9]` ile çalışıyorsun; bu senin son verdiğin şemayla uyumlu.

Ama önceki varsayımlarda:
- `PFields[i,10]`
- `PFields[i,11]`
gibi alanlar kullanılmıştı.

Bu yeni kod parçasında bunlar **doğrudan kullanılmıyor**, bu da doğru yönde.

---

### 2) `PFields_Old` kullanımı eski mantıkla uyumlu görünüyor
Yeni kodda:
- unload mapping
- keep matching
- load/keep paketleme
- relocate aday üretimi

hepsi `PFields_Old[i,3]`, `PFields_Old[i,6]`, `PFields_Old[i,7]`, `PFields_Old[i,8]`, `PFields_Old[i,9]`, `PFields_Old[i,10]`, `PFields_Old[i,11]` üzerinden kurulmalı.

Senin verdiğin son şemaya göre bu doğru.

## Ancak dikkat edilmesi gereken tek kritik yer
Yeni kodda ATC eşlemesinde şu satırlar var:

```iecst
Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,4] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchLength[e,d]);
Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,5] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchPosition[e,d]);
Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,6] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchHorn[e,d]);
```

ve load tarafında da benzer kullanım var.

Bu, `Retain_ATC*` listelerinde kolon 4/5/6’ya:
- length
- position
- horn

yazıldığını gösteriyor. Bu mantık eski kodla uyumlu görünüyor.

---

## Şu anda gözümde öne çıkan şey
Yeni kodunda **asıl risk**, `PFields` ve `PFields_Old` içindeki:
- position
- length
- rotation
- horn

alanlarının **eşleştirme algoritmasında** doğru kullanılması.

Bu yeni paylaştığın kodda:
- keep matching için `PFields[i,7]` length,
- `PFields[i,8]` rotation,
- `PFields[i,9]` horn

olarak okunuyor. Bu, senin son mapping’inle uyumlu.

özellikle:

## Copilot

Şu an **emin olduğum kadarıyla**:  
**hayır, belirttiğin kolonlarda eski koda göre bir farklılık görünmüyor.**

## Emin olduğum uyum
Aşağıdaki alanlar yeni kodda, eski kodun bu parçasıyla uyumlu görünüyor:

### `PFields`
- `[3]` name
- `[6]` position
- `[7]` length
- `[8]` rotation
- `[9]` horn

### `PFields_Old`
- `[3]` name
- `[6]` position
- `[7]` length
- `[8]` rotation
- `[9]` horn
- `[10]` drawer no
- `[11]` slot no

---

## Özellikle söyleyebileceğim
- **Eski kodda doğruladığım `PFields_Old[10]`, `[11]` kullanımı yeni kodla da tutarlı**
- **Yeni kodda `PFields[10]`, `[11]` kullanımı görünmüyor**
- `PFields` ve `PFields_Old` için senin son verdiğin kolon şemasıyla çelişen bariz bir durum yok

---

## Dikkat
Ben bunu **sadece paylaştığın kod parçalarına dayanarak** söylüyorum.  
Yani:
- açıkça görünen kolon kullanımında fark yok
- ama başka dosya / başka bloklarda farklı kullanım varsa onları bu mesajda doğrulayamam

---

## Kısa cevap
**Hayır, şu an gördüğüm kadarıyla eski koda göre kolon elemanlarında bir fark yok.**  
En azından bu paylaştığın iki versiyon arasında, senin verdiğin mapping ile çelişen bir kolon kayması görünmüyor.

```
(* Main execution: run on rising edge of Trigger or Unload *)
IF Unload THEN
  (* initialize *)
  Busy := TRUE;
  Done := FALSE;
  Error := FALSE;
  ErrorText := '';
  ValidityFlag := TRUE;

  numSame := 0;
  numDiff := 0;
  newCount := 0;
  oldCount := 0;

  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    KeepList[i] := FALSE;
    ReplaceList[i] := FALSE;
    LoadOnlyList[i] := FALSE;
    UnloadOnlyList[i] := FALSE;
    PerIndexStatus[i] := PIndexStatus.SAME;
    OldMatched[i] := FALSE;
    NewMatchedToOld[i] := 0;
  END_FOR;

  (* Clear all target global retain arrays before packing *)
  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
      Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,j] := '';
      Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[i,j] := '';
      Retain_LoadPunchList[i,j] := '';
      Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[i,j] := '';
      Retain_KeepPunchList[i,j] := '';
      Retain_KeepPunchListNew[i,j] := '';
    END_FOR;
  END_FOR;

  (* Build unload candidates only from current physical state PFields_Old *)
  UnloadTempCount := 0;
  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    IF PFields_Old[i,3] <> '' THEN
      oldCount := oldCount + 1;
      UnloadOnlyList[i] := TRUE;

      foundIndex := 0;
      FOR k := 1 TO 16 DO
        IF pDrawerName[k] = PFields_Old[i,3] THEN
          foundIndex := k;
          EXIT;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;

      IF foundIndex <> 0 THEN
        UnloadTempCount := UnloadTempCount + 1;
        UnloadTempOrigIndex[UnloadTempCount] := i;
        UnloadTempDrawerIdx[UnloadTempCount] := foundIndex;
        UnloadTempOrder[UnloadTempCount] := UnloadTempCount;
      END_IF;

      PerIndexStatus[i] := PIndexStatus.DIFF;
    ELSE
      PerIndexStatus[i] := PIndexStatus.SAME;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  numSame := 0;
  numDiff := oldCount;
  newCount := 0;

  FOR a := 1 TO UnloadTempCount - 1 DO
    minIdx := a;
    FOR b := a + 1 TO UnloadTempCount DO
      IF UnloadTempDrawerIdx[b] < UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] THEN
        minIdx := b;
      ELSIF (UnloadTempDrawerIdx[b] = UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx]) AND (UnloadTempOrder[b] < UnloadTempOrder[minIdx]) THEN
        minIdx := b;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    IF minIdx <> a THEN
      tmpInt := UnloadTempOrigIndex[a];
      UnloadTempOrigIndex[a] := UnloadTempOrigIndex[minIdx];
      UnloadTempOrigIndex[minIdx] := tmpInt;

      tmpInt := UnloadTempDrawerIdx[a];
      UnloadTempDrawerIdx[a] := UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx];
      UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] := tmpInt;

      tmpInt := UnloadTempOrder[a];
      UnloadTempOrder[a] := UnloadTempOrder[minIdx];
      UnloadTempOrder[minIdx] := tmpInt;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  UnloadCount := 0;
  FOR a := 1 TO UnloadTempCount DO
    UnloadCount := UnloadCount + 1;
    i := UnloadTempOrigIndex[a];
    FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
      Retain_UnloadPunchList[UnloadCount, j] := PFields_Old[i, j];
    END_FOR;
    Retain_UnloadPunchList[UnloadCount, 12] := INT_TO_STRING(i);
  END_FOR;

  FOR c := 1 TO 15 DO
    FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
      Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c, j] := '';
    END_FOR;
  END_FOR;

  FOR c := 1 TO UnloadCount DO
    tmpInt := UnloadTempOrigIndex[c];

    IF (tmpInt >= 1) AND (tmpInt <= 15) AND (PFields_Old[tmpInt,10] <> '') AND (PFields_Old[tmpInt,11] <> '') THEN
      e := STRING_TO_INT(PFields_Old[tmpInt,10]);
      d := STRING_TO_INT(PFields_Old[tmpInt,11]);

      IF (e >= 1) AND (e <= 16) AND (d >= 1) AND (d <= 15) THEN
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,1] := pDrawerName[e];
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,2] := PFields_Old[tmpInt,10];
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,3] := PFields_Old[tmpInt,11];
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,4] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchLength[e,d]);
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,5] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchPosition[e,d]);
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,6] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchHorn[e,d]);
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,12] := INT_TO_STRING(tmpInt);
      END_IF;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  PackageState := PPackageState.PARTIAL_CHANGE;
  NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.NO_ACTION;
  ValidityFlag := TRUE;

  Busy := FALSE;
  Done := TRUE;

ELSIF Trigger THEN
  (* initialize *)
  Busy := TRUE;
  Done := FALSE;
  Error := FALSE;
  ErrorText := '';
  ValidityFlag := TRUE;

  numSame := 0;
  numDiff := 0;
  newCount := 0;
  oldCount := 0;

  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    KeepList[i] := FALSE;
    ReplaceList[i] := FALSE;
    LoadOnlyList[i] := FALSE;
    UnloadOnlyList[i] := FALSE;
    PerIndexStatus[i] := PIndexStatus.SAME;
    OldMatched[i] := FALSE;
    NewMatchedToOld[i] := 0;
  END_FOR;

  (* STEP 1: basic ATC existence + requested length presence check for all requested new entries
     NOTE: PunchUsed is NOT checked here. Keep matching happens later. *)
  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    NewName := PFields[i,3];

    IF NewName <> '' THEN
      newCount := newCount + 1;
      NewLen := PFields[i,7];

      foundIndex := 0;
      FOR j := 1 TO 16 DO
        IF pDrawerName[j] = NewName THEN
          foundIndex := j;
          EXIT;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;

      IF foundIndex = 0 THEN
        ValidityFlag := FALSE;
        PackageState := PPackageState.INVALID;
        NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.INVALID_ABORT;
        Error := TRUE;
        ErrorText := CONCAT('INVALID: missing ATC tool name: ', NewName);

        FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
          FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
            PFields[i,j] := '';
          END_FOR;
        END_FOR;

        Busy := FALSE;
        Done := TRUE;
        RETURN;
      END_IF;

      IF NewLen = '' THEN
        ValidityFlag := FALSE;
        PackageState := PPackageState.INVALID;
        NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.INVALID_ABORT;
        Error := TRUE;
        ErrorText := CONCAT('INVALID: missing length for tool: ', NewName);

        FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
          FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
            PFields[i,j] := '';
          END_FOR;
        END_FOR;

        Busy := FALSE;
        Done := TRUE;
        RETURN;
      END_IF;

      foundLengthMatch := FALSE;
      hasLengthValue := FALSE;
      NewLenReal := 0.0;

      IF NewLen <> '' THEN
        NewLenReal := STRING_TO_REAL(NewLen);
        hasLengthValue := TRUE;
      END_IF;

      IF hasLengthValue THEN
        FOR j := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[j] = NewName THEN
            FOR k := 1 TO 15 DO
              IF ABS(PunchLength[j, k] - NewLenReal) <= eps THEN
                foundLengthMatch := TRUE;
                EXIT;
              END_IF;
            END_FOR;

            IF foundLengthMatch THEN
              EXIT;
            END_IF;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
      END_IF;

      IF NOT foundLengthMatch THEN
        ValidityFlag := FALSE;
        PackageState := PPackageState.INVALID;
        NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.INVALID_ABORT;
        Error := TRUE;
        ErrorText := CONCAT('INVALID: requested length NOT found FOR tool: ', NewName);

        FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
          FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
            PFields[i,j] := '';
          END_FOR;
        END_FOR;

        Busy := FALSE;
        Done := TRUE;
        RETURN;
      END_IF;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  (* STEP 2: Deterministic one-to-one keep matching (consume-old approach) *)
  OldAvailCount := 0;
  FOR j := 1 TO 15 DO
    OldName := PFields_Old[j,3];
    IF OldName <> '' THEN
      OldAvailCount := OldAvailCount + 1;
      OldAvailIndex[OldAvailCount] := j;
      OldMatched[j] := FALSE;
      oldCount := oldCount + 1;
    ELSE
      OldMatched[j] := FALSE;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    NewName := PFields[i,3];
    IF NewName <> '' THEN
      NewLen := PFields[i,7];
      NewHorn := PFields[i,9];
      NewRot := PFields[i,8];
      NewLenReal := 0.0;
      IF NewLen <> '' THEN
        NewLenReal := STRING_TO_REAL(NewLen);
      END_IF;

      NewMatchedToOld[i] := 0;
      a := 1;
      WHILE (a <= OldAvailCount) AND (NewMatchedToOld[i] = 0) DO
        j := OldAvailIndex[a];
        OldName := PFields_Old[j,3];
        IF OldName <> '' THEN
          OldLen := PFields_Old[j,7];
          OldHorn := PFields_Old[j,9];
          OldRot := PFields_Old[j,8];

          OldLenReal := 0.0;
          IF OldLen <> '' THEN
            OldLenReal := STRING_TO_REAL(OldLen);
          END_IF;

          IF (NewName = OldName) AND (NewHorn = OldHorn) AND (NewRot = OldRot) AND (ABS(NewLenReal - OldLenReal) <= eps) THEN
            OldMatched[j] := TRUE;
            KeepList[j] := TRUE;
            NewMatchedToOld[i] := j;

            FOR b := a TO OldAvailCount - 1 DO
              OldAvailIndex[b] := OldAvailIndex[b + 1];
            END_FOR;
            OldAvailCount := OldAvailCount - 1;
          ELSE
            a := a + 1;
          END_IF;
        ELSE
          a := a + 1;
        END_IF;
      END_WHILE;

      IF NewMatchedToOld[i] = 0 THEN
        LoadOnlyList[i] := TRUE;
      END_IF;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  FOR a := 1 TO OldAvailCount DO
    j := OldAvailIndex[a];
    IF PFields_Old[j,3] <> '' THEN
      UnloadOnlyList[j] := TRUE;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  (* STEP 3: PunchUsed-based validation ONLY for load-only punches *)
  (* 3a - per-load-only length availability in physically present ATC punches *)
  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    IF LoadOnlyList[i] THEN
      NewName := PFields[i,3];
      NewLen := PFields[i,7];

      foundLengthMatch := FALSE;
      hasLengthValue := FALSE;
      NewLenReal := 0.0;

      IF NewLen <> '' THEN
        NewLenReal := STRING_TO_REAL(NewLen);
        hasLengthValue := TRUE;
      END_IF;

      IF hasLengthValue THEN
        FOR j := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[j] = NewName THEN
            FOR k := 1 TO 15 DO
              IF (NOT PunchUsed[j,k]) AND (ABS(PunchLength[j, k] - NewLenReal) <= eps) THEN
                foundLengthMatch := TRUE;
                EXIT;
              END_IF;
            END_FOR;

            IF foundLengthMatch THEN
              EXIT;
            END_IF;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
      END_IF;

      IF NOT foundLengthMatch THEN
        ValidityFlag := FALSE;
        PackageState := PPackageState.INVALID;
        NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.INVALID_ABORT;
        Error := TRUE;
        ErrorText := CONCAT('INVALID: requested load punch length NOT available in free ATC punches FOR tool: ', NewName);

        FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
          FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
            PFields[i,j] := '';
          END_FOR;
        END_FOR;

        Busy := FALSE;
        Done := TRUE;
        RETURN;
      END_IF;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  (* 3b - multiplicity check ONLY for load-only punches *)
  uniqCount := 0;
  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    IF LoadOnlyList[i] THEN
      foundIndex := 0;
      FOR a := 1 TO uniqCount DO
        IF (uniqName[a] = PFields[i,3]) AND (uniqLen[a] = PFields[i,7]) AND (uniqHorn[a] = PFields[i,9]) THEN
          foundIndex := a;
          EXIT;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;

      IF foundIndex = 0 THEN
        uniqCount := uniqCount + 1;
        uniqName[uniqCount] := PFields[i,3];
        uniqLen[uniqCount] := PFields[i,7];
        uniqHorn[uniqCount] := PFields[i,9];
        uniqNeeded[uniqCount] := 1;
      ELSE
        uniqNeeded[foundIndex] := uniqNeeded[foundIndex] + 1;
      END_IF;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  FOR a := 1 TO uniqCount DO
    NewName := uniqName[a];
    NewLen := uniqLen[a];
    NewHorn := uniqHorn[a];

    foundIndex := 0;
    FOR e := 1 TO 16 DO
      IF pDrawerName[e] = NewName THEN
        foundIndex := e;
        EXIT;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    IF foundIndex = 0 THEN
      ValidityFlag := FALSE;
      PackageState := PPackageState.INVALID;
      NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.INVALID_ABORT;
      Error := TRUE;
      ErrorText := CONCAT('INVALID (load multiplicity): missing drawer for ', NewName);

      FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
        FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
          PFields[i,j] := '';
        END_FOR;
      END_FOR;

      Busy := FALSE;
      Done := TRUE;
      RETURN;
    END_IF;

    availCount := 0;
    IF (NewLen <> '') AND (NewHorn <> '') THEN
      NewLenReal := STRING_TO_REAL(NewLen);
      NewHornReal := STRING_TO_REAL(NewHorn);

      FOR e := 1 TO 16 DO
        IF pDrawerName[e] = NewName THEN
          FOR d := 1 TO 15 DO
            IF (NOT PunchUsed[e,d]) AND
               (ABS(PunchLength[e,d] - NewLenReal) <= eps) AND
               (ABS(PunchHorn[e,d] - NewHornReal) <= eps) THEN
              availCount := availCount + 1;
            END_IF;
          END_FOR;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;
    END_IF;

    IF availCount < uniqNeeded[a] THEN
      ValidityFlag := FALSE;
      PackageState := PPackageState.INVALID;
      NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.INVALID_ABORT;
      Error := TRUE;
      ErrorText := CONCAT('INVALID: insufficient FREE ATC slots for load tool ', NewName);
      ErrorText := CONCAT(ErrorText, CONCAT(' len=', NewLen));
      ErrorText := CONCAT(ErrorText, CONCAT(' horn=', NewHorn));
      ErrorText := CONCAT(ErrorText, CONCAT(' needed=', INT_TO_STRING(uniqNeeded[a])));
      ErrorText := CONCAT(ErrorText, CONCAT(' available=', INT_TO_STRING(availCount)));

      FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
        FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
          PFields[i,j] := '';
        END_FOR;
      END_FOR;

      Busy := FALSE;
      Done := TRUE;
      RETURN;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  (* Compute summary counters *)
  numSame := 0;
  numDiff := 0;
  FOR j := 1 TO 15 DO
    IF KeepList[j] THEN
      numSame := numSame + 1;
    END_IF;
    IF UnloadOnlyList[j] THEN
      numDiff := numDiff + 1;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;
  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    IF LoadOnlyList[i] THEN
      numDiff := numDiff + 1;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    OldName := PFields_Old[i,3];
    NewName := PFields[i,3];
    IF KeepList[i] THEN
      PerIndexStatus[i] := PIndexStatus.SAME;
    ELSIF (OldName = '') AND (NewName = '') THEN
      PerIndexStatus[i] := PIndexStatus.SAME;
    ELSE
      PerIndexStatus[i] := PIndexStatus.DIFF;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  IF NOT ValidityFlag THEN
    PackageState := PPackageState.INVALID;
    NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.INVALID_ABORT;
  ELSE
    PackageState := PPackageState.PARTIAL_CHANGE;
    NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.NO_ACTION;
  END_IF;

  ValidityFlag := NOT Error;

  IF PackageState <> PPackageState.INVALID THEN
    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_LoadPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_KeepPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_KeepPunchListNew[i,j] := '';
      END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Pack UnloadPunchList *)
    UnloadTempCount := 0;
    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      IF UnloadOnlyList[i] THEN
        foundIndex := 0;
        FOR k := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[k] = PFields_Old[i,3] THEN
            foundIndex := k;
            EXIT;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
        IF foundIndex <> 0 THEN
          UnloadTempCount := UnloadTempCount + 1;
          UnloadTempOrigIndex[UnloadTempCount] := i;
          UnloadTempDrawerIdx[UnloadTempCount] := foundIndex;
          UnloadTempOrder[UnloadTempCount] := UnloadTempCount;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    FOR a := 1 TO UnloadTempCount - 1 DO
      minIdx := a;
      FOR b := a + 1 TO UnloadTempCount DO
        IF UnloadTempDrawerIdx[b] < UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] THEN
          minIdx := b;
        ELSIF (UnloadTempDrawerIdx[b] = UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx]) AND (UnloadTempOrder[b] < UnloadTempOrder[minIdx]) THEN
          minIdx := b;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;
      IF minIdx <> a THEN
        tmpInt := UnloadTempOrigIndex[a];
        UnloadTempOrigIndex[a] := UnloadTempOrigIndex[minIdx];
        UnloadTempOrigIndex[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := UnloadTempDrawerIdx[a];
        UnloadTempDrawerIdx[a] := UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx];
        UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := UnloadTempOrder[a];
        UnloadTempOrder[a] := UnloadTempOrder[minIdx];
        UnloadTempOrder[minIdx] := tmpInt;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    UnloadCount := 0;
    FOR a := 1 TO UnloadTempCount DO
      UnloadCount := UnloadCount + 1;
      i := UnloadTempOrigIndex[a];
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_UnloadPunchList[UnloadCount, j] := PFields_Old[i, j];
      END_FOR;
      Retain_UnloadPunchList[UnloadCount, 12] := INT_TO_STRING(i);
    END_FOR;

    (* Pack LoadPunchList *)
    LoadTempCount := 0;
    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      IF LoadOnlyList[i] THEN
        foundIndex := 0;
        FOR k := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[k] = PFields[i,3] THEN
            foundIndex := k;
            EXIT;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
        IF foundIndex <> 0 THEN
          LoadTempCount := LoadTempCount + 1;
          LoadTempOrigIndex[LoadTempCount] := i;
          LoadTempDrawerIdx[LoadTempCount] := foundIndex;
          LoadTempOrder[LoadTempCount] := LoadTempCount;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    FOR a := 1 TO LoadTempCount - 1 DO
      minIdx := a;
      FOR b := a + 1 TO LoadTempCount DO
        IF LoadTempDrawerIdx[b] < LoadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] THEN
          minIdx := b;
        ELSIF (LoadTempDrawerIdx[b] = LoadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx]) AND (LoadTempOrder[b] < LoadTempOrder[minIdx]) THEN
          minIdx := b;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;
      IF minIdx <> a THEN
        tmpInt := LoadTempOrigIndex[a];
        LoadTempOrigIndex[a] := LoadTempOrigIndex[minIdx];
        LoadTempOrigIndex[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := LoadTempDrawerIdx[a];
        LoadTempDrawerIdx[a] := LoadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx];
        LoadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := LoadTempOrder[a];
        LoadTempOrder[a] := LoadTempOrder[minIdx];
        LoadTempOrder[minIdx] := tmpInt;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    LoadCount := 0;
    FOR a := 1 TO LoadTempCount DO
      LoadCount := LoadCount + 1;
      i := LoadTempOrigIndex[a];
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_LoadPunchList[LoadCount, j] := PFields[i, j];
      END_FOR;
      Retain_LoadPunchList[LoadCount, 12] := INT_TO_STRING(i);
    END_FOR;

    (* ATC load mapping - PunchUsed applies only here and in load-only validation above *)
    FOR c := 1 TO 15 DO
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c, j] := '';
      END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    FOR e := 1 TO 16 DO
      FOR d := 1 TO 15 DO
        usedSlot[e,d] := FALSE;
      END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      NewAssignedDrawer[i] := 0;
      NewAssignedSlot[i] := 0;
    END_FOR;

    FOR c := 1 TO LoadCount DO
      origNewIdx := LoadTempOrigIndex[c];
      NewName := Retain_LoadPunchList[c,3];
      lenStr := Retain_LoadPunchList[c,7];
      hornStr := Retain_LoadPunchList[c,9];

      foundIndex := 0;

      IF (NewName <> '') AND (lenStr <> '') AND (hornStr <> '') THEN
        lenRealLocal := STRING_TO_REAL(lenStr);
        hornRealLocal := STRING_TO_REAL(hornStr);

        FOR e := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[e] = NewName THEN
            FOR d := 1 TO 15 DO
              IF (NOT usedSlot[e,d]) AND (NOT PunchUsed[e,d]) THEN
                IF (ABS(PunchLength[e,d] - lenRealLocal) <= eps) AND
                   (ABS(PunchHorn[e,d] - hornRealLocal) <= eps) THEN
                  usedSlot[e,d] := TRUE;
                  foundIndex := e;

                  Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,1] := pDrawerName[e];
                  Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,2] := INT_TO_STRING(e);
                  Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,3] := INT_TO_STRING(d);
                  Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,4] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchLength[e,d]);
                  Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,5] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchPosition[e,d]);
                  Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,6] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchHorn[e,d]);
                  Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,12] := INT_TO_STRING(origNewIdx);

                  NewAssignedDrawer[origNewIdx] := e;
                  NewAssignedSlot[origNewIdx] := d;
                  EXIT;
                END_IF;
              END_IF;
            END_FOR;

            IF foundIndex <> 0 THEN
              EXIT;
            END_IF;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    (* Pack KeepPunchList old + corresponding new *)
    KeepTempCount := 0;
    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      IF KeepList[i] THEN
        foundIndex := 0;
        FOR k := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[k] = PFields_Old[i,3] THEN
            foundIndex := k;
            EXIT;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
        IF foundIndex <> 0 THEN
          KeepTempCount := KeepTempCount + 1;
          KeepTempOrigIndex[KeepTempCount] := i;
          KeepTempDrawerIdx[KeepTempCount] := foundIndex;
          KeepTempOrder[KeepTempCount] := KeepTempCount;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    FOR a := 1 TO KeepTempCount - 1 DO
      minIdx := a;
      FOR b := a + 1 TO KeepTempCount DO
        IF KeepTempDrawerIdx[b] < KeepTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] THEN
          minIdx := b;
        ELSIF (KeepTempDrawerIdx[b] = KeepTempDrawerIdx[minIdx]) AND (KeepTempOrder[b] < KeepTempOrder[minIdx]) THEN
          minIdx := b;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;
      IF minIdx <> a THEN
        tmpInt := KeepTempOrigIndex[a];
        KeepTempOrigIndex[a] := KeepTempOrigIndex[minIdx];
        KeepTempOrigIndex[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := KeepTempDrawerIdx[a];
        KeepTempDrawerIdx[a] := KeepTempDrawerIdx[minIdx];
        KeepTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := KeepTempOrder[a];
        KeepTempOrder[a] := KeepTempOrder[minIdx];
        KeepTempOrder[minIdx] := tmpInt;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    KeepCount := 0;
    FOR a := 1 TO KeepTempCount DO
      KeepCount := KeepCount + 1;
      i := KeepTempOrigIndex[a];
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_KeepPunchList[KeepCount, j] := PFields_Old[i, j];
        Retain_KeepPunchListNew[KeepCount, j] := '';
      END_FOR;
      Retain_KeepPunchList[KeepCount, 12] := INT_TO_STRING(i);

      tmpInt := 0;
      FOR b := 1 TO 15 DO
        IF NewMatchedToOld[b] = i THEN
          tmpInt := b;
          EXIT;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;

      IF tmpInt <> 0 THEN
        FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
          Retain_KeepPunchListNew[KeepCount, j] := PFields[tmpInt, j];
        END_FOR;
        Retain_KeepPunchListNew[KeepCount, 12] := INT_TO_STRING(tmpInt);
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    (* ATC unload mapping uses PFields_Old[,10]=drawer and [,11]=slot *)
    FOR c := 1 TO 15 DO
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c, j] := '';
      END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    FOR c := 1 TO UnloadCount DO
      tmpInt := UnloadTempOrigIndex[c];

      IF (tmpInt >= 1) AND (tmpInt <= 15) AND (PFields_Old[tmpInt,10] <> '') AND (PFields_Old[tmpInt,11] <> '') THEN
        e := STRING_TO_INT(PFields_Old[tmpInt,10]);
        d := STRING_TO_INT(PFields_Old[tmpInt,11]);

        IF (e >= 1) AND (e <= 16) AND (d >= 1) AND (d <= 15) THEN
          Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,1] := pDrawerName[e];
          Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,2] := PFields_Old[tmpInt,10];
          Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,3] := PFields_Old[tmpInt,11];
          Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,4] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchLength[e,d]);
          Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,5] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchPosition[e,d]);
          Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,6] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchHorn[e,d]);
          Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,12] := INT_TO_STRING(tmpInt);
        END_IF;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    Busy := FALSE;
    Done := TRUE;
  ELSE
    Busy := FALSE;
    Done := TRUE;
  END_IF;

END_IF;
```
tamamdır o halde şimdi yeni kodumuza geri dönelim. PunchChanger kodumu relovate ve dragg işlemleri için revize etmiştik.
Şimdi bana bu kodda akışın PFileds'tan ve PFields_Old tan başlayarak nasıl arraylere  ayrıldığını. Load unload keep relocate dragg arraylerinin nasıl oluşturulduğu oluşturulma kuralları gibi detaylı analiz yap ve oluşturduğumuz tüm arraylerin sütun elemanlarının açıklamalarını ve nerden edinikdiğini söyle 

## Copilot

Anladım. Şimdi **yeni PunchChanger kodunu**, senin son verdiğin doğru kolon şemasına göre, akış ve array üretimi açısından analiz ediyorum.

Aşağıda:
1. akışın nasıl başladığını,
2. `PFields` / `PFields_Old`’dan hangi listelere nasıl ayrıldığını,
3. load / unload / keep / drag / relocate listelerinin hangi kuralla oluştuğunu,
4. her array’in sütunlarının ne anlama geldiğini ve nereden türediğini

tek tek anlatıyorum.

---

# 1) Genel akış

Kod iki ana moda ayrılıyor:

## A) `Unload = TRUE`
Amaç:
- eski programı sistemden dışarı alma hazırlığı yapmak
- sadece `PFields_Old` üzerinden `Unload` listesi oluşturmak

Bu modda:
- `PFields_Old` taranıyor
- boş olmayan satırlar unload adayı oluyor
- drawer no / slot no varsa ATC unload listesi hazırlanıyor
- sonuç `Retain_UnloadPunchList` ve `Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList` oluyor

---

## B) `Trigger = TRUE`
Amaç:
- yeni program ile eski programı karşılaştırmak
- aradaki farklardan load / unload / keep / drag / relocate listelerini üretmek

Bu modda sırasıyla:
1. yeni program doğrulanıyor
2. eski program ile bire bir keep eşleşmesi aranıyor
3. load-only satırlar belirleniyor
4. unload-only satırlar belirleniyor
5. load-only punchlar ATC’de var mı diye kontrol ediliyor
6. multiplicity kontrolü yapılıyor
7. summary counters güncelleniyor
8. sonra listeler paketleniyor:
   - unload
   - load
   - keep
   - ATC load / unload
   - relocate için ileride kullanılacak candidate listeler

---

# 2) `PFields` ve `PFields_Old` nasıl ayrılıyor?

## `PFields`
Yeni program verisi.

Senin son şeman:
- `[3]` name
- `[6]` position
- `[7]` length
- `[8]` rotation
- `[9]` horn

Kodda:
- `PFields[i,3] <> ''` ise satır aktif kabul ediliyor
- `PFields[i,7]` → length olarak okunuyor
- `PFields[i,8]` → rotation
- `PFields[i,9]` → horn

Bu yeni giriş seti, “yeni programda istenen punchlar”ı temsil ediyor.

---

## `PFields_Old`
Eski program verisi.

Senin son şeman:
- `[3]` name
- `[6]` position
- `[7]` length
- `[8]` rotation
- `[9]` horn
- `[10]` drawer no
- `[11]` slot no

Kodda:
- `PFields_Old[i,3] <> ''` ise eski satır aktif
- `PFields_Old[i,10]` ve `[11]` unload / ATC eşlemesi için kullanılıyor
- keep listesi bu eski satırlardan üretiliyor
- relocate da buradan türetiliyor

---

# 3) Unload listesi nasıl oluşuyor?

## Kural
- sadece `PFields_Old` içindeki aktif satırlar alınır
- yani eski programda olan ama yeni analizde unload edilecek punchlar

## Adımlar
1. `PFields_Old[i,3] <> ''` kontrolü yapılır
2. aktifse `UnloadOnlyList[i] := TRUE`
3. eski satırın `pDrawerName` içindeki drawer index’i bulunur
4. bu index’e göre sıralama yapılır
5. `Retain_UnloadPunchList` doldurulur
6. sonra ATC karşılığı olarak `Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList` yapılır

---

## `Retain_UnloadPunchList` kaynağı
- doğrudan `PFields_Old[i,j]` kopyası
- son kolon `[12]` içine orijinal eski index yazılır

---

## `Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList` kaynağı
Bu liste, unload sırasında ATC’nin hangi drawer/slot ile çalışacağını gösterir.

Kodda:
- `PFields_Old[tmpInt,10]` → drawer no
- `PFields_Old[tmpInt,11]` → slot no

bunlardan:
- drawer adı `pDrawerName[e]`
- length `PunchLength[e,d]`
- position `PunchPosition[e,d]`
- horn `PunchHorn[e,d]`

üretir.

---

# 4) Keep listesi nasıl oluşuyor?

## Kural
Keep, eski ve yeni programda aynı kabul edilen punchlardır.

Kodun eşleşme koşulu:
- `NewName = OldName`
- `NewHorn = OldHorn`
- `NewRot = OldRot`
- `ABS(NewLenReal - OldLenReal) <= eps`

Yani eşleşme için:
- name
- length
- rotation
- horn

birlikte kontrol ediliyor.

---

## Keep oluşumu
1. yeni satır okunur
2. eski satırlar arasında eşleşme aranır
3. ilk uygun eski satır eşleşmeye alınır
4. `KeepList[j] := TRUE`
5. `NewMatchedToOld[i] := j`

Bu yaklaşım:
- **one-to-one**
- **consume-old**
yöntemi

yani bir eski satır bir kez eşleşebiliyor.

---

## Keep listesi paketleme
Sonra:
- `Retain_KeepPunchList` = eski satırın kopyası
- `Retain_KeepPunchListNew` = yeni eşleşen satırın kopyası

Her ikisinde de:
- `[12]` ilgili kaynak index’idir

---

# 5) Load listesi nasıl oluşuyor?

## Kural
Yeni programda var ama eski ile eşleşmeyen satırlar load-only olur.

Kodda:
- eşleşme bulunamazsa `LoadOnlyList[i] := TRUE`

Bunlar:
- `Retain_LoadPunchList` içine alınır
- sonra ATC uygunluğu kontrol edilerek `Retain_ATCLoadPunchList` oluşturulur

---

## Load validation
Load-only punch için:
- drawer adı var mı?
- length doğru mu?
- aynı length ATC’de boş slotta var mı?
- yükleme için aynı name+length+horn kombinasyonundan yeterli sayıda free slot var mı?

Bunlar doğrulanıyor.

---

## Load paketleme
`Retain_LoadPunchList`:
- `PFields[i,j]` kopyası
- `[12]` yeni program index’i

`Retain_ATCLoadPunchList`:
- drawer adı
- drawer no
- slot no
- actual length
- position
- horn
- source index

---

# 6) Unload-only listesi nasıl oluşuyor?

Keep ve load belirlendikten sonra:
- eski satırların içinde eşleşmeyenler unload-only kalıyor

Kodda:
- kalan `OldAvailIndex[]` üzerinden `UnloadOnlyList[j] := TRUE`

Yani eski tarafta var ama yeni tarafta eşleşmeyen satırlar unload olarak sınıflanıyor.

---

# 7) Relocate listesi nasıl oluşuyor?

Relocate listesi, senin yeni algoritmanda çok kritik.

## Genel kural
- relocate, keep punchlar içinden çıkar
- drag yolu ile geometrik çakışma olan keep punchlar relocate olur

Yani relocate = keep ∩ drag collision

---

## Relocate oluşum mantığı
Bunu şu şekilde düşün:

1. keep punchlar belirlenir
2. drag punchlar belirlenir
3. keep punchın pozisyon aralığı ile drag yolu kesişiyor mu bakılır
4. kesişiyorsa relocate adayı olur

---

## Bu yüzden relocate listesi hangi veriyi kullanıyor?
- keep tarafındaki eski punch bilgisi
- özellikle position / length / width ile tanımlanan geometrik aralıklar

---

# 8) Drag listesi nasıl oluşuyor?

Drag listesi yeni kodda, ATC’de mevcut olan ve belirli drawer gruplarına ait punchlardan geliyor.

## Kural
Kodda şu drawer numaraları drag candidate kabul ediliyor:
- `4`
- `8`
- `12`
- `16`

Bu drawer’larda bulunan punchlar drag tarafına giriyor.

---

## Drag paketleme mantığı
Drag punchlar:
- `PFields`’dan alınır
- drawer adı çözülür
- drawer numarası bulunur
- pozisyonlarına göre sıralanır
- `Retain_DragPunchList`
- `Retain_ATCDragPunchList`

oluşturulur

---
