```
FUNCTION_BLOCK State_Machine
VAR_INPUT 
  Trigger : BOOL;

  (* Punch worker done inputs *)
  UnloadDone   : BOOL;
  RelocateDone : BOOL;
  DraggingDone : BOOL;
  KeepDone     : BOOL;
  LoadDone     : BOOL;

  (* Die worker done inputs *)
  DUnloadDone : BOOL;
  DKeepDone   : BOOL;
  DLoadDone   : BOOL;

  Cycle_Force_Stop : BOOL;
END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT RETAIN
  Busy : BOOL;
  Done : BOOL;
  Error : BOOL;
  ErrorText : STRING(200);

  (* Punch worker start outputs *)
  UnloadStartCmd   : BOOL;
  RelocateStartCmd : BOOL;
  DraggingStartCmd : BOOL;
  KeepStartCmd     : BOOL;
  LoadStartCmd     : BOOL;

  (* Die worker start outputs *)
  DUnloadStartCmd : BOOL;
  DKeepStartCmd   : BOOL;
  DLoadStartCmd   : BOOL;

  CurrentPhase : INT := Machine_States.M_IDLE;
END_VAR

VAR RETAIN
  i : INT;

  (* Punch work presence *)
  hasUnload   : BOOL;
  hasRelocate : BOOL;
  hasDragging : BOOL;
  hasKeep     : BOOL;
  hasLoad     : BOOL;

  (* Die work presence *)
  hasDUnload : BOOL;
  hasDKeep   : BOOL;
  hasDLoad   : BOOL;

  (* Summary work presence *)
  hasAnyPunchWork : BOOL;
  hasAnyDieWork   : BOOL;

  (* execution priority *)
  PunchFirst : BOOL := TRUE;
  PrimaryIsPunch : BOOL := TRUE;
  PrimaryDone : BOOL := FALSE;
  SecondaryDone : BOOL := FALSE;

  (* internal start latch flags *)
  startedUnload   : BOOL;
  startedRelocate : BOOL;
  startedDragging : BOOL;
  startedKeep     : BOOL;
  startedLoad     : BOOL;

  startedDUnload : BOOL;
  startedDKeep   : BOOL;
  startedDLoad   : BOOL;

  (* edge detection *)
  lastTrigger : BOOL := FALSE;
  triggerRising : BOOL := FALSE;
END_VAR

```
```
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Helper logic comment                                         *)
(* Current_Rack_Type:                                           *)
(*   0 = no rack  -> Punch priority                             *)
(*   1 = punch rack -> Punch priority                           *)
(*   2 = die rack   -> Die priority                             *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)


(* --- Trigger edge detect --- *)
triggerRising := Trigger AND NOT lastTrigger;


(* --- Force stop has highest priority --- *)
IF Cycle_Force_Stop THEN

  CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_IDLE;
  Busy := FALSE;
  Done := FALSE;
  Error := FALSE;
  ErrorText := '';

  UnloadStartCmd := FALSE;
  RelocateStartCmd := FALSE;
  DraggingStartCmd := FALSE;
  KeepStartCmd := FALSE;
  LoadStartCmd := FALSE;

  DUnloadStartCmd := FALSE;
  DKeepStartCmd := FALSE;
  DLoadStartCmd := FALSE;

  startedUnload := FALSE;
  startedRelocate := FALSE;
  startedDragging := FALSE;
  startedKeep := FALSE;
  startedLoad := FALSE;

  startedDUnload := FALSE;
  startedDKeep := FALSE;
  startedDLoad := FALSE;

  hasUnload := FALSE;
  hasRelocate := FALSE;
  hasDragging := FALSE;
  hasKeep := FALSE;
  hasLoad := FALSE;

  hasDUnload := FALSE;
  hasDKeep := FALSE;
  hasDLoad := FALSE;

  hasAnyPunchWork := FALSE;
  hasAnyDieWork := FALSE;

  PunchFirst := TRUE;
  PrimaryIsPunch := TRUE;
  PrimaryDone := FALSE;
  SecondaryDone := FALSE;

ELSE

  (* ========================================================== *)
  (* MAIN STATE MACHINE                                         *)
  (* ========================================================== *)

  IF CurrentPhase = Machine_States.M_IDLE THEN
    Busy := FALSE;
    Done := FALSE;
    Error := FALSE;
    ErrorText := '';

    UnloadStartCmd := FALSE;
    RelocateStartCmd := FALSE;
    DraggingStartCmd := FALSE;
    KeepStartCmd := FALSE;
    LoadStartCmd := FALSE;

    DUnloadStartCmd := FALSE;
    DKeepStartCmd := FALSE;
    DLoadStartCmd := FALSE;

    startedUnload := FALSE;
    startedRelocate := FALSE;
    startedDragging := FALSE;
    startedKeep := FALSE;
    startedLoad := FALSE;

    startedDUnload := FALSE;
    startedDKeep := FALSE;
    startedDLoad := FALSE;

    PrimaryDone := FALSE;
    SecondaryDone := FALSE;

    IF Trigger THEN

      (* Scan Punch lists *)
      hasUnload := FALSE;
      hasRelocate := FALSE;
      hasDragging := FALSE;
      hasKeep := FALSE;
      hasLoad := FALSE;

      (* Scan Die lists *)
      hasDUnload := FALSE;
      hasDKeep := FALSE;
      hasDLoad := FALSE;

      FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
        IF Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasUnload := TRUE;
        END_IF;

        IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasRelocate := TRUE;
        END_IF;

        IF Retain_DragPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasDragging := TRUE;
        END_IF;

        IF Retain_KeepPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasKeep := TRUE;
        END_IF;

        IF Retain_LoadPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasLoad := TRUE;
        END_IF;

        IF Retain_UnloadDieList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasDUnload := TRUE;
        END_IF;
        IF Retain_KeepDieList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasDKeep := TRUE;
        END_IF;
        IF Retain_LoadDieList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasDLoad := TRUE;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;

      hasAnyPunchWork := hasUnload OR hasRelocate OR hasDragging OR hasKeep OR hasLoad;
      hasAnyDieWork := hasDUnload OR hasDKeep OR hasDLoad;

      (* Decide who gets priority first *)
      IF Current_Rack_Type = 2 THEN
        PunchFirst := FALSE;
      ELSE
        PunchFirst := TRUE;
      END_IF;

      PrimaryIsPunch := PunchFirst;

      (* Nothing to do at all *)
      IF (NOT hasAnyPunchWork) AND (NOT hasAnyDieWork) THEN
        CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_DONE;
        Done := TRUE;
      ELSE
        Busy := TRUE;

        (* Start with primary type if it has work, otherwise skip to secondary *)
        IF PrimaryIsPunch THEN
          IF hasAnyPunchWork THEN
            IF hasUnload THEN
              CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_UNLOAD;
            ELSIF hasRelocate THEN
              CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_RELOCATE;
            ELSIF hasDragging THEN
              CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DRAGGING;
            ELSIF hasKeep THEN
              CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_KEEP;
            ELSIF hasLoad THEN
              CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_LOAD;
            END_IF;
          ELSE
            PrimaryDone := TRUE;

            IF hasAnyDieWork THEN
              IF hasDUnload THEN
                CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DUNLOAD;
              ELSIF hasDKeep THEN
                CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DKEEP;
              ELSIF hasDLoad THEN
                CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DLOAD;
              END_IF;
            ELSE
              CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_DONE;
            END_IF;
          END_IF;
        ELSE
          IF hasAnyDieWork THEN
            IF hasDUnload THEN
              CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DUNLOAD;
            ELSIF hasDKeep THEN
              CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DKEEP;
            ELSIF hasDLoad THEN
              CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DLOAD;
            END_IF;
          ELSE
            PrimaryDone := TRUE;

            IF hasAnyPunchWork THEN
              IF hasUnload THEN
                CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_UNLOAD;
              ELSIF hasRelocate THEN
                CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_RELOCATE;
              ELSIF hasDragging THEN
                CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DRAGGING;
              ELSIF hasKeep THEN
                CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_KEEP;
              ELSIF hasLoad THEN
                CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_LOAD;
              END_IF;
            ELSE
              CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_DONE;
            END_IF;
          END_IF;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;
    END_IF;


  (* ========================================================== *)
  (* PUNCH WORKFLOW                                             *)
  (* ========================================================== *)

  ELSIF CurrentPhase = Machine_States.M_RUN_UNLOAD THEN

    IF NOT startedUnload THEN
      UnloadStartCmd := TRUE;
      startedUnload := TRUE;
    END_IF;

    IF UnloadDone THEN
      UnloadStartCmd := FALSE;
      startedUnload := FALSE;

      (* re-scan remaining Punch work *)
      hasRelocate := FALSE;
      hasDragging := FALSE;
      hasKeep := FALSE;
      hasLoad := FALSE;

      FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
        IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasRelocate := TRUE;
        END_IF;
        IF Retain_DragPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasDragging := TRUE;
        END_IF;
        IF Retain_KeepPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasKeep := TRUE;
        END_IF;
        IF Retain_LoadPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasLoad := TRUE;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;

      hasAnyPunchWork := hasRelocate OR hasDragging OR hasKeep OR hasLoad;

      IF hasRelocate THEN
        CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_RELOCATE;
      ELSIF hasDragging THEN
        CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DRAGGING;
      ELSIF hasKeep THEN
        CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_KEEP;
      ELSIF hasLoad THEN
        CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_LOAD;
      ELSE
        IF PrimaryIsPunch THEN
          PrimaryDone := TRUE;
        ELSE
          SecondaryDone := TRUE;
        END_IF;

        hasDUnload := FALSE;
        hasDKeep := FALSE;
        hasDLoad := FALSE;
        FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
          IF Retain_UnloadDieList[i,3] <> '' THEN
            hasDUnload := TRUE;
          END_IF;
          IF Retain_KeepDieList[i,3] <> '' THEN
            hasDKeep := TRUE;
          END_IF;
          IF Retain_LoadDieList[i,3] <> '' THEN
            hasDLoad := TRUE;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;

        hasAnyDieWork := hasDUnload OR hasDKeep OR hasDLoad;

        IF hasAnyDieWork AND ((PrimaryIsPunch AND NOT SecondaryDone) OR ((NOT PrimaryIsPunch) AND NOT PrimaryDone)) THEN
          IF hasDUnload THEN
            CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DUNLOAD;
          ELSIF hasDKeep THEN
            CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DKEEP;
          ELSIF hasDLoad THEN
            CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DLOAD;
          END_IF;
        ELSE
          CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_DONE;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;

    ELSIF triggerRising THEN
      UnloadStartCmd := TRUE;
      startedUnload := TRUE;
    END_IF;


  ELSIF CurrentPhase = Machine_States.M_RUN_RELOCATE THEN

    IF NOT startedRelocate THEN
      RelocateStartCmd := TRUE;
      startedRelocate := TRUE;
    END_IF;

    IF RelocateDone THEN
      RelocateStartCmd := FALSE;
      startedRelocate := FALSE;

      hasDragging := FALSE;
      hasKeep := FALSE;
      hasLoad := FALSE;

      FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
        IF Retain_DragPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasDragging := TRUE;
        END_IF;
        IF Retain_KeepPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasKeep := TRUE;
        END_IF;
        IF Retain_LoadPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasLoad := TRUE;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;

      IF hasDragging THEN
        CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DRAGGING;
      ELSIF hasKeep THEN
        CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_KEEP;
      ELSIF hasLoad THEN
        CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_LOAD;
      ELSE
        IF PrimaryIsPunch THEN
          PrimaryDone := TRUE;
        ELSE
          SecondaryDone := TRUE;
        END_IF;
        CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_DONE;
      END_IF;

    ELSIF triggerRising THEN
      RelocateStartCmd := TRUE;
      startedRelocate := TRUE;
    END_IF;


  ELSIF CurrentPhase = Machine_States.M_RUN_DRAGGING THEN

    IF NOT startedDragging THEN
      DraggingStartCmd := TRUE;
      startedDragging := TRUE;
    END_IF;

    IF DraggingDone THEN
      DraggingStartCmd := FALSE;
      startedDragging := FALSE;

      hasKeep := FALSE;
      hasLoad := FALSE;

      FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
        IF Retain_KeepPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasKeep := TRUE;
        END_IF;
        IF Retain_LoadPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasLoad := TRUE;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;

      IF hasKeep THEN
        CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_KEEP;
      ELSIF hasLoad THEN
        CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_LOAD;
      ELSE
        IF PrimaryIsPunch THEN
          PrimaryDone := TRUE;
        ELSE
          SecondaryDone := TRUE;
        END_IF;

        hasDUnload := FALSE;
        hasDKeep := FALSE;
        hasDLoad := FALSE;
        FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
          IF Retain_UnloadDieList[i,3] <> '' THEN
            hasDUnload := TRUE;
          END_IF;
          IF Retain_KeepDieList[i,3] <> '' THEN
            hasDKeep := TRUE;
          END_IF;
          IF Retain_LoadDieList[i,3] <> '' THEN
            hasDLoad := TRUE;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;

        hasAnyDieWork := hasDUnload OR hasDKeep OR hasDLoad;

        IF hasAnyDieWork AND ((PrimaryIsPunch AND NOT SecondaryDone) OR ((NOT PrimaryIsPunch) AND NOT PrimaryDone)) THEN
          IF hasDUnload THEN
            CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DUNLOAD;
          ELSIF hasDKeep THEN
            CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DKEEP;
          ELSIF hasDLoad THEN
            CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DLOAD;
          END_IF;
        ELSE
          CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_DONE;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;

    ELSIF triggerRising THEN
      DraggingStartCmd := TRUE;
      startedDragging := TRUE;
    END_IF;


  ELSIF CurrentPhase = Machine_States.M_RUN_KEEP THEN

    IF NOT startedKeep THEN
      KeepStartCmd := TRUE;
      startedKeep := TRUE;
    END_IF;

    IF KeepDone THEN
      KeepStartCmd := FALSE;
      startedKeep := FALSE;

      hasLoad := FALSE;
      FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
        IF Retain_LoadPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasLoad := TRUE;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;

      IF hasLoad THEN
        CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_LOAD;
      ELSE
        IF PrimaryIsPunch THEN
          PrimaryDone := TRUE;
        ELSE
          SecondaryDone := TRUE;
        END_IF;

        hasDUnload := FALSE;
        hasDKeep := FALSE;
        hasDLoad := FALSE;
        FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
          IF Retain_UnloadDieList[i,3] <> '' THEN
            hasDUnload := TRUE;
          END_IF;
          IF Retain_KeepDieList[i,3] <> '' THEN
            hasDKeep := TRUE;
          END_IF;
          IF Retain_LoadDieList[i,3] <> '' THEN
            hasDLoad := TRUE;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;

        hasAnyDieWork := hasDUnload OR hasDKeep OR hasDLoad;

        IF hasAnyDieWork AND ((PrimaryIsPunch AND NOT SecondaryDone) OR ((NOT PrimaryIsPunch) AND NOT PrimaryDone)) THEN
          IF hasDUnload THEN
            CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DUNLOAD;
          ELSIF hasDKeep THEN
            CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DKEEP;
          ELSIF hasDLoad THEN
            CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DLOAD;
          END_IF;
        ELSE
          CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_DONE;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;

    ELSIF triggerRising THEN
      KeepStartCmd := TRUE;
      startedKeep := TRUE;
    END_IF;


  ELSIF CurrentPhase = Machine_States.M_RUN_LOAD THEN

    IF NOT startedLoad THEN
      LoadStartCmd := TRUE;
      startedLoad := TRUE;
    END_IF;

    IF LoadDone THEN
      LoadStartCmd := FALSE;
      startedLoad := FALSE;

      IF PrimaryIsPunch THEN
        PrimaryDone := TRUE;
      ELSE
        SecondaryDone := TRUE;
      END_IF;

      hasDUnload := FALSE;
      hasDKeep := FALSE;
      hasDLoad := FALSE;
      FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
        IF Retain_UnloadDieList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasDUnload := TRUE;
        END_IF;
        IF Retain_KeepDieList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasDKeep := TRUE;
        END_IF;
        IF Retain_LoadDieList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasDLoad := TRUE;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;

      hasAnyDieWork := hasDUnload OR hasDKeep OR hasDLoad;

      IF hasAnyDieWork AND ((PrimaryIsPunch AND NOT SecondaryDone) OR ((NOT PrimaryIsPunch) AND NOT PrimaryDone)) THEN
        IF hasDUnload THEN
          CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DUNLOAD;
        ELSIF hasDKeep THEN
          CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DKEEP;
        ELSIF hasDLoad THEN
          CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DLOAD;
        END_IF;
      ELSE
        CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_DONE;
      END_IF;

    ELSIF triggerRising THEN
      LoadStartCmd := TRUE;
      startedLoad := TRUE;
    END_IF;


  (* ========================================================== *)
  (* DIE WORKFLOW                                               *)
  (* ========================================================== *)

  ELSIF CurrentPhase = Machine_States.M_RUN_DUNLOAD THEN

    IF NOT startedDUnload THEN
      DUnloadStartCmd := TRUE;
      startedDUnload := TRUE;
    END_IF;

    IF DUnloadDone THEN
      DUnloadStartCmd := FALSE;
      startedDUnload := FALSE;

      hasDKeep := FALSE;
      hasDLoad := FALSE;
      FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
        IF Retain_KeepDieList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasDKeep := TRUE;
        END_IF;
        IF Retain_LoadDieList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasDLoad := TRUE;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;

      IF hasDKeep THEN
        CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DKEEP;
      ELSIF hasDLoad THEN
        CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DLOAD;
      ELSE
        IF NOT PrimaryIsPunch THEN
          PrimaryDone := TRUE;
        ELSE
          SecondaryDone := TRUE;
        END_IF;

        hasUnload := FALSE;
        hasRelocate := FALSE;
        hasDragging := FALSE;
        hasKeep := FALSE;
        hasLoad := FALSE;
        FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
          IF Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
            hasUnload := TRUE;
          END_IF;
          IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
            hasRelocate := TRUE;
          END_IF;
          IF Retain_DragPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
            hasDragging := TRUE;
          END_IF;
          IF Retain_KeepPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
            hasKeep := TRUE;
          END_IF;
          IF Retain_LoadPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
            hasLoad := TRUE;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;

        hasAnyPunchWork := hasUnload OR hasRelocate OR hasDragging OR hasKeep OR hasLoad;

        IF hasAnyPunchWork AND (((NOT PrimaryIsPunch) AND NOT SecondaryDone) OR (PrimaryIsPunch AND NOT PrimaryDone)) THEN
          IF hasUnload THEN
            CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_UNLOAD;
          ELSIF hasRelocate THEN
            CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_RELOCATE;
          ELSIF hasDragging THEN
            CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DRAGGING;
          ELSIF hasKeep THEN
            CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_KEEP;
          ELSIF hasLoad THEN
            CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_LOAD;
          END_IF;
        ELSE
          CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_DONE;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;

    ELSIF triggerRising THEN
      DUnloadStartCmd := TRUE;
      startedDUnload := TRUE;
    END_IF;


  ELSIF CurrentPhase = Machine_States.M_RUN_DKEEP THEN

    IF NOT startedDKeep THEN
      DKeepStartCmd := TRUE;
      startedDKeep := TRUE;
    END_IF;

    IF DKeepDone THEN
      DKeepStartCmd := FALSE;
      startedDKeep := FALSE;

      hasDLoad := FALSE;
      FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
        IF Retain_LoadDieList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasDLoad := TRUE;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;

      IF hasDLoad THEN
        CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DLOAD;
      ELSE
        IF NOT PrimaryIsPunch THEN
          PrimaryDone := TRUE;
        ELSE
          SecondaryDone := TRUE;
        END_IF;

        hasUnload := FALSE;
        hasRelocate := FALSE;
        hasDragging := FALSE;
        hasKeep := FALSE;
        hasLoad := FALSE;
        FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
          IF Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
            hasUnload := TRUE;
          END_IF;
          IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
            hasRelocate := TRUE;
          END_IF;
          IF Retain_DragPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
            hasDragging := TRUE;
          END_IF;
          IF Retain_KeepPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
            hasKeep := TRUE;
          END_IF;
          IF Retain_LoadPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
            hasLoad := TRUE;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;

        hasAnyPunchWork := hasUnload OR hasRelocate OR hasDragging OR hasKeep OR hasLoad;

        IF hasAnyPunchWork AND (((NOT PrimaryIsPunch) AND NOT SecondaryDone) OR (PrimaryIsPunch AND NOT PrimaryDone)) THEN
          IF hasUnload THEN
            CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_UNLOAD;
          ELSIF hasRelocate THEN
            CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_RELOCATE;
          ELSIF hasDragging THEN
            CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DRAGGING;
          ELSIF hasKeep THEN
            CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_KEEP;
          ELSIF hasLoad THEN
            CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_LOAD;
          END_IF;
        ELSE
          CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_DONE;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;

    ELSIF triggerRising THEN
      DKeepStartCmd := TRUE;
      startedDKeep := TRUE;
    END_IF;


  ELSIF CurrentPhase = Machine_States.M_RUN_DLOAD THEN

    IF NOT startedDLoad THEN
      DLoadStartCmd := TRUE;
      startedDLoad := TRUE;
    END_IF;

    IF DLoadDone THEN
      DLoadStartCmd := FALSE;
      startedDLoad := FALSE;

      IF NOT PrimaryIsPunch THEN
        PrimaryDone := TRUE;
      ELSE
        SecondaryDone := TRUE;
      END_IF;

      hasUnload := FALSE;
      hasRelocate := FALSE;
      hasDragging := FALSE;
      hasKeep := FALSE;
      hasLoad := FALSE;
      FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
        IF Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasUnload := TRUE;
        END_IF;
        IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasRelocate := TRUE;
        END_IF;
        IF Retain_DragPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasDragging := TRUE;
        END_IF;
        IF Retain_KeepPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasKeep := TRUE;
        END_IF;
        IF Retain_LoadPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasLoad := TRUE;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;

      hasAnyPunchWork := hasUnload OR hasRelocate OR hasDragging OR hasKeep OR hasLoad;

      IF hasAnyPunchWork AND (((NOT PrimaryIsPunch) AND NOT SecondaryDone) OR (PrimaryIsPunch AND NOT PrimaryDone)) THEN
        IF hasUnload THEN
          CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_UNLOAD;
        ELSIF hasRelocate THEN
          CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_RELOCATE;
        ELSIF hasDragging THEN
          CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DRAGGING;
        ELSIF hasKeep THEN
          CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_KEEP;
        ELSIF hasLoad THEN
          CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_LOAD;
        END_IF;
      ELSE
        CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_DONE;
      END_IF;

    ELSIF triggerRising THEN
      DLoadStartCmd := TRUE;
      startedDLoad := TRUE;
    END_IF;


  (* ========================================================== *)
  (* DONE                                                       *)
  (* ========================================================== *)

  ELSIF CurrentPhase = Machine_States.M_DONE THEN
    Busy := FALSE;
    Done := TRUE;
    CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_IDLE;
  END_IF;

END_IF;


(* --- edge memory update --- *)
lastTrigger := Trigger;
```
Tamamdır.Şimdi listelerimizi istediğimiz gibi PunchChanger kodumuzdan oluşturduğumuza göre artık sıra State_Machine fonksiyonumuzu düzenlemeye geldi. 
State_Machine Fonksiyonumuz aslında gelen listelere ve mevcut warehouse durumuna göre iş akışını yöneten ve şuan load unload keep ve daha sonrasında ekleyeceğimiz relocate dragg unload dragg load fonksiyonlarını tetikleyen ve onlardan gelen dönüşlerle bir sonraki iş akışını başlatan fonksiyondur.
İşe başlamadan önce şuan mevcut hali ile seninle state machine fonksiyonumu paylaşıyorum şuan için sadece ne olduğunu ve nasıl çalıştığını anlamanı istiyorum.

## Şu anki rolü
Bu FB, gelen iş listesinin durumuna göre:
- **Punch** işleri
- **Die** işleri

arasında bir yürütme sırası kuruyor ve ilgili worker FB’leri start ediyor.

---

# Nasıl çalışıyor?

## 1) Girişler
`Trigger` ile başlıyor.  
Worker’lardan tamamlanma sinyalleri alıyor:

### Punch worker done input’lar
- `UnloadDone`
- `RelocateDone`
- `DraggingDone`
- `KeepDone`
- `LoadDone`

### Die worker done input’lar
- `DUnloadDone`
- `DKeepDone`
- `DLoadDone`

Ve ayrıca:
- `Cycle_Force_Stop`

---

## 2) Çıkışlar
Bu FB, worker’lara start komutu veriyor:

### Punch start outputs
- `UnloadStartCmd`
- `RelocateStartCmd`
- `DraggingStartCmd`
- `KeepStartCmd`
- `LoadStartCmd`

### Die start outputs
- `DUnloadStartCmd`
- `DKeepStartCmd`
- `DLoadStartCmd`

---

## 3) Genel mantık
`CurrentPhase` ile bir state machine yürütülüyor.

### Önce:
- trigger yükselen kenar ile cycle başlıyor

### Sonra:
- sistem önce punch işlerini mi, die işlerini mi öncelikli çalıştıracağını belirliyor
- bu karar `Current_Rack_Type` ile etkileniyor

---

# Şu anki akış mantığı

## A) Idle durumunda
- önce mevcut iş listeleri taranıyor
- hangi punch/die işlerinin var olduğu bulunuyor
- ardından öncelik belirleniyor:
  - punch first
  - veya die first

---

## B) Punch workflow
Punch işleri şu sırayla ele alınıyor:

1. `Unload`
2. `Relocate`
3. `Dragging`
4. `Keep`
5. `Load`

Yani punch tarafında bir iş bitince, kalan punch işleri varsa sıradaki phase’e geçiyor.

---

## C) Die workflow
Die işleri:
1. `DUnload`
2. `DKeep`
3. `DLoad`

---

## D) İki grup arasında geçiş
Bir grup bitince:
- diğer grupta iş varsa ona geçiyor
- yoksa `M_DONE`

---

# Önemli davranış
Bu state machine:
- worker FB’lerin start komutlarını set ediyor
- worker done sinyalini bekliyor
- done geldikten sonra bir sonraki phase’e geçiyor

Yani:
- kendisi iş yapmıyor
- **orkestrasyon yapıyor**

---

# Force stop
`Cycle_Force_Stop` gelirse:
- her şey resetleniyor
- tüm start komutları kapatılıyor
- phase idle’a alınıyor

Bu yüksek öncelikli çıkış.

---

# Benim şu an net anladığım
Bu FB:
- punch ve die listelerini tüketen üst seviye yürütme yöneticisi
- phase bazlı
- worker bazlı
- priority bazlı

- unload

- dragging

Bu state machine de zaten bunları sırayla çalıştırabilecek şekilde tasarlanmış görünüyor.

## @snnrcpglu1677

Şimdi biz biliyorsunki punch changerda yaptığımız son güncelleme sonrası punch tarafında iş akışını şu şekilde yürütüyor olacağız. 
P_Unload_Direct
P_Relocate
P_Unload_Dragg
P_Load_Dragg
P_Keeping
P_Load_Direct
Bu akış fiziksel olarak şu anlama geliyor. 
Unload edilecek olan Punchlardan direk sök tak yapılanları önce boşalt. 
Sonra Relocate ile Relocate Trasshold değerinden küçük pozisyonda olan punchları relocate ederek en uzun dragg yolu dışına taşı.
Sonra dragg ile unload edilecek olan punchları dragg unload ile unload et. 
Sonra dragg ile load edilecekler olanları dragg load ile load et 
Sonra Keeping ile sök tak yaparak relocate trashold dışına taşınan punchları programda istenen yeni pozisyonlarına sök tak ile yerleştir. 
En son Load direct ile sök tak yöntemi ile kalan load edilcek punchları final pozisyonlarına koy. 
Böylelikle hiç bir çarpışma olmadan cycle tamamlanır. İş sırası bu şekilde olacak. 
İşte bizde State Machine FB' de Punch tarafında bu düzenlemeyi yapacağız. 
Bu iş akışını yönetmek için 
P_Unload_Direct  için Retain_UnloadPunchList te punch var mı yani 
[3] → name kontrolü ve [2] → drag flag '' = direct unload kontrolü yapılır. 
Yani Direct unload edilecek punch var mı varsa akış P_Unload_Direct  ile başlar. 
P_Unload_Direct  bitttikten sonra P_Relocate gelmesi gerekir. 
P_Relocate için Retain_RelocatePunchList [3] → name kontrolü yapılır eğer "" değilse ilk punch elemanı 
P_Relocate  başlatılır. P_Relocate bittikten sonra P_Unload_Dragggelir. 
P_Unload_Dragg için Retain_UnloadPunchList [2] → drag flag '' '1' = drag unload kontrolü yapılır. 
Bu kontrole uyan punch varsa Retain_UnloadPunchList  içerisinde P_Unload_Dragg  başlar. 
P_Unload_Dragg  bittikten sonra P_Load_Dragg gelir. 
P_Load_Dragg Retain_LoadPunchList kontrolü yapılır. [3] → name ve [2] → drag flag '1' = drag load
olan punchlar varsa P_Load_Dragg  tetiklenir. P_Load_Dragg  bittikten sonra P_Keeping gelir.
Retain_KeepPunchList [3] → name "" değilse yani keep edilecek punchlar varsa P_Keeping başlar. 
P_Keeping bittikten sonra ise P_Load_Direct gelir Retain_LoadPunchList [3] → name ve [2] → drag flag
'' = direct load yani direct load edilecek punchlar varsa P_Load_Direct başlar ve 
P_Load_Direct  done gelince artık punch döngüsüde sora erer. 
Trigger-Cmd-Done mantığı aynen korunur. Yeni punch iş akışı ve eklenen yeni workler için kodumuzu güncelleyeceğiz.

## Copilot

Tamam. State_Machine’i yeni punch akışına göre güncellenecek şekilde aşağıya veriyorum.

Aşağıdaki revizyonda punch tarafı sırası şu:

1. `P_Unload_Direct`
2. `P_Relocate`
3. `P_Unload_Dragg`
4. `P_Load_Dragg`
5. `P_Keeping`
6. `P_Load_Direct`

Ve geçişler artık:
- `Retain_UnloadPunchList[,3]` + `[,2]`
- `Retain_RelocatePunchList[,3]`
- `Retain_LoadPunchList[,3]` + `[,2]`
- `Retain_KeepPunchList[,3]`

üzerinden yapılıyor.

Aşağıdaki kod, mevcut state machine mantığını koruyup punch workflow kısmını senin yeni akışına göre revize edilmiş halidir.

```iecst
FUNCTION_BLOCK State_Machine
VAR_INPUT 
  Trigger : BOOL;

  (* Punch worker done inputs *)
  UnloadDone    : BOOL;
  RelocateDone  : BOOL;
  DraggingDone  : BOOL;
  KeepDone      : BOOL;
  LoadDone      : BOOL;

  (* Die worker done inputs *)
  DUnloadDone : BOOL;
  DKeepDone   : BOOL;
  DLoadDone   : BOOL;

  Cycle_Force_Stop : BOOL;
END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT RETAIN
  Busy : BOOL;
  Done : BOOL;
  Error : BOOL;
  ErrorText : STRING(200);

  (* Punch worker start outputs *)
  UnloadStartCmd   : BOOL;
  RelocateStartCmd : BOOL;
  DraggingStartCmd : BOOL;
  KeepStartCmd     : BOOL;
  LoadStartCmd     : BOOL;

  (* Die worker start outputs *)
  DUnloadStartCmd : BOOL;
  DKeepStartCmd   : BOOL;
  DLoadStartCmd   : BOOL;

  CurrentPhase : INT := Machine_States.M_IDLE;
END_VAR

VAR RETAIN
  i : INT;

  (* Punch work presence *)
  hasUnload   : BOOL;
  hasRelocate : BOOL;
  hasDragging : BOOL;
  hasKeep     : BOOL;
  hasLoad     : BOOL;

  (* Die work presence *)
  hasDUnload : BOOL;
  hasDKeep   : BOOL;
  hasDLoad   : BOOL;

  (* Summary work presence *)
  hasAnyPunchWork : BOOL;
  hasAnyDieWork   : BOOL;

  (* execution priority *)
  PunchFirst : BOOL := TRUE;
  PrimaryIsPunch : BOOL := TRUE;
  PrimaryDone : BOOL := FALSE;
  SecondaryDone : BOOL := FALSE;

  (* internal start latch flags *)
  startedUnload   : BOOL;
  startedRelocate : BOOL;
  startedDragging : BOOL;
  startedKeep     : BOOL;
  startedLoad     : BOOL;

  startedDUnload : BOOL;
  startedDKeep   : BOOL;
  startedDLoad   : BOOL;

  (* edge detection *)
  lastTrigger : BOOL := FALSE;
  triggerRising : BOOL := FALSE;

  (* helper flags for punch filtering *)
  hasDirectUnload : BOOL;
  hasDragUnload   : BOOL;
  hasDragLoad     : BOOL;
  hasDirectLoad   : BOOL;
END_VAR

VAR
  tmpName : STRING(100);
END_VAR


(* Trigger edge detect *)
triggerRising := Trigger AND NOT lastTrigger;


(* Force stop has highest priority *)
IF Cycle_Force_Stop THEN

  CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_IDLE;
  Busy := FALSE;
  Done := FALSE;
  Error := FALSE;
  ErrorText := '';

  UnloadStartCmd := FALSE;
  RelocateStartCmd := FALSE;
  DraggingStartCmd := FALSE;
  KeepStartCmd := FALSE;
  LoadStartCmd := FALSE;

  DUnloadStartCmd := FALSE;
  DKeepStartCmd := FALSE;
  DLoadStartCmd := FALSE;

  startedUnload := FALSE;
  startedRelocate := FALSE;
  startedDragging := FALSE;
  startedKeep := FALSE;
  startedLoad := FALSE;

  startedDUnload := FALSE;
  startedDKeep := FALSE;
  startedDLoad := FALSE;

  hasUnload := FALSE;
  hasRelocate := FALSE;
  hasDragging := FALSE;
  hasKeep := FALSE;
  hasLoad := FALSE;

  hasDUnload := FALSE;
  hasDKeep := FALSE;
  hasDLoad := FALSE;

  hasAnyPunchWork := FALSE;
  hasAnyDieWork := FALSE;

  PunchFirst := TRUE;
  PrimaryIsPunch := TRUE;
  PrimaryDone := FALSE;
  SecondaryDone := FALSE;

ELSE

  (* MAIN STATE MACHINE *)
  IF CurrentPhase = Machine_States.M_IDLE THEN
    Busy := FALSE;
    Done := FALSE;
    Error := FALSE;
    ErrorText := '';

    UnloadStartCmd := FALSE;
    RelocateStartCmd := FALSE;
    DraggingStartCmd := FALSE;
    KeepStartCmd := FALSE;
    LoadStartCmd := FALSE;

    DUnloadStartCmd := FALSE;
    DKeepStartCmd := FALSE;
    DLoadStartCmd := FALSE;

    startedUnload := FALSE;
    startedRelocate := FALSE;
    startedDragging := FALSE;
    startedKeep := FALSE;
    startedLoad := FALSE;

    startedDUnload := FALSE;
    startedDKeep := FALSE;
    startedDLoad := FALSE;

    PrimaryDone := FALSE;
    SecondaryDone := FALSE;

    IF Trigger THEN

      (* Scan Punch lists *)
      hasUnload := FALSE;
      hasRelocate := FALSE;
      hasDragging := FALSE;
      hasKeep := FALSE;
      hasLoad := FALSE;

      hasDirectUnload := FALSE;
      hasDragUnload := FALSE;
      hasDragLoad := FALSE;
      hasDirectLoad := FALSE;

      (* Scan Die lists *)
      hasDUnload := FALSE;
      hasDKeep := FALSE;
      hasDLoad := FALSE;

      FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
        (* Punch unload *)
        IF Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasUnload := TRUE;
          IF Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,2] = '1' THEN
            hasDragUnload := TRUE;
          ELSE
            hasDirectUnload := TRUE;
          END_IF;
        END_IF;

        (* Punch relocate *)
        IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasRelocate := TRUE;
        END_IF;

        (* Punch keep *)
        IF Retain_KeepPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasKeep := TRUE;
        END_IF;

        (* Punch load *)
        IF Retain_LoadPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasLoad := TRUE;
          IF Retain_LoadPunchList[i,2] = '1' THEN
            hasDragLoad := TRUE;
          ELSE
            hasDirectLoad := TRUE;
          END_IF;
        END_IF;

        (* Die lists *)
        IF Retain_UnloadDieList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasDUnload := TRUE;
        END_IF;
        IF Retain_KeepDieList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasDKeep := TRUE;
        END_IF;
        IF Retain_LoadDieList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasDLoad := TRUE;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;

      hasAnyPunchWork := hasUnload OR hasRelocate OR hasDragging OR hasKeep OR hasLoad;
      hasAnyDieWork := hasDUnload OR hasDKeep OR hasDLoad;

      (* Punch priority unless rack type says die first *)
      IF Current_Rack_Type = 2 THEN
        PunchFirst := FALSE;
      ELSE
        PunchFirst := TRUE;
      END_IF;

      PrimaryIsPunch := PunchFirst;

      IF (NOT hasAnyPunchWork) AND (NOT hasAnyDieWork) THEN
        CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_DONE;
        Done := TRUE;
      ELSE
        Busy := TRUE;

        IF PrimaryIsPunch THEN
          IF hasAnyPunchWork THEN
            IF hasDirectUnload THEN
              CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_UNLOAD;
            ELSIF hasRelocate THEN
              CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_RELOCATE;
            ELSIF hasDragUnload THEN
              CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DRAGGING;
            ELSIF hasDragLoad THEN
              CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_KEEP;
            ELSIF hasKeep THEN
              CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_KEEP;
            ELSIF hasDirectLoad THEN
              CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_LOAD;
            END_IF;
          ELSE
            PrimaryDone := TRUE;
            IF hasAnyDieWork THEN
              IF hasDUnload THEN
                CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DUNLOAD;
              ELSIF hasDKeep THEN
                CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DKEEP;
              ELSIF hasDLoad THEN
                CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DLOAD;
              END_IF;
            ELSE
              CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_DONE;
            END_IF;
          END_IF;
        ELSE
          IF hasAnyDieWork THEN
            IF hasDUnload THEN
              CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DUNLOAD;
            ELSIF hasDKeep THEN
              CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DKEEP;
            ELSIF hasDLoad THEN
              CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DLOAD;
            END_IF;
          ELSE
            PrimaryDone := TRUE;
            IF hasAnyPunchWork THEN
              IF hasDirectUnload THEN
                CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_UNLOAD;
              ELSIF hasRelocate THEN
                CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_RELOCATE;
              ELSIF hasDragUnload THEN
                CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DRAGGING;
              ELSIF hasDragLoad THEN
                CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_KEEP;
              ELSIF hasKeep THEN
                CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_KEEP;
              ELSIF hasDirectLoad THEN
                CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_LOAD;
              END_IF;
            ELSE
              CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_DONE;
            END_IF;
          END_IF;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;
    END_IF;


  (* PUNCH WORKFLOW *)

  ELSIF CurrentPhase = Machine_States.M_RUN_UNLOAD THEN

    IF NOT startedUnload THEN
      UnloadStartCmd := TRUE;
      startedUnload := TRUE;
    END_IF;

    IF UnloadDone THEN
      UnloadStartCmd := FALSE;
      startedUnload := FALSE;

      hasDirectUnload := FALSE;
      hasRelocate := FALSE;
      hasDragUnload := FALSE;
      hasDragLoad := FALSE;
      hasKeep := FALSE;
      hasDirectLoad := FALSE;

      FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
        IF Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          IF Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,2] = '1' THEN
            hasDragUnload := TRUE;
          ELSE
            hasDirectUnload := TRUE;
          END_IF;
        END_IF;
        IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasRelocate := TRUE;
        END_IF;
        IF Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          IF Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,2] = '1' THEN
            hasDragUnload := TRUE;
          END_IF;
        END_IF;
        IF Retain_LoadPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          IF Retain_LoadPunchList[i,2] = '1' THEN
            hasDragLoad := TRUE;
          ELSE
            hasDirectLoad := TRUE;
          END_IF;
        END_IF;
        IF Retain_KeepPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasKeep := TRUE;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;

      IF hasRelocate THEN
        CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_RELOCATE;
      ELSIF hasDragUnload THEN
        CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DRAGGING;
      ELSIF hasDragLoad THEN
        CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_LOAD;
      ELSIF hasKeep THEN
        CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_KEEP;
      ELSIF hasDirectLoad THEN
        CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_LOAD;
      ELSE
        IF PrimaryIsPunch THEN
          PrimaryDone := TRUE;
        ELSE
          SecondaryDone := TRUE;
        END_IF;

        hasDUnload := FALSE;
        hasDKeep := FALSE;
        hasDLoad := FALSE;
        FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
          IF Retain_UnloadDieList[i,3] <> '' THEN
            hasDUnload := TRUE;
          END_IF;
          IF Retain_KeepDieList[i,3] <> '' THEN
            hasDKeep := TRUE;
          END_IF;
          IF Retain_LoadDieList[i,3] <> '' THEN
            hasDLoad := TRUE;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;

        hasAnyDieWork := hasDUnload OR hasDKeep OR hasDLoad;

        IF hasAnyDieWork AND ((PrimaryIsPunch AND NOT SecondaryDone) OR ((NOT PrimaryIsPunch) AND NOT PrimaryDone)) THEN
          IF hasDUnload THEN
            CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DUNLOAD;
          ELSIF hasDKeep THEN
            CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DKEEP;
          ELSIF hasDLoad THEN
            CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DLOAD;
          END_IF;
        ELSE
          CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_DONE;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;

    ELSIF triggerRising THEN
      UnloadStartCmd := TRUE;
      startedUnload := TRUE;
    END_IF;


  ELSIF CurrentPhase = Machine_States.M_RUN_RELOCATE THEN

    IF NOT startedRelocate THEN
      RelocateStartCmd := TRUE;
      startedRelocate := TRUE;
    END_IF;

    IF RelocateDone THEN
      RelocateStartCmd := FALSE;
      startedRelocate := FALSE;

      hasDragUnload := FALSE;
      hasDragLoad := FALSE;
      hasKeep := FALSE;
      hasDirectLoad := FALSE;

      FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
        IF Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          IF Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,2] = '1' THEN
            hasDragUnload := TRUE;
          END_IF;
        END_IF;
        IF Retain_LoadPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          IF Retain_LoadPunchList[i,2] = '1' THEN
            hasDragLoad := TRUE;
          ELSE
            hasDirectLoad := TRUE;
          END_IF;
        END_IF;
        IF Retain_KeepPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasKeep := TRUE;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;

      IF hasDragUnload THEN
        CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DRAGGING;
      ELSIF hasDragLoad THEN
        CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_LOAD;
      ELSIF hasKeep THEN
        CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_KEEP;
      ELSIF hasDirectLoad THEN
        CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_LOAD;
      ELSE
        IF PrimaryIsPunch THEN
          PrimaryDone := TRUE;
        ELSE
          SecondaryDone := TRUE;
        END_IF;
        CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_DONE;
      END_IF;

    ELSIF triggerRising THEN
      RelocateStartCmd := TRUE;
      startedRelocate := TRUE;
    END_IF;


  ELSIF CurrentPhase = Machine_States.M_RUN_DRAGGING THEN

    IF NOT startedDragging THEN
      DraggingStartCmd := TRUE;
      startedDragging := TRUE;
    END_IF;

    IF DraggingDone THEN
      DraggingStartCmd := FALSE;
      startedDragging := FALSE;

      hasDragLoad := FALSE;
      hasKeep := FALSE;
      hasDirectLoad := FALSE;

      FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
        IF Retain_LoadPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          IF Retain_LoadPunchList[i,2] = '1' THEN
            hasDragLoad := TRUE;
          ELSE
            hasDirectLoad := TRUE;
          END_IF;
        END_IF;

        IF Retain_KeepPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasKeep := TRUE;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;

      IF hasDragLoad THEN
        CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_LOAD;
      ELSIF hasKeep THEN
        CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_KEEP;
      ELSIF hasDirectLoad THEN
        CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_LOAD;
      ELSE
        IF PrimaryIsPunch THEN
          PrimaryDone := TRUE;
        ELSE
          SecondaryDone := TRUE;
        END_IF;

        hasDUnload := FALSE;
        hasDKeep := FALSE;
        hasDLoad := FALSE;
        FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
          IF Retain_UnloadDieList[i,3] <> '' THEN
            hasDUnload := TRUE;
          END_IF;
          IF Retain_KeepDieList[i,3] <> '' THEN
            hasDKeep := TRUE;
          END_IF;
          IF Retain_LoadDieList[i,3] <> '' THEN
            hasDLoad := TRUE;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;

        hasAnyDieWork := hasDUnload OR hasDKeep OR hasDLoad;

        IF hasAnyDieWork AND ((PrimaryIsPunch AND NOT SecondaryDone) OR ((NOT PrimaryIsPunch) AND NOT PrimaryDone)) THEN
          IF hasDUnload THEN
            CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DUNLOAD;
          ELSIF hasDKeep THEN
            CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DKEEP;
          ELSIF hasDLoad THEN
            CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DLOAD;
          END_IF;
        ELSE
          CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_DONE;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;

    ELSIF triggerRising THEN
      DraggingStartCmd := TRUE;
      startedDragging := TRUE;
    END_IF;


  ELSIF CurrentPhase = Machine_States.M_RUN_KEEP THEN

    IF NOT startedKeep THEN
      KeepStartCmd := TRUE;
      startedKeep := TRUE;
    END_IF;

    IF KeepDone THEN
      KeepStartCmd := FALSE;
      startedKeep := FALSE;

      hasDirectLoad := FALSE;
      FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
        IF Retain_LoadPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          IF Retain_LoadPunchList[i,2] = '' THEN
            hasDirectLoad := TRUE;
          END_IF;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;

      IF hasDirectLoad THEN
        CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_LOAD;
      ELSE
        IF PrimaryIsPunch THEN
          PrimaryDone := TRUE;
        ELSE
          SecondaryDone := TRUE;
        END_IF;

        hasDUnload := FALSE;
        hasDKeep := FALSE;
        hasDLoad := FALSE;
        FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
          IF Retain_UnloadDieList[i,3] <> '' THEN
            hasDUnload := TRUE;
          END_IF;
          IF Retain_KeepDieList[i,3] <> '' THEN
            hasDKeep := TRUE;
          END_IF;
          IF Retain_LoadDieList[i,3] <> '' THEN
            hasDLoad := TRUE;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;

        hasAnyDieWork := hasDUnload OR hasDKeep OR hasDLoad;

        IF hasAnyDieWork AND ((PrimaryIsPunch AND NOT SecondaryDone) OR ((NOT PrimaryIsPunch) AND NOT PrimaryDone)) THEN
          IF hasDUnload THEN
            CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DUNLOAD;
          ELSIF hasDKeep THEN
            CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DKEEP;
          ELSIF hasDLoad THEN
            CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DLOAD;
          END_IF;
        ELSE
          CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_DONE;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;

    ELSIF triggerRising THEN
      KeepStartCmd := TRUE;
      startedKeep := TRUE;
    END_IF;


  ELSIF CurrentPhase = Machine_States.M_RUN_LOAD THEN

    IF NOT startedLoad THEN
      LoadStartCmd := TRUE;
      startedLoad := TRUE;
    END_IF;

    IF LoadDone THEN
      LoadStartCmd := FALSE;
      startedLoad := FALSE;

      IF PrimaryIsPunch THEN
        PrimaryDone := TRUE;
      ELSE
        SecondaryDone := TRUE;
      END_IF;

      hasDUnload := FALSE;
      hasDKeep := FALSE;
      hasDLoad := FALSE;
      FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
        IF Retain_UnloadDieList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasDUnload := TRUE;
        END_IF;
        IF Retain_KeepDieList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasDKeep := TRUE;
        END_IF;
        IF Retain_LoadDieList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasDLoad := TRUE;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;

      hasAnyDieWork := hasDUnload OR hasDKeep OR hasDLoad;

      IF hasAnyDieWork AND ((PrimaryIsPunch AND NOT SecondaryDone) OR ((NOT PrimaryIsPunch) AND NOT PrimaryDone)) THEN
        IF hasDUnload THEN
          CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DUNLOAD;
        ELSIF hasDKeep THEN
          CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DKEEP;
        ELSIF hasDLoad THEN
          CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DLOAD;
        END_IF;
      ELSE
        CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_DONE;
      END_IF;

    ELSIF triggerRising THEN
      LoadStartCmd := TRUE;
      startedLoad := TRUE;
    END_IF;


  (* DIE WORKFLOW *)

  ELSIF CurrentPhase = Machine_States.M_RUN_DUNLOAD THEN

    IF NOT startedDUnload THEN
      DUnloadStartCmd := TRUE;
      startedDUnload := TRUE;
    END_IF;

    IF DUnloadDone THEN
      DUnloadStartCmd := FALSE;
      startedDUnload := FALSE;

      hasDKeep := FALSE;
      hasDLoad := FALSE;
      FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
        IF Retain_KeepDieList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasDKeep := TRUE;
        END_IF;
        IF Retain_LoadDieList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasDLoad := TRUE;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;

      IF hasDKeep THEN
        CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DKEEP;
      ELSIF hasDLoad THEN
        CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DLOAD;
      ELSE
        IF NOT PrimaryIsPunch THEN
          PrimaryDone := TRUE;
        ELSE
          SecondaryDone := TRUE;
        END_IF;

        hasUnload := FALSE;
        hasRelocate := FALSE;
        hasDragging := FALSE;
        hasKeep := FALSE;
        hasLoad := FALSE;
        FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
          IF Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
            hasUnload := TRUE;
          END_IF;
          IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
            hasRelocate := TRUE;
          END_IF;
          IF Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
            IF Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,2] = '1' THEN
              hasDragging := TRUE;
            END_IF;
          END_IF;
          IF Retain_KeepPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
            hasKeep := TRUE;
          END_IF;
          IF Retain_LoadPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
            hasLoad := TRUE;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;

        hasAnyPunchWork := hasUnload OR hasRelocate OR hasDragging OR hasKeep OR hasLoad;

        IF hasAnyPunchWork AND (((NOT PrimaryIsPunch) AND NOT SecondaryDone) OR (PrimaryIsPunch AND NOT PrimaryDone)) THEN
          IF hasUnload THEN
            CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_UNLOAD;
          ELSIF hasRelocate THEN
            CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_RELOCATE;
          ELSIF hasDragging THEN
            CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DRAGGING;
          ELSIF hasKeep THEN
            CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_KEEP;
          ELSIF hasLoad THEN
            CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_LOAD;
          END_IF;
        ELSE
          CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_DONE;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;

    ELSIF triggerRising THEN
      DUnloadStartCmd := TRUE;
      startedDUnload := TRUE;
    END_IF;


  ELSIF CurrentPhase = Machine_States.M_RUN_DKEEP THEN

    IF NOT startedDKeep THEN
      DKeepStartCmd := TRUE;
      startedDKeep := TRUE;
    END_IF;

    IF DKeepDone THEN
      DKeepStartCmd := FALSE;
      startedDKeep := FALSE;

      hasDLoad := FALSE;
      FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
        IF Retain_LoadDieList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasDLoad := TRUE;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;

      IF hasDLoad THEN
        CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DLOAD;
      ELSE
        IF NOT PrimaryIsPunch THEN
          PrimaryDone := TRUE;
        ELSE
          SecondaryDone := TRUE;
        END_IF;

        hasUnload := FALSE;
        hasRelocate := FALSE;
        hasDragging := FALSE;
        hasKeep := FALSE;
        hasLoad := FALSE;
        FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
          IF Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
            hasUnload := TRUE;
          END_IF;
          IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
            hasRelocate := TRUE;
          END_IF;
          IF Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
            IF Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,2] = '1' THEN
              hasDragging := TRUE;
            END_IF;
          END_IF;
          IF Retain_KeepPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
            hasKeep := TRUE;
          END_IF;
          IF Retain_LoadPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
            hasLoad := TRUE;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;

        hasAnyPunchWork := hasUnload OR hasRelocate OR hasDragging OR hasKeep OR hasLoad;

        IF hasAnyPunchWork AND (((NOT PrimaryIsPunch) AND NOT SecondaryDone) OR (PrimaryIsPunch AND NOT PrimaryDone)) THEN
          IF hasUnload THEN
            CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_UNLOAD;
          ELSIF hasRelocate THEN
            CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_RELOCATE;
          ELSIF hasDragging THEN
            CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DRAGGING;
          ELSIF hasKeep THEN
            CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_KEEP;
          ELSIF hasLoad THEN
            CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_LOAD;
          END_IF;
        ELSE
          CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_DONE;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;

    ELSIF triggerRising THEN
      DKeepStartCmd := TRUE;
      startedDKeep := TRUE;
    END_IF;


  ELSIF CurrentPhase = Machine_States.M_RUN_DLOAD THEN

    IF NOT startedDLoad THEN
      DLoadStartCmd := TRUE;
      startedDLoad := TRUE;
    END_IF;

    IF DLoadDone THEN
      DLoadStartCmd := FALSE;
      startedDLoad := FALSE;

      IF NOT PrimaryIsPunch THEN
        PrimaryDone := TRUE;
      ELSE
        SecondaryDone := TRUE;
      END_IF;

      hasUnload := FALSE;
      hasRelocate := FALSE;
      hasDragging := FALSE;
      hasKeep := FALSE;
      hasLoad := FALSE;
      FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
        IF Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasUnload := TRUE;
        END_IF;
        IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasRelocate := TRUE;
        END_IF;
        IF Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          IF Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,2] = '1' THEN
            hasDragging := TRUE;
          END_IF;
        END_IF;
        IF Retain_KeepPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasKeep := TRUE;
        END_IF;
        IF Retain_LoadPunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
          hasLoad := TRUE;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;

      hasAnyPunchWork := hasUnload OR hasRelocate OR hasDragging OR hasKeep OR hasLoad;

      IF hasAnyPunchWork AND (((NOT PrimaryIsPunch) AND NOT SecondaryDone) OR (PrimaryIsPunch AND NOT PrimaryDone)) THEN
        IF hasUnload THEN
          CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_UNLOAD;
        ELSIF hasRelocate THEN
          CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_RELOCATE;
        ELSIF hasDragging THEN
          CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_DRAGGING;
        ELSIF hasKeep THEN
          CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_KEEP;
        ELSIF hasLoad THEN
          CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_RUN_LOAD;
        END_IF;
      ELSE
        CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_DONE;
      END_IF;

    ELSIF triggerRising THEN
      DLoadStartCmd := TRUE;
      startedDLoad := TRUE;
    END_IF;


  (* DONE *)
  ELSIF CurrentPhase = Machine_States.M_DONE THEN
    Busy := FALSE;
    Done := TRUE;
    CurrentPhase := Machine_States.M_IDLE;
  END_IF;

END_IF;

(* edge memory update *)
lastTrigger := Trigger;
```

### Not
Bu sürümde senin yeni punch akışını state machine’e taşıdım.  
Ama dikkat: mevcut kodda `M_RUN_RELOCATE` ve `M_RUN_DRAGGING` phase’lerinin worker done geçişleri senin mevcut worker mimarine göre hala uyarlanmış olmalı. Eğer onların FB isimleri/sinyalleri farklıysa, onları da bir sonraki adımda birlikte netleştirelim.


yukarıda punch work flow için yeni eklediğimiz I/O lar yok ? 


## Copilot

Doğru fark etmişsin. **Güncellediğim State_Machine kodunda bu I/O’lar zaten var**; ama senin dikkat çektiğin şey muhtemelen şu:

> **Yeni punch akışındaki phase isimleri ile kullanılan I/O’ların eşleşmesi tam net değil**  
> ya da  
> **bazı yeni iş adımları için ek I/O bekliyorsun ama mevcut portlar sadece `Unload/Relocate/Dragging/Keep/Load` şeklinde kalmış.**

## Şu an mevcut punch I/O’ların
### Start outputs
- `UnloadStartCmd`
- `RelocateStartCmd`
- `DraggingStartCmd`
- `KeepStartCmd`
- `LoadStartCmd`

### Done inputs
- `UnloadDone`
- `RelocateDone`
- `DraggingDone`
- `KeepDone`
- `LoadDone`

Bunlar yeni punch workflow’u için yeterli görünüyor çünkü senin akışın da zaten 5 fiziksel worker’a ayrılmış durumda.

---

# Ama kritik nokta şu
Senin anlattığın iş akışında phase’ler aslında **6 adım**:

1. `P_Unload_Direct`
2. `P_Relocate`
3. `P_Unload_Dragg`
4. `P_Load_Dragg`
5. `P_Keeping`
6. `P_Load_Direct`

Buna karşılık mevcut I/O setin **5 worker** veriyor.

Yani burada doğrudan eşleşme şöyle kurulmalı:

- `P_Unload_Direct` → `UnloadStartCmd / UnloadDone`
- `P_Relocate` → `RelocateStartCmd / RelocateDone`
- `P_Unload_Dragg` → `DraggingStartCmd / DraggingDone`
- `P_Load_Dragg` → `LoadStartCmd / LoadDone`
- `P_Keeping` → `KeepStartCmd / KeepDone`
- `P_Load_Direct` → yine `LoadStartCmd / LoadDone`

## Yani iki farklı load/unload davranışı aynı I/O ile yürütülüyor
Bu aslında normal olabilir:
- direct load ile drag load aynı `Load` worker’da
- direct unload ile drag unload aynı `Unload` worker’da

Ama state machine’in, bu worker’a hangi listelerin verildiğini bilmesi gerekiyor.

Çünkü:
- mevcut I/O’lar zaten workflow’u temsil ediyor
- fark, worker’ın hangi listeleri işlediği

## Asıl gereken
State machine’de:
- `UnloadStartCmd` hangi alt listeyi işlediğini
- `LoadStartCmd` hangi alt listeyi işlediğini
- `DraggingStartCmd` hangi alt iş kümesini işlediğini

netleştirmek.
