          END_IF;

        PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U14_RACKCHANGE_CLEAR_CURRENT_INFO:
          Current_Rack_ID := 0;
          Current_Rack_Type := 0;
          Current_Drawer_ID := 0;

          WH_NeedRackChange := FALSE;
          WH_NeedRackBring := TRUE;
          WH_SameRack := FALSE;

          WH_R_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          WH_X_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          WH_R_Done := FALSE;
          WH_X_Done := FALSE;
          WH_WaitRackInPos := FALSE;

          WH_R_LoadRequested := FALSE;
          WH_R_LoadDone := FALSE;
          R_Not_Safety_Zone := FALSE;
          Rack_Presence_Error := FALSE;

          PUnload_WH_SubStates := PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U14_UNLOCK_CHECK;

        PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U14_UNLOCK_CHECK:
          IF NOT (Fmsc_PLC_IO.Carriage_Unlocked_Left AND Fmsc_PLC_IO.Carriage_Unlocked_Right) THEN
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Carriage_UnLocking_Valve := TRUE;
          ELSE
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Carriage_UnLocking_Valve := FALSE;

            IF R_Not_Safety_Zone THEN
              PUnload_WH_SubStates := PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U14_WAIT_R_SAFEZONE;
            ELSE
              PUnload_WH_SubStates := PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U14_R_TO_PICKUP_REQ;
            END_IF;
          END_IF;

        PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U14_WAIT_R_SAFEZONE:
          IF arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].ActualPos < TO_LREAL(Retain_RParameters[7]) THEN
            R_Not_Safety_Zone := FALSE;
            PUnload_WH_SubStates := PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U14_R_TO_PICKUP_REQ;
          END_IF;

        PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U14_R_TO_PICKUP_REQ:
          IF arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].ActualPos < TO_LREAL(Retain_RParameters[7]) THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].TargetPos := -10.0;
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
            WH_R_MoveRequested := TRUE;
            WH_R_Done := FALSE;

            PUnload_WH_SubStates := PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U14_R_TO_PICKUP_WAIT;
          ELSE
            R_Not_Safety_Zone := TRUE;
            WH_R_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            WH_R_Done := FALSE;
            PUnload_WH_SubStates := PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U14_WAIT_R_SAFEZONE;
          END_IF;

        PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U14_R_TO_PICKUP_WAIT:
          IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].ActualPos - (-10.0)) > WH_Eps) THEN
            PUnload_WH_SubStates := PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U14_R_TO_PICKUP_REQ;
          END_IF;

          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].ActualPos - (-10.0)) <= WH_Eps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            WH_R_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            WH_R_Done := TRUE;

            PUnload_WH_SubStates := PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U14_X_TO_DRAWER_REQ;
          END_IF;

        PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U14_X_TO_DRAWER_REQ:
          IF WH_TargetDrawerIdx >= 1 THEN

            IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].ActualPos - TO_LREAL(pDrawerParam2[WH_TargetDrawerIdx])) <= WH_Eps THEN
              WH_X_Done := TRUE;
              WH_X_MoveRequested := FALSE;
              PUnload_WH_SubStates := PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U14_R_LIFT_REQ;
            ELSE
              arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(pDrawerParam2[WH_TargetDrawerIdx]);
              arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
              WH_X_MoveRequested := TRUE;
              WH_X_Done := FALSE;

              PUnload_WH_SubStates := PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U14_X_TO_DRAWER_WAIT;
            END_IF;

          ELSE
            UnloadError := TRUE;
          END_IF;

        PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U14_X_TO_DRAWER_WAIT:
          IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
             (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
            PUnload_WH_SubStates := PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U14_X_TO_DRAWER_REQ;
          END_IF;

          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            WH_X_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            WH_X_Done := TRUE;

            PUnload_WH_SubStates := PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U14_R_LIFT_REQ;
          END_IF;

        PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U14_R_LIFT_REQ:
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(Retain_RParameters[3]);
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
          WH_R_LoadRequested := TRUE;
          WH_R_LoadDone := FALSE;
          Rack_Presence_Error := FALSE;

          PUnload_WH_SubStates := PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U14_R_LIFT_WAIT;

        PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U14_R_LIFT_WAIT:
          IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
             (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
            PUnload_WH_SubStates := PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U14_R_LIFT_REQ;
          END_IF;

          IF arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].ActualPos >= TO_LREAL(Retain_RParameters[7]) THEN

            IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Rack_Presence THEN
              Current_Rack_ID := WH_TargetRackID;
              Current_Rack_Type := 1;
              Current_Drawer_ID := WH_TargetDrawerIdx;
            ELSE
              arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
              WH_R_LoadRequested := FALSE;
              WH_R_LoadDone := FALSE;
              Rack_Presence_Error := TRUE;

              General_Stop := TRUE;
              General_Start := FALSE;

              PUnload_WH_SubStates := PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U14_ERROR_RACK_PRESENCE;
            END_IF;

          END_IF;

          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            WH_R_LoadRequested := FALSE;
            WH_R_LoadDone := TRUE;
            Rack_Presence_Error := FALSE;

            PUnload_WH_SubStates := PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U14_WAIT_RACK_IN_POS;
          END_IF;

        PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U14_WAIT_RACK_IN_POS:
          WH_WaitRackInPos := (WH_R_LoadDone AND WH_X_Done);

          IF WH_WaitRackInPos THEN
            PUnload_WH_SubStates := PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U14_DONE;
          END_IF;

        PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U14_ERROR_RACK_PRESENCE:
          WH_WaitRackInPos := FALSE;

          IF arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].ActualPos < TO_LREAL(Retain_RParameters[7]) THEN
            Rack_Presence_Error := FALSE;
            PUnload_WH_SubStates := PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U14_R_LIFT_REQ;
          END_IF;

        PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U14_DONE:
          Local_WareHouse_State := WareHouse_States.U_Punches_rack_taken;
          PUnload_WH_SubStates := PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U15_INIT;

        PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U15_INIT:
          WH_X_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          WH_X_Done := FALSE;
          WH_R_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          WH_R_Done := FALSE;

          PUnload_WH_SubStates := PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U15_X_TO_UNLPOS_REQ;

        PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U15_X_TO_UNLPOS_REQ:
          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].ActualPos - TO_LREAL(Retain_XParameters[2])) <= WH_Eps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            WH_X_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            WH_X_Done := TRUE;
            PUnload_WH_SubStates := PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U15_R_TO_UNLPOS_REQ;
          ELSE
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(Retain_XParameters[2]);
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
            WH_X_MoveRequested := TRUE;
            WH_X_Done := FALSE;

            PUnload_WH_SubStates := PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U15_X_TO_UNLPOS_WAIT;
          END_IF;

        PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U15_X_TO_UNLPOS_WAIT:
          IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
             (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
            PUnload_WH_SubStates := PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U15_X_TO_UNLPOS_REQ;
          END_IF;

          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            WH_X_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            WH_X_Done := TRUE;

            PUnload_WH_SubStates := PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U15_R_TO_UNLPOS_REQ;
          END_IF;

        PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U15_R_TO_UNLPOS_REQ:
          IF (WH_TargetDrawerIdx >= 1) AND (WH_TargetDrawerIdx <= 16) THEN

            IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].ActualPos - TO_LREAL(pDrawerParam1[WH_TargetDrawerIdx])) <= WH_Eps THEN
              arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
              WH_R_MoveRequested := FALSE;
              WH_R_Done := TRUE;
              PUnload_WH_SubStates := PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U15_DONE;
            ELSE
              arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(pDrawerParam1[WH_TargetDrawerIdx]);
              arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
              WH_R_MoveRequested := TRUE;
              WH_R_Done := FALSE;

              PUnload_WH_SubStates := PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U15_R_TO_UNLPOS_WAIT;
            END_IF;

          ELSE
            UnloadError := TRUE;
          END_IF;

        PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U15_R_TO_UNLPOS_WAIT:
          IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
             (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
            PUnload_WH_SubStates := PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U15_R_TO_UNLPOS_REQ;
          END_IF;

          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            WH_R_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            WH_R_Done := TRUE;

            PUnload_WH_SubStates := PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U15_DONE;
          END_IF;

        PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U15_DONE:
          Local_WareHouse_State := WareHouse_States.U_PDrawer_Unload_pos_reached;
          PUnload_WH_SubStates := PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U16_INIT;

        PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U16_INIT:
          WH_X_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          WH_X_Done := FALSE;
          WH_R_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          WH_R_Done := FALSE;

          PUnload_WH_SubStates := PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U16_LOCK_CMD;

        PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U16_LOCK_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Carriage_UnLocking_Valve := FALSE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Carriage_Locking_Valve := TRUE;

          PUnload_WH_SubStates := PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U16_WAIT_LOCKED;

        PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U16_WAIT_LOCKED:
          IF (Fmsc_PLC_IO.Carriage_Locked_Left AND Fmsc_PLC_IO.Carriage_Locked_Right) THEN
            PUnload_WH_SubStates := PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U16_DONE;
          END_IF;

        PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U16_DONE:
          Local_WareHouse_State := WareHouse_States.U_Punch_Unload_drawer_allowed;
          PUnload_WH_SubStates := PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U17_INIT;

        PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U17_INIT:
          WH_X_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          WH_X_Done := FALSE;
          WH_R_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          WH_R_Done := FALSE;

          PUnload_WH_SubStates := PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U17_SET_CURRENT_RACK;

        PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U17_SET_CURRENT_RACK:
          PUnload_WH_SubStates := PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U17_VERIFY_CURRENT_RACK;

        PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U17_VERIFY_CURRENT_RACK:
          IF (TO_INT(Current_Rack_ID) = WH_TargetRackID) AND
             (Current_Rack_Type = 1) AND
             (Current_Drawer_ID = WH_TargetDrawerIdx) THEN
            PUnload_WH_SubStates := PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U17_DONE;
          END_IF;

        PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U17_DONE:
          PUnload_WH_SubStates := PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U17_DONE;

      ELSE
        PUnload_WH_SubStates := PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U14_INIT;
      END_CASE;

      IF WH_R_LoadDone AND WH_X_Done THEN
        WH_WaitRackInPos := TRUE;
      ELSE
        WH_WaitRackInPos := FALSE;
      END_IF;

    END_IF;
  END_IF;
END_IF


(* ============================================================ *)
(* Shuttle main state machine (SH engine)                       *)
(* ============================================================ *)
IF UnloadStartCmd THEN

  CASE Local_Shuttle_State OF

    Shuttle_States.U_Shuttle_Starts_PPick_Up:

      CASE PUnload_SH_SubStates OF

        PUnload_SH_SubState.SH_IDLE:
          ;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U26_INIT:
          SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          SH_DX_Done := FALSE;
          SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
          SH_Z_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          SH_Z_Done := FALSE;

          PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U26_PINS_INSIDE_CMD;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U26_PINS_INSIDE_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Outside_Valve := FALSE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Outside_Valve := FALSE;

          IF NOT Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Inside THEN
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Inside_Valve := TRUE;
          ELSE
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Inside_Valve := FALSE;
          END_IF;

          IF NOT Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Inside THEN
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Inside_Valve := TRUE;
          ELSE
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Inside_Valve := FALSE;
          END_IF;

          PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U26_WAIT_PINS_INSIDE;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U26_WAIT_PINS_INSIDE:
          IF (Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Inside AND Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Inside) THEN
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Inside_Valve := FALSE;
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Inside_Valve := FALSE;

            IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].ActualPos - TO_LREAL(Retain_DXParameters[4])) <= WH_Eps THEN
              PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U26_Z_DR_DX_TO_PUNCH_PICKPOS_REQ;
            ELSE
              PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U26_DX_TO_SHUTTLE_INSIDE_REQ;
            END_IF;
          END_IF;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U26_DX_TO_SHUTTLE_INSIDE_REQ:
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(Retain_DXParameters[4]);
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
          SH_DX_MoveRequested := TRUE;
          SH_DX_Done := FALSE;

          PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U26_DX_TO_SHUTTLE_INSIDE_WAIT;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U26_DX_TO_SHUTTLE_INSIDE_WAIT:
          IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
             (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
            PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U26_DX_TO_SHUTTLE_INSIDE_REQ;
          END_IF;

          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DX_Done := TRUE;

            PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U26_Z_DR_DX_TO_PUNCH_PICKPOS_REQ;
          END_IF;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U26_Z_DR_DX_TO_PUNCH_PICKPOS_REQ:
			IF RotArm_ReadyForUnload THEN
			  IF (Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,2] <> '') AND
				 (Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,6] <> '') THEN
	
				tmpInt := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,2]);
	
				arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].TargetPos  := STRING_TO_LREAL(Retain_UnloadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,6]) + REAL_TO_LREAL(Retain_ZParameters[19]);
				arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(pDrawerParam6[tmpInt]);
				arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(pDrawerParam8[tmpInt]);
	
				arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
				arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
				arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
	
				SH_Z_MoveRequested := TRUE;
				SH_Z_Done := FALSE;
				SH_DR_MoveRequested := TRUE;
				SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
				SH_DX_MoveRequested := TRUE;
				SH_DX_Done := FALSE;
	
				PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U26_Z_DR_DX_TO_PUNCH_PICKPOS_WAIT;
			  ELSE
				UnloadError := TRUE;
			  END_IF;
			  
		  END_IF;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U26_Z_DR_DX_TO_PUNCH_PICKPOS_WAIT:
          IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
             (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
            PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U26_Z_DR_DX_TO_PUNCH_PICKPOS_REQ;
          END_IF;

          IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
             (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
            PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U26_Z_DR_DX_TO_PUNCH_PICKPOS_REQ;
          END_IF;

          IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
             (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
            PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U26_Z_DR_DX_TO_PUNCH_PICKPOS_REQ;
          END_IF;

          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_Z_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_Z_Done := TRUE;
          END_IF;

          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DR_Done := TRUE;
          END_IF;

          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DX_Done := TRUE;
          END_IF;

          IF SH_Z_Done AND SH_DR_Done AND SH_DX_Done THEN
            PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U26_PIN1_OUTSIDE_CMD;
          END_IF;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U26_PIN1_OUTSIDE_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Inside_Valve := FALSE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Outside_Valve := TRUE;

          PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U26_WAIT_PIN1_OUTSIDE;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U26_WAIT_PIN1_OUTSIDE:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Outside THEN
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Outside_Valve := FALSE;
            PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U26_PIN2_OUTSIDE_CMD;
          END_IF;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U26_PIN2_OUTSIDE_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Inside_Valve := FALSE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Outside_Valve := TRUE;

          PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U26_WAIT_PIN2_OUTSIDE;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U26_WAIT_PIN2_OUTSIDE:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Outside THEN
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Outside_Valve := FALSE;
            PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U26_DONE;
          END_IF;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U26_DONE:
          Local_Shuttle_State := Shuttle_States.U_Punch_Correctly_taken;
          PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U27_INIT;

      ELSE
        PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U26_INIT;
      END_CASE;

    Shuttle_States.U_Punch_Correctly_taken:

      CASE PUnload_SH_SubStates OF

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U27_INIT:
          SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
          SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          SH_DX_Done := FALSE;

          PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U27_PRESS_CLAMP_OFF_CMD;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U27_PRESS_CLAMP_OFF_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Press_Upper_ClampOn := FALSE;
		  ClampOff_Timer.IN := TRUE;

		  IF ClampOff_Timer.Q THEN
         	 PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U27_PRESS_CLAMP_OFF_DONE;
		  END_IF;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U27_PRESS_CLAMP_OFF_DONE:
		  ClampOff_Timer.IN := FALSE;
          PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U27_DR_EXTRACT_REQ;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U27_DR_EXTRACT_REQ:
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisAutoSetVelocity := Retain_DRParameters[2];
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos := arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - TO_LREAL(Retain_DRParameters[5]);
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
          SH_DR_MoveRequested := TRUE;
          SH_DR_Done := FALSE;

          PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U27_DR_EXTRACT_WAIT;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U27_DR_EXTRACT_WAIT:
          IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
             (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
            PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U27_DR_EXTRACT_REQ;
          END_IF;

          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisAutoSetVelocity := Retain_DRParameters[1];
            SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DR_Done := TRUE;

            PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U27_PRESS_CLAMP_ON_CMD;
          END_IF;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U27_PRESS_CLAMP_ON_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Press_Upper_ClampOn := TRUE;
		  ClampOn_Timer.IN := TRUE;
	
		  IF ClampOn_Timer.Q THEN
        	  PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U27_PRESS_CLAMP_ON_DONE;
		  END_IF;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U27_PRESS_CLAMP_ON_DONE:
		  ClampOn_Timer.IN := FALSE;
          PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U27_DX_TO_SHUTTLE_INSIDE_REQ;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U27_DX_TO_SHUTTLE_INSIDE_REQ:
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(Retain_DXParameters[4]);
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
          SH_DX_MoveRequested := TRUE;
          SH_DX_Done := FALSE;

          PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U27_DX_TO_SHUTTLE_INSIDE_WAIT;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U27_DX_TO_SHUTTLE_INSIDE_WAIT:
          IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
             (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
            PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U27_DX_TO_SHUTTLE_INSIDE_REQ;
          END_IF;

          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DX_Done := TRUE;

            PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U27_DONE;
          END_IF;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U27_DONE:
          RotRequired := FALSE;
          IF Retain_UnloadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,8] <> '' THEN
            RotRequired := (STRING_TO_INT(Retain_UnloadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,8]) = 1);
          END_IF;

          IF RotRequired THEN
            IF RotArm_ReadyForUnload THEN
              Local_Shuttle_State := Shuttle_States.U_Punch_correctly_pos_in_rot;
              PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U28_INIT;
            ELSE
              PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U27_DONE;
            END_IF;
          ELSE
            Local_Shuttle_State := Shuttle_States.U_Punch_correctly_extracted;
            PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U31_INIT;
          END_IF;

      ELSE
        PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U27_INIT;
      END_CASE;

    Shuttle_States.U_Punch_correctly_pos_in_rot:

      CASE PUnload_SH_SubStates OF

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U28_INIT:
          SH_Z_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          SH_Z_Done := FALSE;
          SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
          SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          SH_DX_Done := FALSE;

          PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U28_Z_DR_TO_ROT_PICKPOS_REQ;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U28_Z_DR_TO_ROT_PICKPOS_REQ:
          IF Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,2] <> '' THEN
            tmpInt := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,2]);

            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(Retain_ZParameters[11]);
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(pDrawerParam3[tmpInt]);

            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;

            SH_Z_MoveRequested := TRUE;
            SH_Z_Done := FALSE;
            SH_DR_MoveRequested := TRUE;
            SH_DR_Done := FALSE;

            PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U28_Z_DR_TO_ROT_PICKPOS_WAIT;
          ELSE
            UnloadError := TRUE;
          END_IF;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U28_Z_DR_TO_ROT_PICKPOS_WAIT:
          IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
             (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
            PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U28_Z_DR_TO_ROT_PICKPOS_REQ;
          END_IF;

          IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
             (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
            PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U28_Z_DR_TO_ROT_PICKPOS_REQ;
          END_IF;

          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_Z_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_Z_Done := TRUE;
          END_IF;

          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DR_Done := TRUE;
          END_IF;

          IF SH_Z_Done AND SH_DR_Done THEN
            PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U28_DR_BACKOFF_REQ;
          END_IF;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U28_DR_BACKOFF_REQ:
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos := arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - TO_LREAL(Retain_DRParameters[2]);
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
          SH_DR_MoveRequested := TRUE;
          SH_DR_Done := FALSE;

          PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U28_DR_BACKOFF_WAIT;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U28_DR_BACKOFF_WAIT:
          IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
             (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
            PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U28_DR_BACKOFF_REQ;
          END_IF;

          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DR_Done := TRUE;

            PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U28_DX_TO_ROT_ALIGN_REQ;
          END_IF;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U28_DX_TO_ROT_ALIGN_REQ:
          IF Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,2] <> '' THEN
            tmpInt := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,2]);

            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(pDrawerParam7[tmpInt]);
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
            SH_DX_MoveRequested := TRUE;
            SH_DX_Done := FALSE;

            PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U28_DX_TO_ROT_ALIGN_WAIT;
          ELSE
            UnloadError := TRUE;
          END_IF;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U28_DX_TO_ROT_ALIGN_WAIT:
          IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
             (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
            PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U28_DX_TO_ROT_ALIGN_REQ;
          END_IF;

          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DX_Done := TRUE;

            PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U28_DR_INSERT_TO_ROT_REQ;
          END_IF;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U28_DR_INSERT_TO_ROT_REQ:
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisAutoSetVelocity := Retain_DRParameters[2];
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos := arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos + TO_LREAL(Retain_DRParameters[2]);
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
          SH_DR_MoveRequested := TRUE;
          SH_DR_Done := FALSE;

          PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U28_DR_INSERT_TO_ROT_WAIT;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U28_DR_INSERT_TO_ROT_WAIT:
          IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
             (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
            PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U28_DR_INSERT_TO_ROT_REQ;
          END_IF;

          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisAutoSetVelocity := Retain_DRParameters[1];
            SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DR_Done := TRUE;

            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Rotation_Arm_Punch_Lock_Valve := TRUE;
		    Fmsc_PLC_IO.Rotation_Arm_Punch_Unlock_Valve := FALSE;
            PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U28_WAIT_ROT_PUNCH_LOCKED;
          END_IF;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U28_WAIT_ROT_PUNCH_LOCKED:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Punch_Locked_on_Rotation_Arm OR Punch_Lock_Sim THEN
            PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U28_PIN2_INSIDE_CMD;
          END_IF;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U28_PIN2_INSIDE_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Inside_Valve := TRUE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Outside_Valve := FALSE;

          PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U28_WAIT_PIN2_INSIDE;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U28_WAIT_PIN2_INSIDE:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Inside THEN
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Inside_Valve := FALSE;
            PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U28_PIN1_INSIDE_CMD;
          END_IF;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U28_PIN1_INSIDE_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Inside_Valve := TRUE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Outside_Valve := FALSE;

          PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U28_WAIT_PIN1_INSIDE;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U28_WAIT_PIN1_INSIDE:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Inside THEN
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Inside_Valve := FALSE;
            PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U28_DX_DR_Z_TO_ROT_SAFE_REQ;
          END_IF;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U28_DX_DR_Z_TO_ROT_SAFE_REQ:
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(Retain_DXParameters[4]);
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(Retain_DRParameters[8]);
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].TargetPos  := TO_LREAL(Retain_ZParameters[8]);

          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;

          SH_DX_MoveRequested := TRUE;
          SH_DX_Done := FALSE;
          SH_DR_MoveRequested := TRUE;
          SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
          SH_Z_MoveRequested := TRUE;
          SH_Z_Done := FALSE;

          PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U28_DX_DR_Z_TO_ROT_SAFE_WAIT;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U28_DX_DR_Z_TO_ROT_SAFE_WAIT:
          IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
             (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
            PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U28_DX_DR_Z_TO_ROT_SAFE_REQ;
          END_IF;

          IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
             (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
            PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U28_DX_DR_Z_TO_ROT_SAFE_REQ;
          END_IF;

          IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
             (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
            PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U28_DX_DR_Z_TO_ROT_SAFE_REQ;
          END_IF;

          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DX_Done := TRUE;
          END_IF;

          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DR_Done := TRUE;
          END_IF;

          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_Z_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_Z_Done := TRUE;
          END_IF;

          IF SH_DX_Done AND SH_DR_Done AND SH_Z_Done THEN
            PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U28_DONE;
          END_IF;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U28_DONE:
          Local_Shuttle_State := Shuttle_States.U_Punch_correctly_rotated;
          PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U29_INIT;

      ELSE
        PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U28_INIT;
      END_CASE;

    Shuttle_States.U_Punch_correctly_rotated:

      CASE PUnload_SH_SubStates OF

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U29_INIT:
          PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U29_WAIT_ROTARM_READY_TO_ROTATE;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U29_WAIT_ROTARM_READY_TO_ROTATE:
          IF Local_RotArm_State = RotationArm_States.U_RotArm_Rotation_Interrupt_Active THEN
            PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U29_WAIT_ROTATION_DONE;
          END_IF;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U29_WAIT_ROTATION_DONE:
          IF RotArm_RotationDone THEN
            PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U29_DONE;
          END_IF;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U29_DONE:
          Local_Shuttle_State := Shuttle_States.U_Punch_correctly_taken_in_rotation;
          PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U30_INIT;

      ELSE
        PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U29_INIT;
      END_CASE;

    Shuttle_States.U_Punch_correctly_taken_in_rotation:

      CASE PUnload_SH_SubStates OF

	    PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U30_INIT:
		    SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
		    SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
		    SH_Z_MoveRequested := FALSE;
		    SH_Z_Done := FALSE;
		    SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
		    SH_DX_Done := FALSE;
	
		    PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U30_DR_Z_TO_ROT_PICKUP_REQ;
	
	    PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U30_DR_Z_TO_ROT_PICKUP_REQ:
		    IF Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,2] <> '' THEN
			    tmpInt := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,2]);
	
			    arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(Retain_ZParameters[11]);
			    arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(pDrawerParam3[tmpInt]);
	
			    arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
			    arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
	
			    SH_Z_MoveRequested := TRUE;
			    SH_Z_Done := FALSE;
			    SH_DR_MoveRequested := TRUE;
			    SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
	
			    PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U30_DR_Z_TO_ROT_PICKUP_WAIT;
		    ELSE
			    UnloadError := TRUE;
		    END_IF;
	
	    PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U30_DR_Z_TO_ROT_PICKUP_WAIT:
		    IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
		       (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
			    PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U30_DR_Z_TO_ROT_PICKUP_REQ;
		    END_IF;
	
		    IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
		       (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
			    PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U30_DR_Z_TO_ROT_PICKUP_REQ;
		    END_IF;
	
		    IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
			    arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
			    SH_Z_MoveRequested := FALSE;
			    SH_Z_Done := TRUE;
		    END_IF;
	
		    IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
			    arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
			    SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
			    SH_DR_Done := TRUE;
		    END_IF;
	
		    IF SH_DR_Done AND SH_Z_Done THEN
			    PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U30_DX_TO_ROT_PICKUP_REQ;
		    END_IF;
	
	    PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U30_DX_TO_ROT_PICKUP_REQ:
		    IF Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,2] <> '' THEN
			    tmpInt := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,2]);
	
			    arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(pDrawerParam7[tmpInt]);
			    arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
			    SH_DX_MoveRequested := TRUE;
			    SH_DX_Done := FALSE;
	
			    PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U30_DX_TO_ROT_PICKUP_WAIT;
		    ELSE
			    UnloadError := TRUE;
		    END_IF;
	
	    PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U30_DX_TO_ROT_PICKUP_WAIT:
		    IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
		       (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
			    PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U30_DX_TO_ROT_PICKUP_REQ;
		    END_IF;
	
		    IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
			    arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
			    SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
			    SH_DX_Done := TRUE;
	
			    PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U30_PIN1_OUTSIDE_CMD;
		    END_IF;
	
	    PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U30_PIN1_OUTSIDE_CMD:
		    Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Inside_Valve := FALSE;
		    Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Outside_Valve := TRUE;
		    PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U30_WAIT_PIN1_OUTSIDE;
	
	    PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U30_WAIT_PIN1_OUTSIDE:
		    IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Outside THEN
			    Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Outside_Valve := FALSE;
			    PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U30_PIN2_OUTSIDE_CMD;
		    END_IF;
	
	    PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U30_PIN2_OUTSIDE_CMD:
		    Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Inside_Valve := FALSE;
		    Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Outside_Valve := TRUE;
		    PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U30_WAIT_PIN2_OUTSIDE;
	
	    PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U30_WAIT_PIN2_OUTSIDE:
		    IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Outside THEN
			    Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Outside_Valve := FALSE;
			    PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U30_WAIT_ROTARM_RELEASED;
		    END_IF;
	
	    PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U30_WAIT_ROTARM_RELEASED:
		    IF RotArm_PunchReleased THEN
			    PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U30_DR_EXTRACT_FROM_ROT_REQ;
		    END_IF;
	
	    PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U30_DR_EXTRACT_FROM_ROT_REQ:
		    arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisAutoSetVelocity := Retain_DRParameters[2];
		    arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos := arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - TO_LREAL(Retain_DRParameters[5]);
		    arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
		    SH_DR_MoveRequested := TRUE;
		    SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
	
		    PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U30_DR_EXTRACT_FROM_ROT_WAIT;
	
	    PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U30_DR_EXTRACT_FROM_ROT_WAIT:
		    IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
		       (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
			    PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U30_DR_EXTRACT_FROM_ROT_REQ;
		    END_IF;
	
		    IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
			    arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
			    arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisAutoSetVelocity := Retain_DRParameters[1];
			    SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
			    SH_DR_Done := TRUE;
	
			    PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U30_DX_TO_POSTROT_ALIGN_REQ;
		    END_IF;
	
	    PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U30_DX_TO_POSTROT_ALIGN_REQ:
		    IF Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,2] <> '' THEN
			    tmpInt := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,2]);
	
			    arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(Retain_DXParameters[4]); 
			    arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
			    SH_DX_MoveRequested := TRUE;
			    SH_DX_Done := FALSE;
	
			    PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U30_DX_TO_POSTROT_ALIGN_WAIT;
		    ELSE
			    UnloadError := TRUE;
		    END_IF;
	
	    PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U30_DX_TO_POSTROT_ALIGN_WAIT:
		    IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
		       (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
			    PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U30_DX_TO_POSTROT_ALIGN_REQ;
		    END_IF;
	
		    IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
			    arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
			    SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
			    SH_DX_Done := TRUE;
	
			    PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U30_DONE;
		    END_IF;
	
			PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U30_DONE:
			  Local_Shuttle_State := Shuttle_States.U_Punch_correctly_extracted;
			  PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U31_INIT;

      ELSE
        PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U30_INIT;
      END_CASE;

    Shuttle_States.U_Punch_correctly_extracted:

      CASE PUnload_SH_SubStates OF

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U31_INIT:
          SH_Z_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          SH_Z_Done := FALSE;
          SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          SH_DR_Done := FALSE;

          PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U31_Z_DR_TO_WH_REPOS_REQ;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U31_Z_DR_TO_WH_REPOS_REQ:
          IF (Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,2] <> '') AND
             (Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,5] <> '') THEN

            tmpInt := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,2]);

            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].TargetPos  := STRING_TO_LREAL(Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,5]);
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(pDrawerParam3[tmpInt]);

            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;

            SH_Z_MoveRequested := TRUE;
            SH_Z_Done := FALSE;
            SH_DR_MoveRequested := TRUE;
            SH_DR_Done := FALSE;

            PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U31_Z_DR_TO_WH_REPOS_WAIT;
          ELSE
            UnloadError := TRUE;
          END_IF;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U31_Z_DR_TO_WH_REPOS_WAIT:
          IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
             (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
            PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U31_Z_DR_TO_WH_REPOS_REQ;
          END_IF;

          IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
             (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
            PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U31_Z_DR_TO_WH_REPOS_REQ;
          END_IF;

          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_Z_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_Z_Done := TRUE;
          END_IF;

          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DR_Done := TRUE;
          END_IF;

          IF SH_Z_Done AND SH_DR_Done THEN
            PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U31_DONE;
          END_IF;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U31_DONE:
          Local_Shuttle_State := Shuttle_States.U_Extracted_punch_repos_in_rail;
          PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U32_INIT;

      ELSE
        PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U31_INIT;
      END_CASE;

    Shuttle_States.U_Extracted_punch_repos_in_rail:

      CASE PUnload_SH_SubStates OF

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U32_INIT:
          SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          SH_DX_Done := FALSE;
          PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U32_WAIT_WH_READY;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U32_WAIT_WH_READY:
          IF PUnload_WH_SubStates = PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U17_DONE THEN
            PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U32_DX_TO_WH_DRAWER_ALIGN_REQ;
          END_IF;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U32_DX_TO_WH_DRAWER_ALIGN_REQ:
          IF Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,2] <> '' THEN
            tmpInt := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,2]);

            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(pDrawerParam7[tmpInt]);
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
            SH_DX_MoveRequested := TRUE;
            SH_DX_Done := FALSE;

            PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U32_DX_TO_WH_DRAWER_ALIGN_WAIT;
          ELSE
            UnloadError := TRUE;
          END_IF;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U32_DX_TO_WH_DRAWER_ALIGN_WAIT:
          IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
             (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
            PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U32_DX_TO_WH_DRAWER_ALIGN_REQ;
          END_IF;

          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DX_Done := TRUE;

            PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U32_DONE;
          END_IF;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U32_DONE:
          Local_Shuttle_State := Shuttle_States.U_Punch_positioning_in_WH_progress;
          PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U33_INIT;

      ELSE
        PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U32_INIT;
      END_CASE;

    Shuttle_States.U_Punch_positioning_in_WH_progress:

      CASE PUnload_SH_SubStates OF

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U33_INIT:
          SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
          PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U33_DR_TO_WH_INSERT_REQ;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U33_DR_TO_WH_INSERT_REQ:
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisAutoSetVelocity := Retain_DRParameters[2];
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos := arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos + TO_LREAL(Retain_DRParameters[2]);
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
          SH_DR_MoveRequested := TRUE;
          SH_DR_Done := FALSE;

          PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U33_DR_TO_WH_INSERT_WAIT;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U33_DR_TO_WH_INSERT_WAIT:
          IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
             (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
            PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U33_DR_TO_WH_INSERT_REQ;
          END_IF;

          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisAutoSetVelocity := Retain_DRParameters[1];
            SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DR_Done := TRUE;

            PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U33_DONE;
          END_IF;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U33_DONE:
          Local_Shuttle_State := Shuttle_States.U_Punch_correctly_repos_in_WH;
          PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U34_INIT;

      ELSE
        PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U33_INIT;
      END_CASE;

    Shuttle_States.U_Punch_correctly_repos_in_WH:

      CASE PUnload_SH_SubStates OF

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U34_INIT:
          PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U34_PIN2_INSIDE_CMD;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U34_PIN2_INSIDE_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Outside_Valve := FALSE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Inside_Valve := TRUE;

          PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U34_WAIT_PIN2_INSIDE;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U34_WAIT_PIN2_INSIDE:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Inside THEN
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Inside_Valve := FALSE;
            PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U34_PIN1_INSIDE_CMD;
          END_IF;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U34_PIN1_INSIDE_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Outside_Valve := FALSE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Inside_Valve := TRUE;

          PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U34_WAIT_PIN1_INSIDE;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U34_WAIT_PIN1_INSIDE:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Inside THEN
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Inside_Valve := FALSE;
            PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U34_DONE;
          END_IF;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U34_DONE:
		  PunchUsed [TO_INT(Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,2]),TO_INT(Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,3])] := FALSE;
          PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U34_NEXT_PUNCH_INIT;

        PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U34_NEXT_PUNCH_INIT:
			tmpInt2 := 0;
			IF Retain_UnloadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,12] <> '' THEN
			  tmpInt2 := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_UnloadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,12]);
			END_IF;

			IF (tmpInt2 >= 1) AND (tmpInt2 <= 15) THEN
			  FOR l := 1 TO 12 DO
				Punch_Visu[tmpInt2] := TRUE;  
				PFields_Old[tmpInt2, l] := '';
			  END_FOR;

			  OldAssignedDrawer[tmpInt2] := 0;
			  OldAssignedSlot[tmpInt2] := 0;
			END_IF;		
          Current_PunchIndex := Current_PunchIndex + 1;
		  Current_Punch_Count := Current_Punch_Count - 1;

          IF Current_PunchIndex > 15 THEN
            Current_PunchIndex := 0;
            Current_PunchLoaded := FALSE;
            UnloadDone := TRUE;
            initiated := FALSE;
            UnloadBusy := FALSE;
            LastInitializedPunch := 0;

            Local_WareHouse_State := 0;
            Local_Shuttle_State := 0;
            Local_RotArm_State := 0;

            PUnload_WH_SubStates := PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_IDLE;
            PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.SH_IDLE;
            PUnload_RotArm_SubStates := PUnload_RotArm_SubState.ROT_IDLE;

          ELSE
            Current_PunchLoaded := FALSE;
            LastInitializedPunch := 0;

            WH_TargetDrawerIdx := 0;
            WH_TargetRackID := 0;
            WH_NeedRackBring := FALSE;
            WH_NeedRackChange := FALSE;
            WH_SameRack := FALSE;

            WH_R_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            WH_X_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            WH_R_Done := FALSE;
            WH_X_Done := FALSE;
            WH_WaitRackInPos := FALSE;

            WH_R_LoadRequested := FALSE;
            WH_R_LoadDone := FALSE;
            R_Not_Safety_Zone := FALSE;
            Rack_Presence_Error := FALSE;

            SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DX_Done := FALSE;
            SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
            SH_Z_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_Z_Done := FALSE;

            RotRequired := FALSE;
            RotArm_RotationDone := FALSE;
            RotArm_PunchReleased := FALSE;

            Local_WareHouse_State := WareHouse_States.U_PDrawer_pickup_start;
            PUnload_WH_SubStates := PUnload_WH_SubState.PUNL_U14_INIT;

            Local_Shuttle_State := Shuttle_States.U_Shuttle_Starts_PPick_Up;
            PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U26_INIT;
          END_IF;

      ELSE
        PUnload_SH_SubStates := PUnload_SH_SubState.PUNL_U34_INIT;
      END_CASE;

  ELSE
    ;
  END_CASE;

END_IF


(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Edge memory update                                           *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
lastStartCmd := UnloadStartCmd;
```

Retain_RelocatePunchList : ARRAY[1..15, 1..12] OF STRING;
Arrayinde tutar. 
Bu array de 1. index punch indexi 2. sütun indexi i se punch datalarını içeriyor. PunchChanger kodunu da birlikte oluşturduğumuz için sende bu array elemanlarına hakimsin. 
Relocate
Keep punchlar içinden:

drag unload / drag load yolunu tıkayanlar relocate olur
Tek liste vardır:
Retain_RelocatePunchList
Relocate threshold
Tek relocate sınırı kullanılır:
RelocateThreshold = MAX(RightmostDragUnloadPos, RightmostDragLoadPos)
Kural
Keep punchların pozisyonu bu eşik altında kalıyorsa ve drag yolunu tıkıyorsa relocate adayı olur.
Kolonlar
[1] → source/punch name bilgisi
[2] → drag flag
[3] → name
[6] → position
[7] → length
[8] → rotation
[9] → horn
[10] → drawer no
[11] → slot no
[12] → source old index

RelocateTrashold_Value global olarak kullanılan 
{attribute 'ac_persist':='PersistenceChannel'}RelocateTrashold_Value : LREAL;
şeklinde projemizde tanımlanmış ve PunchChanger kodumuz tarafından atanan Relocate Eşik poziston değeridir. 
Şimdi öncelikle mevcut Relocate FB ile ne yapıyoruz bunu bir anlayalım Mevcut kodda Retain_RelocatePunchList kullanılıyor mu. Punchlar nereyelere nasıl hangi kurallar ile hareket ettiriliyor. Mevcut kodda Retain_RelocatePunchList için verdiğim sütun elemanları doğru işlenmiş mi. 
Bunları anlayalım sonrasında ekleme çıkarma yapmamız gereken enum var mı en sondada tüm konular netleşince FB güncellemesi yapacağız.

## @snnrcpglu1677

Evet şuan akış haritasına ihtiyacım yok sadece bana artık gereksiz olan yerleri söyle Punch_Relocate için. Ayrıca relocate edilecek punch'içi RelocateTrashold_Value’yu  biliyoruz ancak Relocate listesinde 1'den fazla punch olabilir ve bizim burda bir işlem yapmamız gerekiyor. Aşağıda sana RelocateTrashold_Value’ya göre Relocate için punch hedef pozisyon hesap algoritmasını veriyorum.
RelocateTrashold_Value üstüne +150 eklenir. 
Relocate edilecek ilk punch için [7] length bilgisi ve RelocateTrashold_Value +150 pozisyon bilgisi vardır. 
İlk punch RelocateTrashold_Value üstüne +150 pozisyonuna hareket ettirilir. 
RelocateTrashold_Value üstüne +150 pozisyonu bu pozisyona koyulan punch'ın merkez noktasıdır. 
Yani punch RelocateTrashold_Value üstüne +150 pozisyounun + ve - olarak (Retain_RelocatePunchList [i,7]/2) kadar yer kaplar. 
RelocateTrashold_Value  1000 olsun+150 offset eklediğimizde RelocateTrashold_Value  1150 olur. 
Relocate edilecek ilk punch merkezi bu konuma koyulduğunda ilk punch genişliğide 100 varsayarsak.
Bu relocated punch 1100 ve 1200 pozisyonlarını tutar. 
Dolayısı ile Retain_RelocatePunchList  2.relocate edilmesi gereken punch'a geçildiğinde 
RelocateTrashold_Value 1200 olarak güncellenmelidir.

gereksiz.

# Yeni relocate hedef pozisyon algoritması
Senin tarifin çok net, şöyle uygulanacak:

## Temel kural
- `RelocateTrashold_Value` başlangıç referansıdır
- hedef merkez ilk punch için:

```iecst
TargetCenter := RelocateTrashold_Value + 150;
```

- punch’ın kaplayacağı alan:

```iecst
HalfWidth := STRING_TO_LREAL(Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,7]) / 2.0;
```

- punch’ın fiziksel aralığı:

```iecst
StartPos := TargetCenter - HalfWidth;
EndPos   := TargetCenter + HalfWidth;
```

---

# İkinci punch için güncelleme
İlk punch yerleşince, yeni threshold artık şudur:

```iecst
RelocateTrashold_Value := EndPos;
```

ve senin örneğine göre:
- threshold 1000
- +150 → hedef merkez 1150
- width 100 → punch 1100..1200
- bir sonraki punch için threshold = 1200

Bu doğru.

---

# Genel formül
Her relocate punch için:

```iecst
TargetCenter := RelocateTrashold_Value + 150;
HalfWidth := Length / 2.0;
PlacedStart := TargetCenter - HalfWidth;
PlacedEnd := TargetCenter + HalfWidth;
RelocateTrashold_Value := PlacedEnd;
```

---

# Bu ne demek?
- punch’lar art arda dizilecek
- her punch, öncekinin sağ ucundan devam eden yeni eşik ile yerleştirilecek
- böylece birbirine çakışmadan güvenli buffer ile relocate edilmiş olacak

---

- `Retain_RelocatePunchList` tüketimi
- `Current_PunchIndex`
- `RelocateCount`
- `RelocateActive`, `RelocateDoneArr`
- `RelocateOldIndex`
- `PFields_Old` commit güncellemeleri
- shuttle / rotarm / dx / dr motion sequence

- yeniden analiz / max end çıkarma mantığı
- current/target range hesapları

## Korunacaklar:
- sırayla relocate etme
- commit update

- Punch_Changer’ın ürettiği `RelocateTrashold_Value` kullanımı
