           (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
          PDraggLoad_WH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L09_RACKCHANGE_X_TO_CURRENT_DRAWER_REQ;
        END_IF;

        IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
          WH_X_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          WH_X_Done := TRUE;
          PDraggLoad_WH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L09_RACKCHANGE_R_TO_DROP_REQ;
        END_IF;

      PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L09_RACKCHANGE_R_TO_DROP_REQ:
        arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].TargetPos := -10.0;
        arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
        WH_R_MoveRequested := TRUE;
        WH_R_Done := FALSE;
        PDraggLoad_WH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L09_RACKCHANGE_R_TO_DROP_WAIT;

      PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L09_RACKCHANGE_R_TO_DROP_WAIT:
        IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
           (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
          PDraggLoad_WH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L09_RACKCHANGE_R_TO_DROP_REQ;
        END_IF;

        IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
          WH_R_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          WH_R_Done := TRUE;
          PDraggLoad_WH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L09_RACKCHANGE_WAIT_RACK_RELEASED;
        END_IF;

      PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L09_RACKCHANGE_WAIT_RACK_RELEASED:
        IF NOT Fmsc_PLC_IO.Rack_Presence THEN
          PDraggLoad_WH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L09_RACKCHANGE_CLEAR_CURRENT_INFO;
        END_IF;

      PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L09_RACKCHANGE_CLEAR_CURRENT_INFO:
        Current_Rack_ID := 0;
        Current_Rack_Type := 0;
        Current_Drawer_ID := 0;

        WH_NeedRackChange := FALSE;
        WH_NeedRackBring := TRUE;
        WH_SameRack := FALSE;

        WH_R_MoveRequested := FALSE;
        WH_X_MoveRequested := FALSE;
        WH_R_Done := FALSE;
        WH_X_Done := FALSE;
        WH_WaitRackInPos := FALSE;

        WH_R_LoadRequested := FALSE;
        WH_R_LoadDone := FALSE;
        R_Not_Safety_Zone := FALSE;
        Rack_Presence_Error := FALSE;

        PDraggLoad_WH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L09_UNLOCK_CHECK;

      PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L09_UNLOCK_CHECK:
        IF NOT (Fmsc_PLC_IO.Carriage_Unlocked_Left AND Fmsc_PLC_IO.Carriage_Unlocked_Right) THEN
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Carriage_UnLocking_Valve := TRUE;
        ELSE
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Carriage_UnLocking_Valve := FALSE;

          IF R_Not_Safety_Zone THEN
            PDraggLoad_WH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L09_WAIT_R_SAFEZONE;
          ELSE
            PDraggLoad_WH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L09_R_TO_PICKUP_REQ;
          END_IF;
        END_IF;

      PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L09_WAIT_R_SAFEZONE:
        IF arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].ActualPos < TO_LREAL(Retain_RParameters[7]) THEN
          R_Not_Safety_Zone := FALSE;
          PDraggLoad_WH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L09_R_TO_PICKUP_REQ;
        END_IF;

      PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L09_R_TO_PICKUP_REQ:
        IF arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].ActualPos < TO_LREAL(Retain_RParameters[7]) THEN
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].TargetPos := -10.0;
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
          WH_R_MoveRequested := TRUE;
          WH_R_Done := FALSE;
          PDraggLoad_WH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L09_R_TO_PICKUP_WAIT;
        ELSE
          R_Not_Safety_Zone := TRUE;
          WH_R_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          WH_R_Done := FALSE;
          PDraggLoad_WH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L09_WAIT_R_SAFEZONE;
        END_IF;

      PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L09_R_TO_PICKUP_WAIT:
        IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
           (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].ActualPos - (-10.0)) > WH_Eps) THEN
          PDraggLoad_WH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L09_R_TO_PICKUP_REQ;
        END_IF;

        IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].ActualPos - (-10.0)) <= WH_Eps THEN
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
          WH_R_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          WH_R_Done := TRUE;
          PDraggLoad_WH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L09_X_TO_DRAWER_REQ;
        END_IF;

      PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L09_X_TO_DRAWER_REQ:
        IF WH_TargetDrawerIdx >= 1 THEN

          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].ActualPos - TO_LREAL(pDrawerParam2[WH_TargetDrawerIdx])) <= WH_Eps THEN
            WH_X_Done := TRUE;
            WH_X_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            PDraggLoad_WH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L09_R_LIFT_REQ;
          ELSE
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(pDrawerParam2[WH_TargetDrawerIdx]);
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
            WH_X_MoveRequested := TRUE;
            WH_X_Done := FALSE;
            PDraggLoad_WH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L09_X_TO_DRAWER_WAIT;
          END_IF;

        ELSE
          LoadError := TRUE;
        END_IF;

      PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L09_X_TO_DRAWER_WAIT:
        IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
           (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
          PDraggLoad_WH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L09_X_TO_DRAWER_REQ;
        END_IF;

        IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
          WH_X_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          WH_X_Done := TRUE;
          PDraggLoad_WH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L09_R_LIFT_REQ;
        END_IF;

      PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L09_R_LIFT_REQ:
        arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(Retain_RParameters[3]);
        arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
        WH_R_LoadRequested := TRUE;
        WH_R_LoadDone := FALSE;
        Rack_Presence_Error := FALSE;
        PDraggLoad_WH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L09_R_LIFT_WAIT;

      PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L09_R_LIFT_WAIT:
        IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
           (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
          PDraggLoad_WH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L09_R_LIFT_REQ;
        END_IF;

        IF arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].ActualPos >= TO_LREAL(Retain_RParameters[7]) THEN

          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Rack_Presence THEN
            Current_Rack_ID := WH_TargetRackID;
            Current_Rack_Type := 1;
            Current_Drawer_ID := WH_TargetDrawerIdx;
          ELSE
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            WH_R_LoadRequested := FALSE;
            WH_R_LoadDone := FALSE;
            Rack_Presence_Error := TRUE;

            General_Stop := TRUE;
            General_Start := FALSE;

            PDraggLoad_WH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L09_ERROR_RACK_PRESENCE;
          END_IF;

        END_IF;

        IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
          WH_R_LoadRequested := FALSE;
          WH_R_LoadDone := TRUE;
          Rack_Presence_Error := FALSE;
          PDraggLoad_WH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L09_WAIT_RACK_IN_POS;
        END_IF;

      PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L09_WAIT_RACK_IN_POS:
        WH_WaitRackInPos := (WH_R_LoadDone AND WH_X_Done);

        IF WH_WaitRackInPos THEN
          PDraggLoad_WH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L09_DONE;
        END_IF;

      PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L09_ERROR_RACK_PRESENCE:
        WH_WaitRackInPos := FALSE;

        IF arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].ActualPos < TO_LREAL(Retain_RParameters[7]) THEN
          Rack_Presence_Error := FALSE;
          PDraggLoad_WH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L09_R_LIFT_REQ;
        END_IF;

      PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L09_DONE:
        Local_WareHouse_State := WareHouse_States.DL_Punches_rack_taken;
        PDraggLoad_WH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L10_INIT;

      PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L10_INIT:
        WH_X_MoveRequested := FALSE;
        WH_X_Done := FALSE;
        WH_R_MoveRequested := FALSE;
        WH_R_Done := FALSE;
        PDraggLoad_WH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L10_X_TO_PICKPOS_REQ;

      PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L10_X_TO_PICKPOS_REQ:
        IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].ActualPos - TO_LREAL(Retain_XParameters[2])) <= WH_Eps THEN
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
          WH_X_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          WH_X_Done := TRUE;
          PDraggLoad_WH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L10_R_TO_PICKPOS_REQ;
        ELSE
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(Retain_XParameters[2]);
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
          WH_X_MoveRequested := TRUE;
          WH_X_Done := FALSE;
          PDraggLoad_WH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L10_X_TO_PICKPOS_WAIT;
        END_IF;

      PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L10_X_TO_PICKPOS_WAIT:
        IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
           (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
          PDraggLoad_WH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L10_X_TO_PICKPOS_REQ;
        END_IF;

        IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_X].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
          WH_X_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          WH_X_Done := TRUE;
          PDraggLoad_WH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L10_R_TO_PICKPOS_REQ;
        END_IF;

      PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L10_R_TO_PICKPOS_REQ:
        IF (WH_TargetDrawerIdx >= 1) AND (WH_TargetDrawerIdx <= 16) THEN

          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].ActualPos - TO_LREAL(pDrawerParam1[WH_TargetDrawerIdx])) <= WH_Eps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            WH_R_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            WH_R_Done := TRUE;
            PDraggLoad_WH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L10_DONE;
          ELSE
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(pDrawerParam1[WH_TargetDrawerIdx]);
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
            WH_R_MoveRequested := TRUE;
            WH_R_Done := FALSE;
            PDraggLoad_WH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L10_R_TO_PICKPOS_WAIT;
          END_IF;

        ELSE
          LoadError := TRUE;
        END_IF;

      PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L10_R_TO_PICKPOS_WAIT:
        IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
           (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
          PDraggLoad_WH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L10_R_TO_PICKPOS_REQ;
        END_IF;

        IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_R].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
          WH_R_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          WH_R_Done := TRUE;
          PDraggLoad_WH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L10_DONE;
        END_IF;

      PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L10_DONE:
        Local_WareHouse_State := WareHouse_States.DL_PDrawer_pickup_Pos_reached;
        PDraggLoad_WH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L11_INIT;

      PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L11_INIT:
        WH_X_MoveRequested := FALSE;
        WH_X_Done := FALSE;
        WH_R_MoveRequested := FALSE;
        WH_R_Done := FALSE;
        PDraggLoad_WH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L11_LOCK_CMD;

      PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L11_LOCK_CMD:
        Fmsc_PLC_IO.Carriage_UnLocking_Valve := FALSE;
        Fmsc_PLC_IO.Carriage_Locking_Valve := TRUE;
        PDraggLoad_WH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L11_WAIT_LOCKED;

      PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L11_WAIT_LOCKED:
        IF (Fmsc_PLC_IO.Carriage_Locked_Left AND Fmsc_PLC_IO.Carriage_Locked_Right) THEN
          PDraggLoad_WH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L11_DONE;
        END_IF;

      PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L11_DONE:
        Local_WareHouse_State := WareHouse_States.DL_PPickup_from_drawer_allowed;
        PDraggLoad_WH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L12_INIT;

      PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L12_INIT:
        WH_X_MoveRequested := FALSE;
        WH_X_Done := FALSE;
        WH_R_MoveRequested := FALSE;
        WH_R_Done := FALSE;
        PDraggLoad_WH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L12_SET_CURRENT_RACK;

      PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L12_SET_CURRENT_RACK:
        PDraggLoad_WH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L12_VERIFY_CURRENT_RACK;

      PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L12_VERIFY_CURRENT_RACK:
        IF (TO_INT(Current_Rack_ID) = WH_TargetRackID) AND
           (Current_Rack_Type = 1) AND
           (Current_Drawer_ID = WH_TargetDrawerIdx) THEN
          PDraggLoad_WH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L12_DONE;
        END_IF;

      PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L12_DONE:
        PDraggLoad_WH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L12_DONE;

    ELSE
      PDraggLoad_WH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L09_INIT;
    END_CASE;

    IF WH_R_LoadDone AND WH_X_Done THEN
      WH_WaitRackInPos := TRUE;
    ELSE
      WH_WaitRackInPos := FALSE;
    END_IF;

  END_IF;
END_IF


(* ============================================================ *)
(* Shuttle main state machine (SH engine) - Drag Load            *)
(* ============================================================ *)
IF LoadStartCmd THEN

  CASE Local_Shuttle_State OF

    Shuttle_States.DL_Shuttle_starts_PPick_up:

      CASE PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates OF

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_SH_IDLE:
          ;

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L10_INIT:
          SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          SH_DX_Done := FALSE;
          SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
          SH_Z_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          SH_Z_Done := FALSE;
          PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L10_Z_DR_TO_WH_PICKPOS_REQ;

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L10_Z_DR_TO_WH_PICKPOS_REQ:
          IF Retain_ATCDragLoadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,2] <> '' THEN
            tmpInt := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_ATCDragLoadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,2]);

            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(Retain_ATCDragLoadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,5]);
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(pDrawerParam3[tmpInt]);

            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;

            SH_Z_MoveRequested := TRUE;
            SH_Z_Done := FALSE;
            SH_DR_MoveRequested := TRUE;
            SH_DR_Done := FALSE;

            PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L10_Z_DR_TO_WH_PICKPOS_WAIT;
          ELSE
            LoadError := TRUE;
          END_IF;

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L10_Z_DR_TO_WH_PICKPOS_WAIT:
          IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
             (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
            PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L10_Z_DR_TO_WH_PICKPOS_REQ;
          END_IF;

          IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
             (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
            PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L10_Z_DR_TO_WH_PICKPOS_REQ;
          END_IF;

          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_Z_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_Z_Done := TRUE;
          END_IF;

          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DR_Done := TRUE;
          END_IF;

          IF SH_Z_Done AND SH_DR_Done THEN
            PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L10_WAIT_WH_READY;
          END_IF;

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L10_WAIT_WH_READY:
          IF PDraggLoad_WH_SubStates = PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L12_DONE THEN
            PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L10_DX_TO_WH_DRAWER_ALIGN_REQ;
          END_IF;

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L10_DX_TO_WH_DRAWER_ALIGN_REQ:
          IF Retain_ATCDragLoadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,2] <> '' THEN
            tmpInt := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_ATCDragLoadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,2]);

            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(pDrawerParam7[tmpInt]);
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
            SH_DX_MoveRequested := TRUE;
            SH_DX_Done := FALSE;

            PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L10_DX_TO_WH_DRAWER_ALIGN_WAIT;
          ELSE
            LoadError := TRUE;
          END_IF;

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L10_DX_TO_WH_DRAWER_ALIGN_WAIT:
          IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
             (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
            PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L10_DX_TO_WH_DRAWER_ALIGN_REQ;
          END_IF;

          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DX_Done := TRUE;

            PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L10_PIN1_OUTSIDE_CMD;
          END_IF;

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L10_PIN1_OUTSIDE_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Inside_Valve := FALSE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Outside_Valve := TRUE;
          PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L10_WAIT_PIN1_OUTSIDE;

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L10_WAIT_PIN1_OUTSIDE:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Outside THEN
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Outside_Valve := FALSE;
            PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L10_PIN2_OUTSIDE_CMD;
          END_IF;

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L10_PIN2_OUTSIDE_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Inside_Valve := FALSE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Outside_Valve := TRUE;
          PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L10_WAIT_PIN2_OUTSIDE;

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L10_WAIT_PIN2_OUTSIDE:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Outside THEN
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Outside_Valve := FALSE;
            PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L10_DONE;
          END_IF;

        (* ----------------------------------------------------------- *)
        (* Punch pick tamamlandı. RotRequired + PunchUsed + routing.   *)
        (* L11/L12 direct-load extraction adımları drag'de yok.        *)
        (* ----------------------------------------------------------- *)
        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L10_DONE:
          RotRequired := FALSE;
          PunchUsed[TO_INT(Retain_ATCDragLoadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,2]), TO_INT(Retain_ATCDragLoadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,3])] := TRUE;

          IF Retain_DragLoadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,8] <> '' THEN
            RotRequired := (STRING_TO_INT(Retain_DragLoadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,8]) = 1);
          END_IF;

          IF RotRequired THEN
            IF RotArm_ReadyForLoad THEN
              Local_Shuttle_State := Shuttle_States.DL_Punch_positioned_to_be_rot;
              PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L13_INIT;
            ELSE
              PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L10_DONE;
            END_IF;
          ELSE
            Local_Shuttle_State := Shuttle_States.DL_Punch_positioning_progress;
            PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L16_INIT;
          END_IF;

      ELSE
        PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L10_INIT;
      END_CASE;


    Shuttle_States.DL_Punch_positioned_to_be_rot:

      CASE PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates OF

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L13_INIT:
          SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
          SH_Z_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          SH_Z_Done := FALSE;
          SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          SH_DX_Done := FALSE;
          PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L13_DR_Z_TO_ROT_PICKPOS_REQ;

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L13_DR_Z_TO_ROT_PICKPOS_REQ:
          IF Retain_ATCDragLoadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,2] <> '' THEN
            tmpInt := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_ATCDragLoadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,2]);

            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(Retain_ZParameters[11]);
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(pDrawerParam3[tmpInt]);

            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;

            SH_Z_MoveRequested := TRUE;
            SH_Z_Done := FALSE;
            SH_DR_MoveRequested := TRUE;
            SH_DR_Done := FALSE;

            PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L13_DR_Z_TO_ROT_PICKPOS_WAIT;
          ELSE
            LoadError := TRUE;
          END_IF;

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L13_DR_Z_TO_ROT_PICKPOS_WAIT:
          IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
             (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
            PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L13_DR_Z_TO_ROT_PICKPOS_REQ;
          END_IF;

          IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
             (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
            PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L13_DR_Z_TO_ROT_PICKPOS_REQ;
          END_IF;

          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_Z_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_Z_Done := TRUE;
          END_IF;

          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DR_Done := TRUE;
          END_IF;

          IF SH_Z_Done AND SH_DR_Done THEN
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Rotation_Arm_Locking_Valve := TRUE;
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Rotation_Arm_Unlocking_Valve := FALSE;
            PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L13_WAIT_ROT_PUNCH_LOCKED;
          END_IF;

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L13_WAIT_ROT_PUNCH_LOCKED:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Punch_Locked_on_Rotation_Arm THEN
            PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L13_PIN2_INSIDE_CMD;
          END_IF;

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L13_PIN2_INSIDE_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Outside_Valve := FALSE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Inside_Valve := TRUE;
          PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L13_WAIT_PIN2_INSIDE;

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L13_WAIT_PIN2_INSIDE:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Inside THEN
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Inside_Valve := FALSE;
            PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L13_PIN1_INSIDE_CMD;
          END_IF;

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L13_PIN1_INSIDE_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Outside_Valve := FALSE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Inside_Valve := TRUE;
          PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L13_WAIT_PIN1_INSIDE;

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L13_WAIT_PIN1_INSIDE:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Inside THEN
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Inside_Valve := FALSE;
            PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L13_DX_DR_Z_TO_ROT_SAFE_REQ;
          END_IF;

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L13_DX_DR_Z_TO_ROT_SAFE_REQ:
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(Retain_DXParameters[4]);
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(Retain_DRParameters[8]);
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(Retain_ZParameters[8]);

          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;

          SH_DX_MoveRequested := TRUE;
          SH_DX_Done := FALSE;
          SH_DR_MoveRequested := TRUE;
          SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
          SH_Z_MoveRequested := TRUE;
          SH_Z_Done := FALSE;

          PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L13_DX_DR_Z_TO_ROT_SAFE_WAIT;

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L13_DX_DR_Z_TO_ROT_SAFE_WAIT:
          IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
             (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
            PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L13_DX_DR_Z_TO_ROT_SAFE_REQ;
          END_IF;

          IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
             (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
            PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L13_DX_DR_Z_TO_ROT_SAFE_REQ;
          END_IF;

          IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
             (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
            PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L13_DX_DR_Z_TO_ROT_SAFE_REQ;
          END_IF;

          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DX_Done := TRUE;
          END_IF;

          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DR_Done := TRUE;
          END_IF;

          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_Z_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_Z_Done := TRUE;
          END_IF;

          IF SH_DX_Done AND SH_DR_Done AND SH_Z_Done THEN
            PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L13_DONE;
          END_IF;

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L13_DONE:
          Local_Shuttle_State := Shuttle_States.DL_Punch_correctly_rotated;
          PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L14_INIT;

      ELSE
        PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L13_INIT;
      END_CASE;


    Shuttle_States.DL_Punch_correctly_rotated:

      CASE PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates OF

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L14_INIT:
          PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L14_WAIT_ROTARM_READY_TO_ROTATE;

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L14_WAIT_ROTARM_READY_TO_ROTATE:
          IF Local_RotArm_State = RotationArm_States.DL_RotArm_Rotation_Interrupt_Active THEN
            PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L14_WAIT_ROTATION_DONE;
          END_IF;

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L14_WAIT_ROTATION_DONE:
          IF RotArm_RotationDone THEN
            PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L14_DONE;
          END_IF;

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L14_DONE:
          Local_Shuttle_State := Shuttle_States.DL_Punch_Correctly_taken_after_rot;
          PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L15_INIT;

      ELSE
        PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L14_INIT;
      END_CASE;


    Shuttle_States.DL_Punch_Correctly_taken_after_rot:

      CASE PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates OF

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L15_INIT:
          SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
          SH_Z_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          SH_Z_Done := FALSE;
          SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          SH_DX_Done := FALSE;
          PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L15_DR_Z_TO_ROT_PICKUP_REQ;

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L15_DR_Z_TO_ROT_PICKUP_REQ:
          IF Retain_ATCDragLoadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,2] <> '' THEN
            tmpInt := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_ATCDragLoadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,2]);

            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(Retain_ZParameters[11]);
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(pDrawerParam3[tmpInt]);

            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;

            SH_Z_MoveRequested := TRUE;
            SH_Z_Done := FALSE;
            SH_DR_MoveRequested := TRUE;
            SH_DR_Done := FALSE;

            PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L15_DR_Z_TO_ROT_PICKUP_WAIT;
          ELSE
            LoadError := TRUE;
          END_IF;

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L15_DR_Z_TO_ROT_PICKUP_WAIT:
          IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
             (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
            PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L15_DR_Z_TO_ROT_PICKUP_REQ;
          END_IF;

          IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
             (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
            PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L15_DR_Z_TO_ROT_PICKUP_REQ;
          END_IF;

          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_Z_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_Z_Done := TRUE;
          END_IF;

          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DR_Done := TRUE;
          END_IF;

          IF SH_DR_Done AND SH_Z_Done THEN
            PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L15_DX_TO_ROT_PICKUP_REQ;
          END_IF;

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L15_DX_TO_ROT_PICKUP_REQ:
          IF Retain_ATCDragLoadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,2] <> '' THEN
            tmpInt := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_ATCDragLoadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,2]);

            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(pDrawerParam7[tmpInt]);
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
            SH_DX_MoveRequested := TRUE;
            SH_DX_Done := FALSE;

            PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L15_DX_TO_ROT_PICKUP_WAIT;
          ELSE
            LoadError := TRUE;
          END_IF;

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L15_DX_TO_ROT_PICKUP_WAIT:
          IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
             (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
            PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L15_DX_TO_ROT_PICKUP_REQ;
          END_IF;

          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DX_Done := TRUE;

            PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L15_PIN1_OUTSIDE_CMD;
          END_IF;

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L15_PIN1_OUTSIDE_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Inside_Valve := FALSE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Outside_Valve := TRUE;
          PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L15_WAIT_PIN1_OUTSIDE;

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L15_WAIT_PIN1_OUTSIDE:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Outside THEN
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Outside_Valve := FALSE;
            PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L15_PIN2_OUTSIDE_CMD;
          END_IF;

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L15_PIN2_OUTSIDE_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Inside_Valve := FALSE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Outside_Valve := TRUE;
          PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L15_WAIT_PIN2_OUTSIDE;

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L15_WAIT_PIN2_OUTSIDE:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Outside THEN
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Outside_Valve := FALSE;
            PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L15_WAIT_ROTARM_RELEASED;
          END_IF;

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L15_WAIT_ROTARM_RELEASED:
          IF RotArm_PunchReleased THEN
            PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L15_DONE;
          END_IF;

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L15_DONE:
          Local_Shuttle_State := Shuttle_States.DL_Punch_positioning_progress;
          PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L16_INIT;

      ELSE
        PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L15_INIT;
      END_CASE;


    Shuttle_States.DL_Punch_positioning_progress:

      CASE PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates OF

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L16_INIT:
          SH_Z_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          SH_Z_Done := FALSE;
          SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
          PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L16_PRESS_CLAMP_OFF_CMD;

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L16_PRESS_CLAMP_OFF_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Press_Upper_ClampOn := FALSE;
          ClampOff_Timer.IN := TRUE;
          IF ClampOff_Timer.Q THEN
            ClampOff_Timer.IN := FALSE;
            PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L16_Z_DR_TO_PRESS_LOADPOS_REQ;
          END_IF;

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L16_Z_DR_TO_PRESS_LOADPOS_REQ:
          IF (Retain_DragLoadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,6] <> '') AND
             (Retain_ATCDragLoadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,2] <> '') THEN

            tmpInt := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_ATCDragLoadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,2]);

            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].TargetPos := STRING_TO_LREAL(Retain_DragLoadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,6]) + REAL_TO_LREAL(Retain_ZParameters[19]);
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(pDrawerParam6[tmpInt]);

            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;

            SH_Z_MoveRequested := TRUE;
            SH_Z_Done := FALSE;
            SH_DR_MoveRequested := TRUE;
            SH_DR_Done := FALSE;

            PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L16_Z_DR_TO_PRESS_LOADPOS_WAIT;
          ELSE
            LoadError := TRUE;
          END_IF;

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L16_Z_DR_TO_PRESS_LOADPOS_WAIT:
          IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
             (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
            PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L16_Z_DR_TO_PRESS_LOADPOS_REQ;
          END_IF;

          IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
             (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
            PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L16_Z_DR_TO_PRESS_LOADPOS_REQ;
          END_IF;

          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_Z_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_Z_Done := TRUE;
          END_IF;

          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DR_Done := TRUE;
          END_IF;

          IF SH_Z_Done AND SH_DR_Done THEN
            PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L16_DONE;
          END_IF;

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L16_DONE:
          Local_Shuttle_State := Shuttle_States.DL_Punch_positioning_completed;
          PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L17_INIT;

      ELSE
        PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L16_INIT;
      END_CASE;


    Shuttle_States.DL_Punch_positioning_completed:

      CASE PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates OF

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L17_INIT:
          SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
          SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
          SH_DX_Done := FALSE;
          PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L17_PRESS_CLAMP_ON_CMD;

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L17_PRESS_CLAMP_ON_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Press_Upper_ClampOn := TRUE;
          ClampOn_Timer.IN := TRUE;
          IF ClampOn_Timer.Q THEN
            PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L17_WAIT_CLAMP_OK;
          END_IF;

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L17_WAIT_CLAMP_OK:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Press_Upper_Clamp_Ok THEN
            ClampOn_Timer.IN := FALSE;
            PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L17_PIN2_INSIDE_CMD;
          END_IF;

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L17_PIN2_INSIDE_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Outside_Valve := FALSE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Inside_Valve := TRUE;
          PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L17_WAIT_PIN2_INSIDE;

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L17_WAIT_PIN2_INSIDE:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Inside THEN
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Inside_Valve := FALSE;
            PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L17_PIN1_INSIDE_CMD;
          END_IF;

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L17_PIN1_INSIDE_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Outside_Valve := FALSE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Inside_Valve := TRUE;
          PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L17_WAIT_PIN1_INSIDE;

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L17_WAIT_PIN1_INSIDE:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Inside THEN
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Inside_Valve := FALSE;
            PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L17_DX_TO_SAFE_REQ;
          END_IF;

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L17_DX_TO_SAFE_REQ:
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(Retain_DXParameters[4]);
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
          SH_DX_MoveRequested := TRUE;
          SH_DX_Done := FALSE;
          PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L17_DX_TO_SAFE_WAIT;

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L17_DX_TO_SAFE_WAIT:
          IF (NOT arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs) AND
             (ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos) > WH_Eps) THEN
            PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L17_DX_TO_SAFE_REQ;
          END_IF;

          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos) <= WH_Eps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DX_Done := TRUE;
            PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L17_DONE;
          END_IF;

        PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L17_DONE:
          tmpInt2 := 0;
          IF Retain_DragLoadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,12] <> '' THEN
            tmpInt2 := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_DragLoadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,12]);
          END_IF;

          IF (tmpInt2 >= 1) AND (tmpInt2 <= 15) THEN
            FOR l := 1 TO 12 DO
              PFields_Old[tmpInt2, l] := Retain_DragLoadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex, l];
            END_FOR;

            IF Retain_ATCDragLoadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,2] <> '' THEN
              PFields_Old[tmpInt2,10] := Retain_ATCDragLoadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,2];
            ELSE
              PFields_Old[tmpInt2,10] := '';
            END_IF;

            IF Retain_ATCDragLoadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,3] <> '' THEN
              PFields_Old[tmpInt2,11] := Retain_ATCDragLoadPunchList[Current_PunchIndex,3];
            ELSE
              PFields_Old[tmpInt2,11] := '';
            END_IF;
          END_IF;

          Current_PunchIndex := Current_PunchIndex + 1;
          Current_Punch_Count := Current_Punch_Count + 1;

          IF Current_PunchIndex > DragLoadPunchCount THEN
            Current_PunchIndex := 0;
            Current_PunchLoaded := FALSE;
            LoadDone := TRUE;
            initiated := FALSE;
            LoadBusy := FALSE;
            DragLoadPrepared := FALSE;
            LastInitializedPunch := 0;

            Local_WareHouse_State := 0;
            Local_Shuttle_State := 0;
            Local_RotArm_State := 0;

            PDraggLoad_WH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_IDLE;
            PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_SH_IDLE;
            PDraggLoad_RotArm_SubStates := PDraggLoad_RotArm_SubState.PDLD_ROT_IDLE;

          ELSE
            Current_PunchLoaded := TRUE;
            LastInitializedPunch := 0;

            WH_TargetDrawerIdx := 0;
            WH_TargetRackID := 0;
            WH_NeedRackBring := FALSE;
            WH_NeedRackChange := FALSE;
            WH_SameRack := FALSE;

            WH_R_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            WH_X_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            WH_R_Done := FALSE;
            WH_X_Done := FALSE;
            WH_WaitRackInPos := FALSE;

            WH_R_LoadRequested := FALSE;
            WH_R_LoadDone := FALSE;
            R_Not_Safety_Zone := FALSE;
            Rack_Presence_Error := FALSE;

            SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DX_Done := FALSE;
            SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
            SH_Z_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_Z_Done := FALSE;

            RotRequired := FALSE;
            RotArm_RotationDone := FALSE;
            RotArm_PunchReleased := FALSE;

            Local_WareHouse_State := WareHouse_States.DL_PDrawer_pickup_start;
            PDraggLoad_WH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_WH_SubState.PDLD_L09_INIT;

            Local_Shuttle_State := Shuttle_States.DL_Shuttle_starts_PPick_up;
            PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L10_INIT;
          END_IF;

      ELSE
        PDraggLoad_SH_SubStates := PDraggLoad_SH_SubState.PDLD_L17_INIT;
      END_CASE;

  ELSE
    ;
  END_CASE;

END_IF


(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Edge memory update                                            *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
lastStartCmd := LoadStartCmd;

## Copilot

`C0048: Array requires exactly 1 indexes` hatasının anlamı şudur:

> Kodda iki indeksle kullanılan bir array, projede tek boyutlu olarak tanımlanmış.

Örneğin kod şu şekilde kullanıyor:

```iecst
Retain_DragLoadPunchList[i,k]
Retain_ATCDragLoadPunchList[i,k]
```

Bu kullanım için array tanımı mutlaka iki boyutlu olmalıdır:

```iecst
ARRAY[1..15, 1..12] OF STRING(100)
```

Ancak projendeki tanım büyük ihtimalle şu tiplerden biri:

```iecst
ARRAY[1..15] OF STRING(100)
```

veya:

```iecst
ARRAY[1..15] OF SomeStruct
```

Bu durumda yalnızca tek indeks kullanılabilir:

```iecst
Retain_DragLoadPunchList[i]
```

## Copilot

Evet, `Punch_DraggLoad` tamamlandıktan sonra sıradaki FB’yi düzenleyebiliriz.

Önerilen sıradaki kontrol noktası, ana state machine’deki **direct/drag ayrımını ve çağrı sırasını** düzenlemek olmalı:

1. `PunchChanger` listeleri üretir  
2. Direct unload varsa `Punch_Unloading` çalışır  
3. Drag unload varsa `Punch_DraggUnload` çalışır  
4. Direct load varsa `Punch_Loading` çalışır  
5. Drag load varsa `Punch_DraggLoad` çalışır  
6. Sonrasında keep/relocate veya finalizasyon akışı devam eder  

Böylece aynı anda iki FB’nin aynı `ATC_R`, `ATC_X`, `ATC_DX`, `ATC_DR`, `ATC_Z` veya `ATC_W` eksenlerine komut yazması engellenir.

Sıradaki düzenlemek istediğin FB’nin kodunu paylaş; mevcut akışa göre:
- hangi state’te çağrılacağını,
- giriş/çıkış handshake’lerini,
- `Busy / Done / Error / Ack` bağlantılarını,
- drag/direct öncelik sırasını

birlikte düzenleyelim.

## @snnrcpglu1677

Punch_Unloading ile direct unload edilenler sök tak ile unload edildi. 
Punch_Relocate ile Punch_DraggUnload ve Punch_DraggLoad öncesi punch sürükleme yolu açıldı. 
Punch_DraggUnload ile sürüklenerek warehouse unload edilecek dragg unlaod punchlar unload edildi. 
Punch_DraggLoad ile sürüklenerek load edilecek punchlar warehouse to abkant load yapıldı. 
Şimdi ise sırada Punch_Keeping ile Relocate edilmiş ve keep punch olarak ayrılmış ve dragg yolu dışında kalan dolayısı ile relocate ile dokunulmamış ancak abkant üstünd bulunan ve yeni programda da kullanılacak olan punchlarda var. 
İşte relocate edilmiş ve relocate edilmemiş ancak keep olarka hala duran punchlar 
Punch_Keeping ile yeni programdaki final yerlerine koyulacak. 
Böylece artık geriye son bir adım olan Punch_Loading yani direct load fonksiyonu ile dragg olmayan ve direk yeni program yerlerine koyulacak olan punchlar kalacak çünkü unload işlemleri tamamlanmış dragg unload dragg load ve keep işleri tamamlanmış geriye sadece direk load edilecek punchlar ve onların boş olan pozisyonları kalmış olacak. 

## Copilot

Anladım — akış sırası artık net:

1. **`Punch_Unloading`** — direct unload (sök-tak)
2. **`Punch_Relocate`** — drag yolunu açmak için gerekli keep punch'ları geçici olarak kaydırma
3. **`Punch_DraggUnload`** — drag unload (Warehouse'a sürükleyerek)
4. **`Punch_DraggLoad`** — drag load (Warehouse'dan Abkant'a sürükleyerek)
5. **`Punch_Keeping`** — relocate edilmiş veya edilmemiş ama keep olan punch'ları **final pozisyonlarına** yerleştirme
6. **`Punch_Loading`** — geriye kalan direct load punch'ları (boş kalan pozisyonlara direkt yükleme)

## `Punch_Keeping`'in özel durumu
Bu FB'nin girdisi iki farklı kaynaktan geliyor:
- **Relocate edilmiş** keep punch'lar → mevcut konumları `Retain_RelocatePunchList` ile değişmiş olabilir, bunlar önce oradan okunmalı
- **Relocate edilmemiş** keep punch'lar → hâlâ eski konumunda (`Retain_KeepPunchList`), dokunulmamış

Her iki grup da:
- eski konumdan (relocate sonrası ya da orijinal) alınıp
- **yeni programdaki (`Retain_KeepPunchListNew`) final pozisyonuna** taşınacak

Bu, aslında bir **Abkant üzerinde iç hareket** (muhtemelen shuttle ile mevcut abkant pozisyonundan yeni abkant pozisyonuna) olacak; warehouse'a gidip gelme yok, çünkü punch zaten abkant üzerinde.

---

Devam etmek için, `Punch_Keeping` FB'nin:
- mevcut/taslak kodunu (varsa), veya
- referans alacağımız state/substate enum yapısını

paylaşabilir misin? Böylece `Punch_Loading`/`Punch_DraggLoad` ile aynı desende (state machine, engine ayrımı, enum isimlendirme) ilerleyebiliriz.

```
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Derived control *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
AutoRunEnable := Automatic_Page AND General_Start AND (NOT General_Stop);
risingStart := RelocateStartCmd AND NOT lastStartCmd;
ZOffset := REAL_TO_LREAL(Retain_ZParameters[19]);

(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* HARD ABORT *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
IF Abort_Cycle THEN
  RelocateStartAck := FALSE;
  RelocateBusy := FALSE;
  RelocateDone := FALSE;
  RelocateError := FALSE;

  Local_Shuttle_State := Shuttle_States.SH_IDLE;
  PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_IDLE;

  initiated := FALSE;
  Current_PunchIndex := 0;
  RelocateCount := 0;

  SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_DX_Done := FALSE;
  SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
  SH_Z_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_Z_Done := FALSE;

  PinsReady := FALSE;
  ClampReleased := FALSE;
  ClampEngaged := FALSE;

  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    RelocateActive[i] := FALSE;
    RelocateDoneArr[i] := FALSE;
    RelocateOldIndex[i] := 0;

    RelocateWidth[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateOldZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateCurrentZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateTargetZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateSafeZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateTargetCenter[i] := 0.0;
    RelocatePlacedStart[i] := 0.0;
    RelocatePlacedEnd[i] := 0.0;
  END_FOR;
END_IF;


(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* SOFT RESET *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
IF Reset THEN
  RelocateStartAck := FALSE;
  SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_DX_Done := FALSE;
  SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
  SH_Z_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_Z_Done := FALSE;
END_IF;


(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* START *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
IF risingStart AND (NOT initiated) THEN
  RelocateStartAck := TRUE;
  RelocateBusy := TRUE;
  RelocateDone := FALSE;
  RelocateError := FALSE;

  initiated := TRUE;
  Current_PunchIndex := 1;
  RelocateCount := 0;

  SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_DX_Done := FALSE;
  SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
  SH_Z_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_Z_Done := FALSE;

  PinsReady := FALSE;
  ClampReleased := FALSE;
  ClampEngaged := FALSE;

  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    RelocateActive[i] := FALSE;
    RelocateDoneArr[i] := FALSE;
    RelocateOldIndex[i] := 0;

    RelocateWidth[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateOldZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateCurrentZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateTargetZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateSafeZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateTargetCenter[i] := 0.0;
    RelocatePlacedStart[i] := 0.0;
    RelocatePlacedEnd[i] := 0.0;
  END_FOR;

  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
      RelocateCount := RelocateCount + 1;
      RelocateActive[i] := TRUE;

      IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,12] <> '' THEN
        RelocateOldIndex[i] := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,12]);
      ELSE
        RelocateOldIndex[i] := 0;
      END_IF;

      IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,7] <> '' THEN
        RelocateWidth[i] := STRING_TO_LREAL(Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,7]);
      ELSE
        RelocateWidth[i] := 0.0;
      END_IF;

      IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,6] <> '' THEN
        RelocateCurrentZ[i] := STRING_TO_LREAL(Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,6]) + ZOffset;
      ELSE
        RelocateCurrentZ[i] := ZOffset;
      END_IF;

      RelocateOldZ[i] := RelocateCurrentZ[i];
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  IF RelocateCount = 0 THEN
    RelocateBusy := FALSE;
    RelocateDone := TRUE;
    RelocateStartAck := FALSE;
    initiated := FALSE;
    Local_Shuttle_State := Shuttle_States.SH_IDLE;
    PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_IDLE;
  ELSE
    Local_Shuttle_State := Shuttle_States.PRG_Proccesing;
    PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_INIT_START;
  END_IF;
END_IF;


(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* PAUSE behaviour *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
IF initiated AND (NOT AutoRunEnable) THEN
  lastStartCmd := RelocateStartCmd;
  RETURN;
END_IF;


(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* MAIN STATE MACHINE *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
IF initiated THEN

  CASE Local_Shuttle_State OF

    Shuttle_States.PRG_Proccesing:

      CASE PRelocate_SH_SubStates OF

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_IDLE:
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_INIT_START;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_INIT_START:
          IF (Current_PunchIndex >= 1) AND (Current_PunchIndex <= RelocateCount) THEN
            IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,3] <> '' THEN
              PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_CHECK_LIST_EMPTY;
            ELSE
              PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_COMMIT_NEXT_INDEX;
            END_IF;
          ELSE

  END_FOR;

  (* STEP 1: validate new program *)
  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    NewName := PFields[i,3];
    IF NewName <> '' THEN
      newCount := newCount + 1;
      NewLen := PFields[i,7];

      foundIndex := 0;
      FOR j := 1 TO 16 DO
        IF pDrawerName[j] = NewName THEN
          foundIndex := j;
          EXIT;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;

      IF foundIndex = 0 THEN
        ValidityFlag := FALSE;
        PackageState := PPackageState.INVALID;
        NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.INVALID_ABORT;
        Error := TRUE;
        ErrorText := CONCAT('INVALID: missing ATC tool name: ', NewName);
        Busy := FALSE;
        Done := TRUE;
        RETURN;
      END_IF;

      IF NewLen = '' THEN
        ValidityFlag := FALSE;
        PackageState := PPackageState.INVALID;
        NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.INVALID_ABORT;
        Error := TRUE;
        ErrorText := CONCAT('INVALID: missing length for tool: ', NewName);
        Busy := FALSE;
        Done := TRUE;
        RETURN;
      END_IF;

      foundLengthMatch := FALSE;
      hasLengthValue := FALSE;
      NewLenReal := 0.0;
      IF NewLen <> '' THEN
        NewLenReal := STRING_TO_REAL(NewLen);
        hasLengthValue := TRUE;
      END_IF;

      IF hasLengthValue THEN
        FOR j := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[j] = NewName THEN
            FOR k := 1 TO 15 DO
              IF ABS(PunchLength[j, k] - NewLenReal) <= eps THEN
                foundLengthMatch := TRUE;
                EXIT;
              END_IF;
            END_FOR;
            IF foundLengthMatch THEN
              EXIT;
            END_IF;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
      END_IF;

      IF NOT foundLengthMatch THEN
        ValidityFlag := FALSE;
        PackageState := PPackageState.INVALID;
        NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.INVALID_ABORT;
        Error := TRUE;
        ErrorText := CONCAT('INVALID: requested length NOT found FOR tool: ', NewName);
        Busy := FALSE;
        Done := TRUE;
        RETURN;
      END_IF;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  (* STEP 2: keep matching *)
  OldAvailCount := 0;
  FOR j := 1 TO 15 DO
    OldName := PFields_Old[j,3];
    IF OldName <> '' THEN
      OldAvailCount := OldAvailCount + 1;
      OldAvailIndex[OldAvailCount] := j;
      OldMatched[j] := FALSE;
      oldCount := oldCount + 1;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    NewName := PFields[i,3];
    IF NewName <> '' THEN
      NewLen := PFields[i,7];
      NewHorn := PFields[i,9];
      NewRot := PFields[i,8];
      NewLenReal := 0.0;
      IF NewLen <> '' THEN
        NewLenReal := STRING_TO_REAL(NewLen);
      END_IF;

      NewMatchedToOld[i] := 0;
      a := 1;
      WHILE (a <= OldAvailCount) AND (NewMatchedToOld[i] = 0) DO
        j := OldAvailIndex[a];
        OldName := PFields_Old[j,3];
        IF OldName <> '' THEN
          OldLen := PFields_Old[j,7];
          OldHorn := PFields_Old[j,9];
          OldRot := PFields_Old[j,8];
          OldLenReal := 0.0;
          IF OldLen <> '' THEN
            OldLenReal := STRING_TO_REAL(OldLen);
          END_IF;

          IF (NewName = OldName) AND (NewHorn = OldHorn) AND (NewRot = OldRot) AND (ABS(NewLenReal - OldLenReal) <= eps) THEN
            OldMatched[j] := TRUE;
            KeepList[j] := TRUE;
            NewMatchedToOld[i] := j;
            FOR b := a TO OldAvailCount - 1 DO
              OldAvailIndex[b] := OldAvailIndex[b + 1];
            END_FOR;
            OldAvailCount := OldAvailCount - 1;
          ELSE
            a := a + 1;
          END_IF;
        ELSE
          a := a + 1;
        END_IF;
      END_WHILE;

      IF NewMatchedToOld[i] = 0 THEN
        LoadOnlyList[i] := TRUE;
      END_IF;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  FOR a := 1 TO OldAvailCount DO
    j := OldAvailIndex[a];
    IF PFields_Old[j,3] <> '' THEN
      UnloadOnlyList[j] := TRUE;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  (* STEP 3: validate load-only punches *)
  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    IF LoadOnlyList[i] THEN
      NewName := PFields[i,3];
      NewLen := PFields[i,7];
      foundLengthMatch := FALSE;
      hasLengthValue := FALSE;
      NewLenReal := 0.0;
      IF NewLen <> '' THEN
        NewLenReal := STRING_TO_REAL(NewLen);
        hasLengthValue := TRUE;
      END_IF;

      IF hasLengthValue THEN
        FOR j := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[j] = NewName THEN
            FOR k := 1 TO 15 DO
              IF (NOT PunchUsed[j,k]) AND (ABS(PunchLength[j, k] - NewLenReal) <= eps) THEN
                foundLengthMatch := TRUE;
                EXIT;
              END_IF;
            END_FOR;
            IF foundLengthMatch THEN
              EXIT;
            END_IF;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
      END_IF;

      IF NOT foundLengthMatch THEN
        ValidityFlag := FALSE;
        PackageState := PPackageState.INVALID;
        NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.INVALID_ABORT;
        Error := TRUE;
        ErrorText := CONCAT('INVALID: requested load punch length NOT available in free ATC punches FOR tool: ', NewName);
        Busy := FALSE;
        Done := TRUE;
        RETURN;
      END_IF;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  (* STEP 4: multiplicity check for load-only *)
  uniqCount := 0;
  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    IF LoadOnlyList[i] THEN
      foundIndex := 0;
      FOR a := 1 TO uniqCount DO
        IF (uniqName[a] = PFields[i,3]) AND (uniqLen[a] = PFields[i,7]) AND (uniqHorn[a] = PFields[i,9]) THEN
          foundIndex := a;
          EXIT;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;
      IF foundIndex = 0 THEN
        uniqCount := uniqCount + 1;
        uniqName[uniqCount] := PFields[i,3];
        uniqLen[uniqCount] := PFields[i,7];
        uniqHorn[uniqCount] := PFields[i,9];
        uniqNeeded[uniqCount] := 1;
      ELSE
        uniqNeeded[foundIndex] := uniqNeeded[foundIndex] + 1;
      END_IF;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  FOR a := 1 TO uniqCount DO
    NewName := uniqName[a];
    NewLen := uniqLen[a];
    NewHorn := uniqHorn[a];

    availCount := 0;
    IF (NewLen <> '') AND (NewHorn <> '') THEN
      NewLenReal := STRING_TO_REAL(NewLen);
      NewHornReal := STRING_TO_REAL(NewHorn);
      FOR e := 1 TO 16 DO
        IF pDrawerName[e] = NewName THEN
          FOR d := 1 TO 15 DO
            IF (NOT PunchUsed[e,d]) AND
               (ABS(PunchLength[e,d] - NewLenReal) <= eps) AND
               (ABS(PunchHorn[e,d] - NewHornReal) <= eps) THEN
              availCount := availCount + 1;
            END_IF;
          END_FOR;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;
    END_IF;

    IF availCount < uniqNeeded[a] THEN
      ValidityFlag := FALSE;
      PackageState := PPackageState.INVALID;
      NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.INVALID_ABORT;
      Error := TRUE;
      ErrorText := CONCAT('INVALID: insufficient FREE ATC slots for load tool ', NewName);
      Busy := FALSE;
      Done := TRUE;
      RETURN;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  (* SUMMARY *)
  numSame := 0;
  numDiff := 0;
  FOR j := 1 TO 15 DO
    IF KeepList[j] THEN numSame := numSame + 1; END_IF;
    IF UnloadOnlyList[j] THEN numDiff := numDiff + 1; END_IF;
  END_FOR;
  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    IF LoadOnlyList[i] THEN numDiff := numDiff + 1; END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  IF NOT ValidityFlag THEN
    PackageState := PPackageState.INVALID;
    NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.INVALID_ABORT;
  ELSE
    PackageState := PPackageState.PARTIAL_CHANGE;
    NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.NO_ACTION;
  END_IF;

  ValidityFlag := NOT Error;

  IF PackageState <> PPackageState.INVALID THEN
    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_LoadPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_KeepPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_KeepPunchListNew[i,j] := '';
        Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,j] := '';
      END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* pack unload *)
    UnloadTempCount := 0;
    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      IF UnloadOnlyList[i] THEN
        foundIndex := 0;
        FOR k := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[k] = PFields_Old[i,3] THEN
            foundIndex := k;
            EXIT;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
        IF foundIndex <> 0 THEN
          UnloadTempCount := UnloadTempCount + 1;
          UnloadTempOrigIndex[UnloadTempCount] := i;
          UnloadTempDrawerIdx[UnloadTempCount] := foundIndex;
          UnloadTempOrder[UnloadTempCount] := UnloadTempCount;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    FOR a := 1 TO UnloadTempCount - 1 DO
      minIdx := a;
      FOR b := a + 1 TO UnloadTempCount DO
        IF UnloadTempDrawerIdx[b] < UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] THEN
          minIdx := b;
        ELSIF (UnloadTempDrawerIdx[b] = UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx]) AND (UnloadTempOrder[b] < UnloadTempOrder[minIdx]) THEN
          minIdx := b;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;
      IF minIdx <> a THEN
        tmpInt := UnloadTempOrigIndex[a];
        UnloadTempOrigIndex[a] := UnloadTempOrigIndex[minIdx];
        UnloadTempOrigIndex[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := UnloadTempDrawerIdx[a];
        UnloadTempDrawerIdx[a] := UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx];
        UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := UnloadTempOrder[a];
        UnloadTempOrder[a] := UnloadTempOrder[minIdx];
        UnloadTempOrder[minIdx] := tmpInt;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    UnloadCount := 0;
    FOR a := 1 TO UnloadTempCount DO
      UnloadCount := UnloadCount + 1;
      i := UnloadTempOrigIndex[a];
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_UnloadPunchList[UnloadCount, j] := PFields_Old[i, j];
      END_FOR;
      Retain_UnloadPunchList[UnloadCount, 12] := INT_TO_STRING(i);
    END_FOR;

    (* pack load *)
    LoadTempCount := 0;
    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      IF LoadOnlyList[i] THEN
        foundIndex := 0;
        FOR k := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[k] = PFields[i,3] THEN
            foundIndex := k;
            EXIT;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
        IF foundIndex <> 0 THEN
          LoadTempCount := LoadTempCount + 1;
          LoadTempOrigIndex[LoadTempCount] := i;
          LoadTempDrawerIdx[LoadTempCount] := foundIndex;
          LoadTempOrder[LoadTempCount] := LoadTempCount;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    FOR a := 1 TO LoadTempCount - 1 DO
      minIdx := a;
      FOR b := a + 1 TO LoadTempCount DO
        IF LoadTempDrawerIdx[b] < LoadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] THEN
          minIdx := b;
        ELSIF (LoadTempDrawerIdx[b] = LoadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx]) AND (LoadTempOrder[b] < LoadTempOrder[minIdx]) THEN
          minIdx := b;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;
      IF minIdx <> a THEN
        tmpInt := LoadTempOrigIndex[a];
        LoadTempOrigIndex[a] := LoadTempOrigIndex[minIdx];
        LoadTempOrigIndex[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := LoadTempDrawerIdx[a];
        LoadTempDrawerIdx[a] := LoadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx];
        LoadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := LoadTempOrder[a];
        LoadTempOrder[a] := LoadTempOrder[minIdx];
        LoadTempOrder[minIdx] := tmpInt;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    LoadCount := 0;
    FOR a := 1 TO LoadTempCount DO
      LoadCount := LoadCount + 1;
      i := LoadTempOrigIndex[a];
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_LoadPunchList[LoadCount, j] := PFields[i, j];
      END_FOR;
      Retain_LoadPunchList[LoadCount, 12] := INT_TO_STRING(i);
    END_FOR;

    (* ATC load mapping *)
    FOR c := 1 TO 15 DO
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c, j] := '';
      END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    FOR e := 1 TO 16 DO
      FOR d := 1 TO 15 DO
        usedSlot[e,d] := FALSE;
      END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      NewAssignedDrawer[i] := 0;
      NewAssignedSlot[i] := 0;
    END_FOR;

    FOR c := 1 TO LoadCount DO
      origNewIdx := LoadTempOrigIndex[c];
      NewName := Retain_LoadPunchList[c,3];
      lenStr := Retain_LoadPunchList[c,7];
      hornStr := Retain_LoadPunchList[c,9];
      foundIndex := 0;

      IF (NewName <> '') AND (lenStr <> '') AND (hornStr <> '') THEN
        lenRealLocal := STRING_TO_REAL(lenStr);
        hornRealLocal := STRING_TO_REAL(hornStr);
        FOR e := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[e] = NewName THEN
            FOR d := 1 TO 15 DO
              IF (NOT usedSlot[e,d]) AND (NOT PunchUsed[e,d]) THEN
                IF (ABS(PunchLength[e,d] - lenRealLocal) <= eps) AND
                   (ABS(PunchHorn[e,d] - hornRealLocal) <= eps) THEN

                  usedSlot[e,d] := TRUE;
                  foundIndex := e;
                  Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,1] := pDrawerName[e];
                  Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,2] := PFields[i,2];
                  Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,3] := INT_TO_STRING(d);
                  Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,4] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchLength[e,d]);
                  Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,5] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchPosition[e,d]);
                  Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,6] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchHorn[e,d]);
                  Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,12] := INT_TO_STRING(origNewIdx);
                  NewAssignedDrawer[origNewIdx] := e;
                  NewAssignedSlot[origNewIdx] := d;
                  EXIT;
                END_IF;
              END_IF;
            END_FOR;
            IF foundIndex <> 0 THEN EXIT; END_IF;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    (* pack keep *)
    KeepTempCount := 0;
    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      IF KeepList[i] THEN
        foundIndex := 0;
        FOR k := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[k] = PFields_Old[i,3] THEN
            foundIndex := k;
            EXIT;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
        IF foundIndex <> 0 THEN
          KeepTempCount := KeepTempCount + 1;
          KeepTempOrigIndex[KeepTempCount] := i;
          KeepTempDrawerIdx[KeepTempCount] := foundIndex;
          KeepTempOrder[KeepTempCount] := KeepTempCount;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    FOR a := 1 TO KeepTempCount - 1 DO
      minIdx := a;
      FOR b := a + 1 TO KeepTempCount DO
        IF KeepTempDrawerIdx[b] < KeepTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] THEN
          minIdx := b;
        ELSIF (KeepTempDrawerIdx[b] = KeepTempDrawerIdx[minIdx]) AND (KeepTempOrder[b] < KeepTempOrder[minIdx]) THEN
          minIdx := b;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;
      IF minIdx <> a THEN
        tmpInt := KeepTempOrigIndex[a];
        KeepTempOrigIndex[a] := KeepTempOrigIndex[minIdx];
        KeepTempOrigIndex[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := KeepTempDrawerIdx[a];
        KeepTempDrawerIdx[a] := KeepTempDrawerIdx[minIdx];
        KeepTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := KeepTempOrder[a];
        KeepTempOrder[a] := KeepTempOrder[minIdx];
        KeepTempOrder[minIdx] := tmpInt;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    KeepCount := 0;
    FOR a := 1 TO KeepTempCount DO
      KeepCount := KeepCount + 1;
      i := KeepTempOrigIndex[a];
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_KeepPunchList[KeepCount, j] := PFields_Old[i, j];
        Retain_KeepPunchListNew[KeepCount, j] := '';
      END_FOR;
      Retain_KeepPunchList[KeepCount, 12] := INT_TO_STRING(i);

      tmpInt := 0;
      FOR b := 1 TO 15 DO
        IF NewMatchedToOld[b] = i THEN
          tmpInt := b;
          EXIT;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;

      IF tmpInt <> 0 THEN
        FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
          Retain_KeepPunchListNew[KeepCount, j] := PFields[tmpInt, j];
        END_FOR;
        Retain_KeepPunchListNew[KeepCount, 12] := INT_TO_STRING(tmpInt);
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    (* relocate selection *)
    RightmostDragUnloadPos := -1.0;
    RightmostDragLoadPos := -1.0;

    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      IF UnloadOnlyList[i] THEN
        eTmp := 0;
        IF PFields_Old[i,10] <> '' THEN
          eTmp := STRING_TO_INT(PFields_Old[i,10]);
        END_IF;
        IF (eTmp <> 4) AND (eTmp <> 8) AND (eTmp <> 12) AND (eTmp <> 16) THEN
          IF PFields_Old[i,6] > '' THEN
            tmpPos := STRING_TO_LREAL(PFields_Old[i,6]);
            IF tmpPos > RightmostDragUnloadPos THEN
              RightmostDragUnloadPos := tmpPos;
            END_IF;
          END_IF;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      IF LoadOnlyList[i] THEN
        eTmp := 0;
        IF PFields[i,10] <> '' THEN
          eTmp := STRING_TO_INT(PFields[i,10]);
        END_IF;
        IF (eTmp <> 4) AND (eTmp <> 8) AND (eTmp <> 12) AND (eTmp <> 16) THEN
          IF PFields[i,6] > '' THEN
            tmpPos := STRING_TO_LREAL(PFields[i,6]);
            IF tmpPos > RightmostDragLoadPos THEN
              RightmostDragLoadPos := tmpPos;
            END_IF;
          END_IF;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    IF RightmostDragUnloadPos < 0.0 THEN RightmostDragUnloadPos := 0.0; END_IF;
    IF RightmostDragLoadPos < 0.0 THEN RightmostDragLoadPos := 0.0; END_IF;

    RelocateThreshold := MAX(RightmostDragUnloadPos, RightmostDragLoadPos);

    RelocateCount := 0;
    FOR a := 1 TO KeepCount DO
      i := KeepTempOrigIndex[a];
      hasRelocateOverlap := FALSE;

      IF PFields_Old[i,6] > '' THEN
        tmpPos := STRING_TO_LREAL(PFields_Old[i,6]);

        IF tmpPos < RelocateThreshold THEN
          hasRelocateOverlap := TRUE;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;

      IF hasRelocateOverlap THEN
        RelocateCount := RelocateCount + 1;
        FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
          Retain_RelocatePunchList[RelocateCount, j] := Retain_KeepPunchList[a, j];
        END_FOR;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    Busy := FALSE;
    Done := TRUE;
  ELSE
    Busy := FALSE;
    Done := TRUE;
  END_IF;

END_IF;
RelocateTrashold_Value:=RelocateThreshold;
```
Bende hali hazırda bir Punch_Keeping FB var sana tüm detayları ile paylaşacağım ancak, Öncelikle netleştirmemiz gereken konular var. 
1. konu Punch_Relocate FB içinde relocate işlemi yapıldıktan onra Relocate edilen Punch dataları özellikle pozisyon bilgisi değişeceğinden hangi listelerde tutuluyor ve hangi listelere ekleniyor. 
Bu önemli 
ekte punch relocate fonksiyonumu paylaşıyorum. 
Ayrıca PunchChanger kodumuda veriyorum.
