## Copilot

# Analiz: Relocate Edilen Punch Verisi Nerede Tutuluyor?

`Punch_Relocate` kodunu ve `PunchChanger` kodunu birlikte incelediğimde kritik bir nokta ortaya çıkıyor.

---

## 1) Relocate işlemi sırasında hangi listeler kullanılıyor?

### Kaynak (okuma)
```iecst
Retain_RelocatePunchList[i, *]
```
Bu liste `PunchChanger` tarafından, `Trigger` anında **bir kerelik** dolduruluyor:

```iecst
Retain_RelocatePunchList[RelocateCount, j] := Retain_KeepPunchList[a, j];
```

Yani `Retain_RelocatePunchList`, `Retain_KeepPunchList`'in **relocate gerektiren alt kümesinin bir kopyası**.

### Hedef (yazma) — kritik nokta burada
`Punch_Relocate` fiziksel hareket bittikten sonra **tek bir yere** commit yapıyor:

```iecst
PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_COMMIT_UPDATE_PFIELDS:
  CommitOldIndex := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,12]);

  IF (CommitOldIndex >= 1) AND (CommitOldIndex <= 15) THEN
    PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,5]  := Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,5];
    PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,6]  := LREAL_TO_STRING(RelocateTargetZ[Current_PunchIndex] - ZOffset);
    PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,10] := Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,10];
    PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,11] := Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,11];
    PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,12] := Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,12];
  END_IF;
```

**Yani relocate sonrası güncellenen tek yer `PFields_Old`'dur** — özellikle **6. sütun (Z pozisyonu)**.

---

## 2) Kritik problem: `Retain_KeepPunchList` GÜNCELLENMİYOR

`Retain_KeepPunchList`, `PunchChanger` `Trigger` anında (yani relocate işleminden **önce**) şu şekilde dolduruluyor:

```iecst
Retain_KeepPunchList[KeepCount, j] := PFields_Old[i, j];
```

Bu bir **snapshot** (o anki fotoğraf). Relocate işlemi daha sonra, ayrı bir cycle'da / ayrı bir FB çağrısında çalışıyor ve **sadece `PFields_Old`'u güncelliyor** — `Retain_KeepPunchList`'e dokunmuyor.

### Sonuç
Relocate edilmiş bir punch için:
- `PFields_Old[orig_index, 6]` → **güncel (yeni) pozisyon**
- `Retain_KeepPunchList[keep_index, 6]` → **eski (relocate öncesi) pozisyon, artık YANLIŞ/STALE**

`Retain_RelocatePunchList` de aynı şekilde günceleme almıyor, o da relocate öncesi pozisyonun kopyası olarak kalıyor.

---

## 3) Bu, `Punch_Keeping` için ne anlama geliyor?

`Punch_Keeping` eğer pick pozisyonunu doğrudan `Retain_KeepPunchList[i,6]`'dan okursa:

- **Relocate edilmemiş** keep punch'lar için → doğru (çünkü hiç değişmedi)
- **Relocate edilmiş** keep punch'lar için → **yanlış pozisyona gidecek**, çünkü liste stale kalmış

### Nasıl ayırt edilir?
`Retain_RelocatePunchList[*, 12]` içindeki orig index'ler, relocate edilmiş punch'ların `PFields_Old` orijinal indexleridir. `Retain_KeepPunchList[*, 12]` içinde de aynı orig index tutuluyor (`INT_TO_STRING(i)` ile).

Yani eşleştirme mümkün: `Retain_KeepPunchList[k,12] == Retain_RelocatePunchList[r,12]` olan satırlar **relocate edilmiş** demektir.

---

## 4) Çözüm seçenekleri — sana sormam gereken karar noktası

### Seçenek A — `Punch_Keeping` pozisyonu her zaman `PFields_Old`'dan okusun
`Retain_KeepPunchList[i,6]` yerine, `Retain_KeepPunchList[i,12]`'den orig index alınıp:
```iecst
tmpOrigIdx := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_KeepPunchList[i,12]);
currentZ := STRING_TO_LREAL(PFields_Old[tmpOrigIdx,6]);
```
şeklinde **canlı veri** kullanılır. Böylece relocate olsun olmasın her zaman güncel pozisyon garanti edilir.

**Avantaj:** Tek kaynaktan okuma, senkron sorunu tamamen ortadan kalkar.

### Seçenek B — `Punch_Relocate` bitince `Retain_KeepPunchList`'i de senkronize etsin
`PRSH_COMMIT_UPDATE_PFIELDS` içine ek olarak:
```iecst
FOR m := 1 TO 15 DO
  IF Retain_KeepPunchList[m,12] = Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,12] THEN
    Retain_KeepPunchList[m,6] := LREAL_TO_STRING(RelocateTargetZ[Current_PunchIndex] - ZOffset);
    EXIT;
  END_IF;
END_FOR;
```
eklenir, böylece `Retain_KeepPunchList` her zaman güncel kalır.

**Avantaj:** `Punch_Keeping` değişmeden mevcut `Retain_KeepPunchList` mantığıyla çalışabilir.

---

## 5) Ekstra gözlem — `Retain_KeepPunchListNew` etkilenmiyor
`Retain_KeepPunchListNew`, **yeni programdaki final hedef veriyi** tutuyor (`PFields[tmpInt, j]`). Bu, relocate'ten bağımsız — zaten değişmesi gereken bir şey değil, doğru duruyor.

---

## Sormam gereken netleştirme sorusu

**Seçenek A mı Seçenek B mi tercih edilsin?**

- **A**: `Punch_Keeping`, pick pozisyonunu her zaman `PFields_Old` üzerinden orig index ile çekecek (daha güvenli, tek kaynak of truth)
- **B**: `Punch_Relocate` kendi committ ettiğinde `Retain_KeepPunchList`'i de senkron tutacak (mevcut `Punch_Keeping` tasarımını değiştirmeden kullanmaya izin verir)

Bu kararı verdikten sonra `Punch_Keeping` kodunu paylaşabilirsin, ona göre uyarlamayı netleştiririz.

## @snnrcpglu1677

Ben seçenek B diyorum.  Çünkü Punch_Keeping güncellerken direk Retain_KeepPunchList'i işletirim. İşimi çok kolaylaştırır. 


## Copilot

Tamam, **B seçeneğini uyguluyoruz**: `Punch_Relocate` tamamlandıktan sonra `Retain_KeepPunchList` de aynı relocate sonucu ile güncellenecek. Böylece `Punch_Keeping`, doğrudan güncel `Retain_KeepPunchList` üzerinden çalışabilecek.

## Güncellenecek alanlar

Relocate sonrası şu alanlar senkronize edilmeli:

- sütun `5`
- sütun `6` → yeni Z pozisyonu
- sütun `10` → drawer no
- sütun `11` → slot no
- sütun `12` → orijinal program indexi

`Retain_KeepPunchListNew` değiştirilmemeli; o liste yeni programdaki **final hedef bilgileri** taşıyor.

## `Punch_Relocate` içine eklenecek değişiklik

`PRSH_COMMIT_UPDATE_PFIELDS` state’ini aşağıdaki gibi güncelle:

```text name=Punch_Relocate.txt
PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_COMMIT_UPDATE_PFIELDS:
  CommitOldIndex := 0;

  IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,12] <> '' THEN
    CommitOldIndex := STRING_TO_INT(
      Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,12]
    );
  END_IF;

  IF (CommitOldIndex >= 1) AND (CommitOldIndex <= 15) THEN

    (* -------------------------------------------------------- *)
    (* Güncel fiziksel konumu PFields_Old içine commit et       *)
    (* -------------------------------------------------------- *)
    PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,5] :=
      Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,5];

    PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,6] :=
      LREAL_TO_STRING(
        RelocateTargetZ[Current_PunchIndex] - ZOffset
      );

    PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,10] :=
      Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,10];

    PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,11] :=
      Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,11];

    PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,12] :=
      Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,12];

    (* -------------------------------------------------------- *)
    (* Retain_KeepPunchList senkronizasyonu                    *)
    (* -------------------------------------------------------- *)
    FOR m := 1 TO 15 DO

      IF Retain_KeepPunchList[m,12] =
         Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,12] THEN

        Retain_KeepPunchList[m,5] :=
          Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,5];

        Retain_KeepPunchList[m,6] :=
          LREAL_TO_STRING(
            RelocateTargetZ[Current_PunchIndex] - ZOffset
          );

        Retain_KeepPunchList[m,10] :=
          Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,10];

        Retain_KeepPunchList[m,11] :=
          Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,11];

        Retain_KeepPunchList[m,12] :=
          Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,12];

        EXIT;
      END_IF;

    END_FOR;
  END_IF;

  PRelocate_SH_SubStates :=
    PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_COMMIT_UPDATE_RETAIN;
```

## Değişken tanımı

`Punch_Relocate` FB’nin `VAR` veya `VAR RETAIN` bölümüne şu değişkeni ekle:

```text name=Punch_Relocate.txt
m : INT;
```

## Neden `Retain_KeepPunchListNew` güncellenmiyor?

Çünkü:

```text
Retain_KeepPunchList
```

mevcut punch’ın relocate sonrası **gerçek konumunu** taşır.

Buna karşılık:

```text
Retain_KeepPunchListNew
```

yeni programdaki punch’ın ulaşması gereken **final hedef konumunu** taşır.

Bu nedenle relocate tamamlanınca yalnızca mevcut konum tarafı güncellenmelidir.

## Sonraki `Punch_Keeping` davranışı

Artık `Punch_Keeping` şu yapıyla çalışabilir:

- `Retain_KeepPunchList[i,6]` → relocate sonrası güncel mevcut Z
- `Retain_KeepPunchListNew[i,6]` → yeni programdaki hedef Z
- `Retain_KeepPunchList[i,10/11]` → mevcut fiziksel drawer/slot
- `Retain_KeepPunchListNew[i,10/11]` → hedef drawer/slot

Böylece relocate edilmiş ve edilmemiş keep punch’lar aynı FB içinde aynı mantıkla işlenebilir.

`Punch_Relocate` kodunda `Retain_KeepPunchList` senkronizasyonu için iki değişiklik gerekir:

2. `PRSH_COMMIT_UPDATE_PFIELDS` state’inin aşağıdaki sürümle değiştirilmesi  

Paylaştığın mevcut implementation’ın geri kalan kısmı aynı kalabilir.

## 1. `VAR` bölümüne eklenecek değişken

VAR
  m : INT;
END_VAR
```

## 2. Güncellenmiş tam commit state’i

Mevcut şu bölümü:

```iecst
PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_COMMIT_UPDATE_PFIELDS:
  CommitOldIndex := 0;
  IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,12] <> '' THEN
    CommitOldIndex := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,12]);
  END_IF;

    PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,5] := Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,5];
    PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,6] := LREAL_TO_STRING(RelocateTargetZ[Current_PunchIndex] - ZOffset);
    PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,10] := Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,10];
    PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,11] := Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,11];
    PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,12] := Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,12];

şununla değiştir:

```text name=Punch_Relocate.txt
PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_COMMIT_UPDATE_PFIELDS:
  CommitOldIndex := 0;

  IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,12] <> '' THEN
    CommitOldIndex :=
      STRING_TO_INT(
        Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,12]
      );
  END_IF;


  (* ---------------------------------------------------------- *)
  (* Validate original PFields_Old index                       *)
  (* ---------------------------------------------------------- *)
  IF (CommitOldIndex >= 1) AND (CommitOldIndex <= 15) THEN

    (* -------------------------------------------------------- *)
    (* Update live/current punch data in PFields_Old            *)
    (* -------------------------------------------------------- *)
    PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,5] :=
      Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,5];

    PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,6] :=
      LREAL_TO_STRING(
        RelocateTargetZ[Current_PunchIndex] - ZOffset
      );

    PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,10] :=
      Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,10];

    PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,11] :=
      Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,11];

    PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,12] :=
      Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,12];


    (* -------------------------------------------------------- *)
    (* Synchronize current data in Retain_KeepPunchList         *)
    (* -------------------------------------------------------- *)
    FOR m := 1 TO 15 DO

      IF Retain_KeepPunchList[m,12] =
         Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,12] THEN

        Retain_KeepPunchList[m,5] :=
          Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,5];

        Retain_KeepPunchList[m,6] :=
          LREAL_TO_STRING(
            RelocateTargetZ[Current_PunchIndex] - ZOffset
          );

        Retain_KeepPunchList[m,10] :=
          Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,10];

        Retain_KeepPunchList[m,11] :=
          Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,11];

        Retain_KeepPunchList[m,12] :=
          Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,12];

        EXIT;
      END_IF;

    END_FOR;

  ELSE
    (* Geçersiz orijinal index *)
    RelocateError := TRUE;
  END_IF;


  PRelocate_SH_SubStates :=
    PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_COMMIT_UPDATE_RETAIN;
```

## Sonuç

Relocate tamamlandıktan sonra aynı punch için iki veri kaynağı güncel kalacak:

```iecst
PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,*]
Retain_KeepPunchList[m,*]
```

Güncellenen alanlar:

```iecst
[5]  (* pozisyon/ilgili mevcut alan *)
[6]  (* yeni Z pozisyonu *)
[10] (* drawer no *)
[11] (* slot no *)
[12] (* orijinal PFields index *)
```

`Retain_KeepPunchListNew` güncellenmeyecek; çünkü bu liste punch’ın yeni programdaki **hedef/final konumunu** temsil ediyor.

> Not: Paylaştığın mevcut `Punch_Relocate` mesajında `VAR` deklarasyon bölümü bulunmadığı için, tüm FB deklarasyonlarını güvenli biçimde yeniden yazmadan mevcut implementation’ın tamamını tekrar üretmek yerine, doğrudan tam olarak değiştirilecek commit state’ini verdim. Bu blok mevcut koduna yerleştirildiğinde senkronizasyon çalışır.

```
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Derived control *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
AutoRunEnable := Automatic_Page AND General_Start AND (NOT General_Stop);
risingStart := RelocateStartCmd AND NOT lastStartCmd;
ZOffset := REAL_TO_LREAL(Retain_ZParameters[19]);

(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* HARD ABORT *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
IF Abort_Cycle THEN
  RelocateStartAck := FALSE;
  RelocateBusy := FALSE;
  RelocateDone := FALSE;
  RelocateError := FALSE;

  Local_Shuttle_State := Shuttle_States.SH_IDLE;
  PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_IDLE;

  initiated := FALSE;
  Current_PunchIndex := 0;
  RelocateCount := 0;

  SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_DX_Done := FALSE;
  SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
  SH_Z_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_Z_Done := FALSE;

  PinsReady := FALSE;
  ClampReleased := FALSE;
  ClampEngaged := FALSE;

  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    RelocateActive[i] := FALSE;
    RelocateDoneArr[i] := FALSE;
    RelocateOldIndex[i] := 0;

    RelocateWidth[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateOldZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateCurrentZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateTargetZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateSafeZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateTargetCenter[i] := 0.0;
    RelocatePlacedStart[i] := 0.0;
    RelocatePlacedEnd[i] := 0.0;
  END_FOR;
END_IF;


(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* SOFT RESET *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
IF Reset THEN
  RelocateStartAck := FALSE;
  SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_DX_Done := FALSE;
  SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
  SH_Z_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_Z_Done := FALSE;
END_IF;


(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* START *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
IF risingStart AND (NOT initiated) THEN
  RelocateStartAck := TRUE;
  RelocateBusy := TRUE;
  RelocateDone := FALSE;
  RelocateError := FALSE;

  initiated := TRUE;
  Current_PunchIndex := 1;
  RelocateCount := 0;

  SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_DX_Done := FALSE;
  SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
  SH_Z_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_Z_Done := FALSE;

  PinsReady := FALSE;
  ClampReleased := FALSE;
  ClampEngaged := FALSE;

  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    RelocateActive[i] := FALSE;
    RelocateDoneArr[i] := FALSE;
    RelocateOldIndex[i] := 0;

    RelocateWidth[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateOldZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateCurrentZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateTargetZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateSafeZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateTargetCenter[i] := 0.0;
    RelocatePlacedStart[i] := 0.0;
    RelocatePlacedEnd[i] := 0.0;
  END_FOR;

  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
      RelocateCount := RelocateCount + 1;
      RelocateActive[i] := TRUE;

      IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,12] <> '' THEN
        RelocateOldIndex[i] := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,12]);
      ELSE
        RelocateOldIndex[i] := 0;
      END_IF;

      IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,7] <> '' THEN
        RelocateWidth[i] := STRING_TO_LREAL(Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,7]);
      ELSE
        RelocateWidth[i] := 0.0;
      END_IF;

      IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,6] <> '' THEN
        RelocateCurrentZ[i] := STRING_TO_LREAL(Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,6]) + ZOffset;
      ELSE
        RelocateCurrentZ[i] := ZOffset;
      END_IF;

      RelocateOldZ[i] := RelocateCurrentZ[i];
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  IF RelocateCount = 0 THEN
    RelocateBusy := FALSE;
    RelocateDone := TRUE;
    RelocateStartAck := FALSE;
    initiated := FALSE;
    Local_Shuttle_State := Shuttle_States.SH_IDLE;
    PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_IDLE;
  ELSE
    Local_Shuttle_State := Shuttle_States.PRG_Proccesing;
    PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_INIT_START;
  END_IF;
END_IF;


(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* PAUSE behaviour *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
IF initiated AND (NOT AutoRunEnable) THEN
  lastStartCmd := RelocateStartCmd;
  RETURN;
END_IF;


(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* MAIN STATE MACHINE *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
IF initiated THEN

  CASE Local_Shuttle_State OF

    Shuttle_States.PRG_Proccesing:

      CASE PRelocate_SH_SubStates OF

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_IDLE:
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_INIT_START;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_INIT_START:
          IF (Current_PunchIndex >= 1) AND (Current_PunchIndex <= RelocateCount) THEN
            IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,3] <> '' THEN
              PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_CHECK_LIST_EMPTY;
            ELSE
              PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_COMMIT_NEXT_INDEX;
            END_IF;
          ELSE
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_FINISHED;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_CHECK_LIST_EMPTY:
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PREP_CURRENT_INDEX;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PREP_CURRENT_INDEX:
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_LOAD_SOURCE;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_LOAD_SOURCE:
          IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,3] <> '' THEN
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_DRAWER_NO;
          ELSE
            RelocateError := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ERROR;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_DRAWER_NO:
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_PICK_Z;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_PICK_Z:
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_SAFE_POS;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_SAFE_POS:
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_NEXT_SAFE_POS;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_NEXT_SAFE_POS:
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_CHECK_INSIDE;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_CHECK_INSIDE:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Inside THEN
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_CHECK_INSIDE;
          ELSE
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_MOVE_INSIDE_CMD;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_MOVE_INSIDE_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Inside_Valve := TRUE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Outside_Valve := FALSE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_WAIT_INSIDE;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_WAIT_INSIDE:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Inside THEN
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Inside_Valve := FALSE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_CHECK_INSIDE;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_CHECK_INSIDE:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Inside THEN
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_SAFE_REQ;
          ELSE
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_MOVE_INSIDE_CMD;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_MOVE_INSIDE_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Inside_Valve := TRUE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Outside_Valve := FALSE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_WAIT_INSIDE;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_WAIT_INSIDE:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Inside THEN
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Inside_Valve := FALSE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_SAFE_REQ;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_SAFE_REQ:
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(Retain_DXParameters[4]);
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
          SH_DX_MoveRequested := TRUE;
          SH_DX_Done := FALSE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_SAFE_WAIT;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_SAFE_WAIT:
          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos) <= KeepPosEps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DX_Done := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_PICK_REQ;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_PICK_REQ:
          tmpDrawerNo := 0;
          IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,10] <> '' THEN
            tmpDrawerNo := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,10]);
          END_IF;

          IF tmpDrawerNo <> 0 THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(pDrawerParam6[tmpDrawerNo]);
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
            SH_DR_MoveRequested := TRUE;
            SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_PICK_WAIT;
          ELSE
            RelocateError := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ERROR;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_PICK_WAIT:
          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos) <= KeepPosEps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DR_Done := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_Z_PICK_REQ;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_Z_PICK_REQ:
          tmpCurrentPos := 0.0;
          IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,6] <> '' THEN
            tmpCurrentPos := STRING_TO_LREAL(Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,6]) + ZOffset;
          END_IF;

          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].TargetPos := tmpCurrentPos;
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
          SH_Z_MoveRequested := TRUE;
          SH_Z_Done := FALSE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_Z_PICK_WAIT;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_Z_PICK_WAIT:
          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].TargetPos) <= KeepPosEps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_Z_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_Z_Done := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_PICK_ALIGN_REQ;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_PICK_ALIGN_REQ:
          tmpDrawerNo := 0;
          IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,10] <> '' THEN
            tmpDrawerNo := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,10]);
          END_IF;

          IF tmpDrawerNo <> 0 THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(Retain_DXParameters[4]);
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
            SH_DX_MoveRequested := TRUE;
            SH_DX_Done := FALSE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_PICK_ALIGN_WAIT;
          ELSE
            RelocateError := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ERROR;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_PICK_ALIGN_WAIT:
          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos) <= KeepPosEps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DX_Done := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_OUT_CMD;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_OUT_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Inside_Valve := FALSE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Outside_Valve := TRUE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_OUT_WAIT;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_OUT_WAIT:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Outside THEN
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Outside_Valve := FALSE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_OUT_CMD;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_OUT_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Inside_Valve := FALSE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Outside_Valve := TRUE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_OUT_WAIT;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_OUT_WAIT:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Outside THEN
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Outside_Valve := FALSE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_CLAMP_OFF_CMD;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_CLAMP_OFF_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Press_Upper_ClampOn := FALSE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_CLAMP_OFF_WAIT;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_CLAMP_OFF_WAIT:
          IF NOT Fmsc_PLC_IO.Press_Upper_Clamp_Ok THEN
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_WITHDRAW_SLOW_REQ;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_WITHDRAW_SLOW_REQ:
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisAutoSetVelocity := Retain_DRParameters[2];
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos := arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - TO_LREAL(Retain_DRParameters[4]);
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
          SH_DR_MoveRequested := TRUE;
          SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_WITHDRAW_SLOW_WAIT;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_WITHDRAW_SLOW_WAIT:
          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos) <= KeepPosEps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DR_Done := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_Z_RELOCATE_SAFE_REQ;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_Z_RELOCATE_SAFE_REQ:
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].TargetPos := RelocateTargetZ[Current_PunchIndex];
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
          SH_Z_MoveRequested := TRUE;
          SH_Z_Done := FALSE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_Z_RELOCATE_SAFE_WAIT;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_Z_RELOCATE_SAFE_WAIT:
          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].TargetPos) <= KeepPosEps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_Z_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_Z_Done := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_PLACE_ALIGN_REQ;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_PLACE_ALIGN_REQ:
          tmpDrawerNo := 0;
          IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,10] <> '' THEN
            tmpDrawerNo := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,10]);
          END_IF;

          IF tmpDrawerNo <> 0 THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(Retain_DXParameters[4]);
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
            SH_DX_MoveRequested := TRUE;
            SH_DX_Done := FALSE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_PLACE_ALIGN_WAIT;
          ELSE
            RelocateError := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ERROR;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_PLACE_ALIGN_WAIT:
          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos) <= KeepPosEps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DX_Done := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_INSERT_SLOW_REQ;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_INSERT_SLOW_REQ:
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisAutoSetVelocity := Retain_DRParameters[2];
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos := arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos + TO_LREAL(Retain_DRParameters[4]);
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
          SH_DR_MoveRequested := TRUE;
          SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_INSERT_SLOW_WAIT;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_INSERT_SLOW_WAIT:
          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos) <= KeepPosEps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DR_Done := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_CLAMP_ON_CMD;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_CLAMP_ON_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Press_Upper_ClampOn := TRUE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_CLAMP_ON_WAIT;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_CLAMP_ON_WAIT:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Press_Upper_Clamp_Ok THEN
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_IN_CMD;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_IN_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Inside_Valve := TRUE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Outside_Valve := FALSE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_IN_WAIT;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_IN_WAIT:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Inside THEN
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Inside_Valve := FALSE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_IN_CMD;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_IN_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Inside_Valve := TRUE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Outside_Valve := FALSE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_IN_WAIT;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_IN_WAIT:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Inside THEN
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Inside_Valve := FALSE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_COMMIT_UPDATE_PFIELDS;
          END_IF;

		PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_COMMIT_UPDATE_PFIELDS:
		  CommitOldIndex := 0;
		
		  IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,12] <> '' THEN
			CommitOldIndex :=
			  STRING_TO_INT(
				Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,12]
			  );
		  END_IF;
		
		
		  (* ---------------------------------------------------------- *)
		  (* Validate original PFields_Old index                       *)
		  (* ---------------------------------------------------------- *)
		  IF (CommitOldIndex >= 1) AND (CommitOldIndex <= 15) THEN
		
			(* -------------------------------------------------------- *)
			(* Update live/current punch data in PFields_Old            *)
			(* -------------------------------------------------------- *)
			PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,5] :=
			  Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,5];
		
			PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,6] :=
			  LREAL_TO_STRING(
				RelocateTargetZ[Current_PunchIndex] - ZOffset
			  );
		
			PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,10] :=
			  Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,10];
		
			PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,11] :=
			  Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,11];
		
			PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,12] :=
			  Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,12];
		
		
			(* -------------------------------------------------------- *)
			(* Synchronize current data in Retain_KeepPunchList         *)
			(* -------------------------------------------------------- *)
			FOR m := 1 TO 15 DO
		
			  IF Retain_KeepPunchList[m,12] =
				 Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,12] THEN
		
				Retain_KeepPunchList[m,5] :=
				  Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,5];
		
				Retain_KeepPunchList[m,6] :=
				  LREAL_TO_STRING(
					RelocateTargetZ[Current_PunchIndex] - ZOffset
				  );
		
				Retain_KeepPunchList[m,10] :=
				  Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,10];
		
				Retain_KeepPunchList[m,11] :=
				  Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,11];
		
				Retain_KeepPunchList[m,12] :=
				  Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,12];
		
				EXIT;
			  END_IF;
		
			END_FOR;
		
		  ELSE
			(* Geçersiz orijinal index *)
			RelocateError := TRUE;
		  END_IF;
		
		
		  PRelocate_SH_SubStates :=	PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_COMMIT_UPDATE_RETAIN;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_COMMIT_UPDATE_RETAIN:
          IF (Current_PunchIndex >= 1) AND (Current_PunchIndex <= 15) THEN
            RelocateDoneArr[Current_PunchIndex] := TRUE;
            RelocateActive[Current_PunchIndex] := FALSE;
          END_IF;

          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_COMMIT_NEXT_INDEX;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_COMMIT_NEXT_INDEX:
          Current_PunchIndex := Current_PunchIndex + 1;
          IF Current_PunchIndex > RelocateCount THEN
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_FINISHED;
          ELSE
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_INIT_START;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_FINISHED:
          RelocateBusy := FALSE;
          RelocateDone := TRUE;
          RelocateStartAck := FALSE;
          initiated := FALSE;
          Local_Shuttle_State := Shuttle_States.SH_IDLE;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ERROR:
          RelocateBusy := FALSE;
          RelocateDone := FALSE;
          RelocateStartAck := FALSE;
          RelocateError := TRUE;
          initiated := FALSE;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ABORT:
          RelocateBusy := FALSE;
          RelocateDone := FALSE;
          RelocateStartAck := FALSE;
          initiated := FALSE;

        ELSE
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ERROR;
      END_CASE;

    ELSE
      ;
  END_CASE;
END_IF;


(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Edge memory update *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
lastStartCmd := RelocateStartCmd;
```

## Copilot

Kod akışını kontrol ettim. `PRSH_COMMIT_UPDATE_PFIELDS` geçişi artık doğru:

```iecst
PRelocate_SH_SubStates :=
  PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_COMMIT_UPDATE_RETAIN;
```

Ardından:

```iecst
PRelocate_SH_SubStates :=
  PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_COMMIT_NEXT_INDEX;
```

şeklinde devam ediyor.

Ancak mevcut kodda iki zorunlu düzeltme var.

---

## 1. `m` değişkeni tanımlı olmalı

`VAR` bölümüne ekle:

```iecst
m : INT;
```

Ayrıca aşağıdaki değişkenlerin de deklarasyon bölümünde bulunduğunu doğrula:

```iecst
CommitOldIndex : INT;
tmpDrawerNo    : INT;
tmpCurrentPos  : LREAL;
KeepPosEps     : REAL;
ZOffset        : LREAL;
```

---

## 2. HARD ABORT sonunda `RETURN` olmalı

Mevcut `Abort_Cycle` bloğunun sonunda yalnızca:

```iecst
END_IF;
```

varsa, abort sonrasında aynı PLC çevriminde state machine çalışmaya devam edebilir.

Şu şekilde değiştir:

```iecst
  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    RelocateActive[i] := FALSE;
    RelocateDoneArr[i] := FALSE;
    RelocateOldIndex[i] := 0;

    RelocateWidth[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateOldZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateCurrentZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateTargetZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateSafeZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateTargetCenter[i] := 0.0;
    RelocatePlacedStart[i] := 0.0;
    RelocatePlacedEnd[i] := 0.0;
  END_FOR;

  RETURN;
END_IF;
```

## Güncel commit bölümü

Aşağıdaki bölümü mevcut kodundaki `PRSH_COMMIT_UPDATE_PFIELDS` ile değiştir:

```iecst
        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_COMMIT_UPDATE_PFIELDS:
          CommitOldIndex := 0;

          IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,12] <> '' THEN
            CommitOldIndex :=
              STRING_TO_INT(
                Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,12]
              );
          END_IF;

          IF (CommitOldIndex >= 1) AND
             (CommitOldIndex <= 15) THEN

            (* ------------------------------------------------ *)
            (* Güncel fiziksel konumu PFields_Old içine yaz     *)
            (* ------------------------------------------------ *)
            PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,5] :=
              Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,5];

            PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,6] :=
              LREAL_TO_STRING(
                RelocateTargetZ[Current_PunchIndex] - ZOffset
              );

            PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,10] :=
              Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,10];

            PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,11] :=
              Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,11];

            PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,12] :=
              Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,12];


            (* ------------------------------------------------ *)
            (* Retain_KeepPunchList senkronizasyonu             *)
            (* ------------------------------------------------ *)
            FOR m := 1 TO 15 DO

              IF Retain_KeepPunchList[m,12] =
                 Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,12] THEN

                Retain_KeepPunchList[m,5] :=
                  Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,5];

                Retain_KeepPunchList[m,6] :=
                  LREAL_TO_STRING(
                    RelocateTargetZ[Current_PunchIndex] - ZOffset
                  );

                Retain_KeepPunchList[m,10] :=
                  Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,10];

                Retain_KeepPunchList[m,11] :=
                  Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,11];

                Retain_KeepPunchList[m,12] :=
                  Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,12];

                EXIT;
              END_IF;

            END_FOR;

          ELSE
            RelocateError := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates :=
              PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ERROR;
          END_IF;

          IF NOT RelocateError THEN
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates :=
              PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_COMMIT_UPDATE_RETAIN;
          END_IF;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_COMMIT_UPDATE_RETAIN:
          IF (Current_PunchIndex >= 1) AND
             (Current_PunchIndex <= RelocateCount) THEN

            RelocateDoneArr[Current_PunchIndex] := TRUE;
            RelocateActive[Current_PunchIndex] := FALSE;
          END_IF;

          PRelocate_SH_SubStates :=
            PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_COMMIT_NEXT_INDEX;


        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_COMMIT_NEXT_INDEX:
          Current_PunchIndex := Current_PunchIndex + 1;

          IF Current_PunchIndex > RelocateCount THEN
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates :=
              PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_FINISHED;
          ELSE
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates :=
              PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_INIT_START;
          END_IF;
```

## Önemli düzeltme

Senin mevcut kodunda geçersiz `CommitOldIndex` durumunda:

```iecst
RelocateError := TRUE;
```

atanıyor fakat hemen arkasından koşulsuz olarak:

```iecst
PRelocate_SH_SubStates :=
  PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_COMMIT_UPDATE_RETAIN;
```

atanıyordu. Bu, hata oluşsa bile normal akışa devam edilmesine neden olabilir.

Yukarıdaki sürümde geçersiz index durumunda:

```iecst
PRelocate_SH_SubStates :=
  PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ERROR;
```

yapılıyor ve yalnızca hata yoksa `PRSH_COMMIT_UPDATE_RETAIN` state’ine geçiliyor.

Sonuçta doğru akış şöyledir:

```text
PRSH_COMMIT_UPDATE_PFIELDS
        ↓
PRSH_COMMIT_UPDATE_RETAIN
        ↓
PRSH_COMMIT_NEXT_INDEX
        ↓
PRSH_INIT_START veya PRSH_FINISHED
```

Hata durumunda ise:

```text
PRSH_COMMIT_UPDATE_PFIELDS
        ↓
PRSH_ERROR
```

`Retain_KeepPunchListNew` bu işlemde güncellenmemeli; çünkü o liste yeni programdaki hedef pozisyonları temsil ediyor.

FUNCTION_BLOCK Punch_Relocate
VAR_INPUT
  RelocateStartCmd   : BOOL;   (* State_Machine'den gelen başlat komutu *)

(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Derived control *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
AutoRunEnable := Automatic_Page AND General_Start AND (NOT General_Stop);
risingStart := RelocateStartCmd AND NOT lastStartCmd;
ZOffset := REAL_TO_LREAL(Retain_ZParameters[19]);

(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* HARD ABORT *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
IF Abort_Cycle THEN
  RelocateStartAck := FALSE;
  RelocateBusy := FALSE;
  RelocateDone := FALSE;
  RelocateError := FALSE;

  Local_Shuttle_State := Shuttle_States.SH_IDLE;
  PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_IDLE;

  initiated := FALSE;
  Current_PunchIndex := 0;
  RelocateCount := 0;

  SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_DX_Done := FALSE;
  SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
  SH_Z_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_Z_Done := FALSE;

  PinsReady := FALSE;
  ClampReleased := FALSE;
  ClampEngaged := FALSE;

  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    RelocateActive[i] := FALSE;
    RelocateDoneArr[i] := FALSE;
    RelocateOldIndex[i] := 0;

    RelocateWidth[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateOldZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateCurrentZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateTargetZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateSafeZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateTargetCenter[i] := 0.0;
    RelocatePlacedStart[i] := 0.0;
    RelocatePlacedEnd[i] := 0.0;
  END_FOR;
END_IF;


(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* SOFT RESET *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
IF Reset THEN
  RelocateStartAck := FALSE;
  SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_DX_Done := FALSE;
  SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
  SH_Z_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_Z_Done := FALSE;
END_IF;


(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* START *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
IF risingStart AND (NOT initiated) THEN
  RelocateStartAck := TRUE;
  RelocateBusy := TRUE;
  RelocateDone := FALSE;
  RelocateError := FALSE;

  initiated := TRUE;
  Current_PunchIndex := 1;
  RelocateCount := 0;

  SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_DX_Done := FALSE;
  SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
  SH_Z_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_Z_Done := FALSE;

  PinsReady := FALSE;
  ClampReleased := FALSE;
  ClampEngaged := FALSE;

  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    RelocateActive[i] := FALSE;
    RelocateDoneArr[i] := FALSE;
    RelocateOldIndex[i] := 0;

    RelocateWidth[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateOldZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateCurrentZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateTargetZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateSafeZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateTargetCenter[i] := 0.0;
    RelocatePlacedStart[i] := 0.0;
    RelocatePlacedEnd[i] := 0.0;
  END_FOR;

  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
      RelocateCount := RelocateCount + 1;
      RelocateActive[i] := TRUE;

      IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,12] <> '' THEN
        RelocateOldIndex[i] := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,12]);
      ELSE
        RelocateOldIndex[i] := 0;
      END_IF;

      IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,7] <> '' THEN
        RelocateWidth[i] := STRING_TO_LREAL(Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,7]);
      ELSE
        RelocateWidth[i] := 0.0;
      END_IF;

      IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,6] <> '' THEN
        RelocateCurrentZ[i] := STRING_TO_LREAL(Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,6]) + ZOffset;
      ELSE
        RelocateCurrentZ[i] := ZOffset;
      END_IF;

      RelocateOldZ[i] := RelocateCurrentZ[i];
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  IF RelocateCount = 0 THEN
    RelocateBusy := FALSE;
    RelocateDone := TRUE;
    RelocateStartAck := FALSE;
    initiated := FALSE;
    Local_Shuttle_State := Shuttle_States.SH_IDLE;
    PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_IDLE;
  ELSE
    Local_Shuttle_State := Shuttle_States.PRG_Proccesing;
    PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_INIT_START;
  END_IF;
END_IF;


(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* PAUSE behaviour *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
IF initiated AND (NOT AutoRunEnable) THEN
  lastStartCmd := RelocateStartCmd;
  RETURN;
END_IF;


(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* MAIN STATE MACHINE *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
IF initiated THEN

  CASE Local_Shuttle_State OF

    Shuttle_States.PRG_Proccesing:

      CASE PRelocate_SH_SubStates OF

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_IDLE:
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_INIT_START;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_INIT_START:
          IF (Current_PunchIndex >= 1) AND (Current_PunchIndex <= RelocateCount) THEN
            IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,3] <> '' THEN
              PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_CHECK_LIST_EMPTY;
            ELSE
              PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_COMMIT_NEXT_INDEX;
            END_IF;
          ELSE
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_FINISHED;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_CHECK_LIST_EMPTY:
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PREP_CURRENT_INDEX;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PREP_CURRENT_INDEX:
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_LOAD_SOURCE;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_LOAD_SOURCE:
          IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,3] <> '' THEN
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_DRAWER_NO;
          ELSE
            RelocateError := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ERROR;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_DRAWER_NO:
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_PICK_Z;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_PICK_Z:
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_SAFE_POS;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_SAFE_POS:
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_NEXT_SAFE_POS;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_NEXT_SAFE_POS:
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_CHECK_INSIDE;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_CHECK_INSIDE:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Inside THEN
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_CHECK_INSIDE;
          ELSE
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_MOVE_INSIDE_CMD;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_MOVE_INSIDE_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Inside_Valve := TRUE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Outside_Valve := FALSE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_WAIT_INSIDE;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_WAIT_INSIDE:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Inside THEN
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Inside_Valve := FALSE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_CHECK_INSIDE;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_CHECK_INSIDE:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Inside THEN
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_SAFE_REQ;
          ELSE
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_MOVE_INSIDE_CMD;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_MOVE_INSIDE_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Inside_Valve := TRUE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Outside_Valve := FALSE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_WAIT_INSIDE;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_WAIT_INSIDE:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Inside THEN
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Inside_Valve := FALSE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_SAFE_REQ;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_SAFE_REQ:
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(Retain_DXParameters[4]);
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
          SH_DX_MoveRequested := TRUE;
          SH_DX_Done := FALSE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_SAFE_WAIT;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_SAFE_WAIT:
          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos) <= KeepPosEps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DX_Done := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_PICK_REQ;
          END_IF;

            tmpDrawerNo := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,10]);
          END_IF;

          IF tmpDrawerNo <> 0 THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(pDrawerParam6[tmpDrawerNo]);
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;

            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ERROR;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_PICK_ALIGN_WAIT:
          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos) <= KeepPosEps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DX_Done := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_OUT_CMD;
          END_IF;

          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Inside_Valve := FALSE;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_OUT_WAIT:

            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_OUT_CMD;
