            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_COMMIT_UPDATE_PFIELDS;
          END_IF;

		PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_COMMIT_UPDATE_PFIELDS:
		  CommitOldIndex := 0;
		
		  IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,12] <> '' THEN
			CommitOldIndex :=
			  STRING_TO_INT(
				Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,12]
			  );
		  END_IF;
		
		
		  (* ---------------------------------------------------------- *)
		  (* Validate original PFields_Old index                       *)
		  (* ---------------------------------------------------------- *)
		  IF (CommitOldIndex >= 1) AND (CommitOldIndex <= 15) THEN
		
			(* -------------------------------------------------------- *)
			(* Update live/current punch data in PFields_Old            *)
			(* -------------------------------------------------------- *)
			PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,5] :=
			  Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,5];
		
			PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,6] :=
			  LREAL_TO_STRING(
				RelocateTargetZ[Current_PunchIndex] - ZOffset
			  );
		
			PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,10] :=
			  Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,10];
		
			PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,11] :=
			  Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,11];
		
			PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,12] :=
			  Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,12];
		
		
			(* -------------------------------------------------------- *)
			(* Synchronize current data in Retain_KeepPunchList         *)
			(* -------------------------------------------------------- *)
			FOR m := 1 TO 15 DO
		
			  IF Retain_KeepPunchList[m,12] =
				 Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,12] THEN
		
				Retain_KeepPunchList[m,5] :=
				  Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,5];
		
				Retain_KeepPunchList[m,6] :=
				  LREAL_TO_STRING(
					RelocateTargetZ[Current_PunchIndex] - ZOffset
				  );
		
				Retain_KeepPunchList[m,10] :=
				  Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,10];
		
				Retain_KeepPunchList[m,11] :=
				  Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,11];
		
				Retain_KeepPunchList[m,12] :=
				  Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,12];
		
				EXIT;
			  END_IF;
		
			END_FOR;
		
		  ELSE
			(* Geçersiz orijinal index *)
			RelocateError := TRUE;
		  END_IF;
		
		
		  PRelocate_SH_SubStates :=	PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_COMMIT_UPDATE_RETAIN;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_COMMIT_UPDATE_RETAIN:
          IF (Current_PunchIndex >= 1) AND (Current_PunchIndex <= 15) THEN
            RelocateDoneArr[Current_PunchIndex] := TRUE;
            RelocateActive[Current_PunchIndex] := FALSE;
          END_IF;

          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_COMMIT_NEXT_INDEX;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_COMMIT_NEXT_INDEX:
          Current_PunchIndex := Current_PunchIndex + 1;
          IF Current_PunchIndex > RelocateCount THEN
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_FINISHED;
          ELSE
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_INIT_START;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_FINISHED:
          RelocateBusy := FALSE;
          RelocateDone := TRUE;
          RelocateStartAck := FALSE;
          initiated := FALSE;
          Local_Shuttle_State := Shuttle_States.SH_IDLE;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ERROR:
          RelocateBusy := FALSE;
          RelocateDone := FALSE;
          RelocateStartAck := FALSE;
          RelocateError := TRUE;
          initiated := FALSE;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ABORT:
          RelocateBusy := FALSE;
          RelocateDone := FALSE;
          RelocateStartAck := FALSE;
          initiated := FALSE;

        ELSE
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ERROR;
      END_CASE;

    ELSE
      ;
  END_CASE;
END_IF;


(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Edge memory update *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
lastStartCmd := RelocateStartCmd;
```
işte kodun tamamı. eğer bir yerde hata varsa bana tek parça txt olarak ver . 


## Copilot

Kodun tamamını inceledim. İki düzeltme gerekiyor:

1. **HARD ABORT** bloğunun sonunda `RETURN` eksik — abort sonrası aynı cycle'da state machine'e girilmemesi gerekir.
2. **`PRSH_COMMIT_UPDATE_PFIELDS`** içinde, geçersiz `CommitOldIndex` durumunda `RelocateError := TRUE` set edildikten sonra koşulsuz olarak `PRSH_COMMIT_UPDATE_RETAIN`'e geçiliyordu — hata durumunda `PRSH_ERROR`'a gitmesi gerekir.

Aşağıda düzeltilmiş tam dosya:

```text name=Punch_Relocate.txt
FUNCTION_BLOCK Punch_Relocate
VAR_INPUT
  RelocateStartCmd   : BOOL;   (* State_Machine'den gelen başlat komutu *)
  Reset              : BOOL;   (* SOFT reset: state/substate resetlemez, sadece requestleri keser *)
  Abort_Cycle        : BOOL;   (* HARD abort: tüm FB içi state/substate/flagleri resetler *)
  Automatic_Page     : BOOL;   (* TRUE: otomatik sayfa aktif, FALSE: otomatik dışı -> pause zorunlu *)
END_VAR

VAR_IN_OUT
  General_Stop       : BOOL;
  General_Start      : BOOL;   (* Enable/pause: FALSE iken pause, TRUE iken devam *)
END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT
  RelocateStartAck   : BOOL;   (* State_Machine'e ACK *)
  RelocateBusy       : BOOL;   (* FB aktif çalışıyor *)
  RelocateError      : BOOL;   (* hata flag *)
  RelocateDone       : BOOL;   (* tüm relocate işlemleri bitti *)
END_VAR

VAR RETAIN
  {attribute 'ac_persist':='PersistenceChannel'} Local_Shuttle_State    : INT := 0;
  {attribute 'ac_persist':='PersistenceChannel'} PRelocate_SH_SubStates  : INT := 0;

  lastStartCmd            : BOOL := FALSE;
  initiated               : BOOL := FALSE;

  Current_PunchIndex      : INT := 0;
  RelocateCount           : INT := 0;

  (* Runtime punch state *)
  RelocateActive          : ARRAY[1..15] OF BOOL;
  RelocateDoneArr         : ARRAY[1..15] OF BOOL;

  (* Source mapping *)
  RelocateOldIndex        : ARRAY[1..15] OF INT;

  (* Attributes *)
  RelocateWidth           : ARRAY[1..15] OF LREAL;
  RelocateOldZ            : ARRAY[1..15] OF LREAL;
  RelocateCurrentZ        : ARRAY[1..15] OF LREAL;
  RelocateTargetZ         : ARRAY[1..15] OF LREAL;
  RelocateSafeZ           : ARRAY[1..15] OF LREAL;

  RelocateTargetCenter    : ARRAY[1..15] OF LREAL;
  RelocatePlacedStart     : ARRAY[1..15] OF LREAL;
  RelocatePlacedEnd       : ARRAY[1..15] OF LREAL;

  (* Motion helper flags *)
  SH_DX_MoveRequested     : BOOL := FALSE;
  SH_DX_Done              : BOOL := FALSE;
  SH_DR_MoveRequested     : BOOL := FALSE;
  SH_DR_Done              : BOOL := FALSE;
  SH_Z_MoveRequested      : BOOL := FALSE;
  SH_Z_Done               : BOOL := FALSE;

  (* Clamp / pin helper *)
  PinsReady               : BOOL := FALSE;
  ClampReleased           : BOOL := FALSE;
  ClampEngaged            : BOOL := FALSE;
END_VAR

VAR
  risingStart             : BOOL;
  AutoRunEnable           : BOOL;
  i                       : INT;

  tmpInt                  : INT;
  tmpWidth                : LREAL;
  tmpHalfWidth            : LREAL;
  tmpCurrentPos           : LREAL;
  tmpDrawerNo             : INT;
  CommitOldIndex          : INT;

  PosEps                  : LREAL := 0.01;
  KeepPosEps              : LREAL := 0.01;

  ClampOff_Timer          : TON;
  ClampOn_Timer           : TON;

  ZOffset                 : LREAL;
  TargetCenter            : LREAL;
  m                       : INT;
END_VAR

(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Derived control *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
AutoRunEnable := Automatic_Page AND General_Start AND (NOT General_Stop);
risingStart := RelocateStartCmd AND NOT lastStartCmd;
ZOffset := REAL_TO_LREAL(Retain_ZParameters[19]);

(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* HARD ABORT *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
IF Abort_Cycle THEN
  RelocateStartAck := FALSE;
  RelocateBusy := FALSE;
  RelocateDone := FALSE;
  RelocateError := FALSE;

  Local_Shuttle_State := Shuttle_States.SH_IDLE;
  PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_IDLE;

  initiated := FALSE;
  Current_PunchIndex := 0;
  RelocateCount := 0;

  SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_DX_Done := FALSE;
  SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
  SH_Z_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_Z_Done := FALSE;

  PinsReady := FALSE;
  ClampReleased := FALSE;
  ClampEngaged := FALSE;

  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    RelocateActive[i] := FALSE;
    RelocateDoneArr[i] := FALSE;
    RelocateOldIndex[i] := 0;

    RelocateWidth[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateOldZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateCurrentZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateTargetZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateSafeZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateTargetCenter[i] := 0.0;
    RelocatePlacedStart[i] := 0.0;
    RelocatePlacedEnd[i] := 0.0;
  END_FOR;

  RETURN;
END_IF;


(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* SOFT RESET *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
IF Reset THEN
  RelocateStartAck := FALSE;
  SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_DX_Done := FALSE;
  SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
  SH_Z_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_Z_Done := FALSE;
END_IF;


(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* START *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
IF risingStart AND (NOT initiated) THEN
  RelocateStartAck := TRUE;
  RelocateBusy := TRUE;
  RelocateDone := FALSE;
  RelocateError := FALSE;

  initiated := TRUE;
  Current_PunchIndex := 1;
  RelocateCount := 0;

  SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_DX_Done := FALSE;
  SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
  SH_Z_MoveRequested := FALSE;
  SH_Z_Done := FALSE;

  PinsReady := FALSE;
  ClampReleased := FALSE;
  ClampEngaged := FALSE;

  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    RelocateActive[i] := FALSE;
    RelocateDoneArr[i] := FALSE;
    RelocateOldIndex[i] := 0;

    RelocateWidth[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateOldZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateCurrentZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateTargetZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateSafeZ[i] := 0.0;
    RelocateTargetCenter[i] := 0.0;
    RelocatePlacedStart[i] := 0.0;
    RelocatePlacedEnd[i] := 0.0;
  END_FOR;

  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,3] <> '' THEN
      RelocateCount := RelocateCount + 1;
      RelocateActive[i] := TRUE;

      IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,12] <> '' THEN
        RelocateOldIndex[i] := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,12]);
      ELSE
        RelocateOldIndex[i] := 0;
      END_IF;

      IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,7] <> '' THEN
        RelocateWidth[i] := STRING_TO_LREAL(Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,7]);
      ELSE
        RelocateWidth[i] := 0.0;
      END_IF;

      IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,6] <> '' THEN
        RelocateCurrentZ[i] := STRING_TO_LREAL(Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,6]) + ZOffset;
      ELSE
        RelocateCurrentZ[i] := ZOffset;
      END_IF;

      RelocateOldZ[i] := RelocateCurrentZ[i];
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  IF RelocateCount = 0 THEN
    RelocateBusy := FALSE;
    RelocateDone := TRUE;
    RelocateStartAck := FALSE;
    initiated := FALSE;
    Local_Shuttle_State := Shuttle_States.SH_IDLE;
    PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_IDLE;
  ELSE
    Local_Shuttle_State := Shuttle_States.PRG_Proccesing;
    PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_INIT_START;
  END_IF;
END_IF;


(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* PAUSE behaviour *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
IF initiated AND (NOT AutoRunEnable) THEN
  lastStartCmd := RelocateStartCmd;
  RETURN;
END_IF;


(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* MAIN STATE MACHINE *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
IF initiated THEN

  CASE Local_Shuttle_State OF

    Shuttle_States.PRG_Proccesing:

      CASE PRelocate_SH_SubStates OF

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_IDLE:
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_INIT_START;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_INIT_START:
          IF (Current_PunchIndex >= 1) AND (Current_PunchIndex <= RelocateCount) THEN
            IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,3] <> '' THEN
              PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_CHECK_LIST_EMPTY;
            ELSE
              PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_COMMIT_NEXT_INDEX;
            END_IF;
          ELSE
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_FINISHED;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_CHECK_LIST_EMPTY:
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PREP_CURRENT_INDEX;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PREP_CURRENT_INDEX:
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_LOAD_SOURCE;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_LOAD_SOURCE:
          IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,3] <> '' THEN
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_DRAWER_NO;
          ELSE
            RelocateError := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ERROR;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_DRAWER_NO:
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_PICK_Z;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_PICK_Z:
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_SAFE_POS;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_SAFE_POS:
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_NEXT_SAFE_POS;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ANALYZE_NEXT_SAFE_POS:
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_CHECK_INSIDE;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_CHECK_INSIDE:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Inside THEN
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_CHECK_INSIDE;
          ELSE
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_MOVE_INSIDE_CMD;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_MOVE_INSIDE_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Inside_Valve := TRUE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Outside_Valve := FALSE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_WAIT_INSIDE;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_WAIT_INSIDE:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Inside THEN
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Inside_Valve := FALSE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_CHECK_INSIDE;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_CHECK_INSIDE:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Inside THEN
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_SAFE_REQ;
          ELSE
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_MOVE_INSIDE_CMD;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_MOVE_INSIDE_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Inside_Valve := TRUE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Outside_Valve := FALSE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_WAIT_INSIDE;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_WAIT_INSIDE:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Inside THEN
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Inside_Valve := FALSE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_SAFE_REQ;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_SAFE_REQ:
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(Retain_DXParameters[4]);
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
          SH_DX_MoveRequested := TRUE;
          SH_DX_Done := FALSE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_SAFE_WAIT;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_SAFE_WAIT:
          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos) <= KeepPosEps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DX_Done := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_PICK_REQ;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_PICK_REQ:
          tmpDrawerNo := 0;
          IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,10] <> '' THEN
            tmpDrawerNo := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,10]);
          END_IF;

          IF tmpDrawerNo <> 0 THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(pDrawerParam6[tmpDrawerNo]);
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
            SH_DR_MoveRequested := TRUE;
            SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_PICK_WAIT;
          ELSE
            RelocateError := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ERROR;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_PICK_WAIT:
          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos) <= KeepPosEps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DR_Done := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_Z_PICK_REQ;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_Z_PICK_REQ:
          tmpCurrentPos := 0.0;
          IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,6] <> '' THEN
            tmpCurrentPos := STRING_TO_LREAL(Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,6]) + ZOffset;
          END_IF;

          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].TargetPos := tmpCurrentPos;
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
          SH_Z_MoveRequested := TRUE;
          SH_Z_Done := FALSE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_Z_PICK_WAIT;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_Z_PICK_WAIT:
          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].TargetPos) <= KeepPosEps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_Z_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_Z_Done := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_PICK_ALIGN_REQ;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_PICK_ALIGN_REQ:
          tmpDrawerNo := 0;
          IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,10] <> '' THEN
            tmpDrawerNo := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,10]);
          END_IF;

          IF tmpDrawerNo <> 0 THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(Retain_DXParameters[4]);
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
            SH_DX_MoveRequested := TRUE;
            SH_DX_Done := FALSE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_PICK_ALIGN_WAIT;
          ELSE
            RelocateError := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ERROR;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_PICK_ALIGN_WAIT:
          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos) <= KeepPosEps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DX_Done := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_OUT_CMD;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_OUT_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Inside_Valve := FALSE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Outside_Valve := TRUE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_OUT_WAIT;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_OUT_WAIT:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Outside THEN
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Outside_Valve := FALSE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_OUT_CMD;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_OUT_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Inside_Valve := FALSE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Outside_Valve := TRUE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_OUT_WAIT;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_OUT_WAIT:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Outside THEN
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Outside_Valve := FALSE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_CLAMP_OFF_CMD;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_CLAMP_OFF_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Press_Upper_ClampOn := FALSE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_CLAMP_OFF_WAIT;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_CLAMP_OFF_WAIT:
          IF NOT Fmsc_PLC_IO.Press_Upper_Clamp_Ok THEN
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_WITHDRAW_SLOW_REQ;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_WITHDRAW_SLOW_REQ:
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisAutoSetVelocity := Retain_DRParameters[2];
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos := arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - TO_LREAL(Retain_DRParameters[4]);
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
          SH_DR_MoveRequested := TRUE;
          SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_WITHDRAW_SLOW_WAIT;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_WITHDRAW_SLOW_WAIT:
          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos) <= KeepPosEps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DR_Done := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_Z_RELOCATE_SAFE_REQ;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_Z_RELOCATE_SAFE_REQ:
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].TargetPos := RelocateTargetZ[Current_PunchIndex];
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
          SH_Z_MoveRequested := TRUE;
          SH_Z_Done := FALSE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_Z_RELOCATE_SAFE_WAIT;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_Z_RELOCATE_SAFE_WAIT:
          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].TargetPos) <= KeepPosEps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_Z].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_Z_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_Z_Done := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_PLACE_ALIGN_REQ;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_PLACE_ALIGN_REQ:
          tmpDrawerNo := 0;
          IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,10] <> '' THEN
            tmpDrawerNo := STRING_TO_INT(Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,10]);
          END_IF;

          IF tmpDrawerNo <> 0 THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos := TO_LREAL(Retain_DXParameters[4]);
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
            SH_DX_MoveRequested := TRUE;
            SH_DX_Done := FALSE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_PLACE_ALIGN_WAIT;
          ELSE
            RelocateError := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ERROR;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DX_PLACE_ALIGN_WAIT:
          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].TargetPos) <= KeepPosEps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DX].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_DX_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DX_Done := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_INSERT_SLOW_REQ;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_INSERT_SLOW_REQ:
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisAutoSetVelocity := Retain_DRParameters[2];
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos := arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos + TO_LREAL(Retain_DRParameters[4]);
          arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := TRUE;
          SH_DR_MoveRequested := TRUE;
          SH_DR_Done := FALSE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_INSERT_SLOW_WAIT;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_DR_INSERT_SLOW_WAIT:
          IF ABS(arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].ActualPos - arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].TargetPos) <= KeepPosEps THEN
            arAxes[EN_Axes.ATC_DR].AxisTravelRequestAbs := FALSE;
            SH_DR_MoveRequested := FALSE;
            SH_DR_Done := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_CLAMP_ON_CMD;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_CLAMP_ON_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Press_Upper_ClampOn := TRUE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_CLAMP_ON_WAIT;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_CLAMP_ON_WAIT:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Press_Upper_Clamp_Ok THEN
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_IN_CMD;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_IN_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Inside_Valve := TRUE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Outside_Valve := FALSE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_IN_WAIT;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN2_IN_WAIT:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Inside THEN
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin2_Move_Inside_Valve := FALSE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_IN_CMD;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_IN_CMD:
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Inside_Valve := TRUE;
          Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Outside_Valve := FALSE;
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_IN_WAIT;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_PIN1_IN_WAIT:
          IF Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Inside THEN
            Fmsc_PLC_IO.Shuttle_Pin1_Move_Inside_Valve := FALSE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_COMMIT_UPDATE_PFIELDS;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_COMMIT_UPDATE_PFIELDS:
          CommitOldIndex := 0;

          IF Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,12] <> '' THEN
            CommitOldIndex :=
              STRING_TO_INT(
                Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,12]
              );
          END_IF;

          (* ---------------------------------------------------------- *)
          (* Validate original PFields_Old index                       *)
          (* ---------------------------------------------------------- *)
          IF (CommitOldIndex >= 1) AND (CommitOldIndex <= 15) THEN

            (* -------------------------------------------------------- *)
            (* Update live/current punch data in PFields_Old            *)
            (* -------------------------------------------------------- *)
            PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,5] :=
              Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,5];

            PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,6] :=
              LREAL_TO_STRING(
                RelocateTargetZ[Current_PunchIndex] - ZOffset
              );

            PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,10] :=
              Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,10];

            PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,11] :=
              Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,11];

            PFields_Old[CommitOldIndex,12] :=
              Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,12];

            (* -------------------------------------------------------- *)
            (* Synchronize current data in Retain_KeepPunchList         *)
            (* -------------------------------------------------------- *)
            FOR m := 1 TO 15 DO

              IF Retain_KeepPunchList[m,12] =
                 Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,12] THEN

                Retain_KeepPunchList[m,5] :=
                  Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,5];

                Retain_KeepPunchList[m,6] :=
                  LREAL_TO_STRING(
                    RelocateTargetZ[Current_PunchIndex] - ZOffset
                  );

                Retain_KeepPunchList[m,10] :=
                  Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,10];

                Retain_KeepPunchList[m,11] :=
                  Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,11];

                Retain_KeepPunchList[m,12] :=
                  Retain_RelocatePunchList[Current_PunchIndex,12];

                EXIT;
              END_IF;

            END_FOR;

            PRelocate_SH_SubStates :=
              PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_COMMIT_UPDATE_RETAIN;

          ELSE
            (* Geçersiz orijinal index -> hata state'ine geç *)
            RelocateError := TRUE;
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates :=
              PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ERROR;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_COMMIT_UPDATE_RETAIN:
          IF (Current_PunchIndex >= 1) AND (Current_PunchIndex <= 15) THEN
            RelocateDoneArr[Current_PunchIndex] := TRUE;
            RelocateActive[Current_PunchIndex] := FALSE;
          END_IF;

          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_COMMIT_NEXT_INDEX;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_COMMIT_NEXT_INDEX:
          Current_PunchIndex := Current_PunchIndex + 1;
          IF Current_PunchIndex > RelocateCount THEN
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_FINISHED;
          ELSE
            PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_INIT_START;
          END_IF;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_FINISHED:
          RelocateBusy := FALSE;
          RelocateDone := TRUE;
          RelocateStartAck := FALSE;
          initiated := FALSE;
          Local_Shuttle_State := Shuttle_States.SH_IDLE;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ERROR:
          RelocateBusy := FALSE;
          RelocateDone := FALSE;
          RelocateStartAck := FALSE;
          RelocateError := TRUE;
          initiated := FALSE;

        PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ABORT:
          RelocateBusy := FALSE;
          RelocateDone := FALSE;
          RelocateStartAck := FALSE;
          initiated := FALSE;

        ELSE
          PRelocate_SH_SubStates := PunchRelocate_SH_SubState.PRSH_ERROR;
      END_CASE;

    ELSE
      ;
  END_CASE;
END_IF;


(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Edge memory update *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
lastStartCmd := RelocateStartCmd;
```

## Yapılan iki düzeltme özeti

1. **HARD ABORT** bloğunun sonuna `RETURN;` eklendi — böylece abort sonrası aynı cycle'da state machine tekrar çalışıp state'i değiştirmiyor.
2. **`PRSH_COMMIT_UPDATE_PFIELDS`** artık geçiş mantığını `IF/ELSE` bloklarının içine taşıdı:
   - `CommitOldIndex` geçerliyse → tüm commit + senkron işlemleri yapılır → `PRSH_COMMIT_UPDATE_RETAIN`'e geçilir
   - `CommitOldIndex` geçersizse → `RelocateError := TRUE` + doğrudan `PRSH_ERROR`'a geçilir

Kodun geri kalanı (state akışı, eksen hareketleri, pin/clamp sıralaması) değişmeden korunmuştur.

Evet. `RelocateThreshold` değeri **`PunchChanger` içinde** hesaplanıyor.

Akış şu şekilde:

1. `UnloadOnlyList` içindeki drag-unload punchların en sağ Z pozisyonu bulunur:
```iecst
RightmostDragUnloadPos
```

2. `LoadOnlyList` içindeki drag-load punchların en sağ Z pozisyonu bulunur:
```iecst
RightmostDragLoadPos
```

3. Sonra eşik hesaplanır:
```iecst
RelocateThreshold := MAX(
  RightmostDragUnloadPos,
  RightmostDragLoadPos
);
```

4. Keep punchlar için mevcut Z pozisyonu bu eşikle karşılaştırılır:
```iecst
IF tmpPos < RelocateThreshold THEN
  hasRelocateOverlap := TRUE;
END_IF;
```

5. Eşiğin solunda kalan keep punchlar `Retain_RelocatePunchList` içine aktarılır.

Ek olarak global/HMI izleme için de aşağıdaki atama var:

```iecst
RelocateTrashold_Value := RelocateThreshold;
```

Yani `Punch_Relocate`, eşiği yeniden hesaplamıyor; `PunchChanger` tarafından hazırlanmış `Retain_RelocatePunchList` listesini işler.

## Copilot

Doğru tespit. `RelocateThreshold`, yalnızca **drag-unload** ve **drag-load** punch'ların en sağ pozisyonlarına bakıyor — ama `RelocateThreshold`'un sağında duran ve **relocate edilmeyecek** bir keep punch olabilir. Bu durumda `Punch_Relocate`, relocate edilen punch'ı o sabit duran keep punch'ın üzerine götürebilir.

## Çözüm
`RelocateTrashold_Value := RelocateThreshold;` atamasından önce, `Retain_KeepPunchList` içinde `RelocateThreshold`'dan **büyük** pozisyona sahip punch'lar taranmalı. Eğer varsa, bunların **en küçüğü** (yani `RelocateThreshold`'a en yakın olanı) yeni eşik olarak kullanılmalı — böylece relocate edilen punch bu sabit punch'a çarpmadan en sağa kadar yerleşebilir.

## Gerekli yeni değişkenler

`PunchChanger` `VAR` bölümüne eklenmeli:

```iecst
MinKeepAboveThreshold  : LREAL;
FoundKeepAboveThreshold: BOOL;
```

## Değiştirilecek kısım

Mevcut son satırı:

```iecst
RelocateTrashold_Value:=RelocateThreshold;
```

şununla değiştir:

```text name=PunchChanger.txt
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Relocate threshold refinement:                                *)
(* RelocateThreshold sadece drag-unload/drag-load punch'lara     *)
(* göre hesaplandı. Ancak RelocateThreshold'un sağında,          *)
(* relocate edilmeyen (hâlâ keep olarak duran) bir punch olabilir.*)
(* Böyle bir punch varsa relocate edilen punch onun üzerine       *)
(* gönderilmemeli; bu yüzden eşik, o punch'ın pozisyonuna göre    *)
(* daraltılmalı.                                                  *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
MinKeepAboveThreshold := 0.0;
FoundKeepAboveThreshold := FALSE;

FOR a := 1 TO KeepCount DO
  IF Retain_KeepPunchList[a,6] <> '' THEN
    tmpPos := STRING_TO_LREAL(Retain_KeepPunchList[a,6]);

    IF tmpPos > RelocateThreshold THEN
      IF (NOT FoundKeepAboveThreshold) OR (tmpPos < MinKeepAboveThreshold) THEN
        MinKeepAboveThreshold := tmpPos;
        FoundKeepAboveThreshold := TRUE;
      END_IF;
    END_IF;
  END_IF;
END_FOR;

IF FoundKeepAboveThreshold THEN
  RelocateTrashold_Value := MinKeepAboveThreshold;
ELSE
  RelocateTrashold_Value := RelocateThreshold;
END_IF;
```

## Mantığın özeti

- `Retain_KeepPunchList` içindeki her punch'ın 6. sütunundaki (Z pozisyonu) değeri kontrol edilir.
- `RelocateThreshold`'dan büyük pozisyona sahip punch'lar arasından **en küçüğü** bulunur (yani `RelocateThreshold`'a en yakın, sabit duran punch).
- Böyle bir punch varsa → `RelocateTrashold_Value` bu punch'ın pozisyonuna eşitlenir (relocate edilen punch bu noktaya kadar gidebilir, ötesine geçemez).
- Böyle bir punch yoksa → mevcut davranış korunur, `RelocateTrashold_Value := RelocateThreshold`.

Bu sayede `Punch_Relocate`, relocate edilen punch'ları asla sabit duran bir keep punch'ın üzerine göndermeyecek.

## Güncellenmiş mantık

```text name=PunchChanger.txt
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Relocate threshold refinement:                                *)
(* RelocateThreshold sadece drag-unload/drag-load punch'lara     *)
(* göre hesaplandı. Ancak RelocateThreshold'un sağında,          *)
(* relocate edilmeyen (hâlâ keep olarak duran) punch'lar olabilir.*)
(* Böyle punch'lar varsa relocate edilen punch bunların üzerine   *)
(* gönderilmemeli; bu yüzden eşik, bu punch'lar arasındaki en     *)
(* büyük (en sağdaki) pozisyona göre güncellenmeli.               *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
MaxKeepAboveThreshold := 0.0;
FoundKeepAboveThreshold := FALSE;

FOR a := 1 TO KeepCount DO
  IF Retain_KeepPunchList[a,6] <> '' THEN
    tmpPos := STRING_TO_LREAL(Retain_KeepPunchList[a,6]);

    IF tmpPos > RelocateThreshold THEN
      IF (NOT FoundKeepAboveThreshold) OR (tmpPos > MaxKeepAboveThreshold) THEN
        MaxKeepAboveThreshold := tmpPos;
        FoundKeepAboveThreshold := TRUE;
      END_IF;
    END_IF;
  END_IF;
END_FOR;

IF FoundKeepAboveThreshold THEN
  RelocateTrashold_Value := MaxKeepAboveThreshold;
ELSE
  RelocateTrashold_Value := RelocateThreshold;
END_IF;
```

## Değişken tanımı güncellemesi

`PunchChanger` `VAR` bölümünde şu değişkeni değiştir:

```iecst
MinKeepAboveThreshold  : LREAL;
```

yerine:

```iecst
MaxKeepAboveThreshold  : LREAL;
FoundKeepAboveThreshold: BOOL;
```

## Özet
- `Retain_KeepPunchList` taranır
- `RelocateThreshold`'dan büyük pozisyona sahip punch'lar arasından **en büyüğü** bulunur
- Bulunursa → `RelocateTrashold_Value` bu en büyük pozisyona eşitlenir
- Bulunamazsa → `RelocateTrashold_Value := RelocateThreshold` (mevcut davranış)

        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,4] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchLength[e,d]);
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,5] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchPosition[e,d]);
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,6] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchHorn[e,d]);
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[c,12] := INT_TO_STRING(tmpInt);
      END_IF;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  PackageState := PPackageState.PARTIAL_CHANGE;
  NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.NO_ACTION;
  ValidityFlag := TRUE;

  Busy := FALSE;
  Done := TRUE;

ELSIF Trigger THEN
  Busy := TRUE;
  Done := FALSE;
  Error := FALSE;
  ErrorText := '';
  ValidityFlag := TRUE;

  numSame := 0;
  numDiff := 0;
  newCount := 0;
  oldCount := 0;

  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    KeepList[i] := FALSE;
    ReplaceList[i] := FALSE;
    LoadOnlyList[i] := FALSE;
    UnloadOnlyList[i] := FALSE;
    PerIndexStatus[i] := PIndexStatus.SAME;
    OldMatched[i] := FALSE;
    NewMatchedToOld[i] := 0;
  END_FOR;

  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
      Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,j] := '';
      Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[i,j] := '';
      Retain_LoadPunchList[i,j] := '';
      Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[i,j] := '';
      Retain_KeepPunchList[i,j] := '';
      Retain_KeepPunchListNew[i,j] := '';
      Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,j] := '';
    END_FOR;
  END_FOR;

  (* STEP 1: validate new program *)
  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    NewName := PFields[i,3];
    IF NewName <> '' THEN
      newCount := newCount + 1;
      NewLen := PFields[i,7];

      foundIndex := 0;
      FOR j := 1 TO 16 DO
        IF pDrawerName[j] = NewName THEN
          foundIndex := j;
          EXIT;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;

      IF foundIndex = 0 THEN
        ValidityFlag := FALSE;
        PackageState := PPackageState.INVALID;
        NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.INVALID_ABORT;
        Error := TRUE;
        ErrorText := CONCAT('INVALID: missing ATC tool name: ', NewName);
        Busy := FALSE;
        Done := TRUE;
        RETURN;
      END_IF;

      IF NewLen = '' THEN
        ValidityFlag := FALSE;
        PackageState := PPackageState.INVALID;
        NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.INVALID_ABORT;
        Error := TRUE;
        ErrorText := CONCAT('INVALID: missing length for tool: ', NewName);
        Busy := FALSE;
        Done := TRUE;
        RETURN;
      END_IF;

      foundLengthMatch := FALSE;
      hasLengthValue := FALSE;
      NewLenReal := 0.0;
      IF NewLen <> '' THEN
        NewLenReal := STRING_TO_REAL(NewLen);
        hasLengthValue := TRUE;
      END_IF;

      IF hasLengthValue THEN
        FOR j := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[j] = NewName THEN
            FOR k := 1 TO 15 DO
              IF ABS(PunchLength[j, k] - NewLenReal) <= eps THEN
                foundLengthMatch := TRUE;
                EXIT;
              END_IF;
            END_FOR;
            IF foundLengthMatch THEN
              EXIT;
            END_IF;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
      END_IF;

      IF NOT foundLengthMatch THEN
        ValidityFlag := FALSE;
        PackageState := PPackageState.INVALID;
        NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.INVALID_ABORT;
        Error := TRUE;
        ErrorText := CONCAT('INVALID: requested length NOT found FOR tool: ', NewName);
        Busy := FALSE;
        Done := TRUE;
        RETURN;
      END_IF;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  (* STEP 2: keep matching *)
  OldAvailCount := 0;
  FOR j := 1 TO 15 DO
    OldName := PFields_Old[j,3];
    IF OldName <> '' THEN
      OldAvailCount := OldAvailCount + 1;
      OldAvailIndex[OldAvailCount] := j;
      OldMatched[j] := FALSE;
      oldCount := oldCount + 1;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    NewName := PFields[i,3];
    IF NewName <> '' THEN
      NewLen := PFields[i,7];
      NewHorn := PFields[i,9];
      NewRot := PFields[i,8];
      NewLenReal := 0.0;
      IF NewLen <> '' THEN
        NewLenReal := STRING_TO_REAL(NewLen);
      END_IF;

      NewMatchedToOld[i] := 0;
      a := 1;
      WHILE (a <= OldAvailCount) AND (NewMatchedToOld[i] = 0) DO
        j := OldAvailIndex[a];
        OldName := PFields_Old[j,3];
        IF OldName <> '' THEN
          OldLen := PFields_Old[j,7];
          OldHorn := PFields_Old[j,9];
          OldRot := PFields_Old[j,8];
          OldLenReal := 0.0;
          IF OldLen <> '' THEN
            OldLenReal := STRING_TO_REAL(OldLen);
          END_IF;

          IF (NewName = OldName) AND (NewHorn = OldHorn) AND (NewRot = OldRot) AND (ABS(NewLenReal - OldLenReal) <= eps) THEN
            OldMatched[j] := TRUE;
            KeepList[j] := TRUE;
            NewMatchedToOld[i] := j;
            FOR b := a TO OldAvailCount - 1 DO
              OldAvailIndex[b] := OldAvailIndex[b + 1];
            END_FOR;
            OldAvailCount := OldAvailCount - 1;
          ELSE
            a := a + 1;
          END_IF;
        ELSE
          a := a + 1;
        END_IF;
      END_WHILE;

      IF NewMatchedToOld[i] = 0 THEN
        LoadOnlyList[i] := TRUE;
      END_IF;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  FOR a := 1 TO OldAvailCount DO
    j := OldAvailIndex[a];
    IF PFields_Old[j,3] <> '' THEN
      UnloadOnlyList[j] := TRUE;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  (* STEP 3: validate load-only punches *)
  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    IF LoadOnlyList[i] THEN
      NewName := PFields[i,3];
      NewLen := PFields[i,7];
      foundLengthMatch := FALSE;
      hasLengthValue := FALSE;
      NewLenReal := 0.0;
      IF NewLen <> '' THEN
        NewLenReal := STRING_TO_REAL(NewLen);
        hasLengthValue := TRUE;
      END_IF;

      IF hasLengthValue THEN
        FOR j := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[j] = NewName THEN
            FOR k := 1 TO 15 DO
              IF (NOT PunchUsed[j,k]) AND (ABS(PunchLength[j, k] - NewLenReal) <= eps) THEN
                foundLengthMatch := TRUE;
                EXIT;
              END_IF;
            END_FOR;
            IF foundLengthMatch THEN
              EXIT;
            END_IF;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
      END_IF;

      IF NOT foundLengthMatch THEN
        ValidityFlag := FALSE;
        PackageState := PPackageState.INVALID;
        NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.INVALID_ABORT;
        Error := TRUE;
        ErrorText := CONCAT('INVALID: requested load punch length NOT available in free ATC punches FOR tool: ', NewName);
        Busy := FALSE;
        Done := TRUE;
        RETURN;
      END_IF;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  (* STEP 4: multiplicity check for load-only *)
  uniqCount := 0;
  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    IF LoadOnlyList[i] THEN
      foundIndex := 0;
      FOR a := 1 TO uniqCount DO
        IF (uniqName[a] = PFields[i,3]) AND (uniqLen[a] = PFields[i,7]) AND (uniqHorn[a] = PFields[i,9]) THEN
          foundIndex := a;
          EXIT;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;
      IF foundIndex = 0 THEN
        uniqCount := uniqCount + 1;
        uniqName[uniqCount] := PFields[i,3];
        uniqLen[uniqCount] := PFields[i,7];
        uniqHorn[uniqCount] := PFields[i,9];
        uniqNeeded[uniqCount] := 1;
      ELSE
        uniqNeeded[foundIndex] := uniqNeeded[foundIndex] + 1;
      END_IF;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  FOR a := 1 TO uniqCount DO
    NewName := uniqName[a];
    NewLen := uniqLen[a];
    NewHorn := uniqHorn[a];

    availCount := 0;
    IF (NewLen <> '') AND (NewHorn <> '') THEN
      NewLenReal := STRING_TO_REAL(NewLen);
      NewHornReal := STRING_TO_REAL(NewHorn);
      FOR e := 1 TO 16 DO
        IF pDrawerName[e] = NewName THEN
          FOR d := 1 TO 15 DO
            IF (NOT PunchUsed[e,d]) AND
               (ABS(PunchLength[e,d] - NewLenReal) <= eps) AND
               (ABS(PunchHorn[e,d] - NewHornReal) <= eps) THEN
              availCount := availCount + 1;
            END_IF;
          END_FOR;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;
    END_IF;

    IF availCount < uniqNeeded[a] THEN
      ValidityFlag := FALSE;
      PackageState := PPackageState.INVALID;
      NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.INVALID_ABORT;
      Error := TRUE;
      ErrorText := CONCAT('INVALID: insufficient FREE ATC slots for load tool ', NewName);
      Busy := FALSE;
      Done := TRUE;
      RETURN;
    END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  (* SUMMARY *)
  numSame := 0;
  numDiff := 0;
  FOR j := 1 TO 15 DO
    IF KeepList[j] THEN numSame := numSame + 1; END_IF;
    IF UnloadOnlyList[j] THEN numDiff := numDiff + 1; END_IF;
  END_FOR;
  FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
    IF LoadOnlyList[i] THEN numDiff := numDiff + 1; END_IF;
  END_FOR;

  IF NOT ValidityFlag THEN
    PackageState := PPackageState.INVALID;
    NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.INVALID_ABORT;
  ELSE
    PackageState := PPackageState.PARTIAL_CHANGE;
    NextActionHint := PNextActionHint.NO_ACTION;
  END_IF;

  ValidityFlag := NOT Error;

  IF PackageState <> PPackageState.INVALID THEN
    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_UnloadPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_ATCUnloadPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_LoadPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_KeepPunchList[i,j] := '';
        Retain_KeepPunchListNew[i,j] := '';
        Retain_RelocatePunchList[i,j] := '';
      END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* pack unload *)
    UnloadTempCount := 0;
    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      IF UnloadOnlyList[i] THEN
        foundIndex := 0;
        FOR k := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[k] = PFields_Old[i,3] THEN
            foundIndex := k;
            EXIT;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
        IF foundIndex <> 0 THEN
          UnloadTempCount := UnloadTempCount + 1;
          UnloadTempOrigIndex[UnloadTempCount] := i;
          UnloadTempDrawerIdx[UnloadTempCount] := foundIndex;
          UnloadTempOrder[UnloadTempCount] := UnloadTempCount;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    FOR a := 1 TO UnloadTempCount - 1 DO
      minIdx := a;
      FOR b := a + 1 TO UnloadTempCount DO
        IF UnloadTempDrawerIdx[b] < UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] THEN
          minIdx := b;
        ELSIF (UnloadTempDrawerIdx[b] = UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx]) AND (UnloadTempOrder[b] < UnloadTempOrder[minIdx]) THEN
          minIdx := b;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;
      IF minIdx <> a THEN
        tmpInt := UnloadTempOrigIndex[a];
        UnloadTempOrigIndex[a] := UnloadTempOrigIndex[minIdx];
        UnloadTempOrigIndex[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := UnloadTempDrawerIdx[a];
        UnloadTempDrawerIdx[a] := UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx];
        UnloadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := UnloadTempOrder[a];
        UnloadTempOrder[a] := UnloadTempOrder[minIdx];
        UnloadTempOrder[minIdx] := tmpInt;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    UnloadCount := 0;
    FOR a := 1 TO UnloadTempCount DO
      UnloadCount := UnloadCount + 1;
      i := UnloadTempOrigIndex[a];
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_UnloadPunchList[UnloadCount, j] := PFields_Old[i, j];
      END_FOR;
      Retain_UnloadPunchList[UnloadCount, 12] := INT_TO_STRING(i);
    END_FOR;

    (* pack load *)
    LoadTempCount := 0;
    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      IF LoadOnlyList[i] THEN
        foundIndex := 0;
        FOR k := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[k] = PFields[i,3] THEN
            foundIndex := k;
            EXIT;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
        IF foundIndex <> 0 THEN
          LoadTempCount := LoadTempCount + 1;
          LoadTempOrigIndex[LoadTempCount] := i;
          LoadTempDrawerIdx[LoadTempCount] := foundIndex;
          LoadTempOrder[LoadTempCount] := LoadTempCount;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    FOR a := 1 TO LoadTempCount - 1 DO
      minIdx := a;
      FOR b := a + 1 TO LoadTempCount DO
        IF LoadTempDrawerIdx[b] < LoadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] THEN
          minIdx := b;
        ELSIF (LoadTempDrawerIdx[b] = LoadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx]) AND (LoadTempOrder[b] < LoadTempOrder[minIdx]) THEN
          minIdx := b;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;
      IF minIdx <> a THEN
        tmpInt := LoadTempOrigIndex[a];
        LoadTempOrigIndex[a] := LoadTempOrigIndex[minIdx];
        LoadTempOrigIndex[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := LoadTempDrawerIdx[a];
        LoadTempDrawerIdx[a] := LoadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx];
        LoadTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := LoadTempOrder[a];
        LoadTempOrder[a] := LoadTempOrder[minIdx];
        LoadTempOrder[minIdx] := tmpInt;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    LoadCount := 0;
    FOR a := 1 TO LoadTempCount DO
      LoadCount := LoadCount + 1;
      i := LoadTempOrigIndex[a];
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_LoadPunchList[LoadCount, j] := PFields[i, j];
      END_FOR;
      Retain_LoadPunchList[LoadCount, 12] := INT_TO_STRING(i);
    END_FOR;

    (* ATC load mapping *)
    FOR c := 1 TO 15 DO
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c, j] := '';
      END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    FOR e := 1 TO 16 DO
      FOR d := 1 TO 15 DO
        usedSlot[e,d] := FALSE;
      END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      NewAssignedDrawer[i] := 0;
      NewAssignedSlot[i] := 0;
    END_FOR;

    FOR c := 1 TO LoadCount DO
      origNewIdx := LoadTempOrigIndex[c];
      NewName := Retain_LoadPunchList[c,3];
      lenStr := Retain_LoadPunchList[c,7];
      hornStr := Retain_LoadPunchList[c,9];
      foundIndex := 0;

      IF (NewName <> '') AND (lenStr <> '') AND (hornStr <> '') THEN
        lenRealLocal := STRING_TO_REAL(lenStr);
        hornRealLocal := STRING_TO_REAL(hornStr);
        FOR e := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[e] = NewName THEN
            FOR d := 1 TO 15 DO
              IF (NOT usedSlot[e,d]) AND (NOT PunchUsed[e,d]) THEN
                IF (ABS(PunchLength[e,d] - lenRealLocal) <= eps) AND
                   (ABS(PunchHorn[e,d] - hornRealLocal) <= eps) THEN

                  usedSlot[e,d] := TRUE;
                  foundIndex := e;
                  Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,1] := pDrawerName[e];
                  Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,2] := PFields[i,2];
                  Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,3] := INT_TO_STRING(d);
                  Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,4] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchLength[e,d]);
                  Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,5] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchPosition[e,d]);
                  Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,6] := REAL_TO_STRING(PunchHorn[e,d]);
                  Retain_ATCLoadPunchList[c,12] := INT_TO_STRING(origNewIdx);
                  NewAssignedDrawer[origNewIdx] := e;
                  NewAssignedSlot[origNewIdx] := d;
                  EXIT;
                END_IF;
              END_IF;
            END_FOR;
            IF foundIndex <> 0 THEN EXIT; END_IF;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    (* pack keep *)
    KeepTempCount := 0;
    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      IF KeepList[i] THEN
        foundIndex := 0;
        FOR k := 1 TO 16 DO
          IF pDrawerName[k] = PFields_Old[i,3] THEN
            foundIndex := k;
            EXIT;
          END_IF;
        END_FOR;
        IF foundIndex <> 0 THEN
          KeepTempCount := KeepTempCount + 1;
          KeepTempOrigIndex[KeepTempCount] := i;
          KeepTempDrawerIdx[KeepTempCount] := foundIndex;
          KeepTempOrder[KeepTempCount] := KeepTempCount;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    FOR a := 1 TO KeepTempCount - 1 DO
      minIdx := a;
      FOR b := a + 1 TO KeepTempCount DO
        IF KeepTempDrawerIdx[b] < KeepTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] THEN
          minIdx := b;
        ELSIF (KeepTempDrawerIdx[b] = KeepTempDrawerIdx[minIdx]) AND (KeepTempOrder[b] < KeepTempOrder[minIdx]) THEN
          minIdx := b;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;
      IF minIdx <> a THEN
        tmpInt := KeepTempOrigIndex[a];
        KeepTempOrigIndex[a] := KeepTempOrigIndex[minIdx];
        KeepTempOrigIndex[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := KeepTempDrawerIdx[a];
        KeepTempDrawerIdx[a] := KeepTempDrawerIdx[minIdx];
        KeepTempDrawerIdx[minIdx] := tmpInt;

        tmpInt := KeepTempOrder[a];
        KeepTempOrder[a] := KeepTempOrder[minIdx];
        KeepTempOrder[minIdx] := tmpInt;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    KeepCount := 0;
    FOR a := 1 TO KeepTempCount DO
      KeepCount := KeepCount + 1;
      i := KeepTempOrigIndex[a];
      FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
        Retain_KeepPunchList[KeepCount, j] := PFields_Old[i, j];
        Retain_KeepPunchListNew[KeepCount, j] := '';
      END_FOR;
      Retain_KeepPunchList[KeepCount, 12] := INT_TO_STRING(i);

      tmpInt := 0;
      FOR b := 1 TO 15 DO
        IF NewMatchedToOld[b] = i THEN
          tmpInt := b;
          EXIT;
        END_IF;
      END_FOR;

      IF tmpInt <> 0 THEN
        FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
          Retain_KeepPunchListNew[KeepCount, j] := PFields[tmpInt, j];
        END_FOR;
        Retain_KeepPunchListNew[KeepCount, 12] := INT_TO_STRING(tmpInt);
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    (* relocate selection *)
    RightmostDragUnloadPos := -1.0;
    RightmostDragLoadPos := -1.0;

    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      IF UnloadOnlyList[i] THEN
        eTmp := 0;
        IF PFields_Old[i,10] <> '' THEN
          eTmp := STRING_TO_INT(PFields_Old[i,10]);
        END_IF;
        IF (eTmp <> 4) AND (eTmp <> 8) AND (eTmp <> 12) AND (eTmp <> 16) THEN
          IF PFields_Old[i,6] > '' THEN
            tmpPos := STRING_TO_LREAL(PFields_Old[i,6]);
            IF tmpPos > RightmostDragUnloadPos THEN
              RightmostDragUnloadPos := tmpPos;
            END_IF;
          END_IF;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    FOR i := 1 TO 15 DO
      IF LoadOnlyList[i] THEN
        eTmp := 0;
        IF PFields[i,10] <> '' THEN
          eTmp := STRING_TO_INT(PFields[i,10]);
        END_IF;
        IF (eTmp <> 4) AND (eTmp <> 8) AND (eTmp <> 12) AND (eTmp <> 16) THEN
          IF PFields[i,6] > '' THEN
            tmpPos := STRING_TO_LREAL(PFields[i,6]);
            IF tmpPos > RightmostDragLoadPos THEN
              RightmostDragLoadPos := tmpPos;
            END_IF;
          END_IF;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    IF RightmostDragUnloadPos < 0.0 THEN RightmostDragUnloadPos := 0.0; END_IF;
    IF RightmostDragLoadPos < 0.0 THEN RightmostDragLoadPos := 0.0; END_IF;

    RelocateThreshold := MAX(RightmostDragUnloadPos, RightmostDragLoadPos);

    RelocateCount := 0;
    FOR a := 1 TO KeepCount DO
      i := KeepTempOrigIndex[a];
      hasRelocateOverlap := FALSE;

      IF PFields_Old[i,6] > '' THEN
        tmpPos := STRING_TO_LREAL(PFields_Old[i,6]);

        IF tmpPos < RelocateThreshold THEN
          hasRelocateOverlap := TRUE;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;

      IF hasRelocateOverlap THEN
        RelocateCount := RelocateCount + 1;
        FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
          Retain_RelocatePunchList[RelocateCount, j] := Retain_KeepPunchList[a, j];
        END_FOR;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    Busy := FALSE;
    Done := TRUE;
  ELSE
    Busy := FALSE;
    Done := TRUE;
  END_IF;

END_IF;


MaxKeepAboveThreshold := 0.0;
FoundKeepAboveThreshold := FALSE;

FOR a := 1 TO KeepCount DO
  IF Retain_KeepPunchList[a,6] <> '' THEN
    tmpPos := STRING_TO_LREAL(Retain_KeepPunchList[a,6]);

    IF tmpPos > RelocateThreshold THEN
      IF (NOT FoundKeepAboveThreshold) OR (tmpPos > MaxKeepAboveThreshold) THEN
        MaxKeepAboveThreshold := tmpPos;
        FoundKeepAboveThreshold := TRUE;
      END_IF;
    END_IF;
  END_IF;
END_FOR;

IF FoundKeepAboveThreshold THEN
  RelocateTrashold_Value := MaxKeepAboveThreshold;
ELSE
  RelocateTrashold_Value := RelocateThreshold;
END_IF;
```
Değişikliği ekledim ancak şunu soracağım. Bu eklenti sürekli olarak döngüde kalmamalı doğru yere mş koymusum ? 

## Copilot

Hayır, doğru yere koymadın. Şu anda bu blok **her PLC cycle'ında**, `Trigger` veya `Unload` olsun olmasın çalışıyor — çünkü `END_IF;` (ana `IF Unload... ELSIF Trigger...END_IF`) satırından **sonra**, hiçbir koşula bağlı olmadan duruyor.

## Sorunlar

1. **Gereksiz sürekli çalışma**: `KeepCount`, `RelocateThreshold`, `Retain_KeepPunchList` yalnızca `Trigger` anında anlamlı şekilde dolduruluyor. Bu blok her cycle'da çalışırsa gereksiz yere CPU tüketir.

2. **`Unload` dalında yanlış veri kullanımı**: `Unload` çalıştığında `KeepCount` hesaplanmıyor (o dalda `KeepList`/`KeepCount` mantığı yok), dolayısıyla bu blok `Unload` sırasında **eski/stale `KeepCount`** değeriyle çalışır — yanlış sonuç üretebilir.

3. **`PackageState = INVALID` durumunda da çalışır**: Trigger geçersiz bir paket ürettiğinde (`RETURN` ile çıkılan veya `ELSE` dalına düşen durumlar) `RelocateThreshold` ve `KeepCount` anlamlı değildir, ama blok yine de çalışıp `RelocateTrashold_Value`'yu güncellemeye çalışır.

## Doğru yer
Bu blok, **yalnızca `Trigger` dalı içinde**, `PackageState <> PPackageState.INVALID` bloğunun içinde, `RelocateCount` hesaplaması bittikten **hemen sonra**, `Busy := FALSE; Done := TRUE;` satırlarından **önce** olmalı.

## Düzeltme

Mevcut kodunda şunu:

```iecst
    RelocateCount := 0;
    FOR a := 1 TO KeepCount DO
      i := KeepTempOrigIndex[a];
      hasRelocateOverlap := FALSE;

      IF PFields_Old[i,6] > '' THEN
        tmpPos := STRING_TO_LREAL(PFields_Old[i,6]);

        IF tmpPos < RelocateThreshold THEN
          hasRelocateOverlap := TRUE;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;

      IF hasRelocateOverlap THEN
        RelocateCount := RelocateCount + 1;
        FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
          Retain_RelocatePunchList[RelocateCount, j] := Retain_KeepPunchList[a, j];
        END_FOR;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    Busy := FALSE;
    Done := TRUE;
  ELSE
    Busy := FALSE;
    Done := TRUE;
  END_IF;

END_IF;


MaxKeepAboveThreshold := 0.0;
...
IF FoundKeepAboveThreshold THEN
  RelocateTrashold_Value := MaxKeepAboveThreshold;
ELSE
  RelocateTrashold_Value := RelocateThreshold;
END_IF;
```

şu şekilde değiştir — yeni bloğu `RelocateCount` döngüsünden hemen sonra, `IF PackageState <> PPackageState.INVALID` bloğunun **içine** taşı:

```text name=PunchChanger.txt
    RelocateCount := 0;
    FOR a := 1 TO KeepCount DO
      i := KeepTempOrigIndex[a];
      hasRelocateOverlap := FALSE;

      IF PFields_Old[i,6] > '' THEN
        tmpPos := STRING_TO_LREAL(PFields_Old[i,6]);

        IF tmpPos < RelocateThreshold THEN
          hasRelocateOverlap := TRUE;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;

      IF hasRelocateOverlap THEN
        RelocateCount := RelocateCount + 1;
        FOR j := 1 TO 12 DO
          Retain_RelocatePunchList[RelocateCount, j] := Retain_KeepPunchList[a, j];
        END_FOR;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    (* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
    (* Relocate threshold refinement:                                *)
    (* RelocateThreshold sadece drag-unload/drag-load punch'lara     *)
    (* göre hesaplandı. Ancak RelocateThreshold'un sağında,          *)
    (* relocate edilmeyen (hâlâ keep olarak duran) punch'lar olabilir.*)
    (* Böyle punch'lar varsa relocate edilen punch bunların üzerine   *)
    (* gönderilmemeli; bu yüzden eşik, bu punch'lar arasındaki en     *)
    (* büyük (en sağdaki) pozisyona göre güncellenmeli.               *)
    (* ------------------------------------------------------------ *)
    MaxKeepAboveThreshold := 0.0;
    FoundKeepAboveThreshold := FALSE;

    FOR a := 1 TO KeepCount DO
      IF Retain_KeepPunchList[a,6] <> '' THEN
        tmpPos := STRING_TO_LREAL(Retain_KeepPunchList[a,6]);

        IF tmpPos > RelocateThreshold THEN
          IF (NOT FoundKeepAboveThreshold) OR (tmpPos > MaxKeepAboveThreshold) THEN
            MaxKeepAboveThreshold := tmpPos;
            FoundKeepAboveThreshold := TRUE;
          END_IF;
        END_IF;
      END_IF;
    END_FOR;

    IF FoundKeepAboveThreshold THEN
      RelocateTrashold_Value := MaxKeepAboveThreshold;
    ELSE
      RelocateTrashold_Value := RelocateThreshold;
    END_IF;

    Busy := FALSE;
    Done := TRUE;
  ELSE
    Busy := FALSE;
    Done := TRUE;
  END_IF;

END_IF;
```

## Sonuç
Bu şekilde:
- Hesaplama yalnızca `Trigger` tetiklendiğinde ve paket geçerli olduğunda çalışır
- `Unload` dalı bu hesaplamadan etkilenmez (zaten `RelocateThreshold`/`KeepCount` o dalda anlamlı değil)
- Geçersiz paket durumunda (`INVALID`) gereksiz hesaplama yapılmaz
- `RelocateTrashold_Value`, doğru `KeepCount` ve `RelocateThreshold` değerleriyle, doğru cycle'da bir kez güncellenir
